cues.zh: 一句話能夠挑起連天的戰火， 也能表達愛慕的情愫。 很多人都有相似的經歷： 說了話卻沒人在聽。

cues.text: that when they speak, people don't listen to them.
cues.en: that when they speak, people don't listen to them.
cues.zh: 說了話卻沒人在聽。

cues.text: And why is that?
cues.en: And why is that?
cues.zh: 這是為什麼呢？

cues.text: How can we speak powerfully to make change in the world?
cues.en: How can we speak powerfully to make change in the world?
cues.zh: 如何讓話語擲地有聲， 進而改變世界？

cues.text: What I'd like to suggest, there are a number of habits that we need to move away from.
cues.en: What I'd like to suggest, there are a number of habits that we need to move away from.
cues.zh: 我建議大家， 我們要改掉一些不良習慣。 我整理出講話中的「七宗罪」，

cues.text: I've assembled for your pleasure here seven deadly sins of speaking.
cues.en: I've assembled for your pleasure here seven deadly sins of speaking.
cues.zh: 我整理出講話中的「七宗罪」， 供大家參考。

cues.text: I'm not pretending this is an exhaustive list, but these seven, I think, are pretty large habits that we can all fall into.
cues.en: I'm not pretending this is an exhaustive list, but these seven, I think, are pretty large habits that we can all fall into.
cues.zh: 供大家參考。 內容並非盡善盡美， 但是這七條過失， 可能是我們所有人的弱點。

cues.text: First, gossip.
cues.en: First, gossip.
cues.zh: 可能是我們所有人的弱點。 首先，「說長道短」。

cues.text: Speaking ill of somebody who's not present.
cues.en: Speaking ill of somebody who's not present.
cues.zh: 我們在別人背後指指點點，

cues.text: Not a nice habit, and we know perfectly well the person gossiping, five minutes later, will be gossiping about us.
cues.en: Not a nice habit, and we know perfectly well the person gossiping, five minutes later, will be gossiping about us.
cues.zh: 這是個壞習慣。 如果有人在我們面前搬弄別人的是非， 那麼五分鐘後他就會在別人面前評論我們。

cues.text: Second, judging.
cues.en: Second, judging.
cues.zh: 那麼五分鐘後他就會在別人面前評論我們。 第二，「評斷」。

cues.text: We know people who are like this in conversation, and it's very hard to listen to somebody
cues.en: We know people who are like this in conversation, and it's very hard to listen to somebody
cues.zh: 很多人在交談時都很喜歡評判。 如果別人在說話時批評你， 或認為你能力不足，

cues.text: if you know that you're being judged and found wanting at the same time.
cues.en: if you know that you're being judged and found wanting at the same time.
cues.zh: 或認為你能力不足， 你就不會願意聽他講話。

cues.text: Third, negativity.
cues.en: Third, negativity.
cues.zh: 第三，「心態消極」。

cues.text: You can fall into this.
cues.en: You can fall into this.
cues.zh: 你也可能陷入這種狀態。 我母親晚年時的心態變得非常消極，

cues.text: My mother, in the last years of her life, became very negative, and it's hard to listen.
cues.en: My mother, in the last years of her life, became very negative, and it's hard to listen.
cues.zh: 我母親晚年時的心態變得非常消極， 沒有人願意聽她講話。 有一天我對她說：

cues.text: I remember one day, I said to her, "It's October 1 today," and she said, "I know, isn't it dreadful?"
cues.en: I remember one day, I said to her, "It's October 1 today," and she said, "I know, isn't it dreadful?"
cues.zh: 有一天我對她說： 「今天是10月1日了。」 她說：「是啊，很糟吧？」

cues.text: It's hard to listen when somebody's that negative.
cues.en: It's hard to listen when somebody's that negative.
cues.zh: （笑聲） 大家可不想聽那麼消極的人說話。

cues.text: And another form of negativity, complaining.
cues.en: And another form of negativity, complaining.
cues.zh: 抱怨也是一種負面情緒， 這已經成為了一種英國文化。

cues.text: Well, this is the national art of the U.K.
cues.en: Well, this is the national art of the U.K.
cues.zh: 這已經成為了一種英國文化。

cues.text: It's our national sport.
cues.en: It's our national sport.
cues.zh: 這已經成為了一種英國文化。 這是全民運動，我們抱怨天氣、

cues.text: We complain about the weather, sport, about politics, about everything, but actually, complaining is viral misery.
cues.en: We complain about the weather, sport, about politics, about everything, but actually, complaining is viral misery.
cues.zh: 這是全民運動，我們抱怨天氣、 抱怨比賽、抱怨政治，抱怨一切。 但抱怨是病毒般的災難。 因為你沒有把溫暖和光明帶給他人。

cues.text: It's not spreading sunshine and lightness in the world.
cues.en: It's not spreading sunshine and lightness in the world.
cues.zh: 因為你沒有把溫暖和光明帶給他人。

cues.text: Excuses.
cues.en: Excuses.
cues.zh: 因為你沒有把溫暖和光明帶給他人。 「找藉口」。我們都碰過這種人。

cues.text: We've all met this guy.
cues.en: We've all met this guy.
cues.zh: 「找藉口」。我們都碰過這種人。 也許我們都曾找藉口開脫。

cues.text: Maybe we've all been this guy.
cues.en: Maybe we've all been this guy.
cues.zh: 也許我們都曾找藉口開脫。 有些人老是找替死鬼，

cues.text: Some people have a blamethrower.
cues.en: Some people have a blamethrower.
cues.zh: 有些人老是找替死鬼，

cues.text: They just pass it on to everybody else and don't take responsibility for their actions,
cues.en: They just pass it on to everybody else and don't take responsibility for their actions,
cues.zh: 他們推諉塞責， 不為自己的言行承擔責任， 我們不太會去聽這種人說話。

cues.text: and again, hard to listen to somebody who is being like that.
cues.en: and again, hard to listen to somebody who is being like that.
cues.zh: 我們不太會去聽這種人說話。 倒數第二點，也就是第六點，

cues.text: Penultimate, the sixth of the seven, embroidery, exaggeration.
cues.en: Penultimate, the sixth of the seven, embroidery, exaggeration.
cues.zh: 倒數第二點，也就是第六點， 「花言巧語，過分誇張」。

cues.text: It demeans our language, actually, sometimes.
cues.en: It demeans our language, actually, sometimes.
cues.zh: 這可以說是對語言的褻瀆。

cues.text: For example, if I see something that really is awesome, what do I call it?
cues.en: For example, if I see something that really is awesome, what do I call it?
cues.zh: 假如一個說話誇張的人， 遇到超讚的事， 那麼他還能用什麼形容詞呢？

cues.text: And then, of course, this exaggeration becomes lying, and we don't want to listen to people we know are lying to us.
cues.en: And then, of course, this exaggeration becomes lying, and we don't want to listen to people we know are lying to us.
cues.zh: 其實，語言過分誇張就是欺騙， 不折不扣的謊言， 沒有人喜歡聽騙子的話。 最後是「過分武斷」。

cues.text: And finally, dogmatism.
cues.en: And finally, dogmatism.
cues.zh: 最後是「過分武斷」。

cues.text: The confusion of facts with opinions.
cues.en: The confusion of facts with opinions.
cues.zh: 真相與見解混淆不清。

cues.text: When those two things get conflated, you're listening into the wind.
cues.en: When those two things get conflated, you're listening into the wind.
cues.zh: 真相與見解混淆不清。 這樣講話只會成為別人的耳旁風。 就像有人用自以為是的觀點炮轟你，

cues.text: You know, somebody is bombarding you with their opinions as if they were true.
cues.en: You know, somebody is bombarding you with their opinions as if they were true.
cues.zh: 就像有人用自以為是的觀點炮轟你， 很難有人想聽他說話。

cues.text: It's difficult to listen to that.
cues.en: It's difficult to listen to that.
cues.zh: 很難有人想聽他說話。

cues.text: So here they are, seven deadly sins of speaking.
cues.en: So here they are, seven deadly sins of speaking.
cues.zh: 以上就是講話中的「七宗罪」。

cues.text: These are things I think we need to avoid.
cues.en: These are things I think we need to avoid.
cues.zh: 我們應該避免以上的錯誤。

cues.text: But is there a positive way to think about this?
cues.en: But is there a positive way to think about this?
cues.zh: 我們應該避免以上的錯誤。 那麼在講話時是否有能遵循的原則呢？

cues.text: Yes, there is.
cues.en: Yes, there is.
cues.zh: 是有幾項。

cues.text: I'd like to suggest that there are four really powerful cornerstones, foundations,
cues.en: I'd like to suggest that there are four really powerful cornerstones, foundations,
cues.zh: 我一共總結了四個 強而有力的基本要點， 能使我們講話更有影響力，

cues.text: that we can stand on if we want our speech to be powerful and to make change in the world.
cues.en: that we can stand on if we want our speech to be powerful and to make change in the world.
cues.zh: 能使我們講話更有影響力， 並且能夠改變這個世界。

cues.text: Fortunately, these things spell a word.
cues.en: Fortunately, these things spell a word.
cues.zh: 很湊巧，這四個要點可以拼成一個單詞，

cues.text: The word is "hail," and it has a great definition as well.
cues.en: The word is "hail," and it has a great definition as well.
cues.zh: 很湊巧，這四個要點可以拼成一個單詞， 這就是「HAIL」，這個單詞 本身就包含深刻的意義。

cues.text: I'm not talking about the stuff that falls from the sky and hits you on the head.
cues.en: I'm not talking about the stuff that falls from the sky and hits you on the head.
cues.zh: 我指的不是從天而下、 砸在你頭上的冰雹。 我指的是熱情歡呼、喝采的意思，

cues.text: I'm talking about this definition, to greet or acclaim enthusiastically, which is how I think our words will be received
cues.en: I'm talking about this definition, to greet or acclaim enthusiastically, which is how I think our words will be received
cues.zh: 我指的是熱情歡呼、喝采的意思， 若能依據這四個要點， 別人就能聽進我們的話。

cues.text: if we stand on these four things.
cues.en: if we stand on these four things.
cues.zh: 別人就能聽進我們的話。 那麼「HAIL」分別代表什麼呢？

cues.text: So what do they stand for?
cues.en: So what do they stand for?
cues.zh: 那麼「HAIL」分別代表什麼呢？

cues.text: See if you can guess.
cues.en: See if you can guess.
cues.zh: 你猜猜看。

cues.text: The H, honesty, of course, being true in what you say, being straight and clear.
cues.en: The H, honesty, of course, being true in what you say, being straight and clear.
cues.zh: 當然，「H」代表誠實 。 講話的內容要真實，且清晰無任何歪曲。

cues.text: The A is authenticity, just being yourself.
cues.en: The A is authenticity, just being yourself.
cues.zh: 講話的內容要真實，且清晰無任何歪曲。 「A」代表內心誠懇、 正心誠意（Authenticity）。

cues.text: A friend of mine described it as standing in your own truth, which I think is a lovely way to put it.
cues.en: A friend of mine described it as standing in your own truth, which I think is a lovely way to put it.
cues.zh: 「A」代表內心誠懇、 正心誠意（Authenticity）。 我朋友認為， 這就如同對自己誠實。 這個解釋非常到位。

cues.text: The I is integrity, being your word, actually doing what you say,
cues.en: The I is integrity, being your word, actually doing what you say,
cues.zh: 這個解釋非常到位。 「I」代表言行一致（Integrity）， 不能說一套做一套，

cues.text: and being somebody people can trust.
cues.en: and being somebody people can trust.
cues.zh: 做一個能讓人信任的人。

cues.text: And the L is love.
cues.en: And the L is love.
cues.zh: 「L」代表愛（Love），

cues.text: I don't mean romantic love, but I do mean wishing people well, for two reasons.
cues.en: I don't mean romantic love, but I do mean wishing people well, for two reasons.
cues.zh: 這不是指男女之間的愛情， 而是希望幫助別人、成就別人。 原因有二：首先，

cues.text: First of all, I think absolute honesty may not be what we want.
cues.en: First of all, I think absolute honesty may not be what we want.
cues.zh: 原因有二：首先， 我們也許不需要絕對的誠實。 「天哪，你今早真是難看」之類的話，

cues.text: I mean, my goodness, you look ugly this morning.
cues.en: I mean, my goodness, you look ugly this morning.
cues.zh: 「天哪，你今早真是難看」之類的話，

cues.text: Perhaps that's not necessary.
cues.en: Perhaps that's not necessary.
cues.zh: 「天哪，你今早真是難看」之類的話， 是沒有必要的。

cues.text: Tempered with love, of course, honesty is a great thing.
cues.en: Tempered with love, of course, honesty is a great thing.
cues.zh: 是沒有必要的。 如果你內心充滿慈愛， 那麼誠實就是很大的優點。

cues.text: But also, if you're really wishing somebody well, it's very hard to judge them at the same time.
cues.en: But also, if you're really wishing somebody well, it's very hard to judge them at the same time.
cues.zh: 如果你真心希望別人受益， 你就不會指摘別人的不是，

cues.text: I'm not even sure you can do those two things simultaneously.
cues.en: I'm not even sure you can do those two things simultaneously.
cues.zh: 你就不會指摘別人的不是， 因為你無法同時做到這兩件事。

cues.text: So hail.
cues.en: So hail.
cues.zh: 因為你無法同時做到這兩件事。 這就是「HAIL」。

cues.text: Also, now that's what you say, and it's like the old song, it is what you say,
cues.en: Also, now that's what you say, and it's like the old song, it is what you say,
cues.zh: 以上介紹的是講話的內容， 就像一首老歌裡唱的，你說的話重要， 你說話的方式也很重要。

cues.text: it's also the way that you say it.
cues.en: it's also the way that you say it.
cues.zh: 你說話的方式也很重要。 我們每個人都擁有智慧的寶庫，

cues.text: You have an amazing toolbox.
cues.en: You have an amazing toolbox.
cues.zh: 我們每個人都擁有智慧的寶庫，

cues.text: This instrument is incredible, and yet this is a toolbox that very few people have ever opened.
cues.en: This instrument is incredible, and yet this is a toolbox that very few people have ever opened.
cues.zh: 寶庫裡藏著十分有用的工具， 但很少有人開啟這座寶庫。

cues.text: I'd like to have a little rummage in there with you now and just pull a few tools out
cues.en: I'd like to have a little rummage in there with you now and just pull a few tools out
cues.zh: 接下來我將與各位一起進入寶庫探索， 尋找一些大家都樂於使用的工具，

cues.text: that you might like to take away and play with, which will increase the power of your speaking.
cues.en: that you might like to take away and play with, which will increase the power of your speaking.
cues.zh: 尋找一些大家都樂於使用的工具， 就能藉此增強你說話的力量。 首先是音區。

cues.text: Register, for example.
cues.en: Register, for example.
cues.zh: 首先是音區。

cues.text: Now, falsetto register may not be very useful most of the time,
cues.en: Now, falsetto register may not be very useful most of the time,
cues.zh: 在講話時，假音往往不太有效，

cues.text: but there's a register in between.
cues.en: but there's a register in between.
cues.zh: 因此我們應當使用較為適中的聲區。

cues.text: I'm not going to get very technical about this for any of you who are voice coaches.
cues.en: I'm not going to get very technical about this for any of you who are voice coaches.
cues.zh: 因此我們應當使用較為適中的聲區。 我不想說得太專業，以免班門弄斧， 因為在座有很多是聲樂導師。 其實，我們可以自己調整發聲位置。

cues.text: You can locate your voice, however.
cues.en: You can locate your voice, however.
cues.zh: 其實，我們可以自己調整發聲位置。 如果我透過鼻腔發聲，你就會聽出不同；

cues.text: So if I talk up here in my nose, you can hear the difference.
cues.en: So if I talk up here in my nose, you can hear the difference.
cues.zh: 如果我透過鼻腔發聲，你就會聽出不同； 透過喉嚨發聲是這樣的，

cues.text: If I go down here in my throat, which is where most of us speak from most of the time.
cues.en: If I go down here in my throat, which is where most of us speak from most of the time.
cues.zh: 透過喉嚨發聲是這樣的， 在座大多數人通常都透過喉嚨發聲。 但如果你想加強聲音的厚重感，

cues.text: But if you want weight, you need to go down here to the chest.
cues.en: But if you want weight, you need to go down here to the chest.
cues.zh: 但如果你想加強聲音的厚重感， 就可以透過胸腔發聲。

cues.text: You hear the difference?
cues.en: You hear the difference?
cues.zh: 你能聽出區別嗎？

cues.text: We vote for politicians with lower voices, it's true,
cues.en: We vote for politicians with lower voices, it's true,
cues.zh: 我們會把票投給嗓音低沉的候選人， 這是真的，因為低沉的嗓音

cues.text: because we associate depth with power and with authority.
cues.en: because we associate depth with power and with authority.
cues.zh: 這是真的，因為低沉的嗓音 會讓人們想到力量和權威。

cues.text: That's register.
cues.en: That's register.
cues.zh: 會讓人們想到力量和權威。 這是「聲區」。

cues.text: Then we have timbre.
cues.en: Then we have timbre.
cues.zh: 這是「聲區」。 下面我們介紹「音色」，

cues.text: It's the way your voice feels.
cues.en: It's the way your voice feels.
cues.zh: 下面我們介紹「音色」， 也就是嗓音帶給別人的感覺。

cues.text: Again, the research shows that we prefer voices which are rich, smooth, warm,
cues.en: Again, the research shows that we prefer voices which are rich, smooth, warm,
cues.zh: 研究顯示，我們偏好 如同熱巧克力一般 豐富、流暢、溫暖的嗓音。

cues.text: like hot chocolate.
cues.en: like hot chocolate.
cues.zh: 如同熱巧克力一般 豐富、流暢、溫暖的嗓音。

cues.text: Well if that's not you, that's not the end of the world, because you can train.
cues.en: Well if that's not you, that's not the end of the world, because you can train.
cues.zh: 如同熱巧克力一般 豐富、流暢、溫暖的嗓音。 你沒有這種嗓音也不要緊， 可以透過訓練改變，

cues.text: Go and get a voice coach.
cues.en: Go and get a voice coach.
cues.zh: 可以尋求聲樂導師的幫助。

cues.text: And there are amazing things you can do with breathing, with posture, and with exercises
cues.en: And there are amazing things you can do with breathing, with posture, and with exercises
cues.zh: 你也可以在很多方面下功夫， 比如呼吸、姿勢以及勤奮的練習，

cues.text: to improve the timbre of your voice.
cues.en: to improve the timbre of your voice.
cues.zh: 比如呼吸、姿勢以及勤奮的練習， 這樣你就能改善自己的音色。

cues.text: Then prosody. I love prosody.
cues.en: Then prosody. I love prosody.
cues.zh: 第三是注意「抑揚頓挫」。

cues.text: This is the sing-song, the meta-language that we use in order to impart meaning.
cues.en: This is the sing-song, the meta-language that we use in order to impart meaning.
cues.zh: 這就好比是歌唱， 它能使語意層次分明，

cues.text: It's root one for meaning in conversation.
cues.en: It's root one for meaning in conversation.
cues.zh: 這是談話中表達意義的根本。

cues.text: People who speak all on one note are really quite hard to listen to
cues.en: People who speak all on one note are really quite hard to listen to
cues.zh: 這是談話中表達意義的根本。 單一的語調 很不利於他人聆聽。

cues.text: if they don't have any prosody at all.

8KkKuTCFvzI.title: What Makes a Good Life? Lessons from the Longest Study on Happiness | Robert Waldinger | TED
8KkKuTCFvzI.speaker: TED
8KkKuTCFvzI.zh: 【TED】美好生活是什麼？最長的幸福研究的教訓|羅伯特·瓦爾丁格 |泰德（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: What keeps us healthy and happy as we go through life?
cues.en: What keeps us healthy and happy as we go through life?
cues.zh: 當我們渡過此生 是什麼讓我們保有健康跟幸福呢？

cues.text: If you were going to invest now in your future best self,
cues.en: If you were going to invest now in your future best self,
cues.zh: 為了將來過得最好的自己， 假使你們現在正要下本錢的話，

cues.text: where would you put your time and your energy?
cues.en: where would you put your time and your energy?
cues.zh: 你會把時間和精力投注在哪兒呢？

cues.text: There was a recent survey of millennials asking them what their most important life goals were,
cues.en: There was a recent survey of millennials asking them what their most important life goals were,
cues.zh: 有個對千禧世代的近期研究 問他們人生最重要的目標是什麼？

cues.text: and over 80 percent said that a major life goal for them was to get rich.
cues.en: and over 80 percent said that a major life goal for them was to get rich.
cues.zh: 超過八成說主要的目標是變得富有；

cues.text: And another 50 percent of those same young adults
cues.en: And another 50 percent of those same young adults
cues.zh: 以及同一批未成氣候的成年人

cues.text: said that another major life goal was to become famous.
cues.en: said that another major life goal was to become famous.
cues.zh: 另有五成說另一個主要的目標 是變得名聲響亮。

cues.text: And we're constantly told to lean in to work, to push harder
cues.en: And we're constantly told to lean in to work, to push harder
cues.zh: 而且我們不斷地聽人講要傾心工作、 更賣力些以及取得更多的成就；

cues.text: and achieve more.
cues.en: and achieve more.
cues.zh: 更賣力些以及取得更多的成就；

cues.text: We're given the impression that these are the things that we need to go after
cues.en: We're given the impression that these are the things that we need to go after
cues.zh: 我們被灌輸概念－為了有美好的生活，

cues.text: in order to have a good life.
cues.en: in order to have a good life.
cues.zh: 我們被灌輸概念－為了有美好的生活， 這些東西是我們需要追求的。

cues.text: Pictures of entire lives, of the choices that people make and how those choices work out for them,
cues.en: Pictures of entire lives, of the choices that people make and how those choices work out for them,
cues.zh: 周齊的人生圖景－ 大家做出的選擇以及這些選擇 為他們帶來什麼結果－

cues.text: those pictures are almost impossible to get.
cues.en: those pictures are almost impossible to get.
cues.zh: 幾乎無從得知；

cues.text: Most of what we know about human life we know from asking people to remember the past,
cues.en: Most of what we know about human life we know from asking people to remember the past,
cues.zh: 我們對人生所知道的絕大部份 來自於訴請別人記起過往。

cues.text: and as we know, hindsight is anything but 20/20.
cues.en: and as we know, hindsight is anything but 20/20.
cues.zh: 來自於訴請別人記起過往。 如同我們所知－事後很容易有後見知明， 但是要預測未來是很難的；

cues.text: We forget vast amounts of what happens to us in life,
cues.en: We forget vast amounts of what happens to us in life,
cues.zh: 我們記不住一生當中 大多數發生在我們身上的事情，

cues.text: and sometimes memory is downright creative.
cues.en: and sometimes memory is downright creative.
cues.zh: 而且有時候記憶是極其不切實際的。

cues.text: But what if we could watch entire lives
cues.en: But what if we could watch entire lives
cues.zh: 不過要是我們能夠看見齊全的人生－

cues.text: as they unfold through time?
cues.en: as they unfold through time?
cues.zh: 當它們穿越時間展開來呢？

cues.text: What if we could study people from the time that they were teenagers
cues.en: What if we could study people from the time that they were teenagers
cues.zh: 要是我們能夠研究大家 －從他們少年一路直到老朽－

cues.text: all the way into old age to see what really keeps people happy and healthy?
cues.en: all the way into old age to see what really keeps people happy and healthy?
cues.zh: 要是我們能夠研究大家 －從他們少年一路直到老朽－ 來看是什麼確實讓人保持幸福和健康呢？

cues.text: We did that.
cues.en: We did that.
cues.zh: 我們做過了！

cues.text: The Harvard Study of Adult Development may be the longest study of adult life that's ever been done.
cues.en: The Harvard Study of Adult Development may be the longest study of adult life that's ever been done.
cues.zh: 哈佛大學的成年人生涯進展研究 或許是前所未見最長久的 成年人生涯研究，

cues.text: For 75 years, we've tracked the lives of 724 men,
cues.en: For 75 years, we've tracked the lives of 724 men,
cues.zh: 75 年來我們已經追查了 724 位男士的生活，

cues.text: year after year, asking about their work, their home lives, their health,
cues.en: year after year, asking about their work, their home lives, their health,
cues.zh: 年復一年問及其工作、居家生活、健康，

cues.text: and of course asking all along the way without knowing how their life stories
cues.en: and of course asking all along the way without knowing how their life stories
cues.zh: 年復一年問及其工作、居家生活、健康， 當然了這一路問下來 對他們人生的故事即將如何 翻轉我們也毫不知情。

cues.text: were going to turn out.
cues.en: were going to turn out.
cues.zh: 對他們人生的故事即將如何 翻轉我們也毫不知情。

cues.text: Studies like this are exceedingly rare.
cues.en: Studies like this are exceedingly rare.
cues.zh: 像這樣的研究計畫微乎其微，

cues.text: Almost all projects of this kind fall apart within a decade
cues.en: Almost all projects of this kind fall apart within a decade
cues.zh: 像這樣的研究計畫微乎其微， 幾乎所有這種研究在十年內就破局了；

cues.text: because too many people drop out of the study, or funding for the research dries up,
cues.en: because too many people drop out of the study, or funding for the research dries up,
cues.zh: 因為太多人放棄了研究， 或者金援研究的資金沒了著落，

cues.text: or the researchers get distracted, or they die, and nobody moves the ball further down the field.
cues.en: or the researchers get distracted, or they die, and nobody moves the ball further down the field.
cues.zh: 或是研究負責人琵琶別抱， 或是研究負責人死亡 而且無人讓該計畫再做出進展。

cues.text: But through a combination of luck and the persistence of several generations of researchers,
cues.en: But through a combination of luck and the persistence of several generations of researchers,
cues.zh: 不過透過好運加上幾個世代 研究人員的堅毅，

cues.text: this study has survived.
cues.en: this study has survived.
cues.zh: 這個研究並未中斷。

cues.text: About 60 of our original 724 men are still alive,
cues.en: About 60 of our original 724 men are still alive,
cues.zh: 我們原先的 724 位男士大約有 60 人 仍然還活著、一直參與著這個研究，

cues.text: still participating in the study, most of them in their 90s.
cues.en: still participating in the study, most of them in their 90s.
cues.zh: 仍然還活著、一直參與著這個研究， 他們大多都 90 多歲了，

cues.text: And we are now beginning to study the more than 2,000 children of these men.
cues.en: And we are now beginning to study the more than 2,000 children of these men.
cues.zh: 而且我們現在正要開始研究 這些男士 2,000 多名的子女們；

cues.text: And I'm the fourth director of the study.
cues.en: And I'm the fourth director of the study.
cues.zh: 而我是本研究的第四位主持人了。

cues.text: Since 1938, we've tracked the lives of two groups of men.
cues.en: Since 1938, we've tracked the lives of two groups of men.
cues.zh: 從 1938 年來我們已經追蹤了 兩組男士的生活，

cues.text: The first group started in the study when they were sophomores at Harvard College.
cues.en: The first group started in the study when they were sophomores at Harvard College.
cues.zh: 第一組當他們在哈佛大學二年級時 就開始在這個研究裡；

cues.text: They all finished college during World War II, and then most went off to serve in the war.
cues.en: They all finished college during World War II, and then most went off to serve in the war.
cues.zh: 二次世界大戰期間他們全部唸完大學， 之後大多數都離家效力於戰場上。

cues.text: And the second group that we've followed was a group of boys from Boston's poorest neighborhoods,
cues.en: And the second group that we've followed was a group of boys from Boston's poorest neighborhoods,
cues.zh: 第二組我們密切關注的－ 是一群來自波士頓最窮澀 裡坊的男孩子們，

cues.text: boys who were chosen for the study specifically because they were from some of the most troubled
cues.en: boys who were chosen for the study specifically because they were from some of the most troubled
cues.zh: 是一群來自波士頓最窮澀 裡坊的男孩子們， 被這研究選到的男孩子們 特別是因為他們來自三零年代 波士頓一些最困頓和弱勢的家庭－

cues.text: and disadvantaged families in the Boston of the 1930s.
cues.en: and disadvantaged families in the Boston of the 1930s.
cues.zh: 波士頓一些最困頓和弱勢的家庭－

cues.text: Most lived in tenements, many without hot and cold running water.
cues.en: Most lived in tenements, many without hot and cold running water.
cues.zh: 波士頓一些最困頓和弱勢的家庭－ 大多數住在低品質的公寓大樓， 很多人家還都沒有自來水和熱水。

cues.text: When they entered the study, all of these teenagers were interviewed.
cues.en: When they entered the study, all of these teenagers were interviewed.
cues.zh: 當他們進入這個研究時 這些十來歲的孩子全都有 接受採訪、做健康檢查、

cues.text: They were given medical exams.
cues.en: They were given medical exams.
cues.zh: 這些十來歲的孩子全都有 接受採訪、做健康檢查、

cues.text: We went to their homes and we interviewed their parents.
cues.en: We went to their homes and we interviewed their parents.
cues.zh: 這些十來歲的孩子全都有 接受採訪、做健康檢查、 我們去到他們家採訪其雙親。

cues.text: And then these teenagers grew up into adults who entered all walks of life.
cues.en: And then these teenagers grew up into adults who entered all walks of life.
cues.zh: 然後這些青少年長大成人 進入社會各階層，

cues.text: They became factory workers and lawyers and bricklayers and doctors,
cues.en: They became factory workers and lawyers and bricklayers and doctors,
cues.zh: 他們成了工廠工人、律師、 泥水匠、醫師，

cues.text: one President of the United States.
cues.en: one President of the United States.
cues.zh: 以及一位美國總統。

cues.text: Some developed alcoholism. A few developed schizophrenia.
cues.en: Some developed alcoholism. A few developed schizophrenia.
cues.zh: 有的人染上酒癮、 偶有人罹患精神分裂症、

cues.text: Some climbed the social ladder from the bottom all the way to the very top,
cues.en: Some climbed the social ladder from the bottom all the way to the very top,
cues.zh: 有一些從社會底層 攀越社會梯階一路飛黃騰達、

cues.text: and some made that journey in the opposite direction.
cues.en: and some made that journey in the opposite direction.
cues.zh: 有一些從社會底層 攀越社會梯階一路飛黃騰達、 有些人則背道而馳了。

cues.text: The founders of this study would never in their wildest dreams
cues.en: The founders of this study would never in their wildest dreams
cues.zh: 這個研究的發起人們絕對意想不到 －即便最狂縱的夢想中－

cues.text: have imagined that I would be standing here today, 75 years later,
cues.en: have imagined that I would be standing here today, 75 years later,
cues.zh: －即便最狂縱的夢想中－ 75 年後的今天我會站在這裡，

cues.text: telling you that the study still continues.
cues.en: telling you that the study still continues.
cues.zh: 正在告訴你們這個研究仍然未中斷。

cues.text: Every two years, our patient and dedicated research staff
cues.en: Every two years, our patient and dedicated research staff
cues.zh: 每兩年我們有耐性 跟認真賣力的研究人手

cues.text: calls up our men and asks them if we can send them yet one more set of questions about their lives.
cues.en: calls up our men and asks them if we can send them yet one more set of questions about their lives.
cues.zh: 每兩年我們有耐性 跟認真賣力的研究人手 致電給我們的研究物件， 問說我們是否能再寄送給他們 一份有關他們生活的問卷。

cues.text: Many of the inner city Boston men ask us,
cues.en: Many of the inner city Boston men ask us,
cues.zh: 許多波士頓化外之地的受訪者問我們：

cues.text: "Why do you keep wanting to study me? My life just isn't that interesting."
cues.en: "Why do you keep wanting to study me? My life just isn't that interesting."
cues.zh: 許多波士頓化外之地的受訪者問我們： 「為什麼你一直想研究我？ 我的人生一點就是不精采呀！」；

cues.text: The Harvard men never ask that question.
cues.en: The Harvard men never ask that question.
cues.zh: 哈佛大學的受訪者們從未問過該問題。

cues.text: To get the clearest picture of these lives, we don't just send them questionnaires.
cues.en: To get the clearest picture of these lives, we don't just send them questionnaires.
cues.zh: 為了取得這些人生最清楚的寫照， 我們不只是寄送給他們問券；

cues.text: We interview them in their living rooms.
cues.en: We interview them in their living rooms.
cues.zh: 我們在他們家的客廳做訪談、

cues.text: We get their medical records from their doctors.
cues.en: We get their medical records from their doctors.
cues.zh: 從他們的醫生那裡取得病歷、

cues.text: We draw their blood, we scan their brains, we talk to their children.
cues.en: We draw their blood, we scan their brains, we talk to their children.
cues.zh: 跟他們抽血和做腦部掃描、 跟他們的子女聊、

cues.text: We videotape them talking with their wives about their deepest concerns.
cues.en: We videotape them talking with their wives about their deepest concerns.
cues.zh: 拍攝下他們跟老婆談論最憂心的事情。

cues.text: And when, about a decade ago, we finally asked the wives
cues.en: And when, about a decade ago, we finally asked the wives
cues.zh: 拍攝下他們跟老婆談論最憂心的事情。 然後大約在 10 年前 到頭來我們問了他們的老婆：

cues.text: if they would join us as members of the study, many of the women said, "You know, it's about time."
cues.en: if they would join us as members of the study, many of the women said, "You know, it's about time."
cues.zh: 「妳們是否會參與我們 作為研究受訪者成員呢？」； 許多婦女說：「也該是時候了啦！」

cues.text: So what have we learned?
cues.en: So what have we learned?
cues.zh: 所以我們學到什麼了呢？

cues.text: What are the lessons that come from the tens of thousands of pages
cues.en: What are the lessons that come from the tens of thousands of pages
cues.zh: 從數萬頁的資料－我們已經從 這些人生中收集到－

cues.text: of information that we've generated on these lives?
cues.en: of information that we've generated on these lives?
cues.zh: 從數萬頁的資料－我們已經從 這些人生中收集到－ 裡面有何前車之鑑呢？

cues.text: Well, the lessons aren't about wealth or fame or working harder and harder.
cues.en: Well, the lessons aren't about wealth or fame or working harder and harder.
cues.zh: 此前車之鑑與財富、名氣、 賣命工作無關，

cues.text: The clearest message that we get from this 75-year study is this:
cues.en: The clearest message that we get from this 75-year study is this:
cues.zh: 我們從這個 75 年的研究裡得到 最明確的訊息是這個： 「良好的關係在其期間內 讓我們保持更幸福、健康！」。

cues.text: Good relationships keep us happier and healthier. Period.
cues.en: Good relationships keep us happier and healthier. Period.
cues.zh: 「良好的關係在其期間內 讓我們保持更幸福、健康！」。

cues.text: We've learned three big lessons about relationships.
cues.en: We've learned three big lessons about relationships.
cues.zh: 我們已經學到關於關係的 三大前車之鑑： 第一個是人際聯絡確實對我們是好的，

cues.text: The first is that social connections are really good for us,
cues.en: The first is that social connections are really good for us,
cues.zh: 第一個是人際聯絡確實對我們是好的，

cues.text: and that loneliness kills.

o_XVt5rdpFY.title: The Secrets of Learning a New Language

cues.text: I love learning foreign languages.
cues.en: I love learning foreign languages.
cues.zh: 我熱愛學習外語。

cues.text: In fact, I love it so much that I like to learn a new language every two years,
cues.en: In fact, I love it so much that I like to learn a new language every two years,
cues.zh: 其實我愛到每兩年就學一種新語言，

cues.text: currently working on my eighth one.
cues.en: currently working on my eighth one.
cues.zh: 目前我在學第八種語言。

cues.text: When people find that out about me, they always ask me,
cues.en: When people find that out about me, they always ask me,
cues.zh: 如果有人發現這件事， 他們都會問我，

cues.text: "How do you do that? What's your secret?"
cues.en: "How do you do that? What's your secret?"
cues.zh: 「你是怎麼辦到的？秘訣是什麼？」

cues.text: And to be honest, for many years, my answer would be,
cues.en: And to be honest, for many years, my answer would be,
cues.zh: 老實說，多年來我的答案大多是：

cues.text: "I don't know. I simply love learning languages."
cues.en: "I don't know. I simply love learning languages."
cues.zh: 「不知道耶！我就是愛學語言。」

cues.text: But people were never happy with that answer.
cues.en: But people were never happy with that answer.
cues.zh: 但大家對這個答案都不滿意。

cues.text: They wanted to know why they are spending years trying to learn even one language,
cues.en: They wanted to know why they are spending years trying to learn even one language,
cues.zh: 他們想知道，為何自己費時多年， 而且只學一種語言，

cues.text: never achieving fluency,
cues.en: never achieving fluency,
cues.zh: 還是無法說得流利，

cues.text: and here I come, learning one language after another.
cues.en: and here I come, learning one language after another.
cues.zh: 而我卻能一個語言接著一個語言學。

cues.text: They wanted to know the secret of polyglots,
cues.en: They wanted to know the secret of polyglots,

cues.text: people who speak a lot of languages.
cues.en: people who speak a lot of languages.
cues.zh: 精通多種語言者的秘訣。

cues.en: And that made me wonder, too,

cues.zh: 是什麼因素讓我們

cues.en: to learn languages so much faster than other people?

cues.en: I decided to meet other people like me and find that out.

cues.text: which is why this disenchantment is so important.
cues.en: which is why this disenchantment is so important.

cues.text: Seeing what we get from our habits
cues.en: Seeing what we get from our habits
cues.zh: 明白我們如何養成習慣

cues.text: helps us understand them at a deeper level --
cues.en: helps us understand them at a deeper level --

cues.text: to know it in our bones
cues.en: to know it in our bones

cues.text: so we don't have to force ourselves to hold back
cues.en: so we don't have to force ourselves to hold back

cues.text: or restrain ourselves from behavior.
cues.en: or restrain ourselves from behavior.

cues.text: We're just less interested in doing it in the first place.
cues.en: We're just less interested in doing it in the first place.

cues.text: And this is what mindfulness is all about:
cues.en: And this is what mindfulness is all about:
cues.zh: 這就是冥想：

cues.text: Seeing really clearly what we get when we get caught up in our behaviors,
cues.en: Seeing really clearly what we get when we get caught up in our behaviors,
cues.zh: 當我們被自己的行為絆住的時候， 得真的很清醒得去了解，我們得到的是什麼，

cues.text: becoming disenchanted on a visceral level
cues.en: becoming disenchanted on a visceral level
cues.zh: 發自內心層次的覺悟，

cues.text: and from this disenchanted stance, naturally letting go.
cues.en: and from this disenchanted stance, naturally letting go.
cues.zh: 在覺悟的狀態下，自然地放它走。

cues.text: This isn't to say that, poof, magically we quit smoking.
cues.en: This isn't to say that, poof, magically we quit smoking.
cues.zh: 這不是在說，神奇的 " 噗 "的一聲， 我們就戒菸了。

cues.text: But over time, as we learn to see more and more clearly
cues.en: But over time, as we learn to see more and more clearly
cues.zh: 而是日積月累，當我們學會 看得愈來愈清楚

cues.text: the results of our actions,
cues.en: the results of our actions,
cues.zh: 我們行為所導致的結果，

cues.text: we let go of old habits and form new ones.
cues.en: we let go of old habits and form new ones.
cues.zh: 我們就會摒除掉老習慣， 而養成了新的習慣。

cues.text: The paradox here
cues.en: The paradox here
cues.zh: 吊詭的是，

cues.text: is that mindfulness is just about being really interested
cues.en: is that mindfulness is just about being really interested
cues.zh: 冥想是，打從內心的感到有興趣，

cues.text: in getting close and personal
cues.en: in getting close and personal
cues.zh: 時時刻刻很私密的去體會

cues.text: with what's actually happening in our bodies and minds
cues.en: with what's actually happening in our bodies and minds
cues.zh: 到底我們的身體和心智，發生了什麼事。

cues.text: from moment to moment.
cues.en: from moment to moment.
cues.zh: 將這種意願轉換成我們的體驗

cues.text: This willingness to turn toward our experience
cues.en: This willingness to turn toward our experience
cues.zh: 將這種意願轉換成我們的體驗

cues.text: rather than trying to make unpleasant cravings go away as quickly as possible.
cues.en: rather than trying to make unpleasant cravings go away as quickly as possible.
cues.zh: 而不是嘗試得儘快把 不好的癮念去除。

cues.text: And this willingness to turn toward our experience
cues.en: And this willingness to turn toward our experience
cues.zh: 將意願轉換成體驗

cues.text: is supported by curiosity,
cues.en: is supported by curiosity,
cues.zh: 是源由自好奇，

cues.text: which is naturally rewarding.
cues.en: which is naturally rewarding.
cues.zh: 那是先天性的一種獎勵機制。

cues.text: What does curiosity feel like?
cues.en: What does curiosity feel like?
cues.zh: 好奇的感覺是怎樣的呢？

cues.text: It feels good.
cues.en: It feels good.
cues.zh: 感覺很好。

cues.text: And what happens when we get curious?
cues.en: And what happens when we get curious?
cues.zh: 我們感到好奇的時候會發生什麼事情呢？

cues.text: We start to notice that cravings are simply made up of body sensations --
cues.en: We start to notice that cravings are simply made up of body sensations --
cues.zh: 我們會開始察覺到，癮念其實單就是 從身體的感官所造成 --

cues.text: oh, there's tightness, there's tension,
cues.en: oh, there's tightness, there's tension,
cues.zh: 噢，那裡很緊張，那邊有壓力

cues.text: there's restlessness --
cues.en: there's restlessness --
cues.zh: 那邊煩躁不安 --

cues.text: and that these body sensations come and go.
cues.en: and that these body sensations come and go.
cues.zh: 這些身體的感覺來來去去。

cues.text: These are bite-size pieces of experiences
cues.en: These are bite-size pieces of experiences
cues.zh: 這些都是我們時時刻刻

cues.text: that we can manage from moment to moment
cues.en: that we can manage from moment to moment
cues.zh: 都可以處理好的小體驗，

cues.text: rather than getting clobbered by this huge, scary craving
cues.en: rather than getting clobbered by this huge, scary craving
cues.zh: 無需被這巨大可怕的

cues.text: that we choke on.
cues.en: that we choke on.
cues.zh: 癮念所噎住並擊倒。

cues.text: In other words, when we get curious,
cues.en: In other words, when we get curious,
cues.zh: 換句話來說，當我們感到好奇，

cues.text: we step out of our old, fear-based, reactive habit patterns,
cues.en: we step out of our old, fear-based, reactive habit patterns,
cues.zh: 我們就走出舊有的、恐懼為本的、 回應式的習慣模式，

cues.text: and we step into being.
cues.en: and we step into being.
cues.zh: 我們從而踏進了當下。

cues.text: We become this inner scientist
cues.en: We become this inner scientist
cues.zh: 我們成為了熱切地期待著下一個資料點的

cues.text: where we're eagerly awaiting that next data point.
cues.en: where we're eagerly awaiting that next data point.
cues.zh: 內心科學家。

cues.text: Now, this might sound too simplistic to affect behavior.
cues.en: Now, this might sound too simplistic to affect behavior.
cues.zh: 這聽起來，好像太簡單到 沒那麼容易可以影響行為。

cues.text: But in one study, we found that mindfulness training
cues.en: But in one study, we found that mindfulness training
cues.zh: 但有一個研究顯示， 我們發現了冥想的訓練，

cues.text: was twice as good as gold standard therapy at helping people quit smoking.
cues.en: was twice as good as gold standard therapy at helping people quit smoking.
cues.zh: 在幫助人們戒菸的這事情上， 比黃金標準治療法好 2 倍

cues.text: So it actually works.
cues.en: So it actually works.
cues.zh: 所以冥想真的有效。

cues.text: And when we studied the brains of experienced meditators,
cues.en: And when we studied the brains of experienced meditators,
cues.zh: 當我們研究資深冥想者的大腦時，

cues.text: we found that parts of a neural network of self-referential processing
cues.en: we found that parts of a neural network of self-referential processing
cues.zh: 我們發現了神經網路裡面 「自我指認流程」的部分

cues.text: called the default mode network
cues.en: called the default mode network
cues.zh: 被稱為「預設模式網路」

cues.text: were at play.
cues.en: were at play.
cues.zh: 正在產生影響。

cues.text: Now, one current hypothesis is that a region of this network,
cues.en: Now, one current hypothesis is that a region of this network,
cues.zh: 目前是有一個 關於這個網路某區域的理論，

cues.text: called the posterior cingulate cortex,
cues.en: called the posterior cingulate cortex,
cues.zh: 稱為「後扣帶回皮質」，

cues.text: is activated not necessarily by craving itself
cues.en: is activated not necessarily by craving itself
cues.zh: 會因為癮念本身而引發不必要的啟動。

cues.text: but when we get caught up in it, when we get sucked in,
cues.en: but when we get caught up in it, when we get sucked in,
cues.zh: 但當我們被它牽絆住， 當我們被吸進去的時候，

cues.text: and it takes us for a ride.
cues.en: and it takes us for a ride.
cues.zh: 它會欺騙我們。

cues.text: In contrast, when we let go --
cues.en: In contrast, when we let go --
cues.zh: 相反來說，如果我們就讓它走--

cues.text: step out of the process
cues.en: step out of the process
cues.zh: 從流程裡走出來

cues.text: just by being curiously aware of what's happening --
cues.en: just by being curiously aware of what's happening --
cues.zh: 只是單純的好奇 到底發生甚麼事情--

cues.text: this same brain region quiets down.
cues.en: this same brain region quiets down.
cues.zh: 同一區域的大腦就會安靜下來。

cues.text: Now we're testing app and online-based mindfulness training programs
cues.en: Now we're testing app and online-based mindfulness training programs
cues.zh: 現在我們在測試手機應用程式和 以網路為基礎的冥想訓練課程，

cues.text: that target these core mechanisms
cues.en: that target these core mechanisms
cues.zh: 目標就是這些核心機制，

cues.text: and, ironically, use the same technology that's driving us to distraction
cues.en: and, ironically, use the same technology that's driving us to distraction
cues.zh: 諷刺的是，竟是使用同一種 讓我們分心的科技

cues.text: to help us step out of our unhealthy habit patterns
cues.en: to help us step out of our unhealthy habit patterns
cues.zh: 去幫助我們脫離自己不健康的習慣模式，

cues.text: of smoking, of stress eating and other addictive behaviors.
cues.en: of smoking, of stress eating and other addictive behaviors.
cues.zh: 像是吸煙、因壓力而狂吃 和其他上癮的行為。

cues.text: Now, remember that bit about context-dependent memory?
cues.en: Now, remember that bit about context-dependent memory?
cues.zh: 現在，還記得剛才曾提過的情境記憶嗎？

cues.text: We can deliver these tools to peoples' fingertips
cues.en: We can deliver these tools to peoples' fingertips
cues.zh: 我們可以把這些最重要的

cues.text: in the contexts that matter most.
cues.en: in the contexts that matter most.
cues.zh: 內容工具傳遞到人們的指尖。

cues.text: So we can help them
cues.en: So we can help them
cues.zh: 所以我們可以幫助他們

cues.text: tap into their inherent capacity to be curiously aware
cues.en: tap into their inherent capacity to be curiously aware
cues.zh: 在渴望抽菸、遇壓力亂吃或 任何不好的慾望浮現的霎那，

cues.en: right when that urge to smoke or stress eat or whatever arises.
cues.zh: 挖掘他們的內心潛力 去好奇地意識正確。

cues.text: So if you don't smoke or stress eat,
cues.en: So if you don't smoke or stress eat,
cues.zh: 所以如果你不抽菸、 也沒有因為壓力而狂吃，

cues.text: maybe the next time you feel this urge to check your email when you're bored,
cues.en: maybe the next time you feel this urge to check your email when you're bored,

cues.text: or you're trying to distract yourself from work,
cues.en: or you're trying to distract yourself from work,

cues.en: see if you can tap into this natural capacity,
cues.zh: 看看你是不是可以，藉助這先天的能力，

cues.text: just be curiously aware
cues.en: just be curiously aware
cues.zh: 就單純的去好奇

cues.text: of what's happening in your body and mind in that moment.
cues.en: of what's happening in your body and mind in that moment.
cues.zh: 到底那一刻，你的身體和心智 在發生什麼事。

cues.text: It will just be another chance
cues.en: It will just be another chance
cues.zh: 這可能提供了一個機會

cues.text: to perpetuate one of our endless and exhaustive habit loops ...
cues.en: to perpetuate one of our endless and exhaustive habit loops ...
cues.zh: 讓你持續保有這個永無止境 和消耗性的惡性迴圈......

cues.text: or step out of it.
cues.en: or step out of it.
cues.zh: 或是擺脫掉它。

cues.text: Instead of see text message, compulsively text back,
cues.en: Instead of see text message, compulsively text back,
cues.zh: 看見訊息時，不要再 -- 不得不的回覆

cues.text: feel a little bit better --
cues.en: feel a little bit better --
cues.zh: 反而應該是有蠻好的感覺 --

cues.text: notice the urge,
cues.en: notice the urge,
cues.zh: 察覺到渴望，

cues.text: get curious,
cues.en: get curious,
cues.zh: 感到好奇，

cues.text: feel the joy of letting go
cues.en: feel the joy of letting go
cues.zh: 感受一下放走它的歡愉，

cues.text: and repeat.
cues.en: and repeat.

cues.zh: 這個人腦中究竟裝著什麼神奇的機制？

cues.text: Well, it turns out it’s precisely the same remarkable machinery that all of us have.
cues.en: Well, it turns out it’s precisely the same remarkable machinery that all of us have.
cues.zh: 事實證明，那正是 我們每個人都有的神奇機制。

cues.text: Human beings have something that we might think of
cues.en: Human beings have something that we might think of
cues.zh: 人類擁有一種可以稱為 「心理免疫系統」的東西。

cues.text: as a psychological immune system, a system of cognitive processes,
cues.en: as a psychological immune system, a system of cognitive processes,
cues.zh: 這是一套認知歷程，

cues.text: largely non-conscious cognitive processes,
cues.en: largely non-conscious cognitive processes,
cues.zh: 其中大部分是在無意識中進行的，

cues.text: that help them change their views of the world
cues.en: that help them change their views of the world
cues.zh: 能幫助我們改變自己看待世界的方式，

cues.text: so that they can feel better about the worlds in which they find themselves.
cues.en: so that they can feel better about the worlds in which they find themselves.
cues.zh: 讓我們在身處的世界裡感覺好一些。

cues.text: There it is, Gilbert’s big idea: something called Synthetic Happiness.
cues.en: There it is, Gilbert’s big idea: something called Synthetic Happiness.
cues.zh: 這就是吉伯特的核心概念： 「合成幸福」。

cues.text: He goes on to describe how this works.
cues.en: He goes on to describe how this works.
cues.zh: 接下來，他進一步說明 這套機制如何運作。

cues.text: It's like an immune system for the mind.
cues.en: It's like an immune system for the mind.
cues.zh: 它就像心智的免疫系統。

cues.text: Just as the immune system protects our bodies from infection,
cues.en: Just as the immune system protects our bodies from infection,
cues.zh: 如同免疫系統保護我們身體免受感染，

cues.text: synthesized happiness protects our peace of mind.
cues.en: synthesized happiness protects our peace of mind.
cues.zh: 合成幸福則保護我們的內心平靜。

cues.text: Our brains build happiness for themselves, even when things don’t go as planned.
cues.en: Our brains build happiness for themselves, even when things don’t go as planned.
cues.zh: 即使事情沒有按照計畫發展， 我們的大腦仍然能為自己創造幸福。

cues.text: Gilbert got his audience to understand synthesized happiness
cues.en: Gilbert got his audience to understand synthesized happiness
cues.zh: 吉伯特一步一步 讓觀眾理解了合成幸福，

cues.text: by building on the concepts of prefrontal cortex, experience simulator,
cues.en: by building on the concepts of prefrontal cortex, experience simulator,
cues.zh: 方法就是建立在 「前額葉皮質」、「經驗模擬器」

cues.text: and impact bias.
cues.en: and impact bias.
cues.zh: 和「影響偏誤」這些概念之上。

cues.text: And to make it clear, he used another metaphor: the immune system.
cues.en: And to make it clear, he used another metaphor: the immune system.
cues.zh: 為了讓這個概念更加清楚， 他又使用了另一個比喻：「免疫系統」。

cues.text: Gilbert didn’t try to explain his complicated idea in one big leap.
cues.en: Gilbert didn’t try to explain his complicated idea in one big leap.
cues.zh: 吉伯特沒有試圖一步到位地 解釋這個複雜的概念，

cues.text: He got there piece by piece.
cues.en: He got there piece by piece.
cues.zh: 而是一點一點地帶我們理解。

cues.text: After giving us some examples of synthesized happiness in action,
cues.en: After giving us some examples of synthesized happiness in action,
cues.zh: 在舉出幾個合成幸福 實際運作的例子後，

cues.text: He goes on to show how you can live a wiser, happier life
cues.en: He goes on to show how you can live a wiser, happier life
cues.zh: 他進一步說明：只要記得 「合成幸福」確實存在，

cues.text: if you remember synthetic happiness exists.
cues.en: if you remember synthetic happiness exists.
cues.zh: 我們就能活得更明智、更快樂。

cues.text: At the end of the explanation, the way we see the world has been upgraded.
cues.en: At the end of the explanation, the way we see the world has been upgraded.
cues.zh: 這個解釋聽到最後， 我們看待世界的方式也提升了層次。

cues.text: It’s richer, deeper, and truer.
cues.en: It’s richer, deeper, and truer.
cues.zh: 它變得更豐富、更深刻， 也更接近真實。

cues.text: There is a lot of evidence out there
cues.en: There is a lot of evidence out there
cues.zh: 大量證據顯示，

cues.text: suggesting that this is how understanding must be built.
cues.en: suggesting that this is how understanding must be built.
cues.zh: 理解就是必須這樣一步一步建立起來的。

cues.text: Like a tower,
cues.en: Like a tower,
cues.zh: 就像一座高塔，

cues.text: each new block of information supports the next new block of information.
cues.en: each new block of information supports the next new block of information.
cues.zh: 每一塊新的知識， 都建立在前一塊之上。

cues.text: Each bit gets stronger thanks to metaphors and examples.
cues.en: Each bit gets stronger thanks to metaphors and examples.
cues.zh: 每一個理解的片段， 也都因為比喻和例子而變得更加牢固。

cues.text: The metaphors show us the shape of each new idea
cues.en: The metaphors show us the shape of each new idea
cues.zh: 比喻讓我們看見每個新概念的輪廓，

cues.text: so that the mind knows how to recognize it.
cues.en: so that the mind knows how to recognize it.
cues.zh: 讓心智慧夠辨認它、理解它。

cues.text: If the core of your talk is explaining a powerful new idea, it’s helpful to ask:
cues.en: If the core of your talk is explaining a powerful new idea, it’s helpful to ask:
cues.zh: 如果你的演講核心是要解釋 一個重要的新想法，那麼可以問問自己：

cues.en: what do you think your audience already knows?
cues.zh: 你的觀眾已經知道些什麼？

cues.text: What are the building blocks you need to explain your idea?
cues.en: What are the building blocks you need to explain your idea?
cues.zh: 你需要先建立哪些基礎， 才能讓他們理解你的想法？

cues.text: What metaphors and examples can you use
cues.en: What metaphors and examples can you use
cues.zh: 你可以使用哪些比喻和例子，

cues.text: to help listeners understand things they may not be familiar with yet?
cues.en: to help listeners understand things they may not be familiar with yet?
cues.zh: 幫助聽眾理解 那些他們還不熟悉的事物？

cues.text: It can be tricky to spot what things an audience may need help understanding.
cues.en: It can be tricky to spot what things an audience may need help understanding.
cues.zh: 但要看出觀眾究竟需要 哪些幫助，並不容易。

cues.en: We all suffer from something economist Robin Hogarth calls
cues.zh: 我們都受到經濟學家羅賓．霍加斯 所稱的「知識詛咒」影響。

cues.text: “the curse of knowledge.”
cues.en: “the curse of knowledge.”
cues.zh: 簡單來說，我們很難想起，

cues.text: Basically, we find it hard to remember what it feels like not to know something
cues.en: Basically, we find it hard to remember what it feels like not to know something
cues.zh: 簡單來說，我們很難想起，

cues.text: that we ourselves do know.
cues.en: that we ourselves do know.
cues.zh: 在自己還不知道某件事時， 究竟是什麼感覺。

cues.text: This might be the most important requirement for clear communication.
cues.en: This might be the most important requirement for clear communication.
cues.zh: 這可能是清楚溝通最重要的條件。

cues.text: You can’t give a powerful new idea to an audience
cues.en: You can’t give a powerful new idea to an audience
cues.zh: 除非你能想出該怎麼解釋，

cues.text: unless you can figure out how to explain it.
cues.en: unless you can figure out how to explain it.

cues.text: That can only be done step by step, fueled by curiosity.
cues.en: That can only be done step by step, fueled by curiosity.
cues.zh: 而要做到這一點，唯一方法就是 一步一步來，讓好奇心引領他們前進。

cues.text: Foreign exporters could respond to a tariff by reducing their product’s price
cues.en: Foreign exporters could respond to a tariff by reducing their product’s price
cues.zh: 面對關稅，外國出口商 可能會降低產品價格，

cues.text: to keep an importer’s business.
cues.en: to keep an importer’s business.
cues.zh: 以留住進口商這個客戶。

cues.text: But if they don’t, importers bear this cost
cues.en: But if they don’t, importers bear this cost
cues.zh: 如果出口商不願降價， 這筆成本就會由進口商承擔，

cues.text: and then increase their prices so consumers will make up the difference.
cues.en: and then increase their prices so consumers will make up the difference.
cues.zh: 進口商接著會提高商品價格， 讓消費者來負擔這個差額。

cues.text: This may sound straightforward,
cues.en: This may sound straightforward,
cues.zh: 乍看之下，這似乎很簡單，

cues.text: but enacting a tariff kicks off a complicated economic chain reaction.
cues.en: but enacting a tariff kicks off a complicated economic chain reaction.
cues.zh: 但一旦實施關稅，就會引發 一連串複雜的經濟連鎖反應。

cues.text: So to keep things simple,
cues.en: So to keep things simple,
cues.zh: 為了簡單說明，

cues.text: let's look at some examples from just one country
cues.en: let's look at some examples from just one country
cues.zh: 我們先看單一國家的例子，

cues.text: to explore some of the factors that make a tariff’s outcomes tricky to predict.
cues.en: to explore some of the factors that make a tariff’s outcomes tricky to predict.
cues.zh: 藉此瞭解為什麼關稅帶來的後果 往往很難預料。

cues.text: First, tariffs can be applied to different countries at different rates.
cues.en: First, tariffs can be applied to different countries at different rates.
cues.zh: 首先，關稅可能會因進口商品的 來源國不同，而採用不同的稅率。

cues.text: For example, in 2024,
cues.en: For example, in 2024,

cues.text: America had a 6% tariff on all wool entering the country.
cues.en: America had a 6% tariff on all wool entering the country.
cues.zh: 美國對所有進口羊毛課徵 6% 的關稅。

cues.text: However, if that wool came from Mexico or South Korea,
cues.en: However, if that wool came from Mexico or South Korea,
cues.zh: 不過，如果羊毛來自墨西哥或南韓，

cues.text: it would be tariff-free due to trade agreements.
cues.en: it would be tariff-free due to trade agreements.
cues.zh: 根據雙方的貿易協定，就可以免關稅。

cues.text: Meanwhile, importers getting wool from Russia could face a hefty 55.5% tariff.
cues.en: Meanwhile, importers getting wool from Russia could face a hefty 55.5% tariff.
cues.zh: 相較之下，從俄羅斯進口羊毛的進口商 得繳納高達 55.5% 的關稅。

cues.text: Policies like these might help domestic wool producers,
cues.en: Policies like these might help domestic wool producers,
cues.zh: 這樣的政策可能 對國內的羊毛生產商有利，

cues.text: or they might just encourage importers to buy from specific foreign producers.
cues.en: or they might just encourage importers to buy from specific foreign producers.
cues.zh: 也可能只是讓進口商 改向特定國家的生產商採購。

cues.text: Things get even trickier when trying to predict how tariffs impact jobs.
cues.en: Things get even trickier when trying to predict how tariffs impact jobs.
cues.zh: 當我們試圖預測關稅會如何 影響就業時，事情就更加複雜了。

cues.text: Sometimes the jobs they create come at a high cost.
cues.en: Sometimes the jobs they create come at a high cost.
cues.zh: 有時候，關稅所創造的 工作機會，代價其實相當高。

cues.text: In 2018, the US imposed a tariff on washing machines
cues.en: In 2018, the US imposed a tariff on washing machines
cues.zh: 2018 年，美國對進口洗衣機課徵關稅，

cues.text: that created 1,800 jobs
cues.en: that created 1,800 jobs
cues.zh: 創造了 1,800 個工作機會，

cues.text: and raised roughly $82 million in government revenue.
cues.en: and raised roughly $82 million in government revenue.
cues.zh: 也為政府帶來大約 8,200 萬美元的稅收。

cues.text: However, it also increased the average price of washing machines by $86,
cues.en: However, it also increased the average price of washing machines by $86,
cues.zh: 然而，這項政策也讓洗衣機的 平均價格提高了 86 美元，

cues.text: costing consumers roughly $1.5 billion.
cues.en: costing consumers roughly $1.5 billion.
cues.zh: 讓消費者多支出約 15 億美元。

cues.text: This means consumers paid roughly $817,000 to create each of those jobs.
cues.en: This means consumers paid roughly $817,000 to create each of those jobs.
cues.zh: 換句話說，為了創造這些工作機會，

cues.text: In other cases, the jobs tariffs create come at the cost of existing jobs.
cues.en: In other cases, the jobs tariffs create come at the cost of existing jobs.
cues.zh: 有些情況則是，關稅創造了新的工作， 卻也讓原有的工作消失。

cues.text: In 2002, the Bush administration imposed tariffs as high as 30%
cues.en: In 2002, the Bush administration imposed tariffs as high as 30%
cues.zh: 2002 年，布希政府對進口鋼鐵 課徵最高達 30% 的關稅。

cues.text: on imported steel.
cues.en: on imported steel.
cues.zh: 當時，美國鋼鐵業的就業人數 已經衰退了幾十年，

cues.text: Employment in US steel production had been decaying for decades,
cues.en: Employment in US steel production had been decaying for decades,
cues.zh: 當時，美國鋼鐵業的就業人數 已經衰退了幾十年，

cues.text: so by making foreign steel more expensive,
cues.en: so by making foreign steel more expensive,
cues.zh: 因此政府希望藉由 提高外國鋼鐵的價格，

cues.text: the tariff sought to create new jobs for US steel manufacturers.
cues.en: the tariff sought to create new jobs for US steel manufacturers.
cues.zh: 為美國鋼鐵製造商創造新的工作機會。

cues.text: Initially, the policy did slow down job loss.
cues.en: Initially, the policy did slow down job loss.
cues.zh: 起初，這項政策確實 減緩了失業的速度。

cues.text: But since US steel still cost more than pre-tariff foreign steel,
cues.en: But since US steel still cost more than pre-tariff foreign steel,
cues.zh: 然而，由於美國鋼鐵的價格 仍高於課徵關稅前的進口鋼材，

cues.text: domestic industries that used this material had to increase their prices.
cues.en: domestic industries that used this material had to increase their prices.
cues.zh: 使用鋼鐵作為原料的國內產業 也只好提高產品價格。

cues.text: This made their products less competitive internationally,
cues.en: This made their products less competitive internationally,
cues.zh: 這讓它們在國際市場上的競爭力下降，

cues.text: where foreign manufacturers were still using cheap steel.
cues.en: where foreign manufacturers were still using cheap steel.
cues.zh: 因為外國製造商仍然使用便宜的鋼材。

cues.text: Within a year of enacting the tariff,
cues.en: Within a year of enacting the tariff,
cues.zh: 一年之內，美國在鋼鐵相關產業 流失的工作機會，

cues.text: the US lost far more jobs in steel-related industries
cues.en: the US lost far more jobs in steel-related industries
cues.zh: 一年之內，美國在鋼鐵相關產業 流失的工作機會，

cues.text: than they gained in steel-producing industries.
cues.en: than they gained in steel-producing industries.
cues.zh: 就遠遠超過鋼鐵生產業 所新增的工作機會。

cues.text: Clearly, how other countries respond to tariffs
cues.en: Clearly, how other countries respond to tariffs
cues.zh: 顯然，其他國家如何回應關稅，

cues.text: is another big part of the ripple effect these policies have.
cues.en: is another big part of the ripple effect these policies have.
cues.zh: 也是這些政策所引發 連鎖效應中的重要一環。

cues.text: One clear example comes from 2018,
cues.en: One clear example comes from 2018,
cues.zh: 2018 年就有一個很清楚的例子。

cues.text: when the US attempted to address its trade deficit with China
cues.en: when the US attempted to address its trade deficit with China
cues.zh: 當時，美國試圖透過 對中國商品課徵關稅，

cues.text: by taxing Chinese goods.
cues.en: by taxing Chinese goods.
cues.zh: 來改善美中之間的貿易逆差。

cues.text: While these tariffs protected domestic businesses
cues.en: While these tariffs protected domestic businesses
cues.zh: 這些關稅雖然保護了美國國內企業，

cues.text: and raised government revenue,
cues.en: and raised government revenue,
cues.zh: 也增加了政府收入，

cues.text: they also set off a trade war.
cues.en: they also set off a trade war.
cues.zh: 卻同時引發一場貿易戰。

cues.text: China retaliated by raising tariffs on US exporters,
cues.en: China retaliated by raising tariffs on US exporters,
cues.zh: 中國提高美國商品的 進口關稅作為報復，

cues.text: including farmers relying on Chinese markets for soybean sales.
cues.en: including farmers relying on Chinese markets for soybean sales.
cues.zh: 其中包括美國農民仰賴 中國銷售的黃豆。

cues.text: In the end, this led to higher prices for US consumers
cues.en: In the end, this led to higher prices for US consumers
cues.zh: 最後，這場貿易戰導致美國消費者 承受更高的物價，

cues.text: and a slight drop in America's GDP.
cues.en: and a slight drop in America's GDP.
cues.zh: 也讓美國的國內生產毛額 （GDP）小幅下降。

cues.text: Trade wars aren’t new.
cues.en: Trade wars aren’t new.
cues.zh: 貿易戰並不是新鮮事。

cues.text: And even in the 18th and early 19th centuries,
cues.en: And even in the 18th and early 19th centuries,
cues.zh: 在 18 世紀和 19 世紀初，

cues.text: when certain tariffs did help struggling industries find their domestic footing,
cues.en: when certain tariffs did help struggling industries find their domestic footing,
cues.zh: 即使某些關稅政策確實有助 陷入困境的產業在國內站穩腳步，

cues.text: they were mostly used to raise government funds.
cues.en: they were mostly used to raise government funds.
cues.zh: 關稅最主要的用途仍是增加政府收入。

cues.text: But over the last 200 years,
cues.en: But over the last 200 years,
cues.zh: 但過去 200 年來，

cues.text: our global economy has become far more interdependent.
cues.en: our global economy has become far more interdependent.
cues.zh: 全球經濟的相互依賴程度 已經大幅提高。

cues.text: Today, there are more manufacturing components
cues.en: Today, there are more manufacturing components
cues.zh: 如今，各國進口的 製造零元件之多，更甚以往，

cues.text: being imported than ever before,
cues.en: being imported than ever before,
cues.zh: 如今，各國進口的 製造零元件之多，更甚以往，

cues.text: many of which are used to make a wide variety of consumer goods.
cues.en: many of which are used to make a wide variety of consumer goods.
cues.zh: 而其中許多零元件又會被用來 製造各式各樣的消費商品。

cues.text: This complexity means that even a seemingly simple tariff
cues.en: This complexity means that even a seemingly simple tariff
cues.zh: 這種複雜的經濟關係意味著，

cues.text: can trigger a global chain reaction,
cues.en: can trigger a global chain reaction,
cues.zh: 即使看似簡單的一項關稅， 也可能引發全球性的連鎖反應，

cues.text: creating more consequences than anyone can plan for.
cues.en: creating more consequences than anyone can plan for.
cues.zh: 造成遠超乎預期的後果。

JOs-q7rXqdk.title: 4 Ways to Tell a Great Story

cues.text: Your first job as a speaker is to build a trusting human bond
cues.en: Your first job as a speaker is to build a trusting human bond
cues.zh: 演講者首先要做的，

cues.text: with your audience.
cues.en: with your audience.
cues.zh: 和聽眾建立連結的 一個好方法，就是說故事。

cues.text: One excellent way to connect to an audience is to tell a story.
cues.en: One excellent way to connect to an audience is to tell a story.
cues.zh: 和聽眾建立連結的 一個好方法，就是說故事。

cues.text: Stories helped make us who we are.
cues.en: Stories helped make us who we are.
cues.zh: 故事塑造了我們， 讓我們成為今天的樣子。

cues.text: Really — evidence left behind from our ancient ancestors
cues.en: Really — evidence left behind from our ancient ancestors
cues.zh: 真的，我們的遠古祖先 留下的證據顯示，

cues.text: suggests that the human mind developed alongside human storytelling.
cues.en: suggests that the human mind developed alongside human storytelling.
cues.zh: 人類心智的發展， 是隨著說故事的能力一起進步的。

cues.text: Fire created a new magnet for bonding.
cues.en: Fire created a new magnet for bonding.
cues.zh: 火堆提供人們情感連結的凝聚力。

cues.text: Its warmth and flickering light drew people together after dark.
cues.en: Its warmth and flickering light drew people together after dark.
cues.zh: 天黑之後，火的溫暖與搖曳的光芒， 將人們聚集在一起。

cues.text: This seems to have happened in every ancient culture
cues.en: This seems to have happened in every ancient culture
cues.zh: 過去三十萬年來，

cues.text: over the last 300,000 years.
cues.en: over the last 300,000 years.
cues.zh: 這樣的情景似乎出現在 每一個古老文化中。

cues.text: And what did our ancestors do with this time together?
cues.en: And what did our ancestors do with this time together?
cues.zh: 那麼，我們的祖先會利用 這段團聚時光做什麼事呢？

cues.text: In many cultures,
cues.en: In many cultures,
cues.zh: 在許多文化裡，

cues.text: one type of communal activity became very important: storytelling.
cues.en: one type of communal activity became very important: storytelling.
cues.zh: 有一項共同活動顯得特別重要， 那就是說故事。

cues.text: Stories brought people from faraway places to the fireside.
cues.en: Stories brought people from faraway places to the fireside.
cues.zh: 故事把來自遠方的人吸引到火堆旁。

cues.text: Stories about people who were alive and people who were dead,
cues.en: Stories about people who were alive and people who were dead,
cues.zh: 故事描述活著的人，也講述死去的人；

cues.text: nearby and in distant lands.
cues.en: nearby and in distant lands.
cues.zh: 故事裡有附近的人， 也有生活在遙遠土地上的人。

cues.text: Stories sparked laughter, tension, and amazement.
cues.en: Stories sparked laughter, tension, and amazement.
cues.zh: 故事讓人笑、讓人屏息，也讓人驚嘆。

cues.text: Stories also played an important role in helping expand people’s ability
cues.en: Stories also played an important role in helping expand people’s ability
cues.zh: 故事另一個重要功能是

cues.text: to imagine and to dream, and to understand the minds of others.
cues.en: to imagine and to dream, and to understand the minds of others.
cues.zh: 幫助人們拓展想像力與夢想，

cues.text: Storytellers became important people within a community,
cues.en: Storytellers became important people within a community,
cues.zh: 說書人逐漸成為社群中的重要人物，

cues.text: and their listeners took information from the stories
cues.en: and their listeners took information from the stories
cues.zh: 而聽故事的人也會 從故事中得到一些訊息，

cues.text: that changed how they behaved in the world.
cues.en: that changed how they behaved in the world.
cues.zh: 進而影響他們看待世界和行事的方式。

cues.text: It's not just that we all love hearing stories.
cues.en: It's not just that we all love hearing stories.
cues.zh: 這不只是因為每個人都喜歡聽故事，

cues.text: Stories probably helped shape how our minds share and receive information.
cues.en: Stories probably helped shape how our minds share and receive information.
cues.zh: 而是故事很可能早已形塑了 我們分享與接收資訊的方式。

cues.text: So it's no surprise that many of the best talks are built around a story.
cues.en: So it's no surprise that many of the best talks are built around a story.
cues.zh: 難怪，許多精彩的演講 都是以故事為核心。

cues.text: The most basic way of breaking down a story is this:
cues.en: The most basic way of breaking down a story is this:
cues.zh: 最基本的故事結構，可以這樣拆解：

cues.text: a character with a goal meets an unexpected obstacle.
cues.en: a character with a goal meets an unexpected obstacle.
cues.zh: 一個角色，有追求的目標， 遇上了意料之外的障礙。

cues.text: She tries to overcome that obstacle, which builds to a peak in the action.
cues.en: She tries to overcome that obstacle, which builds to a peak in the action.
cues.zh: 她試著克服這個障礙， 情節因此逐漸推向高潮。

cues.text: Finally, there’s some kind of resolution to the conflict.
cues.en: Finally, there’s some kind of resolution to the conflict.
cues.zh: 最後，衝突以某種方式獲得解決。

cues.text: When it comes to sharing a story from the stage,
cues.en: When it comes to sharing a story from the stage,
cues.zh: 如果你要在臺上分享一個故事，

cues.text: remember four key things:
cues.en: remember four key things:
cues.zh: 請記住四件重要的事。

cues.text: 1. Base the story around a character your audience can empathize with.
cues.en: 1. Base the story around a character your audience can empathize with.
cues.zh: 第一，讓故事圍繞著一個 聽眾能夠產生共鳴的角色。

cues.text: 2. Build tension,
cues.en: 2. Build tension,
cues.zh: 第二，營造緊張感，

cues.text: either through curiosity, relationship with other characters, or actual danger.
cues.en: either through curiosity, relationship with other characters, or actual danger.
cues.zh: 可以勾起好奇心、發展人物關係， 或加入真正的危險。

cues.text: 3. Offer the right level of detail.
cues.en: 3. Offer the right level of detail.
cues.zh: 第三，提供適量的細節。

cues.text: If there's not enough, the story won't come to life.
cues.en: If there's not enough, the story won't come to life.
cues.zh: 如果細節不夠，故事就無法鮮活起來；

cues.text: If there's too much, it will get bogged down.
cues.en: If there's too much, it will get bogged down.
cues.zh: 但如果細節太多，故事又會拖泥帶水。

cues.text: And, 4. End with a satisfying conclusion, whether it’s funny, moving, or surprising.
cues.en: And, 4. End with a satisfying conclusion, whether it’s funny, moving, or surprising.
cues.zh: 第四，用令人滿意的結尾收束故事， 不論結尾好笑、感人，還是出人意料。

cues.text: Some great talks are built around a single story.
cues.en: Some great talks are built around a single story.
cues.zh: 有些精彩的演講， 就圍繞著一個故事展開。

cues.text: This can be really helpful for a speaker.
cues.en: This can be really helpful for a speaker.
cues.zh: 對演講者來說，這是很有幫助的，

cues.text: The throughline is simply the plot of the story.
cues.en: The throughline is simply the plot of the story.
cues.zh: 因為故事的情節本身， 就能成為整場演講的主線。

cues.text: If the story is about you, it can even create empathy in the audience.
cues.en: If the story is about you, it can even create empathy in the audience.
cues.zh: 如果故事講的是你自己的經歷， 還能讓聽眾對你產生同理心。

cues.text: If your journey is exciting and easy to follow,
cues.en: If your journey is exciting and easy to follow,
cues.zh: 如果你的故事精彩，情節又清楚易懂，

cues.text: this type of talk can work really well.
cues.en: this type of talk can work really well.
cues.zh: 這種演講方式就能發揮很好的效果。

cues.text: But there's a trap here too.
cues.en: But there's a trap here too.
cues.zh: 但這裡也有一個陷阱。

cues.text: Remember, the goal is to give.
cues.en: Remember, the goal is to give.
cues.zh: 別忘了，演講的目的 是要帶給聽眾一些東西。

cues.text: Personal stories may entertain or interest an audience,
cues.en: Personal stories may entertain or interest an audience,
cues.zh: 個人故事也許能娛樂或吸引聽眾，

cues.text: or make the speaker feel really good about themselves,
cues.en: or make the speaker feel really good about themselves,
cues.zh: 或者讓演講者自我感覺良好，

cues.text: but they don’t necessarily give the audience
cues.en: but they don’t necessarily give the audience
cues.zh: 但不一定能讓聽眾得到有價值的東西，

cues.text: something they can walk away with;
cues.en: something they can walk away with;
cues.zh: 例如新的觀點、實用的資訊、 看事情的脈絡，或一點希望。

cues.text: a new way of understanding things, actionable information, context, hope.
cues.en: a new way of understanding things, actionable information, context, hope.
cues.zh: 例如新的觀點、實用的資訊、 看事情的脈絡，或一點希望。

cues.text: And that’s a real shame.
cues.en: And that’s a real shame.
cues.zh: 如果沒有這些，那就真的很可惜。

cues.text: The key is to link together the important moments of your story
