cues.zh: 對不起。

cues.text: And I chose to walk away from my job at Harvard
cues.en: And I chose to walk away from my job at Harvard
cues.zh: 最後，我選擇離開哈佛的工作，

cues.text: a year before going up for tenure.
cues.en: a year before going up for tenure.
cues.zh: 那時距離我爭取終身職只剩一年。

cues.text: Not because I was forced to,
cues.en: Not because I was forced to,
cues.zh: 不是因為有人逼我離開，

cues.text: but because I knew that staying meant certain death.
cues.en: but because I knew that staying meant certain death.
cues.zh: 而是因為我知道， 留下來就等於自尋死路。

cues.text: And so ...
cues.en: And so ...
cues.zh: 於是……

cues.text: Eventually,
cues.en: Eventually,
cues.zh: 最後，

cues.text: I tried to take my own life twice,
cues.en: I tried to take my own life twice,
cues.zh: 我曾經兩次試圖自殺，

cues.text: because this kind of bullying
cues.en: because this kind of bullying
cues.zh: 因為這種霸凌同時具有 兩種可怕的面貌：

cues.text: is simultaneously this horrible public spectacle
cues.en: is simultaneously this horrible public spectacle
cues.zh: 一方面是一場公開羞辱的巨大鬧劇，

cues.text: of shame where you're in a spotlight.
cues.en: of shame where you're in a spotlight.
cues.zh: 讓你被聚光燈照得無所遁形；

cues.text: And at the same time,
cues.en: And at the same time,
cues.zh: 另一方面，

cues.text: it's a total erasure of who you are
cues.en: it's a total erasure of who you are
cues.zh: 它又徹底抹去你的身分，

cues.text: and what you've done.
cues.en: and what you've done.
cues.zh: 以及你過往的成就。

cues.text: Many targets don't survive.
cues.en: Many targets don't survive.
cues.zh: 很多成為霸凌目標的人， 最後都沒能活下來。

cues.text: And I do want to say, before I go forward, to the targets:
cues.en: And I do want to say, before I go forward, to the targets:
cues.zh: 在我繼續說下去之前， 我想先對那些成為目標的人說：

cues.text: I understand.
cues.en: I understand.
cues.zh: 我瞭解。

cues.text: I see you, and I know that what seems incredible --
cues.en: I see you, and I know that what seems incredible --
cues.zh: 我懂你，我知道那些 看似不可思議的事——

cues.text: happened.
cues.en: happened.
cues.zh: 確實發生了。

cues.text: But.
cues.en: But.
cues.zh: 但是，

cues.text: This is not a talk about despair.
cues.en: This is not a talk about despair.
cues.zh: 這個演講不是要談絕望。

cues.text: This is a talk about earned hope.
cues.en: This is a talk about earned hope.
cues.zh: 我想談的是「得來不易的希望」。

cues.text: I've been a social psychologist for 25 years,
cues.en: I've been a social psychologist for 25 years,
cues.zh: 我從事社會心理學研究已有 25 年，

cues.text: studying the forces that affect how we treat each other and judge each other.
cues.en: studying the forces that affect how we treat each other and judge each other.
cues.zh: 研究影響我們彼此相待和 評判方式的種種因素。

cues.text: But I've spent the last eight
cues.en: But I've spent the last eight
cues.zh: 但過去八年，

cues.text: focused on how cruelty becomes collective.
cues.en: focused on how cruelty becomes collective.
cues.zh: 我一直專注研究， 殘酷如何成為集體行為，

cues.text: How truth becomes distorted.
cues.en: How truth becomes distorted.
cues.zh: 真相如何被扭曲，

cues.text: How people decide that one person should be pushed out of the group.
cues.en: How people decide that one person should be pushed out of the group.
cues.zh: 人們如何決定要把某個人逐出群體。

cues.text: But also, more importantly,
cues.en: But also, more importantly,
cues.zh: 但更重要的是，

cues.text: what are the things that we can do
cues.en: what are the things that we can do
cues.zh: 我們能做些什麼，

cues.text: to prevent those cultures from taking hold before they harden.
cues.en: to prevent those cultures from taking hold before they harden.
cues.zh: 在這些文化成形、僵化之前， 就阻止它們蔓延。

cues.text: And what I've learned is this.
cues.en: And what I've learned is this.
cues.zh: 以下是我所學到的。

cues.text: First, bullying is not conflict.
cues.en: First, bullying is not conflict.
cues.zh: 首先，霸凌不是衝突。

cues.text: It's not a debate,
cues.en: It's not a debate,
cues.zh: 它不是辯論，

cues.text: it's not criticism,
cues.en: it's not criticism,
cues.zh: 不是批評，

cues.text: it's not humor that you're too sensitive to take well.
cues.en: it's not humor that you're too sensitive to take well.
cues.zh: 也不是你太敏感、 才承受不了的玩笑。

cues.text: It is a deliberately targeted,
cues.en: It is a deliberately targeted,
cues.zh: 霸凌是由多人刻意針對一個人，

cues.text: serial, escalating pattern of attacks
cues.en: serial, escalating pattern of attacks
cues.zh: 一次又一次發動愈演愈烈的攻擊，

cues.text: carried out by multiple people,
cues.en: carried out by multiple people,
cues.zh: 一次又一次發動愈演愈烈的攻擊，

cues.text: and it's intended to destroy a person's reputation
cues.en: and it's intended to destroy a person's reputation
cues.zh: 目的就是摧毀那個人的聲譽，

cues.text: and their ability to contribute.
cues.en: and their ability to contribute.
cues.zh: 以及他為群體做出貢獻的能力。

cues.text: It unfolds in predictable stages.
cues.en: It unfolds in predictable stages.
cues.zh: 霸凌依循可預測的階段一步步發展。

cues.text: And it usually ends with someone being completely silenced
cues.en: And it usually ends with someone being completely silenced
cues.zh: 而結局通常就是讓某個人徹底噤聲，

cues.text: or disappearing completely.
cues.en: or disappearing completely.
cues.zh: 或者徹底消失。

cues.text: This is really important.
cues.en: This is really important.
cues.zh: 這一點非常重要。

cues.text: Bullies are rare.
cues.en: Bullies are rare.
cues.zh: 霸凌者是少數。

cues.text: They're rare.
cues.en: They're rare.
cues.zh: 他們是少數。

cues.text: Most of us are not bullies.
cues.en: Most of us are not bullies.
cues.zh: 我們大多數人都不是霸凌者。

cues.text: Bullies share one thing:
cues.en: Bullies share one thing:
cues.zh: 霸凌者有一個共同點：

cues.text: a worldview.
cues.en: a worldview.
cues.zh: 他們有一套特定的世界觀。

cues.text: In their worldview,
cues.en: In their worldview,
cues.zh: 在他們的世界裡，

cues.text: the world is hostile,
cues.en: the world is hostile,
cues.zh: 世界充滿敵意，

cues.text: people are fundamentally bad,
cues.en: people are fundamentally bad,
cues.zh: 人性本惡，

cues.text: everything of value is scarce,
cues.en: everything of value is scarce,
cues.zh: 有價值的東西都是稀缺的，

cues.text: it’s all zero-sum.
cues.en: it’s all zero-sum.
cues.zh: 樣樣都是零和遊戲。

cues.text: Your achievement is their loss.
cues.en: Your achievement is their loss.
cues.zh: 你的成就，就是他們的損失。

cues.text: They have an insatiable need for recognition and status and dominance,
cues.en: They have an insatiable need for recognition and status and dominance,
cues.zh: 他們對認可、地位和主導優勢 有著永遠無法滿足的渴望，

cues.text: and they prove their dominance
cues.en: and they prove their dominance
cues.zh: 而他們證明自己具有主導地位的方式，

cues.text: by publicly demonstrating that they can force a target,
cues.en: by publicly demonstrating that they can force a target,
cues.zh: 就是公開展示自己能迫使一個目標——

cues.text: a valuable target, to fully submit.
cues.en: a valuable target, to fully submit.
cues.zh: 有價值的目標——完全屈服。

cues.text: That's what bullying is.
cues.en: That's what bullying is.
cues.zh: 這就是霸凌的本質。

cues.text: Bullying has been on the rise among adults for the last 15 years.
cues.en: Bullying has been on the rise among adults for the last 15 years.
cues.zh: 過去 15 年來， 成人間的霸凌現象與日俱增。

cues.text: Digital platforms make bullying faster, easier, louder.
cues.en: Digital platforms make bullying faster, easier, louder.
cues.zh: 數位平臺讓霸凌變得更快、 更容易，聲勢也更浩大。

cues.text: And the bullies' lies last forever now.
cues.en: And the bullies' lies last forever now.
cues.zh: 如今，霸凌者散播的謊言 甚至可以永遠留存。

cues.text: So ...
cues.en: So ...
cues.zh: 那麼……

cues.text: What do we do?
cues.en: What do we do?
cues.zh: 我們該怎麼辦？

cues.text: The first thing to understand is that bullies need us.
cues.en: The first thing to understand is that bullies need us.
cues.zh: 首先，我們必須明白， 霸凌者需要我們。

cues.text: Bullies need an audience.
cues.en: Bullies need an audience.
cues.zh: 霸凌者需要觀眾。

cues.text: They need people to carry out their agenda.
cues.en: They need people to carry out their agenda.
cues.zh: 他們需要有人替他們達成目的。

cues.text: When we just watch and remain silent,
cues.en: When we just watch and remain silent,
cues.zh: 當我們袖手旁觀、保持沉默時，

cues.text: we're what I call passive bystanders.
cues.en: we're what I call passive bystanders.
cues.zh: 我們就成為所謂的「被動旁觀者」。

cues.text: When we join in and amplify and share an attack,
cues.en: When we join in and amplify and share an attack,
cues.zh: 當我們加入其中， 助紂為虐、轉傳攻擊時，

cues.text: we're what I call accessory bullies.
cues.en: we're what I call accessory bullies.
cues.zh: 我們就成了「霸凌的幫兇」。

cues.text: But if we refuse our participation,
cues.en: But if we refuse our participation,
cues.zh: 但如果我們拒絕參與，

cues.text: a lone bully is impotent.
cues.en: a lone bully is impotent.
cues.zh: 孤立的霸凌者就無能為力。

cues.text: Without us, a bully is impotent.
cues.en: Without us, a bully is impotent.
cues.zh: 沒有我們，霸凌者就無能為力。

cues.text: (Applause)
cues.en: (Applause)
cues.zh: （掌聲）

cues.text: Second, we need to learn to spot the opening.
cues.en: Second, we need to learn to spot the opening.
cues.zh: 第二，我們要學會察覺介入的時機。

cues.text: When we get in early,
cues.en: When we get in early,
cues.zh: 如果我們及早介入，

cues.text: we can totally derail this.
cues.en: we can totally derail this.
cues.zh: 就能徹底阻撓霸凌的程序。

cues.text: It starts with what I call a “bully test.”
cues.en: It starts with what I call a “bully test.”
cues.zh: 事情往往從我所謂的 「霸凌測試」開始。

cues.text: The bully tests the audience to see if they can get away
cues.en: The bully tests the audience to see if they can get away
cues.zh: 霸凌者會先試探旁觀者，

cues.text: with bullying that person.
cues.en: with bullying that person.
cues.zh: 可能是在專業場合 說出非常不恰當的話，

cues.text: It might be a really inappropriate comment in a professional setting,
cues.en: It might be a really inappropriate comment in a professional setting,
cues.zh: 可能是在專業場合 說出非常不恰當的話，

cues.text: or it might be an accusation
cues.en: or it might be an accusation
cues.zh: 也可能是對某人提出 足以摧毀其聲譽的指控，

cues.text: against someone that’s reputation-destroying,
cues.en: against someone that’s reputation-destroying,
cues.zh: 卻沒有任何證據支援。

cues.text: but not backed by evidence.
cues.en: but not backed by evidence.
cues.zh: 卻沒有任何證據支援。

cues.text: When we hear those things and we stay silent or we laugh,
cues.en: When we hear those things and we stay silent or we laugh,
cues.zh: 當我們聽到這些話， 卻保持沉默，甚至跟著笑，

cues.text: we're just saying to the bully, "Go forward."
cues.en: we're just saying to the bully, "Go forward."
cues.zh: 我們其實就是在 對霸凌者說：「繼續。」

cues.text: And that's when they launch their attack.
cues.en: And that's when they launch their attack.
cues.zh: 而這時，他們就會發動攻擊。

cues.text: We also need to practice social bravery.
cues.en: We also need to practice social bravery.
cues.zh: 我們還需要培養所謂的「社會勇氣」。

cues.text: These small risks that we take to defend each other,
cues.en: These small risks that we take to defend each other,
cues.zh: 也就是在人際相處時， 願意冒一點小小的風險，

cues.text: to support each other interpersonally.
cues.en: to support each other interpersonally.
cues.zh: 為彼此挺身而出、支援彼此。

cues.text: And social bravery is risky.
cues.en: And social bravery is risky.
cues.zh: 而社會勇氣確實伴隨風險。

cues.text: So we need to distribute the risk across people.
cues.en: So we need to distribute the risk across people.
cues.zh: 所以，我們需要讓更多人 共同承擔這個風險。

cues.text: We need to do it together.
cues.en: We need to do it together.
cues.zh: 我們需要一起做。

cues.text: It is so much easier for two people to do it
cues.en: It is so much easier for two people to do it
cues.zh: 兩個人一起做， 要比一個人單獨做容易得多。

cues.text: than for one person to do it.
cues.en: than for one person to do it.
cues.zh: 當一名旁觀者以明確、 顯著的方式挺身而出，

cues.text: When one bystander steps in, in a way that’s noticeable,
cues.en: When one bystander steps in, in a way that’s noticeable,
cues.zh: 當一名旁觀者以明確、 顯著的方式挺身而出，

cues.text: others step in.
cues.en: others step in.
cues.zh: 其他人也會跟著站出來。

cues.text: And we know from research on changing social conventions
cues.en: And we know from research on changing social conventions
cues.zh: 從改變社會規範的研究中，我們知道，

cues.text: that when about 25 percent of people step in,
cues.en: that when about 25 percent of people step in,
cues.zh: 當大約 25% 的人願意挺身而出，

cues.text: they can flip a social norm completely.
cues.en: they can flip a social norm completely.
cues.zh: 就能徹底扭轉一項社會規範。

cues.text: Bullying is not a personal problem.
cues.en: Bullying is not a personal problem.
cues.zh: 霸凌不是個人的問題，

cues.text: It's a collective problem.
cues.en: It's a collective problem.
cues.zh: 而是集體的問題。

cues.text: And we can fix it.
cues.en: And we can fix it.
cues.zh: 我們可以解決。

cues.text: So after eight years of writing this book,
cues.en: So after eight years of writing this book,
cues.zh: 花了八年寫完這本書後，

cues.text: I turned it in a few months ago.
cues.en: I turned it in a few months ago.
cues.zh: 我幾個月前把稿子交了出去。

cues.text: Right after that,
cues.en: Right after that,
cues.zh: 緊接著，

cues.text: I traveled to Greeley, Colorado,
cues.en: I traveled to Greeley, Colorado,
cues.zh: 我前往科羅拉多州的格里利，

cues.text: a small city in the High Plains
cues.en: a small city in the High Plains
cues.zh: 一座位於高地平原地區的小城市。

cues.text: that was raw,
cues.en: that was raw,
cues.zh: 當時那裡氣氛緊繃、

cues.text: politically divided, on edge.
cues.en: politically divided, on edge.
cues.zh: 政治立場分裂，劍拔弩張。

cues.text: I could feel the vigilance in the air when I looked at them.
cues.en: I could feel the vigilance in the air when I looked at them.
cues.zh: 我看著聽眾，就能感受到 現場瀰漫著戒備的氣氛。

cues.text: I spoke about personal power and trust,
cues.en: I spoke about personal power and trust,
cues.zh: 我談到個人力量與信任，

cues.text: and at the end the moderator said her last question to me was this.
cues.en: and at the end the moderator said her last question to me was this.
cues.zh: 最後，主持人問我一個問題。

cues.text: She said,
cues.en: She said,
cues.zh: 她說：

cues.text: "Is there one piece of leadership advice
cues.en: "Is there one piece of leadership advice
cues.zh: 「能不能給我們一項你從未分享過的

cues.text: that you haven't really shared?"
cues.en: that you haven't really shared?"
cues.zh: 有關領導力的建議？」

cues.text: And I said, “Yeah.
cues.en: And I said, “Yeah.
cues.zh: 我說：「好的。

cues.text: We'll never win by bullying the bullies.
cues.en: We'll never win by bullying the bullies.
cues.zh: 我們永遠不可能靠霸凌霸凌者來獲勝。

cues.text: We cannot validate their worldview.
cues.en: We cannot validate their worldview.
cues.zh: 我們不能認可他們的世界觀是對的。

cues.text: As soon as we tell them that the world has to be brutal,
cues.en: As soon as we tell them that the world has to be brutal,
cues.zh: 因為一旦我們告訴他們， 這個世界本來就必須如此殘酷，

cues.text: they say, ’See?
cues.en: they say, ’See?
cues.zh: 他們就會說：『你看吧？

cues.text: That’s why I have to behave this way.“’
cues.en: That’s why I have to behave this way.“’
cues.zh: 所以我才得這樣做。』」

cues.text: I told them you don’t have to show how much you can hate
cues.en: I told them you don’t have to show how much you can hate
cues.zh: 我告訴他們，你不需要展現 自己有多恨一個人，

cues.text: to prove how much you care, or to prove that you belong.
cues.en: to prove how much you care, or to prove that you belong.
cues.zh: 才能證明你有多在乎，

cues.text: And I looked out and I saw their shoulders relax.
cues.en: And I looked out and I saw their shoulders relax.
cues.zh: 我看向臺下，看見聽眾的肩膀 放鬆了下來。

cues.text: I saw a flicker of hope in their faces.
cues.en: I saw a flicker of hope in their faces.
cues.zh: 我看見他們臉上閃過一絲希望。

cues.text: I felt them collectively exhale.
cues.en: I felt them collectively exhale.
cues.zh: 我感覺到他們一起鬆了一口氣。

cues.text: And the next day a woman wrote to me.
cues.en: And the next day a woman wrote to me.
cues.zh: 第二天，一位女士寫信給我。

cues.text: And she said, "I was at your talk.
cues.en: And she said, "I was at your talk.
cues.zh: 她說：「我當時在現場聽你的演講。

cues.text: And I noticed something interesting as I left the venue.
cues.en: And I noticed something interesting as I left the venue.
cues.zh: 離開會場時，我注意到 一件很有意思的事。

cues.text: The crowd was unusually cheerful and courteous.
cues.en: The crowd was unusually cheerful and courteous.
cues.zh: 群眾異常地愉快，也特別有禮貌。

cues.text: Several drive aisles wove together toward the exits,
cues.en: Several drive aisles wove together toward the exits,
cues.zh: 好幾條車道交織著通往出口，

cues.text: and everyone was alternating and letting each other in.
cues.en: and everyone was alternating and letting each other in.
cues.zh: 而每個人都輪流讓對方先走。

cues.text: No one was saying with their actions
cues.en: No one was saying with their actions
cues.zh: 沒有人用行動表現出 「我比別人重要」。

cues.text: that they were more important than another person.
cues.en: that they were more important than another person.
cues.zh: 沒有人用行動表現出 「我比別人重要」。

cues.text: I just wanted to share the observation
cues.en: I just wanted to share the observation
cues.zh: 我只是想告訴你，我觀察到：

cues.text: that you made an immediate, positive and tangible difference."
cues.en: that you made an immediate, positive and tangible difference."
cues.zh: 你的演講帶來了立即、 正面而具體的改變。」

cues.text: (Applause)
cues.en: (Applause)
cues.zh: （掌聲）

cues.text: We want to be neighbors again.
cues.en: We want to be neighbors again.
cues.zh: 我們想重新成為鄰居。

cues.text: We want to go to our kids' friends' birthday parties
cues.en: We want to go to our kids' friends' birthday parties
cues.zh: 我們想去參加孩子朋友的生日派對，

cues.en: I've always secretly wanted to be a machine.

cues.en: I knew there were people out there that were like this, and I wanted to know what makes them tick.

cues.text: So a few years ago, I started a newsletter called Super Organizers, where I profiled 50 of the top performers in a variety of fields.
cues.en: So a few years ago, I started a newsletter called Super Organizers, where I profiled 50 of the top performers in a variety of fields.

cues.en: I've talked to managers who track everything they do in a day in 15-minute increments.

cues.en: I've also experimented with a lot of hacks myself to try to get me closer to my ideal.

cues.text: The ideal of being a machine is actually a trap.
cues.en: The ideal of being a machine is actually a trap.

cues.text: It gets in the way of our productivity because it makes us blind to the roots of our actual problems.
cues.en: It gets in the way of our productivity because it makes us blind to the roots of our actual problems.

cues.en: Yes, I learnt French when I was younger and I was actually quite good at it, I think,

cues.text: but I was really nervous when I was speaking French. How about you?
cues.en: but I was really nervous when I was speaking French. How about you?
cues.zh: 但當我說法語時我真的很緊張。你呢？

cues.en: Yeah, I've always felt like that with Spanish.
cues.zh: 是的，我對西班牙文一直有這樣的感覺。

cues.text: I am scared to speak because I don't want to make mistakes,
cues.en: I am scared to speak because I don't want to make mistakes,
cues.zh: 我不敢說話因為我不想犯錯

cues.text: even though I know it's OK to make mistakes.
cues.en: even though I know it's OK to make mistakes.
cues.zh: 儘管我知道犯錯是可以的。

cues.text: Well, in this episode of 6 Minute English, we'll be hearing about how to feel less nervous when you speak English.
cues.en: Well, in this episode of 6 Minute English, we'll be hearing about how to feel less nervous when you speak English.
cues.zh: 好吧，在這一集的 6 分鐘英語中，我們將瞭解如何在說英語時減輕緊張感。

cues.text: And as usual, we'll be learning some useful new words and phrases.
cues.en: And as usual, we'll be learning some useful new words and phrases.
cues.zh: 像往常一樣，我們將學習一些有用的新單字和短語。

cues.text: You can practise these with the quiz and worksheet on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
cues.en: You can practise these with the quiz and worksheet on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
cues.zh: 您可以透過我們網站 bbclearningenglish.com 上的測驗和工作表進行練習。

cues.text: But first I have a question for you, Pippa.
cues.en: But first I have a question for you, Pippa.
cues.zh: 但首先我有一個問題要問你，皮帕。

cues.text: So, English has around one million words, but on average,
cues.en: So, English has around one million words, but on average,
cues.zh: 所以，英語大約有一百萬個單詞，但平均而言，

cues.text: how many words does a typical English speaker use in daily conversation?
cues.en: how many words does a typical English speaker use in daily conversation?
cues.zh: 一個典型的說英語的人在日常對話中會使用多少個單字？

cues.text: Is it a) between 2000 and 3000?
cues.en: Is it a) between 2000 and 3000?

cues.text: b) between 20000 and 30000.
cues.en: b) between 20000 and 30000.

cues.text: Or c) between 200000 and 300000.
cues.en: Or c) between 200000 and 300000.

cues.text: I'm going to say a) 2000 to 3000.
cues.en: I'm going to say a) 2000 to 3000.

cues.text: OK. Well we will find out later in the programme.
cues.en: OK. Well we will find out later in the programme.
cues.zh: 好的。好吧，我們稍後會在節目中找到答案。

cues.text: Now, Pippa, you said you found it stressful speaking in French,
cues.en: Now, Pippa, you said you found it stressful speaking in French,
cues.zh: 現在，皮帕，你說你發現說法語有壓力，

cues.text: even though you are quite good at it.
cues.en: even though you are quite good at it.
cues.zh: 即使你很擅長。

cues.text: Now, someone else who has had this experience is Hanan Razek.
cues.en: Now, someone else who has had this experience is Hanan Razek.
cues.zh: 現在，另一個有過這種經驗的人是哈南·拉澤克(Hanan Razek)。

cues.text: Hanan is a journalist at BBC Arabic and also host of the podcast Beating Speaking Anxiety.
cues.en: Hanan is a journalist at BBC Arabic and also host of the podcast Beating Speaking Anxiety.
cues.zh: 哈南是 BBC 阿拉伯語的記者，也是播客《擊敗演講焦慮》的主持人。

cues.text: Here she is telling BBC Learning English presenter Georgie
cues.en: Here she is telling BBC Learning English presenter Georgie
cues.zh: 在這裡，她正在告訴 BBC 英語學習節目主持人 Georgie

cues.text: about speaking English.
cues.en: about speaking English.
cues.zh: 關於說英語。

cues.text: My English was actually pretty good but having conversations with people,
cues.en: My English was actually pretty good but having conversations with people,
cues.zh: 我的英語其實還不錯，但是在與人交談時，

cues.text: I found it really difficult.
cues.en: I found it really difficult.
cues.zh: 我發現這真的很難。

cues.text: So when I first joined the BBC, the Learning English team made an assessment
cues.en: So when I first joined the BBC, the Learning English team made an assessment
cues.zh: 所以當我剛加入BBC的時候，Learning English團隊做了一個評估

cues.text: of my English level, which they used to do for all new joiners
cues.en: of my English level, which they used to do for all new joiners
cues.zh: 我的英語水平，他們以前對所有新加入者都這樣做

cues.text: to see if they need any help or courses.
cues.en: to see if they need any help or courses.
cues.zh: 看看他們是否需要任何幫助或課程。

cues.text: My results were pretty good and I was fluent.
cues.en: My results were pretty good and I was fluent.
cues.zh: 我的成績很好，而且說得很流利。

cues.text: But on that very same day, leaving the building and going to get some coffee,
cues.en: But on that very same day, leaving the building and going to get some coffee,
cues.zh: 但就在同一天，離開大樓去喝咖啡時，

cues.text: I couldn't really understand what the barista was saying, and I felt pretty nervous to order coffee
cues.en: I couldn't really understand what the barista was saying, and I felt pretty nervous to order coffee
cues.zh: 我不太明白咖啡師在說什麼，點咖啡時我感到很緊張

cues.text: and was trying to stress every single word, hoping that my grammar is correct and I am pronouncing the words right.
cues.en: and was trying to stress every single word, hoping that my grammar is correct and I am pronouncing the words right.
cues.zh: 並試圖強調每一個單詞，希望我的語法是正確的，並且我的發音是正確的。

cues.text: Yeah, I'm sure that's a situation lots of people can relate to.
cues.en: Yeah, I'm sure that's a situation lots of people can relate to.
cues.zh: 是的，我相信這是很多人都能體會到的情況。

cues.text: Hanan's results on her English assessment were pretty good, but she was still pretty nervous to speak in English,
cues.en: Hanan's results on her English assessment were pretty good, but she was still pretty nervous to speak in English,
cues.zh: Hanan的英語成績不錯，但說英語還是很緊張，

cues.text: for example when ordering a coffee in English.
cues.en: for example when ordering a coffee in English.
cues.zh: 例如用英語點咖啡時。

cues.text: The modifier pretty means quite or a bit.
cues.en: The modifier pretty means quite or a bit.
cues.zh: 修飾語 Pretty 的意思是相當或一點。

cues.text: Georgie says that Hanan's experience is something that lots of people can relate to.
cues.en: Georgie says that Hanan's experience is something that lots of people can relate to.
cues.zh: 喬治說哈南的經驗是很多人都能感同身受的。

cues.text: If you relate to a situation, you know what it feels like,
cues.en: If you relate to a situation, you know what it feels like,
cues.zh: 如果你涉及到一種情況，你知道那是什麼感覺，

cues.text: usually because a similar thing has happened to you.
cues.en: usually because a similar thing has happened to you.
cues.zh: 通常是因為類似的事情發生在你身上。

cues.text: So lots of people feel nervous speaking another language,
cues.en: So lots of people feel nervous speaking another language,
cues.zh: 所以很多人在說另一種語言時感到緊張，

cues.text: even if they're good at it, like Hanan We can call this speaking anxiety.
cues.en: even if they're good at it, like Hanan We can call this speaking anxiety.
cues.zh: 即使他們很擅長，比如哈南，我們可以稱之為演講焦慮。

cues.text: Anxiety means an uncomfortable feeling or worry about something that is happening or could happen in the future.
cues.en: Anxiety means an uncomfortable feeling or worry about something that is happening or could happen in the future.
cues.zh: 焦慮是指對正在發生或將來可能發生的事情感到不舒服或擔憂。

cues.text: So why do so many people have anxiety about speaking a foreign language?
cues.en: So why do so many people have anxiety about speaking a foreign language?
cues.zh: 那麼為什麼這麼多人對說外語感到焦慮呢？

cues.text: Experts think it's connected to the beliefs we have about ourselves.
cues.en: Experts think it's connected to the beliefs we have about ourselves.
cues.zh: 專家認為這與我們對自己的信念有關。

cues.text: Han Luo, professor of Chinese at Lafayette College in the United States,
cues.en: Han Luo, professor of Chinese at Lafayette College in the United States,
cues.zh: 美國拉斐特學院中文教授韓羅，

cues.text: explains more to BBC Learning English presenter Georgie.
cues.en: explains more to BBC Learning English presenter Georgie.
cues.zh: 向 BBC Learning English 主持人 Georgie 解釋了更多內容。

cues.text: You know, usually the beliefs that cause anxiety, especially severe anxiety,
cues.en: You know, usually the beliefs that cause anxiety, especially severe anxiety,
cues.zh: 你知道，通常是那些導致焦慮，尤其是嚴重焦慮的信念，

cues.text: are, we call it irrational beliefs.
cues.en: are, we call it irrational beliefs.
cues.zh: 是，我們稱之為非理性信念。

cues.text: And also like, uh, some low self-perceptions, um, fear
cues.en: And also like, uh, some low self-perceptions, um, fear
cues.zh: 還有，呃，一些低自我認知，嗯，恐懼

cues.text: of negative evaluation, all those learner internal, you know, factors.
cues.en: of negative evaluation, all those learner internal, you know, factors.
cues.zh: 負面評價，所有這些學習者內部的因素。

cues.text: And Han says that learners worry about mistakes because they're scared of negative evaluation.
cues.en: And Han says that learners worry about mistakes because they're scared of negative evaluation.
cues.zh: 韓說，學習者擔心錯誤是因為他們害怕負面評價。

cues.text: In other words, that people will judge them for their mistakes and think badly of them.
cues.en: In other words, that people will judge them for their mistakes and think badly of them.
cues.zh: 換句話說，人們會因為他們的錯誤而評判他們，並對他們產生不好的看法。

cues.text: Han argues that irrational beliefs can make us anxious.
cues.en: Han argues that irrational beliefs can make us anxious.
cues.zh: 韓認為，非理性信念會讓我們感到焦慮。

cues.text: Irrational beliefs are beliefs that aren't based on things that are true.
cues.en: Irrational beliefs are beliefs that aren't based on things that are true.
cues.zh: 非理性信念是不基於真實事物的信念。

cues.text: They're not logical.
cues.en: They're not logical.
cues.zh: 他們不符合邏輯。

cues.text: Han says some people who have speaking anxiety have low self-perceptions.
cues.en: Han says some people who have speaking anxiety have low self-perceptions.
cues.zh: 韓說，一些有演講焦慮的人自我認知較低。

cues.text: Your self-perception is what you think about yourself.
cues.en: Your self-perception is what you think about yourself.
cues.zh: 你的自我認知就是你對自己的看法。

cues.text: Self-perception and irrational beliefs are both internal factors.
cues.en: Self-perception and irrational beliefs are both internal factors.
cues.zh: 自我認知和非理性信念都是內在因素。

cues.text: They come from inside your head, not from the people around you.
cues.en: They come from inside your head, not from the people around you.
cues.zh: 它們來自你的頭腦，而不是你周圍的人。

cues.text: So, for example, when you speak your first language, you might feel confident and intelligent,
cues.en: So, for example, when you speak your first language, you might feel confident and intelligent,
cues.zh: 例如，當你說你的母語時，你可能會感到自信和聰明，

cues.text: but when you speak in a new language, you make mistakes and feel less confident.
cues.en: but when you speak in a new language, you make mistakes and feel less confident.
cues.zh: 但當你用一種新語言說話時，你就會犯錯並且感到不那麼自信。

cues.text: You can't show people what you're really like, and this is frustrating.
cues.en: You can't show people what you're really like, and this is frustrating.
cues.zh: 你無法向人們展示你真正喜歡的東西，這很令人沮喪。

cues.text: But as we tell people all the time at BBC Learning English,
cues.en: But as we tell people all the time at BBC Learning English,
cues.zh: 但正如我們在 BBC Learning English 中一直告訴人們的那樣，

cues.text: mistakes are normal.
cues.en: mistakes are normal.
cues.zh: 錯誤是正常的。

cues.text: You have to try to speak, even though you make mistakes, and mistakes can be a good thing.
cues.en: You have to try to speak, even though you make mistakes, and mistakes can be a good thing.
cues.zh: 即使你犯了錯誤，你也必須嘗試說話，而錯誤可能是一件好事。

cues.text: They can help us learn.
cues.en: They can help us learn.
cues.zh: 他們可以幫助我們學習。

cues.text: And if you want more tips to improve your speaking, listen to the Beating Speaking Anxiety podcast.
cues.en: And if you want more tips to improve your speaking, listen to the Beating Speaking Anxiety podcast.
cues.zh: 如果您想了解更多提高口語的技巧，請收聽擊敗口語焦慮播客。

cues.text: There's a link in the notes below this episode.
cues.en: There's a link in the notes below this episode.
cues.zh: 本集下面的註釋中有一個連結。

cues.en: But Beth, I think it's time for the answer to your quiz question.
cues.zh: 但是貝絲，我想是時候回答你的測驗問題了。

cues.en: Yes, I asked you how many words does the average English speaker use
cues.zh: 是的，我問你說英語的人平均使用多少個單字

cues.text: in daily communication?
cues.en: in daily communication?
cues.zh: 在日常交流中？

cues.text: The answer is 20000 to 30000.
cues.en: The answer is 20000 to 30000.

cues.text: That's quite a lot. Yeah.
cues.en: That's quite a lot. Yeah.
cues.zh: 這是相當多的。是的。

cues.text: That's loads.
cues.en: That's loads.
cues.zh: 那是負載。

cues.text: OK, let's recap the vocabulary we've learnt. Pretty can be used as a modifier to mean quite or a bit.
cues.en: OK, let's recap the vocabulary we've learnt. Pretty can be used as a modifier to mean quite or a bit.
cues.zh: 好吧，讓我們回顧一下我們學過的詞彙。 Pretty 可以用作修飾語，表示相當或一點。

cues.text: If you relate to a person or situation you understand them, usually because you've experienced something similar.
cues.en: If you relate to a person or situation you understand them, usually because you've experienced something similar.
cues.zh: 如果你與某個人或某個情況有關，你就會理解他們，通常是因為你經歷過類似的事情。

cues.text: Anxiety is feeling uncomfortable or worried about something that is happening or could happen in the future.
cues.en: Anxiety is feeling uncomfortable or worried about something that is happening or could happen in the future.
cues.zh: 焦慮是對正在發生或將來可能發生的事情感到不舒服或擔心。

cues.text: Irrational beliefs are beliefs about something that is not true.
cues.en: Irrational beliefs are beliefs about something that is not true.
cues.zh: 非理性信念是對不真實事物的信念。

cues.text: They're not logical.
cues.en: They're not logical.
cues.zh: 他們不符合邏輯。

cues.text: Self-perception is the way you see yourself. And
cues.en: Self-perception is the way you see yourself. And
cues.zh: 自我認知是你看待自己的方式。並且

cues.text: internal means inside the body or mind.
cues.en: internal means inside the body or mind.
cues.zh: 內在是指身體或心靈內在。

cues.text: Once again, our six minutes are up.
cues.en: Once again, our six minutes are up.
cues.zh: 我們的六分鐘時間又到了。

cues.text: But if you'd like to find out more about speaking anxiety,
cues.en: But if you'd like to find out more about speaking anxiety,
cues.zh: 但如果你想了解更多關於演講焦慮的資訊

cues.en: then head over to our website, bbclearningenglish.com to find our Beating Speaking Anxiety series.
cues.zh: 然後前往我們的網站 bbclearningenglish.com 查詢我們的“擊敗演講焦慮”系列。

cues.text: There are podcasts about the things we find scary when speaking a different language,
cues.en: There are podcasts about the things we find scary when speaking a different language,
cues.zh: 有一些播客是關於我們在說不同語言時感到害怕的事情的，

cues.text: and videos with tips to help you feel more confident with speaking.
cues.en: and videos with tips to help you feel more confident with speaking.
cues.zh: 以及包含提示的影片，可幫助您在演講時更加自信。

qNAfpbnIQkc.title: 3 ways to pronounce 'ed' - English In A Minute
qNAfpbnIQkc.speaker: BBC Learning English
qNAfpbnIQkc.zh: 【BBC Learning English】'ed' 的 3 種發音 - English In A Minute（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Did you know these two letters can be pronounced in three different ways?
cues.en: Did you know these two letters can be pronounced in three different ways?
cues.zh: 您知道這兩個字母可以用三種不同的方式發音嗎？

cues.text: They can be d, t, or id.
cues.en: They can be d, t, or id.
cues.zh: 它們可以是 d、t 或 id。

cues.text: Here's how to find out which.
cues.en: Here's how to find out which.
cues.zh: 以下是如何找出其中的方法。

cues.text: First, feel your neck.
cues.en: First, feel your neck.
cues.zh: 首先，感覺一下你的脖子。

cues.text: If a sound makes it vibrate, like d, then it's voiced.
cues.en: If a sound makes it vibrate, like d, then it's voiced.
cues.zh: 如果一個聲音使它振動，例如 d，那麼它就是濁音。

cues.text: If it doesn't, like t, then it isn't.
cues.en: If it doesn't, like t, then it isn't.
cues.zh: 如果沒有，就像 t 一樣，那麼就不是。

cues.text: Where ED comes after a vowel or a voiced consonant,
cues.en: Where ED comes after a vowel or a voiced consonant,
cues.zh: ED 出現在母音或濁子音之後，

cues.text: then pronounce it as d, which is a voiced sound.
cues.en: then pronounce it as d, which is a voiced sound.
cues.zh: 然後將其發音為d，這是一個濁音。

cues.text: Played.
cues.en: Played.
cues.zh: 玩過。

cues.text: Used.
cues.en: Used.
cues.zh: 用過的。

cues.text: If you have ED after an unvoiced sound,
cues.en: If you have ED after an unvoiced sound,
cues.zh: 如果您在聽到清音後出現 ED，

cues.text: then it sounds like t, an unvoiced sound.
cues.en: then it sounds like t, an unvoiced sound.
cues.zh: 那麼它聽起來像 t，一個清音。

cues.text: Looked.
cues.en: Looked.
cues.zh: 看了。

cues.text: Helped.
cues.en: Helped.
cues.zh: 有幫助。

cues.text: If you have t or d, then ED becomes id.
cues.en: If you have t or d, then ED becomes id.
cues.zh: 如果你有 t 或 d，那麼 ED 就變成 id。

cues.text: It's just easier to say.
cues.en: It's just easier to say.
cues.zh: 只是說起來比較容易。

cues.text: Wanted.
cues.en: Wanted.
cues.zh: 通緝。

cues.text: Needed.
cues.en: Needed.
cues.zh: 需要。

cues.text: So if ED comes after a voiced sound, then it's voiced.
cues.en: So if ED comes after a voiced sound, then it's voiced.
cues.zh: 因此，如果 ED 出現在濁音之後，那麼它就是濁音。

cues.text: If it comes after an unvoiced sound, then it's unvoiced.
cues.en: If it comes after an unvoiced sound, then it's unvoiced.
cues.zh: 如果它出現在清音之後，那麼它就是清音。

cues.text: And if it comes after t or d, then it's id.
cues.en: And if it comes after t or d, then it's id.
cues.zh: 如果它出現在 t 或 d 之後，那麼它就是 id。

cues.text: and also record information about them, creating a memory of what the invaders look like,
cues.en: and also record information about them, creating a memory of what the invaders look like,
cues.zh: 特殊的 B 細胞及 T 細胞 會被徵招來抵抗病菌 並記錄下病原菌資訊 以存檔瞭解侵略者的外觀 及最佳抵禦方式

cues.text: and how best to fight them.
cues.en: and how best to fight them.
cues.zh: 及最佳抵禦方式 下次再碰上同樣病原體時

cues.text: This know-how becomes handy if the same pathogen invades the body again.
cues.en: This know-how becomes handy if the same pathogen invades the body again.
cues.zh: 下次再碰上同樣病原體時 這些實戰知識就能立即拿來使用

cues.text: But despite this smart response, there's still a risk involved.
cues.en: But despite this smart response, there's still a risk involved.
cues.zh: 這些實戰知識就能立即拿來使用 但儘管免疫反應如此精巧 還是有風險存在

cues.text: The body takes time to learn how to respond to pathogens and to build up these defenses.
cues.en: The body takes time to learn how to respond to pathogens and to build up these defenses.
cues.zh: 因為身體需要花時間 才能瞭解如何因應病菌 及建立防禦措施 即便如此

cues.text: And even then, if a body is too weak or young to fight back when it's invaded,
cues.en: And even then, if a body is too weak or young to fight back when it's invaded,
cues.zh: 即便如此 若在發育未臻成熟或體衰時得病 就無法有效抵抗疾病

cues.text: it might face very serious risk if the pathogen is particularly severe.
cues.en: it might face very serious risk if the pathogen is particularly severe.
cues.zh: 因此若碰上特別棘手的病菌時 就可能面臨非常嚴重的危險

cues.text: But what if we could prepare the body's immune response, readying it before someone even got ill?
cues.en: But what if we could prepare the body's immune response, readying it before someone even got ill?
cues.zh: 因此若碰上特別棘手的病菌時 就可能面臨非常嚴重的危險 但要是能在第一次得病前 就讓免疫系統做好對抗疾病的準備呢？

cues.text: This is where vaccines come in.
cues.en: This is where vaccines come in.
cues.zh: 這就是疫苗的由來

cues.text: Using the same principles that the body uses to defend itself,
cues.en: Using the same principles that the body uses to defend itself,
cues.zh: 這就是疫苗的由來 原理就跟身體的自我防禦一樣 科學家利用疫苗來誘發 身體的後天免疫系統

cues.text: scientists use vaccines to trigger the body's adaptive immune system,
cues.en: scientists use vaccines to trigger the body's adaptive immune system,
cues.zh: 科學家利用疫苗來誘發 身體的後天免疫系統 但免除讓人體暴露於完整病程中

cues.text: without exposing humans to the full strength disease.
cues.en: without exposing humans to the full strength disease.
cues.zh: 科學家利用疫苗來誘發 身體的後天免疫系統 但免除讓人體暴露於完整病程中

cues.text: This has resulted in many vaccines, which each work uniquely,
cues.en: This has resulted in many vaccines, which each work uniquely,
cues.zh: 但免除讓人體暴露於完整病程中 於是許多疫苗問世 這些疫苗可被分成多種類別 每個都有其獨特的作用方式

cues.text: separated into many different types.
cues.en: separated into many different types.
cues.zh: 每個都有其獨特的作用方式 首先 有活性減毒疫苗

cues.text: First, we have live attenuated vaccines.
cues.en: First, we have live attenuated vaccines.
cues.zh: 首先 有活性減毒疫苗 由已被削減致病性的活體病菌所製成

cues.text: These are made of the pathogen itself but a much weaker and tamer version.
cues.en: These are made of the pathogen itself but a much weaker and tamer version.
cues.zh: 由已被削減致病性的活體病菌所製成 另外還有非活性疫苗 此疫苗中的病原菌已全被殺死

cues.text: Next, we have inactive vaccines, in which the pathogens have been killed.
cues.en: Next, we have inactive vaccines, in which the pathogens have been killed.
cues.zh: 另外還有非活性疫苗 此疫苗中的病原菌已全被殺死 此兩種疫苗中含有 已被弱化或無活性病菌

cues.text: The weakening and inactivation in both types of vaccine ensures that pathogens don't develop into the full blown disease.
cues.en: The weakening and inactivation in both types of vaccine ensures that pathogens don't develop into the full blown disease.
cues.zh: 此兩種疫苗中含有 已被弱化或無活性病菌 可確保該病原菌 不會在人體內發展成真正的疾病 但卻又能像疾病一樣 誘發免疫反應

cues.text: But just like a disease, they trigger an immune response,
cues.en: But just like a disease, they trigger an immune response,
cues.zh: 但卻又能像疾病一樣 誘發免疫反應 為目標病菌建立檔案

cues.text: teaching the body to recognize an attack by making a profile of pathogens in preparation.
cues.en: teaching the body to recognize an attack by making a profile of pathogens in preparation.
cues.zh: 為目標病菌建立檔案 教導身體辨識該病菌的侵襲 活性減毒疫苗的缺點是難以製備

cues.text: The downside is that live attenuated vaccines can be difficult to make,
cues.en: The downside is that live attenuated vaccines can be difficult to make,
cues.zh: 活性減毒疫苗的缺點是難以製備 且因內含活性相當強大的病菌

cues.text: and because they're live and quite powerful, people with weaker immune systems can't have them,
cues.en: and because they're live and quite powerful, people with weaker immune systems can't have them,
cues.zh: 且因內含活性相當強大的病菌 免疫系統弱的人並不適合接受接種 而非活性疫苗的缺點則是 無法產生長久的免疫效力

cues.text: while inactive vaccines don't create long-lasting immunity.
cues.en: while inactive vaccines don't create long-lasting immunity.
cues.zh: 而非活性疫苗的缺點則是 無法產生長久的免疫效力

cues.text: Another type, the subunit vaccine, is only made from one part of the pathogen, called an antigen,
cues.en: Another type, the subunit vaccine, is only made from one part of the pathogen, called an antigen,
cues.zh: 而非活性疫苗的缺點則是 無法產生長久的免疫效力 另一種疫苗型別： 次單位疫苗 這種疫苗只含部分病原體 稱之為抗原

cues.text: the ingredient that actually triggers the immune response.
cues.en: the ingredient that actually triggers the immune response.
cues.zh: 這種疫苗只含部分病原體 稱之為抗原 也是真正誘發免疫反應的成分 而進一步分離出抗原中的特定成分

cues.text: By even further isolating specific components of antigens, like proteins or polysaccharides,
cues.en: By even further isolating specific components of antigens, like proteins or polysaccharides,
cues.zh: 而進一步分離出抗原中的特定成分 如蛋白質或多醣

cues.text: these vaccines can prompt specific responses.
cues.en: these vaccines can prompt specific responses.
cues.zh: 如蛋白質或多醣 這型別疫苗可立即促使特定反應

cues.text: Scientists are now building a whole new range of vaccines
cues.en: Scientists are now building a whole new range of vaccines
cues.zh: 這型別疫苗可立即促使特定反應 科學家現已著手建立新的疫苗系列

cues.text: called DNA vaccines.
cues.en: called DNA vaccines.
cues.zh: 科學家現已著手建立新的疫苗系列 稱之為 DNA 疫苗

cues.text: For this variety, they isolate the very genes that make the specific antigens
cues.en: For this variety, they isolate the very genes that make the specific antigens
cues.zh: 稱之為 DNA 疫苗 為使身體對特定病菌產生免疫反應 他們分離出目標抗原的基因

cues.text: the body needs to trigger its immune response to specific pathogens.
cues.en: the body needs to trigger its immune response to specific pathogens.
cues.zh: 他們分離出目標抗原的基因 而人體在接受注射後

cues.text: When injected into the human body, those genes instruct cells in the body to make the antigens.
cues.en: When injected into the human body, those genes instruct cells in the body to make the antigens.
cues.zh: 而人體在接受注射後 疫苗內的基因 會指示體內細胞製造抗原 這會引發更強大的免疫反應

cues.text: This causes a stronger immune response, and prepares the body for any future threats,
cues.en: This causes a stronger immune response, and prepares the body for any future threats,
cues.zh: 這會引發更強大的免疫反應 讓身體準備好對抗任何潛在威脅

cues.text: and because the vaccine only includes specific genetic material, it doesn't contain any other ingredients from the rest of the pathogen
cues.en: and because the vaccine only includes specific genetic material, it doesn't contain any other ingredients from the rest of the pathogen
cues.zh: 讓身體準備好對抗任何潛在威脅 此型別疫苗僅由特定基因物質組成 因此不含病原菌其它可能

cues.text: that could develop into the disease and harm the patient.
cues.en: that could develop into the disease and harm the patient.
cues.zh: 因此不含病原菌其它可能 致病並危害病人健康的物質

cues.text: If these vaccines become a success, we might be able to build more effective treatments
cues.en: If these vaccines become a success, we might be able to build more effective treatments
cues.zh: 致病並危害病人健康的物質 若能研發成功 就可能在幾年內 建立更有效的治療方法

cues.text: for invasive pathogens in years to come.
cues.en: for invasive pathogens in years to come.
cues.zh: 就可能在幾年內 建立更有效的治療方法 來對抗侵入性病菌的感染

cues.text: Just like Edward Jenner's amazing discovery spurred on modern medicine all those decades ago,
cues.en: Just like Edward Jenner's amazing discovery spurred on modern medicine all those decades ago,
cues.zh: 來對抗侵入性病菌的感染 正如簡納當年的驚人發現 促成過去數十年的醫學進步

cues.text: continuing the development of vaccines might even allow us to treat diseases like HIV,
cues.en: continuing the development of vaccines might even allow us to treat diseases like HIV,
cues.zh: 隨著疫苗技術的持續發展 也許有天也能找到治療愛滋病 瘧疾

cues.text: malaria, or Ebola, one day.
cues.en: malaria, or Ebola, one day.
cues.zh: 也許有天也能找到治療愛滋病 瘧疾 或伊波拉的方法

2W85Dwxx218.title: Why do we dream? - Amy Adkins
2W85Dwxx218.speaker: TED-Ed
2W85Dwxx218.zh: 【TED-Ed】我們為什麼做夢？ - 艾米·阿德金斯（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: In the third millenium BCE, Mesopotamian kings recorded and interpreted their dreams on wax tablets.
cues.en: In the third millenium BCE, Mesopotamian kings recorded and interpreted their dreams on wax tablets.
cues.zh: 公元前三千年 美索不達米亞諸王在蠟板上 記錄及解讀他們的夢

cues.text: A thousand years later, Ancient Egyptians wrote a dream book listing over a hundred common dreams and their meanings.
cues.en: A thousand years later, Ancient Egyptians wrote a dream book listing over a hundred common dreams and their meanings.
cues.zh: 一千多年之後 古埃及人寫了一本有關夢境的書 書中記載了一百多種 常見的夢境及其涵義 自那時候起

cues.text: And in the years since, we haven't paused in our quest to understand why we dream.
cues.en: And in the years since, we haven't paused in our quest to understand why we dream.
cues.zh: 書中記載了一百多種 常見的夢境及其涵義 自那時候起 我們從未停止探索 我們作夢的原因

cues.text: So, after a great deal of scientific research, technological advancement,
cues.en: So, after a great deal of scientific research, technological advancement,
cues.zh: 所以，儘管在大量的科學研究 科技的進步 以及堅持之下

cues.text: and persistence, we still don't have any definite answers, but we have some interesting theories.
cues.en: and persistence, we still don't have any definite answers, but we have some interesting theories.
cues.zh: 以及堅持之下 我們仍然沒有任何確切的答案 但我們發現了一些有趣的理論 我們在夢裡實現我們的願望

cues.text: We dream to fulfill our wishes.
cues.en: We dream to fulfill our wishes.
cues.zh: 我們仍然沒有任何確切的答案 但我們發現了一些有趣的理論 我們在夢裡實現我們的願望

cues.text: In the early 1900s, Sigmund Freud proposed that while all of our dreams, including our nightmares,
cues.en: In the early 1900s, Sigmund Freud proposed that while all of our dreams, including our nightmares,
cues.zh: 在 20 世紀初期 西格蒙德·佛洛伊德提出 我們所作的夢，包括噩夢 是從我們有意識的日常生活中 所整合的一套表像

cues.text: are a collection of images from our daily conscious lives, they also have symbolic meanings,
cues.en: are a collection of images from our daily conscious lives, they also have symbolic meanings,
cues.zh: 西格蒙德·佛洛伊德提出 我們所作的夢，包括噩夢 是從我們有意識的日常生活中 所整合的一套表像 這些夢也有一些象徵性的涵義

cues.text: which relate to the fulfillment of our subconscious wishes.
cues.en: which relate to the fulfillment of our subconscious wishes.
cues.zh: 這些夢也有一些象徵性的涵義 這些涵義與我們在潛意識中 想實現的願望有關

cues.text: Freud theorized that everything we remember when we wake up from a dream
cues.en: Freud theorized that everything we remember when we wake up from a dream
cues.zh: 這些涵義與我們在潛意識中 想實現的願望有關 佛洛伊德的理論認為 我們從夢中醒來還記得的事情

cues.text: is a symbolic representation of our unconscious primitive thoughts, urges, and desires.
cues.en: is a symbolic representation of our unconscious primitive thoughts, urges, and desires.
cues.zh: 佛洛伊德的理論認為 我們從夢中醒來還記得的事情 便是象徵我們在無意識下 原始想法、衝動、和慾望的表現

cues.text: Freud believed that by analyzing those remembered elements, the unconscious content would be revealed to our conscious mind,
cues.en: Freud believed that by analyzing those remembered elements, the unconscious content would be revealed to our conscious mind,
cues.zh: 佛洛伊德相信 藉由分析這些你所記得的元素 這些無意識的內容 得以在我們清醒的意識下揭露

cues.text: and psychological issues stemming from its repression could be addressed and resolved.
cues.en: and psychological issues stemming from its repression could be addressed and resolved.
cues.zh: 這些無意識的內容 得以在我們清醒的意識下揭露 而那些從無意識的壓抑 所衍生的心理問題 得以抒發和處理

cues.text: We dream to remember.
cues.en: We dream to remember.
cues.zh: 我們為了記憶而作夢

cues.text: To increase performance on certain mental tasks, sleep is good,
cues.en: To increase performance on certain mental tasks, sleep is good,
cues.zh: 要增強一些心智工作的效能 睡眠是很好的方法 但睡眠中作夢更好

cues.text: but dreaming while sleeping is better.
cues.en: but dreaming while sleeping is better.
cues.zh: 睡眠是很好的方法 但睡眠中作夢更好

cues.text: In 2010, researchers found that subjects were much better at getting through a complex 3-D maze
cues.en: In 2010, researchers found that subjects were much better at getting through a complex 3-D maze
cues.zh: 2010 年研究人員發現 實驗物件能夠更容易地 穿過複雜的 3D 立體迷宮 如果他們在第二次嘗試前 曾經小睡及夢到這個迷宮

cues.text: if they had napped and dreamed of the maze prior to their second attempt.
cues.en: if they had napped and dreamed of the maze prior to their second attempt.
cues.zh: 如果他們在第二次嘗試前 曾經小睡及夢到這個迷宮 實際上他們的表現能逹到十倍好

cues.text: In fact, they were up to ten times better at it than those who only thought of the maze while awake between attempts,
cues.en: In fact, they were up to ten times better at it than those who only thought of the maze while awake between attempts,
cues.zh: 實際上他們的表現能逹到十倍好 相較於那些僅在試驗間清醒時段 想過那迷宮的試驗者

cues.text: and those who napped but did not dream about the maze.
cues.en: and those who napped but did not dream about the maze.
cues.zh: 相較於那些僅在試驗間清醒時段 想過那迷宮的試驗者 以及小睡過 但未夢到迷宮的試驗者 研究人員認為 有些記憶處理過程

cues.text: Researchers theorize that certain memory processes can happen only when we are asleep,
cues.en: Researchers theorize that certain memory processes can happen only when we are asleep,
cues.zh: 研究人員認為 有些記憶處理過程 只能在我們睡著時才能發生

cues.text: and our dreams are a signal that these processes are taking place.
cues.en: and our dreams are a signal that these processes are taking place.
cues.zh: 只能在我們睡著時才能發生 而我們的夢 正是這些過程發生的訊號

cues.text: We dream to forget.
cues.en: We dream to forget.
cues.zh: 我們為了忘記而作夢

cues.text: There are about 10,000 trillion neural connections within the architecture of your brain.
cues.en: There are about 10,000 trillion neural connections within the architecture of your brain.
cues.zh: 大約有一千兆個神經連結 在你的大腦結構之中

cues.text: They are created by everything you think and everything you do.
cues.en: They are created by everything you think and everything you do.
cues.zh: 在你的大腦結構之中 它們從你所想所做的 全部事物中產生

cues.text: A 1983 neurobiological theory of dreaming, called reverse learning,
cues.en: A 1983 neurobiological theory of dreaming, called reverse learning,
cues.zh: 1983 年有個研究夢的 神經生物學理論，叫反向學習 說在睡眠時 並主要在快速動眼 期間

cues.text: holds that while sleeping, and mainly during REM sleep cycles,
cues.en: holds that while sleeping, and mainly during REM sleep cycles,
cues.zh: 說在睡眠時 並主要在快速動眼 期間

cues.text: your neocortex reviews these neural connections and dumps the unnecessary ones.
cues.en: your neocortex reviews these neural connections and dumps the unnecessary ones.
cues.zh: 你的大腦新皮質 會回顧這些神經連結 捨棄非必須的連結 如果沒有在夢境中排除記憶

cues.text: Without this unlearning process, which results in your dreams,
cues.en: Without this unlearning process, which results in your dreams,
cues.zh: 如果沒有在夢境中排除記憶

cues.text: your brain could be overrun by useless connections and parasitic thoughts could disrupt the necessary thinking
cues.en: your brain could be overrun by useless connections and parasitic thoughts could disrupt the necessary thinking
cues.zh: 你的腦子可能會充斥無用的連結 還有寄生的想法 可能幹擾你在清醒時必需做的思考

cues.text: you need to do while you're awake.
cues.en: you need to do while you're awake.
cues.zh: 可能幹擾你在清醒時必需做的思考

cues.text: We dream to keep our brains working.
cues.en: We dream to keep our brains working.
cues.zh: 可能幹擾你在清醒時必需做的思考 我們為了讓我們的腦子運作而作夢 「持續活化理論」提出 你的夢是來自

cues.text: The continual activation theory proposes that your dreams result from your brain's need to constantly consolidate and create long-term memories
cues.en: The continual activation theory proposes that your dreams result from your brain's need to constantly consolidate and create long-term memories
cues.zh: 「持續活化理論」提出 你的夢是來自 腦子需要不斷整合及產生 長期記憶而造成的

cues.text: in order to function properly.
cues.en: in order to function properly.
cues.zh: 腦子需要不斷整合及產生 長期記憶而造成的 如此才能正常運作

cues.text: So when external input falls below a certain level, like when you're asleep,
cues.en: So when external input falls below a certain level, like when you're asleep,
cues.zh: 如此才能正常運作 所以當外來的輸入 降到了某一個程度 譬如你睡著時

cues.text: your brain automatically triggers the generation of data from its memory storages,
cues.en: your brain automatically triggers the generation of data from its memory storages,
cues.zh: 譬如你睡著時 你的腦子自動地觸發 記憶儲存區產生資訊 而呈現給你的

cues.text: which appear to you in the form of the thoughts and feelings you experience in your dreams.
cues.en: which appear to you in the form of the thoughts and feelings you experience in your dreams.
cues.zh: 而呈現給你的 是在你夢裡經歷的想法和感覺 換句話說

cues.text: In other words, your dreams might be a random screen saver your brain turns on
cues.en: In other words, your dreams might be a random screen saver your brain turns on
cues.zh: 換句話說 你的夢可能是腦子開啟的 一個隨機螢幕保護程式 因而它不完全關閉

cues.text: so it doesn't completely shut down.
cues.en: so it doesn't completely shut down.
cues.zh: 因而它不完全關閉

cues.text: We dream to rehearse.
cues.en: We dream to rehearse.
cues.zh: 我們作夢來預演

cues.text: Dreams involving dangerous and threatening situations are very common,
cues.en: Dreams involving dangerous and threatening situations are very common,
cues.zh: 夢中包含危險及有威脅的情況 是很平常的 而「原始本能預演理論」認為

cues.text: and the primitive instinct rehearsal theory holds that the content of a dream is significant to its purpose.
cues.en: and the primitive instinct rehearsal theory holds that the content of a dream is significant to its purpose.
cues.zh: 夢中包含危險及有威脅的情況 是很平常的 而「原始本能預演理論」認為 夢的內容對於它的目的是很重要的 不論它是個在森林中 被熊追的焦慮夜晚

cues.text: Whether it's an anxiety-filled night of being chased through the woods by a bear
cues.en: Whether it's an anxiety-filled night of being chased through the woods by a bear
cues.zh: 不論它是個在森林中 被熊追的焦慮夜晚

cues.text: or fighting off a ninja in a dark alley, these dreams allow you to practice your fight or flight instincts
cues.en: or fighting off a ninja in a dark alley, these dreams allow you to practice your fight or flight instincts
cues.zh: 或是在黑暗的山谷中對抗一個忍者 這些夢讓你練習 你的打鬥或跳跑的直覺 並保持對這些技能的敏銳和信賴 以防你在現實生活中的需要

cues.text: and keep them sharp and dependable in case you'll need them in real life.
cues.en: and keep them sharp and dependable in case you'll need them in real life.
cues.zh: 並保持對這些技能的敏銳和信賴 以防你在現實生活中的需要

cues.text: But it doesn't always have to be unpleasant.
cues.en: But it doesn't always have to be unpleasant.
cues.zh: 但這並非全是不愉快的 譬如夢到那位嫵媚動人的鄰居

cues.text: For instance, dreams about your attractive neighbor could actually give your reproductive instinct some practice, too.
cues.en: For instance, dreams about your attractive neighbor could actually give your reproductive instinct some practice, too.
cues.zh: 譬如夢到那位嫵媚動人的鄰居 也可以實際給你的 生殖直覺一些練習

cues.text: We dream to heal.
cues.en: We dream to heal.
cues.zh: 我們作夢來療傷

cues.text: Stress neurotransmitters in the brain are much less active during the REM stage of sleep,
cues.en: Stress neurotransmitters in the brain are much less active during the REM stage of sleep,
cues.zh: 腦中的壓力神經傳導物質 在睡眠中的快速動眼期 比較不活躍 甚至在充滿創傷經驗的 夢中也是如此

cues.text: even during dreams of traumatic experiences, leading some researchers to theorize
cues.en: even during dreams of traumatic experiences, leading some researchers to theorize
cues.zh: 甚至在充滿創傷經驗的 夢中也是如此 這讓研究人員提出下列的理論 作夢的原因之一 是緩和痛苦的經驗

cues.text: that one purpose of dreaming is to take the edge off painful experiences
cues.en: that one purpose of dreaming is to take the edge off painful experiences
cues.zh: 這讓研究人員提出下列的理論 作夢的原因之一 是緩和痛苦的經驗

cues.text: to allow for psychological healing.
cues.en: to allow for psychological healing.
cues.zh: 作夢的原因之一 是緩和痛苦的經驗 來允許心理上的復原

cues.text: Reviewing traumatic events in your dreams with less mental stress may grant you a clearer perspective
cues.en: Reviewing traumatic events in your dreams with less mental stress may grant you a clearer perspective
cues.zh: 來允許心理上的復原 在夢中以較輕的心理壓力 來回顧受創事件 可以給你一個更清楚的視角

cues.text: and enhanced ability to process them in psychologically healthy ways.
cues.en: and enhanced ability to process them in psychologically healthy ways.
cues.zh: 和增強用心理健康的方法 處理這些事件的能力

cues.text: People with certain mood disorders and PTSD often have difficulty sleeping,
cues.en: People with certain mood disorders and PTSD often have difficulty sleeping,
cues.zh: 患有特定情緒失調 及創傷後壓力症候群 的人 常有睡眠上的困難 這讓一些科學家相信

cues.text: leading some scientists to believe that lack of dreaming may be a contributing factor to their illnesses.
cues.en: leading some scientists to believe that lack of dreaming may be a contributing factor to their illnesses.
cues.zh: 這讓一些科學家相信 缺少夢境可能是 他們得病的一個因素 我們作夢來解決問題

cues.text: We dream to solve problems.
cues.en: We dream to solve problems.
cues.zh: 我們作夢來解決問題

cues.text: Unconstrained by reality and the rules of conventional logic, in your dreams, your mind can create limitless scenarios
cues.en: Unconstrained by reality and the rules of conventional logic, in your dreams, your mind can create limitless scenarios
cues.zh: 不受限於現實和慣例邏輯的規則 在你的夢中 你的心智可以創造 無數的情境 來幫助你暸解問題

cues.text: to help you grasp problems and formulate solutions that you may not consider while awake.
cues.en: to help you grasp problems and formulate solutions that you may not consider while awake.
cues.zh: 無數的情境 來幫助你暸解問題 和制訂在你清醒時 無法考慮的解決辦法 約翰‧史坦貝克稱它為 「睡眠委員會」

cues.text: John Steinbeck called it the committee of sleep, and research has demonstrated
cues.en: John Steinbeck called it the committee of sleep, and research has demonstrated
cues.zh: 約翰‧史坦貝克稱它為 「睡眠委員會」 研究人員也展示了 夢在解決問題上的功效

cues.text: the effectiveness of dreaming on problem solving.
cues.en: the effectiveness of dreaming on problem solving.
cues.zh: 研究人員也展示了 夢在解決問題上的功效

cues.text: It's also how renowned chemist August Kekule discovered the structure of the benzene molecule,
cues.en: It's also how renowned chemist August Kekule discovered the structure of the benzene molecule,
cues.zh: 這也是著名的化學家 奧古斯汀‧凱庫勒 發現苯分子結構的途徑 而這個理由也是我們有時說 找到解決問題的最佳方法

cues.text: and it's the reason that sometimes the best solution for a problem is to sleep on it.
cues.en: and it's the reason that sometimes the best solution for a problem is to sleep on it.
cues.zh: 而這個理由也是我們有時說 找到解決問題的最佳方法 是睡覺想一想

cues.text: And those are just a few of the more prominent theories.
cues.en: And those are just a few of the more prominent theories.
cues.zh: 而這些只是一部份較著名的理論

cues.text: As technology increases our capability for understanding the brain,
cues.en: As technology increases our capability for understanding the brain,
cues.zh: 而這些只是一部份較著名的理論 隨著科技增進我們 瞭解腦子的能力

cues.text: it's possible that one day we will discover the definitive reason for them.
cues.en: it's possible that one day we will discover the definitive reason for them.
cues.zh: 有一天可能我們會發現 作夢的決定性理由 但是直到那一刻來臨 我們只能持續地作夢

cues.text: But until that time arrives, we'll just have to keep on dreaming.
cues.en: But until that time arrives, we'll just have to keep on dreaming.
cues.zh: 但是直到那一刻來臨 我們只能持續地作夢

7yDmGnA8Hw0.title: Can you solve the bridge riddle? - Alex Gendler

cues.text: Taking that internship in a remote mountain lab might not have been the best idea.

cues.text: Pulling that lever with the skull symbol just to see what it did
cues.en: Pulling that lever with the skull symbol just to see what it did
cues.zh: 拉下畫有骷髏符號的控制桿， 看看會發生什麼事，

cues.text: because you need to get away from these mutant zombies fast.
cues.en: because you need to get away from these mutant zombies fast.
cues.zh: 因為你得趕緊逃離 這些突變的殭屍。 與你同行的，有管理員、 實驗室助理和一位老教授，

cues.text: With you are the janitor, the lab assistant, and the old professor.
cues.en: With you are the janitor, the lab assistant, and the old professor.
cues.zh: 與你同行的，有管理員、 實驗室助理和一位老教授， 雖然你們已經領先一步， 但要安全逃離，還需要：

cues.text: You've gotten a headstart, but there's only one way to safety:
cues.en: You've gotten a headstart, but there's only one way to safety:
cues.zh: 雖然你們已經領先一步， 但要安全逃離，還需要： 跨越大峽谷上的一座老舊吊橋。

cues.text: across an old rope bridge spanning a massive gorge.
cues.en: across an old rope bridge spanning a massive gorge.
cues.zh: 跨越大峽谷上的一座老舊吊橋。 你衝過吊橋只需要 1 分鐘，

cues.text: You can dash across in a minute, while the lab assistant takes two minutes.
cues.en: You can dash across in a minute, while the lab assistant takes two minutes.
cues.zh: 跨越大峽谷上的一座老舊吊橋。 你衝過吊橋只需要 1 分鐘， 然而實驗室助理需要 2 分鐘。 管理員稍慢一些，需要 5 分鐘，

cues.text: The janitor is a bit slower and needs five minutes, and the professor takes a whole ten minutes,
cues.en: The janitor is a bit slower and needs five minutes, and the professor takes a whole ten minutes,
cues.zh: 管理員稍慢一些，需要 5 分鐘， 而教授需要整整 10 分鐘， 因為他走每一步 都要緊握著繩索來前進。

cues.text: holding onto the ropes every step of the way.
cues.en: holding onto the ropes every step of the way.
cues.zh: 因為他走每一步 都要緊握著繩索來前進。

cues.text: By the professor's calculations, the zombies will catch up to you in just over 17 minutes,
cues.en: By the professor's calculations, the zombies will catch up to you in just over 17 minutes,
cues.zh: 根據教授的計算， 在 17 分鐘後， 殭屍就會追上你們，

cues.text: so you only have that much time to get everyone across and cut the ropes.
cues.en: so you only have that much time to get everyone across and cut the ropes.
cues.zh: 在 17 分鐘後， 殭屍就會追上你們， 你只有這麼多的時間， 讓所有人透過吊橋並剪掉繩索。 不幸的是，吊橋同一時間 只能承載兩個人。

cues.text: Unfortunately, the bridge can only hold two people at a time.
cues.en: Unfortunately, the bridge can only hold two people at a time.
cues.zh: 不幸的是，吊橋同一時間 只能承載兩個人。 更糟糕的是，

cues.text: To make matters worse, it's so dark out that you can barely see,
cues.en: To make matters worse, it's so dark out that you can barely see,
cues.zh: 更糟糕的是， 天色太暗， 讓你伸手不見五指， 而你手中的老舊油燈， 只能照亮一個小範圍。

cues.text: and the old lantern you grabbed on your way only illuminates a tiny area.
cues.en: and the old lantern you grabbed on your way only illuminates a tiny area.
cues.zh: 天色太暗， 讓你伸手不見五指， 而你手中的老舊油燈， 只能照亮一個小範圍。 你能想出讓每個人 及時逃脫的方法嗎？

cues.text: Can you figure out a way to have everyone escape in time?
cues.en: Can you figure out a way to have everyone escape in time?
cues.zh: 你能想出讓每個人 及時逃脫的方法嗎？ 記住：不能超過兩人 同時走在吊橋上；

cues.text: Remember: no more than two people can cross the bridge together,
cues.en: Remember: no more than two people can cross the bridge together,
cues.zh: 記住：不能超過兩人 同時走在吊橋上； 跨越吊橋時，若不帶著油燈， 就得走在提燈者旁。

cues.text: anyone crossing must either hold the lantern or stay right next to it,
cues.en: anyone crossing must either hold the lantern or stay right next to it,
cues.zh: 跨越吊橋時，若不帶著油燈， 就得走在提燈者旁。

cues.text: and any of you can safely wait in the dark on either side of the gorge.
cues.en: and any of you can safely wait in the dark on either side of the gorge.
cues.zh: 而所有人都可以安全地待在 漆黑的峽谷兩端。 最重要的是，所有人必須在 殭屍抵達前安全地透過吊橋。

cues.text: Most importantly, everyone must be safely across before the zombies arrive.
cues.en: Most importantly, everyone must be safely across before the zombies arrive.
cues.zh: 最重要的是，所有人必須在 殭屍抵達前安全地透過吊橋。 否則，當殭屍一踏上橋時， 橋上的人會使吊橋負荷過重而斷裂。

cues.text: Otherwise, the first zombie could step on the bridge while people are still on it.
cues.en: Otherwise, the first zombie could step on the bridge while people are still on it.
cues.zh: 否則，當殭屍一踏上橋時， 橋上的人會使吊橋負荷過重而斷裂。 最後，不能用任何花招。

cues.text: Finally, there are no tricks to use here.
cues.en: Finally, there are no tricks to use here.
cues.zh: 最後，不能用任何花招。

cues.text: You can't swing across, use the bridge as a raft, or befriend the zombies.
cues.en: You can't swing across, use the bridge as a raft, or befriend the zombies.
cues.zh: 你不能用繩索擺盪過去， 也不能把橋做成木筏， 或者和殭屍當朋友。

cues.text: Answer in: 3 Answer in: 2 Answer in: 1

cues.en: At first it might seem like no matter what you do, you're just a minute or two short of time, but there is a way.

cues.en: The key is to minimize the time wasted by the two slowest people
cues.zh: 關鍵就在於： 讓最慢的兩人走在一起， 來減少他們所需要花的時間。

cues.text: And because you'll need to make a couple of return trips with the lantern,
cues.en: And because you'll need to make a couple of return trips with the lantern,
cues.zh: 而且，要有人提著油燈走回來 這總共需要兩趟，

cues.en: you'll want to have the fastest people available to do so.

cues.text: So, you and the lab assistant quickly run across with the lantern,
cues.en: So, you and the lab assistant quickly run across with the lantern,

cues.text: though you have to slow down a bit to match her pace.
cues.en: though you have to slow down a bit to match her pace.

cues.text: After two minutes, both of you are across, and you, as the quickest, run back with the lantern.
cues.en: After two minutes, both of you are across, and you, as the quickest, run back with the lantern.
cues.zh: 兩分鐘後， 你們兩人都透過吊橋， 然後跑得最快的你， 再迅速提著油燈返回， 這樣只花了三分鐘。

cues.text: So far, so good.

cues.text: This takes them ten minutes since the janitor has to slow down for the old professor
cues.en: This takes them ten minutes since the janitor has to slow down for the old professor
cues.zh: 這花了他們 10 分鐘， 因為管理員必須 為了老教授放慢腳步， 教授喃喃自語抱怨著： 他當初不該讓殭屍擁有夜視能力。

cues.text: who keeps muttering that he probably shouldn't have given the zombies night vision.

cues.text: By the time they're across, there are only four minutes left,
cues.en: By the time they're across, there are only four minutes left,
cues.zh: 當他們跨越吊橋時， 只剩下 4 分鐘， 而你仍困在對岸。

cues.text: and you're still stuck on the wrong side of the bridge.
cues.en: and you're still stuck on the wrong side of the bridge.
cues.zh: 而你仍困在對岸。

cues.text: But remember, the lab assistant has been waiting on the other side,
cues.en: But remember, the lab assistant has been waiting on the other side,
cues.zh: 而你仍困在對岸。 但是記住，實驗室助理 已經在另一邊待命， 而她是隊伍中跑第二快的人。

cues.text: and she's the second fastest of the group.

cues.text: So she grabs the lantern from the professor and runs back across to you.
cues.en: So she grabs the lantern from the professor and runs back across to you.
cues.zh: 所以她從教授手中拿起油燈， 快速跑回去你那邊。 現在只剩下 2 分鐘， 你們兩位最後一次過橋，

cues.en: Now with only two minutes left, the two of you make the final crossing.
cues.zh: 現在只剩下 2 分鐘， 你們兩位最後一次過橋， 當你踏上峽谷的另一側，

cues.en: As you step on the far side of the gorge, you cut the ropes and collapse the bridge behind you,
cues.zh: 當你踏上峽谷的另一側， 你剪斷繩索， 摧毀身後的吊橋， 時間剛好趕上。

cues.text: just in the nick of time.
cues.en: just in the nick of time.
cues.zh: 時間剛好趕上。

cues.text: Maybe next summer, you'll just stick to the library.
cues.en: Maybe next summer, you'll just stick to the library.

p7HKvqRI_Bo.title: How does the stock market work? - Oliver Elfenbaum
p7HKvqRI_Bo.speaker: TED-Ed
p7HKvqRI_Bo.zh: 【TED-Ed】股票市場如何運作？ ——奧利佛‧埃爾芬鮑姆（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: In the 1600s the Dutch East India Company employed hundreds of ships
cues.en: In the 1600s the Dutch East India Company employed hundreds of ships
cues.zh: 在 1600 年代， 荷蘭東印度公司僱用了數百艘船，

cues.text: to trade gold, porcelain, spices, and silks around the globe.
cues.en: to trade gold, porcelain, spices, and silks around the globe.
cues.zh: 做黃金、瓷器、香料， 和絲的全球貿易。

cues.text: But running this massive operation wasn’t cheap.
cues.en: But running this massive operation wasn’t cheap.
cues.zh: 但要支撐這麼龐大的營運， 花費一點也不便宜。

cues.text: In order to fund their expensive voyages, the company turned to private citizens–

oqGuJhOeMek.title: Cell vs. virus: A battle for health - Shannon Stiles
oqGuJhOeMek.speaker: TED-Ed
oqGuJhOeMek.zh: 【TED-Ed】細胞與病毒：健康之戰－Shannon Stiles（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: You're in line at the grocery store when, uh oh, someone sneezes on you.
cues.en: You're in line at the grocery store when, uh oh, someone sneezes on you.
cues.zh: 你在超市排隊付帳，哎呀 有人對著你打噴嚏 你的肺吸進了感冒病毒

cues.text: The cold virus is sucked inside your lungs and lands on a cell on your airway lining.
cues.en: The cold virus is sucked inside your lungs and lands on a cell on your airway lining.
cues.zh: 你的肺吸進了感冒病毒 並降落在你的氣道黏膜上 地球上的每一種生物都由細胞組成

cues.text: Every living thing on Earth is made of cells, from the smallest one-celled bacteria
cues.en: Every living thing on Earth is made of cells, from the smallest one-celled bacteria
cues.zh: 地球上的每一種生物都由細胞組成 從最小的單細胞細菌 到巨大的藍鯨，還有你都是

cues.text: to the giant blue whale to you.
cues.en: to the giant blue whale to you.
cues.zh: 從最小的單細胞細菌 到巨大的藍鯨，還有你都是

cues.text: Each cell in your body is surrounded by a cell membrane, a thick flexible layer made of fats and proteins,
cues.en: Each cell in your body is surrounded by a cell membrane, a thick flexible layer made of fats and proteins,
cues.zh: 到巨大的藍鯨，還有你都是 你體內的每個細胞都以細胞膜圍住 它是肥厚可變形的層狀物 由脂肪及蛋白質組成 包圍及保護內部的元件

cues.text: that surrounds and protects the inner components.
cues.en: that surrounds and protects the inner components.
cues.zh: 包圍及保護內部的元件 它具半透性

cues.text: It's semipermeable, meaning that it lets some thing pass in and out
cues.en: It's semipermeable, meaning that it lets some thing pass in and out
cues.zh: 它具半透性 表示它讓某些物質進出 但會阻擋其他的

cues.text: but blocks others.
cues.en: but blocks others.
cues.zh: 但會阻擋其他的

cues.text: The cell membrane is covered with tiny projections.
cues.en: The cell membrane is covered with tiny projections.
cues.zh: 但會阻擋其他的 細胞膜上有很多小突起

cues.text: They all have functions, like helping cells adhere to their neighbors or binding to nutrients the cell will need.
cues.en: They all have functions, like helping cells adhere to their neighbors or binding to nutrients the cell will need.
cues.zh: 細胞膜上有很多小突起 它們都有功能 像是幫助細胞與鄰近細胞黏在一起 或是與細胞所需的營養素結合

cues.text: Animal and plant cells have cell membranes.
cues.en: Animal and plant cells have cell membranes.
cues.zh: 或是與細胞所需的營養素結合 動物及植物的細胞都有細胞膜

cues.text: Only plant cells have a cell wall, which is made of rigid cellulose that gives the plant structure.
cues.en: Only plant cells have a cell wall, which is made of rigid cellulose that gives the plant structure.
cues.zh: 動物及植物的細胞都有細胞膜 只有植物細胞有細胞壁 它是由堅硬的纖維素組成 給予植物形狀 經由噴嚏進入肺內的病毒細胞很狡猾

cues.text: The virus cell that was sneezed into your lungs is sneaky.
cues.en: The virus cell that was sneezed into your lungs is sneaky.
cues.zh: 經由噴嚏進入肺內的病毒細胞很狡猾 它假裝成朋友

cues.text: Pretending to be a friend, it attaches to a projection on the cell membrane,
cues.en: Pretending to be a friend, it attaches to a projection on the cell membrane,
cues.zh: 經由噴嚏進入肺內的病毒細胞很狡猾 它假裝成朋友 附著在細胞膜的某個突起上

cues.text: and the cell brings it through the cell membrane and inside.
cues.en: and the cell brings it through the cell membrane and inside.
cues.zh: 這個細胞就帶著它穿過細胞膜到內部 當病毒順利透過

cues.text: When the virus gets through, the cell recognizes its mistake.
cues.en: When the virus gets through, the cell recognizes its mistake.
cues.zh: 這個細胞就帶著它穿過細胞膜到內部 當病毒順利透過 細胞辨認出錯誤

cues.text: An enemy is inside!
cues.en: An enemy is inside!
cues.zh: 敵人在裡面！

cues.text: Special enzymes arrive at the scene and chop the virus to pieces.
cues.en: Special enzymes arrive at the scene and chop the virus to pieces.
cues.zh: 敵人在裡面！ 特種酵素抵達現場 把病毒大卸八塊 然後把其中一塊送回去

cues.text: They then send one of the pieces back through the cell membrane, where the cell displays it to warn neighboring cells
cues.en: They then send one of the pieces back through the cell membrane, where the cell displays it to warn neighboring cells
cues.zh: 然後把其中一塊送回去 透過細胞膜 細胞在膜上將其示眾 以警告鄰近細胞

cues.text: about the invader.
cues.en: about the invader.
cues.zh: 細胞在膜上將其示眾 以警告鄰近細胞 有入侵者

cues.text: A nearby cell sees the warning and immediately goes into action.
cues.en: A nearby cell sees the warning and immediately goes into action.
cues.zh: 鄰近的細胞看見警告 立刻做出行動

cues.text: It needs to make antibodies, proteins that will attack and kill the invading virus.
cues.en: It needs to make antibodies, proteins that will attack and kill the invading virus.
cues.zh: 它需要製造抗生素 它是蛋白質成分，會攻擊並殺掉 入侵的病毒 這個過程在細胞核內開始

cues.text: This process starts in the nucleus.
cues.en: This process starts in the nucleus.
cues.zh: 這個過程在細胞核內開始 細胞核含有我們的 去氧核糖核酸

cues.text: The nucleus contains our DNA, the blueprint that tells our cells how to make everything
cues.en: The nucleus contains our DNA, the blueprint that tells our cells how to make everything
cues.zh: 細胞核含有我們的 去氧核糖核酸 為一張藍圖，告訴我們的細胞如何製造

cues.text: our bodies need to function.
cues.en: our bodies need to function.
cues.zh: 身體所需的東西以發揮功能

cues.text: A certain section of our DNA contains instructions that tell our cells how to make antibodies.
cues.en: A certain section of our DNA contains instructions that tell our cells how to make antibodies.
cues.zh: 去氧核糖核酸的某段包含指令 告訴我們的細胞如何製造抗生素 在核內的酵素會找到 正確的那一段去氧核糖核酸

cues.text: Enzymes in the nucleus find the right section of DNA, then create a copy of these instructions,
cues.en: Enzymes in the nucleus find the right section of DNA, then create a copy of these instructions,
cues.zh: 在核內的酵素會找到 正確的那一段去氧核糖核酸 然後複製這些指令 稱做傳訊核醣核酸

cues.text: called messenger RNA.
cues.en: called messenger RNA.
cues.zh: 稱做傳訊核醣核酸 傳訊核醣核酸離開細胞核去執行指令

cues.text: The messenger RNA leaves the nucleus to carry out its orders.
cues.en: The messenger RNA leaves the nucleus to carry out its orders.
cues.zh: 傳訊核醣核酸離開細胞核去執行指令 傳訊核醣核酸前往核醣體

cues.text: The messenger RNA travels to a ribosome.
cues.en: The messenger RNA travels to a ribosome.
cues.zh: 傳訊核醣核酸離開細胞核去執行指令 傳訊核醣核酸前往核醣體

cues.text: There can be as many as 10 million ribosomes in a human cell,
cues.en: There can be as many as 10 million ribosomes in a human cell,
cues.zh: 人體細胞內有可高達一千萬個 核醣體 像釘子般綴滿一條帶狀結構

cues.text: all studded along a ribbon-like structure called the endoplasmic reticulum.
cues.en: all studded along a ribbon-like structure called the endoplasmic reticulum.
cues.zh: 核醣體 像釘子般綴滿一條帶狀結構 稱為內質網 這個核醣體讀取從細胞核傳來的指令

cues.text: This ribosome reads the instructions from the nucleus.
cues.en: This ribosome reads the instructions from the nucleus.
cues.zh: 這個核醣體讀取從細胞核傳來的指令

cues.text: It takes amino acids and links them together one by one creating an antibody protein that will go fight the virus.
cues.en: It takes amino acids and links them together one by one creating an antibody protein that will go fight the virus.
cues.zh: 這個核醣體讀取從細胞核傳來的指令 它需要胺基酸並一個個串起來 製造出抗生素蛋白質去對抗病毒 但是在此之前

cues.text: But before it can do that, the antibody needs to leave the cell.
cues.en: But before it can do that, the antibody needs to leave the cell.
cues.zh: 但是在此之前 抗生素需要離開細胞

cues.text: The antibody heads to the golgi apparatus.
cues.en: The antibody heads to the golgi apparatus.
cues.zh: 抗生素前往高基氏體 在這裡抗生素包裹起來 準備運送到細胞外

cues.text: Here, it's packed up for delivery outside the cell.
cues.en: Here, it's packed up for delivery outside the cell.
cues.zh: 在這裡抗生素包裹起來 準備運送到細胞外 包在一個跟細胞膜 同樣材料所製的泡泡裡

cues.text: Enclosed in a bubble made of the same material as the cell membrane, the golgi apparatus also gives the antibody directions,
cues.en: Enclosed in a bubble made of the same material as the cell membrane, the golgi apparatus also gives the antibody directions,
cues.zh: 包在一個跟細胞膜 同樣材料所製的泡泡裡 高基氏體也給抗生素方向 告訴它如何走到細胞的邊緣

cues.text: telling it how to get to the edge of the cell.
cues.en: telling it how to get to the edge of the cell.
cues.zh: 告訴它如何走到細胞的邊緣 當它到達那裡

cues.text: When it gets there, the bubble surrounding the antibody fuses to the cell membrane.
cues.en: When it gets there, the bubble surrounding the antibody fuses to the cell membrane.
cues.zh: 當它到達那裡 這個包圍著抗生素的泡泡 會與細胞膜融合 細胞排出抗生素

cues.text: The cell ejects the antibody, and it heads out to track down the virus.
cues.en: The cell ejects the antibody, and it heads out to track down the virus.
cues.zh: 細胞排出抗生素 而它出發向外去追捕病毒

cues.text: The leftover bubble will be broken down by the cell's lysosomes and its pieces recycled over and over again.
cues.en: The leftover bubble will be broken down by the cell's lysosomes and its pieces recycled over and over again.
cues.zh: 而它出發向外去追捕病毒 留下來的泡泡會分解 由細胞的溶酶體執行 溶掉的碎片會不斷回收利用

cues.text: Where did the cell get the energy to do all this?
cues.en: Where did the cell get the energy to do all this?
cues.zh: 細胞從何處得到能量執行這些事？ 那就是粒線體的角色了

cues.text: That's the roll of the mitochondria.
cues.en: That's the roll of the mitochondria.
cues.zh: 那就是粒線體的角色了

cues.text: To make energy, the mitochondria takes oxygen, this is the only reason we breathe it,
cues.en: To make energy, the mitochondria takes oxygen, this is the only reason we breathe it,
cues.zh: 那就是粒線體的角色了 要產生能量，粒線體需要利用氧氣 這是我們吸進氧氣的唯一理由 並從我們所吃的食物中加進電子

cues.text: and adds electrons from the food we eat to make water molecules.
cues.en: and adds electrons from the food we eat to make water molecules.

cues.text: That process also creates a high energy molecule, called ATP which the cell uses to power all of its parts.
cues.en: That process also creates a high energy molecule, called ATP which the cell uses to power all of its parts.
cues.zh: 那個過程也產生一種高能量分子 稱為三磷酸腺苷 細胞用它提供能量給所有的零件 植物細胞以不同的方法產生能量

cues.text: Plant cells make energy a different way.
cues.en: Plant cells make energy a different way.
cues.zh: 稱為三磷酸腺苷 細胞用它提供能量給所有的零件 植物細胞以不同的方法產生能量 它們有葉綠體

cues.text: They have chloroplasts that combine carbon dioxide and water with light energy from the sun
cues.en: They have chloroplasts that combine carbon dioxide and water with light energy from the sun
cues.zh: 它們有葉綠體 能結合二氧化碳及水 藉助從太陽得來的光能

cues.text: to create oxygen and sugar, a form of chemical energy.
cues.en: to create oxygen and sugar, a form of chemical energy.
cues.zh: 產生氧氣及糖 為化學能的一種形式 細胞內的所有零件都必須合作

cues.text: All the parts of a cell have to work together to keep things running smoothly,
cues.en: All the parts of a cell have to work together to keep things running smoothly,
cues.zh: 為化學能的一種形式 細胞內的所有零件都必須合作 讓一切運作順利 你身體的所有細胞也都必須合作

cues.text: and all the cells of your body have to work together to keep you running smoothly.
cues.en: and all the cells of your body have to work together to keep you running smoothly.
cues.zh: 你身體的所有細胞也都必須合作 讓你運作順利 那是一大堆的細胞

cues.text: That's a whole lot of cells.
cues.en: That's a whole lot of cells.
cues.zh: 那是一大堆的細胞

cues.text: Scientists think there are about 37 trillion of them.
cues.en: Scientists think there are about 37 trillion of them.
