cues.text: One of Leonardo's greatest masterpieces decorates the monks' dining hall
cues.en: One of Leonardo's greatest masterpieces decorates the monks' dining hall
cues.zh: 達文西最偉大的傑作之一裝飾了僧侶的餐廳

cues.text: adjacent the Church of Santa Maria delle Grazie.
cues.en: adjacent the Church of Santa Maria delle Grazie.
cues.zh: 毗鄰聖瑪麗亞感恩教堂。

cues.text: Admission to the "Last Supper" is by reservation only, and spots can be booked up well over a month in advance.
cues.en: Admission to the "Last Supper" is by reservation only, and spots can be booked up well over a month in advance.
cues.zh: 「最後的晚餐」的門票必須提前預訂，並且可以提前一個多月預訂。

cues.text: Good guidebooks explain the process.
cues.en: Good guidebooks explain the process.
cues.zh: 好的指南會解釋這個過程。

cues.text: Because of the fragility of this much-loved Renaissance masterpiece, the humidity is carefully regulated.
cues.en: Because of the fragility of this much-loved Renaissance masterpiece, the humidity is carefully regulated.
cues.zh: 由於這深受喜愛的文藝復興傑作的脆弱性，濕度需要經過精心調節。

cues.text: We're enjoying a private visit with our TV camera.
cues.en: We're enjoying a private visit with our TV camera.
cues.zh: 我們正在用電視攝影機進行私人訪問。

cues.text: But normally, groups of 25 are allowed in every 15 minutes,
cues.en: But normally, groups of 25 are allowed in every 15 minutes,
cues.zh: 但正常情況下，每15分鐘允許25人一組，

cues.text: only after dehumidifying in this waiting chamber.
cues.en: only after dehumidifying in this waiting chamber.
cues.zh: 只有在候診室除濕後。

cues.text: Seeing the "Last Supper," one of the greatest works in art history, is well worth the hassle.
cues.en: Seeing the "Last Supper," one of the greatest works in art history, is well worth the hassle.
cues.zh: 觀看藝術史上最偉大的作品之一《最後的晚餐》是非常值得的。

cues.text: Leonardo portrays the last dinner Jesus had with his disciples before he was crucified.
cues.en: Leonardo portrays the last dinner Jesus had with his disciples before he was crucified.
cues.zh: 列奧納多描繪了耶穌被釘十字架前與門徒共進的最後一頓晚餐。

cues.text: The composition is dreamy.
cues.en: The composition is dreamy.
cues.zh: 構圖很夢幻。

cues.text: Leonardo captures the psychological drama as Jesus says, "One of you will betray me,"
cues.en: Leonardo captures the psychological drama as Jesus says, "One of you will betray me,"
cues.zh: 萊昂納多捕捉到了耶穌所說的心理戲劇：“你們中的一個人會背叛我”

cues.text: and the Apostles, huddling in stressed-out groups of three,
cues.en: and the Apostles, huddling in stressed-out groups of three,
cues.zh: 使徒們三人擠在一起，壓力山大，

cues.text: wonder, "Lord, is it I?" Some are scandalized,
cues.en: wonder, "Lord, is it I?" Some are scandalized,
cues.zh: 疑惑：「主啊，是我嗎？」有些人感到憤慨，

cues.text: others want more information.
cues.en: others want more information.
cues.zh: 其他人想要更多資訊。

cues.text: In this agitated atmosphere, only Judas, clutching his 30 pieces of silver,
cues.en: In this agitated atmosphere, only Judas, clutching his 30 pieces of silver,
cues.zh: 在這躁動的氣氛中，只有猶大，手裡握著他的三十塊銀子，

cues.text: is not shocked.
cues.en: is not shocked.
cues.zh: 並不震驚。

cues.text: Leonardo employs his understanding of perspective to give the fresco added punch.
cues.en: Leonardo employs his understanding of perspective to give the fresco added punch.
cues.zh: 萊昂納多運用他對透視的理解為這幅壁畫增添了衝擊力。

cues.text: The building's lines of perspective converge right on Christ.
cues.en: The building's lines of perspective converge right on Christ.
cues.zh: 建築物的透視線正好集中在基督身上。

cues.text: The viewer doesn't understand the mathematics, but subconsciously,
cues.en: The viewer doesn't understand the mathematics, but subconsciously,
cues.zh: 觀眾不懂數學，但潛意識裡，

cues.text: it's clear to anyone enjoying this masterpiece that Jesus is the powerful center of it all.
cues.en: it's clear to anyone enjoying this masterpiece that Jesus is the powerful center of it all.
cues.zh: 任何欣賞這部傑作的人都清楚，耶穌是這一切的強大中心。

cues.text: Because of Leonardo's experimental fresco technique, deterioration began within six years of its completion.
cues.en: Because of Leonardo's experimental fresco technique, deterioration began within six years of its completion.
cues.zh: 由於列奧納多的實驗性壁畫技術，完成後六年內就開始惡化。

cues.text: The church was bombed in World War II, but -- miraculously, it seemed -- the wall
cues.en: The church was bombed in World War II, but -- miraculously, it seemed -- the wall
cues.zh: 這座教堂在第二次世界大戰中遭到轟炸，但奇蹟般的是，牆

cues.text: holding the "Last Supper" remained standing.
cues.en: holding the "Last Supper" remained standing.
cues.zh: 拿著《最後的晚餐》的人仍然站著。

cues.text: A recent restoration peeled away 500 years of touch-ups,
cues.en: A recent restoration peeled away 500 years of touch-ups,
cues.zh: 最近的一次修復剝離了 500 年的修飾，

cues.text: leaving a faint yet vibrant masterpiece.
cues.en: leaving a faint yet vibrant masterpiece.
cues.zh: 留下了一幅淡淡而充滿活力的傑作。

cues.text: The room depicted in the painting seems like an architectural extension of the actual room.
cues.en: The room depicted in the painting seems like an architectural extension of the actual room.
cues.zh: 畫中描繪的房間似乎是實際房間的建築延伸。

cues.text: Leonardo even painted as if the light from the real windows hit the fresco from the side.
cues.en: Leonardo even painted as if the light from the real windows hit the fresco from the side.
cues.zh: 列奧納多甚至畫得好像真實窗戶的光線從側面照射到壁畫上一樣。

cues.text: Jesus anticipates his sacrifice -- his face is sad, all-knowing, and accepting.
cues.en: Jesus anticipates his sacrifice -- his face is sad, all-knowing, and accepting.
cues.zh: 耶穌預見了他的犧牲——他的臉是悲傷的、全知的和接受的。

cues.text: Like any big European city, Milano's public transit is first class,
cues.en: Like any big European city, Milano's public transit is first class,
cues.zh: 與任何歐洲大城市一樣，米蘭的公共交通是一流的，

cues.text: but only if you use it.
cues.en: but only if you use it.
cues.zh: 但前提是你要使用它。

cues.text: Trams screech and glide everywhere.
cues.en: Trams screech and glide everywhere.
cues.zh: 電車到處都是刺耳的聲音和滑行。

cues.text: The old and new share the well-worn tracks.
cues.en: The old and new share the well-worn tracks.
cues.zh: 新舊事物共享著陳舊的軌道。

cues.text: The modern underground makes this sprawling city much easier to manage.
cues.en: The modern underground makes this sprawling city much easier to manage.
cues.zh: 現代化的地下設施使這座龐大的城市更容易管理。

cues.text: While most of the sights are within walking distance, your day goes easier, especially in the heat of the summer,
cues.en: While most of the sights are within walking distance, your day goes easier, especially in the heat of the summer,
cues.zh: 雖然大多數景點都在步行範圍內，但您的一天會變得更加輕鬆，尤其是在炎熱的夏季，

cues.text: when you use the metro.
cues.en: when you use the metro.
cues.zh: 當你搭乘地鐵時。

cues.text: Milan is home to possibly the world's most prestigious opera house --
cues.en: Milan is home to possibly the world's most prestigious opera house --
cues.zh: 米蘭可能是世界上最負盛名的歌劇院的所在地—

cues.text: La Scala.
cues.en: La Scala.
cues.zh: 斯卡拉歌劇院。

cues.text: While tickets are pricey and tough to get, anyone can visit the museum,
cues.en: While tickets are pricey and tough to get, anyone can visit the museum,
cues.zh: 雖然門票昂貴且很難買到，但任何人都可以參觀博物館，

cues.text: which comes with a peek at the plush theater, often getting set up for the next performance.
cues.en: which comes with a peek at the plush theater, often getting set up for the next performance.
cues.zh: 伴隨著參觀豪華劇院，通常會為下一場演出做好準備。

cues.text: Since it opened in 1778, La Scala has been committed to hosting
cues.en: Since it opened in 1778, La Scala has been committed to hosting
cues.zh: 自 1778 年開業以來，斯卡拉歌劇院一直致力於舉辦

cues.text: the grandest of operas in all their intended glory.
cues.en: the grandest of operas in all their intended glory.
cues.zh: 最偉大的歌劇，其所有的榮耀。

cues.text: The La Scala Museum collection features things that mean absolutely nothing to the MTV crowd:
cues.en: The La Scala Museum collection features things that mean absolutely nothing to the MTV crowd:
cues.zh: 斯卡拉博物館 (La Scala Museum) 的收藏對 MTV 觀眾來說毫無意義：

cues.text: Toscanini's eyeglasses, well-worn batons, Caruso's bust,
cues.en: Toscanini's eyeglasses, well-worn batons, Caruso's bust,
cues.zh: 托斯卡尼尼的眼鏡、破舊的警棍、卡魯索的半身像，

cues.text: original scores, and much more.
cues.en: original scores, and much more.
cues.zh: 原始分數等等。

cues.text: The halls are alive with memories of the great composers and musicians that made this
cues.en: The halls are alive with memories of the great composers and musicians that made this
cues.zh: 大廳裡充滿了對偉大作曲家和音樂家的回憶，他們創造了這個

cues.text: the ultimate opera scene.
cues.en: the ultimate opera scene.
cues.zh: 終極歌劇場景。

cues.text: For over two centuries, Milan's glitterati has enjoyed breathtaking performances
cues.en: For over two centuries, Milan's glitterati has enjoyed breathtaking performances
cues.zh: 兩個多世紀以來，米蘭的名流們一直欣賞著令人驚嘆的表演

cues.text: by the biggest names in opera, from Maria Callas all the way back to Verdi.
cues.en: by the biggest names in opera, from Maria Callas all the way back to Verdi.
cues.zh: 歌劇界最知名的人物，從瑪麗亞·卡拉斯一直到威爾第。

cues.text: Giuseppe Verdi was the greatest of the Romantic Italian opera composers.
cues.en: Giuseppe Verdi was the greatest of the Romantic Italian opera composers.
cues.zh: 朱塞佩·威爾第是義大利最偉大的浪漫主義歌劇作曲家。

cues.text: And in the 19th century, his name meant more than music.
cues.en: And in the 19th century, his name meant more than music.
cues.zh: 在 19 世紀，他的名字不僅僅意味著音樂。

cues.text: He was a champion of the Italian unification movement.
cues.en: He was a champion of the Italian unification movement.
cues.zh: 他是義大利統一運動的擁護者。

cues.text: Back when flying an Italian flag could get you in trouble, Verdi's arias served as virtual national anthems.
cues.en: Back when flying an Italian flag could get you in trouble, Verdi's arias served as virtual national anthems.
cues.zh: 當懸掛義大利國旗可能會給你帶來麻煩時，威爾第的詠嘆調幾乎成了國歌。

cues.text: The nearby Risorgimento Museum tells the story of Italy's unification.
cues.en: The nearby Risorgimento Museum tells the story of Italy's unification.
cues.zh: 附近的復興博物館講述了義大利統一的故事。

cues.text: It helps us imagine the excitement in Europe during the mid-1800s
cues.en: It helps us imagine the excitement in Europe during the mid-1800s
cues.zh: 它幫助我們想像 1800 年代中期歐洲的熱鬧景象

cues.text: as the modern nations of Italy, Germany, and others were being born.
cues.en: as the modern nations of Italy, Germany, and others were being born.
cues.zh: 義大利、德國等現代國家正在誕生。

cues.text: Back then, a few royal families -- such as the Habsburgs, Bourbons, and Romanovs --
cues.en: Back then, a few royal families -- such as the Habsburgs, Bourbons, and Romanovs --
cues.zh: 當時，一些王室家族——比如哈布斯堡王朝、波旁王朝和羅曼諾夫王朝——

cues.text: ruled Europe without regard to nationality.
cues.en: ruled Europe without regard to nationality.
cues.zh: 統治歐洲不分國籍。

cues.text: And none of them wanted to see the emergence of modern nation states.
cues.en: And none of them wanted to see the emergence of modern nation states.
cues.zh: 他們都不想看到現代民族國家的出現。

cues.text: Even without really understanding the details, just pondering the stirring paintings here
cues.en: Even without really understanding the details, just pondering the stirring paintings here
cues.zh: 即使沒有真正瞭解細節，只是沉思這裡激動人心的畫作

cues.text: makes it clear there are Italian equivalents to our battles of Bunker Hill, Valley Forge, and Yorktown.
cues.en: makes it clear there are Italian equivalents to our battles of Bunker Hill, Valley Forge, and Yorktown.
cues.zh: 清楚地表明，義大利的邦克山、福吉谷和約克鎮之戰也有類似的情況。

cues.text: After four centuries of foreign rule, Milan helped spearhead Italy's road to unity.
cues.en: After four centuries of foreign rule, Milan helped spearhead Italy's road to unity.
cues.zh: 經過四個世紀的外國統治後，米蘭幫助義大利走上了統一之路。

cues.text: Step by step -- whether in bloody battle or by popular vote, as was the case in Venice --
cues.en: Step by step -- whether in bloody battle or by popular vote, as was the case in Venice --
cues.zh: 一步一步——無論是透過血腥的戰鬥還是透過民眾投票，就像威尼斯的情況一樣——

cues.text: Italy went from a peninsula of colonies and small states in 1850
cues.en: Italy went from a peninsula of colonies and small states in 1850
cues.zh: 1850 年，義大利從一個由殖民地和小國組成的半島

cues.text: to one united country in 1870.
cues.en: to one united country in 1870.
cues.zh: 1870 年統一為一個國家。

cues.text: Italy's heroic struggles were led by patriots whose names are household words today.
cues.en: Italy's heroic struggles were led by patriots whose names are household words today.
cues.zh: 義大利的英勇鬥爭是由愛國者領導的，他們的名字如今家喻戶曉。

cues.text: Mazzini -- the intellectual who spread the notion that Italian-speaking people should be one nation.
cues.en: Mazzini -- the intellectual who spread the notion that Italian-speaking people should be one nation.
cues.zh: 馬志尼－一位傳播義大利語人民應該成為一個民族這一觀唸的知識分子。

cues.text: Garibaldi -- the guerilla war hero whose feisty little army of red shirts
cues.en: Garibaldi -- the guerilla war hero whose feisty little army of red shirts
cues.zh: 加里波底－遊擊戰爭英雄，他的紅衫小軍充滿活力

cues.text: brought Sicily and Southern Italy into the fold.
cues.en: brought Sicily and Southern Italy into the fold.
cues.zh: 將西西里島和義大利南部納入其中。

cues.text: And Victor Emmanuel -- the only Italian-blooded king,
cues.en: And Victor Emmanuel -- the only Italian-blooded king,
cues.zh: 還有維克多·伊曼紐爾——唯一有義大利血統的國王，

cues.text: who, upon unification, was the slam-dunk favorite to be the first constitutional monarch of the new Italy.
cues.en: who, upon unification, was the slam-dunk favorite to be the first constitutional monarch of the new Italy.
cues.zh: 統一後，他成為新義大利第一位立憲君主的熱門人選。

cues.text: Throughout Italy, the George Washingtons and Thomas Jeffersons of the Italian independence movement are celebrated.
cues.en: Throughout Italy, the George Washingtons and Thomas Jeffersons of the Italian independence movement are celebrated.
cues.zh: 在整個義大利，人們慶祝義大利獨立運動的喬治華盛頓和託馬斯傑斐遜。

cues.text: Statues, streets, and squares are named in honor of the founding fathers of modern Italy.
cues.en: Statues, streets, and squares are named in honor of the founding fathers of modern Italy.
cues.zh: 雕像、街道和廣場都是為了紀念現代義大利的創始人而命名的。

cues.text: But to be honest, most Milanese seem oblivious to all this history.
cues.en: But to be honest, most Milanese seem oblivious to all this history.
cues.zh: 但說實話，大多數米蘭人似乎都忘了這一切歷史。

cues.text: They just enjoy being who they are.
cues.en: They just enjoy being who they are.
cues.zh: 他們只是喜歡做自己。

cues.text: The special Italian love of life is easy to feel in Milan's many fine parks,
cues.en: The special Italian love of life is easy to feel in Milan's many fine parks,
cues.zh: 在米蘭眾多精美的公園裡，很容易感受到義大利人對生活的特殊熱愛，

cues.text: and in a scene like this, the traveler can glimpse yet another dimension
cues.en: and in a scene like this, the traveler can glimpse yet another dimension
cues.zh: 在這樣的場景中，旅行者可以看到另一個維度

cues.text: of this city: its people at play.
cues.en: of this city: its people at play.
cues.zh: 這座城市：人們在玩耍。

cues.text: Another favorite place for the Milanese is an hour away by train.
cues.en: Another favorite place for the Milanese is an hour away by train.
cues.zh: 米蘭人最喜歡的另一個地方是搭火車一小時即可到達。

cues.text: Lombardy's seductively beautiful Lakes district, where Italy meets the Alps,
cues.en: Lombardy's seductively beautiful Lakes district, where Italy meets the Alps,
cues.zh: 倫巴第美麗迷人的湖區，義大利與阿爾卑斯山的交會處，

cues.text: seems heaven-sent for communing with nature.
cues.en: seems heaven-sent for communing with nature.
cues.zh: 與大自然交流似乎是天賜之物。

cues.text: In this land of so many popular lakes, the million-Euro question is -- which one?
cues.en: In this land of so many popular lakes, the million-Euro question is -- which one?
cues.zh: 在這片擁有眾多熱門湖泊的土地上，價值百萬歐元的問題是──哪一個？

cues.text: While all the lakes have their charms, Lake Como is my favorite.
cues.en: While all the lakes have their charms, Lake Como is my favorite.
cues.zh: 雖然所有的湖泊都有其魅力，但科莫湖是我的最愛。

cues.text: It offers the best mix of accessibility, scenery, and offbeat-ness
cues.en: It offers the best mix of accessibility, scenery, and offbeat-ness
cues.zh: 它提供了便利性、風景和另類風格的最佳組合

cues.text: with a heady whiff of aristocratic-old-days romance.
cues.en: with a heady whiff of aristocratic-old-days romance.
cues.zh: 帶著令人陶醉的舊時貴族浪漫氣息。

cues.text: Lake Como is lined with elegant 19th-century villas,
cues.en: Lake Como is lined with elegant 19th-century villas,
cues.zh: 科莫湖兩旁都是優雅的19世紀別墅，

cues.text: crowned by snowcapped mountains and busy with fleets of little ferries.
cues.en: crowned by snowcapped mountains and busy with fleets of little ferries.
cues.zh: 山頂有白雪皚皚的山脈，還有繁忙的小渡輪隊。

cues.text: It's a good place to take a break from the intensity of urban turnstile sightseeing.
cues.en: It's a good place to take a break from the intensity of urban turnstile sightseeing.
cues.zh: 這是一個遠離城市十字轉門觀光的緊張氛圍的好地方。

cues.text: It seems half the travelers you'll meet have tossed their itineraries into the lake
cues.en: It seems half the travelers you'll meet have tossed their itineraries into the lake
cues.zh: 您遇到的旅行者中似乎有一半都將行程單扔進了湖裡

cues.text: and are actually relaxing.
cues.en: and are actually relaxing.
cues.zh: 並且實際上很放鬆。

cues.text: Today the hazy, lazy lake's only serious industry
cues.en: Today the hazy, lazy lake's only serious industry
cues.zh: 如今，這個朦朧、懶惰的湖是唯一嚴肅的產業

cues.text: is tourism.
cues.en: is tourism.
cues.zh: 是旅遊業。

cues.text: Lake Como's isolation and flat economy have left it pretty much the way
cues.en: Lake Como's isolation and flat economy have left it pretty much the way
cues.zh: 科莫湖的偏僻和經濟平淡使其幾乎陷入困境

cues.text: 19th-century Romantic poets first described it.
cues.en: 19th-century Romantic poets first described it.
cues.zh: 19世紀的浪漫主義詩人首先描述了它。

cues.text: Bellagio, the self-proclaimed "pearl of the lake," is a classy combination
cues.en: Bellagio, the self-proclaimed "pearl of the lake," is a classy combination
cues.zh: 自稱為「湖中明珠」的貝拉吉歐 (Bellagio) 是一個優雅的組合

cues.text: of old-world elegance and new-world luxury.
cues.en: of old-world elegance and new-world luxury.
cues.zh: 舊世界的優雅和新世界的奢華。

cues.text: Spendy five-star hotels give the well-heeled traveler all the comforts they're accustomed to.
cues.en: Spendy five-star hotels give the well-heeled traveler all the comforts they're accustomed to.
cues.zh: 豪華的五星級飯店為富有的旅客提供了他們所習慣的所有舒適設施。

cues.text: Harborfront shops entice posh travelers with jewelry and accessories.
cues.en: Harborfront shops entice posh travelers with jewelry and accessories.
cues.zh: 海濱商店以珠寶和配件吸引時尚旅行者。

cues.text: The heavy curtains between the arcades keep the visitors and their poodles from sweating.
cues.en: The heavy curtains between the arcades keep the visitors and their poodles from sweating.
cues.zh: 拱廊之間厚重的窗簾可以防止遊客和他們的貴賓犬出汗。

cues.text: The steep lanes rising from the harbor front lead to a tangle of sun-splashed squares.
cues.en: The steep lanes rising from the harbor front lead to a tangle of sun-splashed squares.
cues.zh: 從港口前線延伸出來的陡峭小巷通往陽光普照的廣場。

cues.text: Part of the fun of your lake visit is town-hopping on the ferries.
cues.en: Part of the fun of your lake visit is town-hopping on the ferries.
cues.zh: 遊覽湖泊的樂趣之一就是乘坐渡輪遊覽城鎮。

cues.text: For me, the ideal home base for Lago di Como is 15 minutes from Bellagio -- Varenna.
cues.en: For me, the ideal home base for Lago di Como is 15 minutes from Bellagio -- Varenna.
cues.zh: 對我來說，科莫湖的理想大本營是距離貝拉焦 - 瓦倫納 15 分鐘路程。

cues.text: This town of 800 people offers the best of all lake worlds.
cues.en: This town of 800 people offers the best of all lake worlds.
cues.zh: 這個擁有 800 人的小鎮擁有世界上最好的湖泊。

cues.text: Easily accessible by train from Milan, yet on the less-developed side of the lake,
cues.en: Easily accessible by train from Milan, yet on the less-developed side of the lake,
cues.zh: 從米蘭搭乘火車即可輕鬆抵達，但位於湖的欠發達一側，

cues.text: Varenna has a romantic promenade...
cues.en: Varenna has a romantic promenade...
cues.zh: 瓦倫納有個浪漫的海濱長廊.....

cues.text: a tiny harbor...
cues.en: a tiny harbor...
cues.zh: 一個小港口...

cues.text: and narrow lanes.
cues.en: and narrow lanes.
cues.zh: 和狹窄的車道。

cues.text: These buildings are stringently protected.
cues.en: These buildings are stringently protected.
cues.zh: 這些建築物受到嚴格保護。

cues.text: You can't even change the color of your home without asking permission.
cues.en: You can't even change the color of your home without asking permission.
cues.zh: 未經許可，你甚至不能改變你家的顏色。

cues.text: There are no streets in the Old Town, just characteristic stepped lanes.
cues.en: There are no streets in the Old Town, just characteristic stepped lanes.
cues.zh: 舊城區沒有街道，只有特色的階梯巷。

cues.text: It's an ideal place to savor a lakeside cappuccino or aperitivo.
cues.en: It's an ideal place to savor a lakeside cappuccino or aperitivo.
cues.zh: 這裡是品嚐湖畔卡布奇諾或開胃酒的理想場所。

cues.text: Imagine this sleepy harbor 200 years ago.
cues.en: Imagine this sleepy harbor 200 years ago.
cues.zh: 想像一下 200 年前這個沉睡的港口。

cues.text: It was busy.
cues.en: It was busy.
cues.zh: 很忙。

cues.text: There were coopers crafting oaken chestnut into barrels, stoneworkers carving and shipping
cues.en: There were coopers crafting oaken chestnut into barrels, stoneworkers carving and shipping
cues.zh: 有制桶工人將橡木栗子製作成桶，石匠進行雕刻和運輸

cues.text: Varenna's prized black marble, and fishing boats dragged up onto this cobbled beach.
cues.en: Varenna's prized black marble, and fishing boats dragged up onto this cobbled beach.
cues.zh: 瓦倫納珍貴的黑色大理石和漁船拖到了這片鵝卵石海灘上。

cues.text: Many Lake Como towns have a villa or two, with their dilapidated 19th-century elegance,
cues.en: Many Lake Como towns have a villa or two, with their dilapidated 19th-century elegance,
cues.zh: 許多科莫湖小鎮都擁有一兩棟別墅，帶著破舊的 19 世紀優雅，

cues.text: and wistful gardens open to the public, and even transformed into inviting hotels.
cues.en: and wistful gardens open to the public, and even transformed into inviting hotels.
cues.zh: 向公眾開放的令人嚮往的花園，甚至改造成誘人的酒店。

cues.text: In Varenna, the sprawling lakeside Villa Cipressi rents rooms and welcomes visitors -- for a small fee --
cues.en: In Varenna, the sprawling lakeside Villa Cipressi rents rooms and welcomes visitors -- for a small fee --
cues.zh: 在瓦倫納，龐大的湖畔 Villa Cipressi 出租房間並歡迎遊客——只需支付少量費用——

cues.text: to explore its peaceful terraced garden.
cues.en: to explore its peaceful terraced garden.
cues.zh: 探索其寧靜的露臺花園。

cues.text: Albergo Milano, located right in the Old Town, is the kind of place I like to recommend in my guidebooks.
cues.en: Albergo Milano, located right in the Old Town, is the kind of place I like to recommend in my guidebooks.
cues.zh: Albergo Milano 位於舊城區，是我喜歡在旅遊指南中推薦的地方。

cues.text: It's graciously run by Egidio and his Swiss wife, Bettina.
cues.en: It's graciously run by Egidio and his Swiss wife, Bettina.
cues.zh: 它由艾吉迪奧 (Egidio) 和他的瑞士妻子貝蒂娜 (Bettina) 慷慨地經營。

cues.text: Fusing the best of Italy with the best of Switzerland, the place manages to be both romantic and very well-run.
cues.en: Fusing the best of Italy with the best of Switzerland, the place manages to be both romantic and very well-run.
cues.zh: 這個地方融合了義大利的精華和瑞士的精華，既浪漫又管理良好。

cues.text: Most of its comfy rooms offer dreamy lake views.
cues.en: Most of its comfy rooms offer dreamy lake views.
cues.zh: 大部分舒適的客房均享有夢幻般的湖景。

cues.text: And Egidio is a fine chef.
cues.en: And Egidio is a fine chef.
cues.zh: 艾吉迪奧是一位出色的廚師。

cues.text: The limited menu changes daily, according to the season and the chef's whim.
cues.en: The limited menu changes daily, according to the season and the chef's whim.
cues.zh: 有限的選單每天都會根據季節和廚師的想法而變化。

cues.text: Varenna whispers "luna di miele" -- honeymoon.
cues.en: Varenna whispers "luna di miele" -- honeymoon.
cues.zh: 瓦倫娜低聲說著「luna di miele」－蜜月。

cues.text: And a good place to enjoy that romance is strolling along its passerella.
cues.en: And a good place to enjoy that romance is strolling along its passerella.
cues.zh: 沿著過街巷漫步是享受浪漫的好地方。

cues.text: You'll pass wisteria-drenched villas, evocative vistas, and lakeside lovers embracing the moment.
cues.en: You'll pass wisteria-drenched villas, evocative vistas, and lakeside lovers embracing the moment.
cues.zh: 您將經過紫藤覆蓋的別墅、令人回味的遠景以及擁抱這一刻的湖畔戀人。

cues.text: It's places like this where I really feel the romance of Europe.
cues.en: It's places like this where I really feel the romance of Europe.
cues.zh: 正是在這樣的地方，我才真正感受到了歐洲的浪漫。

cues.text: I hope you've enjoyed our look at Milano and Lago di Como.
cues.en: I hope you've enjoyed our look at Milano and Lago di Como.
cues.zh: 我希望您喜歡我們對米蘭和科莫湖的看法。

cues.text: I'm Rick Steves.
cues.en: I'm Rick Steves.
cues.zh: 我是瑞克·史蒂夫斯。

cues.text: Until next time, keep on travelin'.
cues.en: Until next time, keep on travelin'.
cues.zh: 直到下次，繼續旅行。

cues.text: "Ciao."
cues.en: "Ciao."
cues.zh: “再見。”

9BZk6eVMa00.title: Dolomites, Italy: Tirolean Culture and Alpine Adventures - Rick Steves’ Europe Travel Guide
9BZk6eVMa00.speaker: Rick Steves' Europe
9BZk6eVMa00.zh: 【Rick Steves' Europe】義大利多洛米蒂山：蒂羅爾文化與高山探險 - Rick Steves 的歐洲旅遊指南（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: We're on our way to Italy's dramatic limestone rooftop.
cues.en: We're on our way to Italy's dramatic limestone rooftop.
cues.zh: 我們正在前往義大利引人注目的石灰岩屋頂的路上。

cues.text: The Dolomites, with their distinct and jagged peaks, offer some of the best Alpine thrills in Europe.
cues.en: The Dolomites, with their distinct and jagged peaks, offer some of the best Alpine thrills in Europe.
cues.zh: 多洛米蒂山脈擁有獨特且鋸齒狀的山峰，提供歐洲最好的阿爾卑斯山刺激體驗。

cues.text: And these mighty mountains seem to protect the traditional culture in the region's villages and bucolic farmsteads.
cues.en: And these mighty mountains seem to protect the traditional culture in the region's villages and bucolic farmsteads.
cues.zh: 這些雄偉的山脈似乎保護著該地區村莊和田園農莊的傳統文化。

cues.text: Historically, the Tirol was its own state.
cues.en: Historically, the Tirol was its own state.
cues.zh: 從歷史上看，蒂羅爾州是一個獨立的州。

cues.text: Today, that region is divided -- part in Austria and part in Italy.
cues.en: Today, that region is divided -- part in Austria and part in Italy.
cues.zh: 如今，該地區已被分裂——一部分屬於奧地利，一部分屬於義大利。

cues.text: The Italian part is called South Tirol.
cues.en: The Italian part is called South Tirol.
cues.zh: 義大利部分稱為南蒂羅爾。

cues.text: The region is a mix of the two cultures and officially bilingual.
cues.en: The region is a mix of the two cultures and officially bilingual.
cues.zh: 該地區是兩種文化的混合體，官方語言是雙語的。

cues.text: While the traditional economy is farming, today tourism is also big --
cues.en: While the traditional economy is farming, today tourism is also big --
cues.zh: 雖然傳統經濟是農業，但如今旅遊業也很重要——

cues.text: skiing in winter, hiking in summer.
cues.en: skiing in winter, hiking in summer.
cues.zh: 冬天滑雪，夏天健行。

cues.text: The Great Dolomite Road, beautifully engineered, leads to the nearly 7,000-foot-high Sela Pass.
cues.en: The Great Dolomite Road, beautifully engineered, leads to the nearly 7,000-foot-high Sela Pass.
cues.zh: 設計精美的大白雲石公路通往近 7,000 英尺高的沙拉山口。

cues.text: ♪♪ It's great for a joy ride, and famously a big challenge for bikers.
cues.en: ♪♪ It's great for a joy ride, and famously a big challenge for bikers.
cues.zh: ♪♪ 這非常適合享受騎乘樂趣，而且對騎腳踏車的人來說也是一個巨大的挑戰。

cues.text: Making it to the summit is always a good excuse for a triumphant group photo.
cues.en: Making it to the summit is always a good excuse for a triumphant group photo.
cues.zh: 登頂始終是拍攝勝利合照的好藉口。

cues.text: These bold limestone pillars offer something for everybody.
cues.en: These bold limestone pillars offer something for everybody.
cues.zh: 這些大膽的石灰石柱為每個人提供了一些東西。

cues.text: This is rock-climbing country -- thrilling, even for spectators.
cues.en: This is rock-climbing country -- thrilling, even for spectators.
cues.zh: 這是一個攀巖國家——即使對觀眾來說也是令人興奮的。

cues.text: ♪♪ From the town of Ortisei, we're catching the Seceda lift.
cues.en: ♪♪ From the town of Ortisei, we're catching the Seceda lift.
cues.zh: ♪♪ 從奧蒂塞伊鎮出發，我們搭乘 Seceda 纜車。

cues.text: All over this region, the lifts do the climbing fast and easy,
cues.en: All over this region, the lifts do the climbing fast and easy,
cues.zh: 在這個地區，電梯可以快速輕鬆地攀爬，

cues.text: depositing hikers sweat-free at thin-air trailheads.
cues.en: depositing hikers sweat-free at thin-air trailheads.
cues.zh: 將健行者無汗地安置在空氣稀薄的步道起點。

cues.text: I love walking on a ridge.
cues.en: I love walking on a ridge.
cues.zh: 我喜歡在山脊上行走。

cues.text: And with as many nationalities enjoying this scene as there are flowers in the fields,
cues.en: And with as many nationalities enjoying this scene as there are flowers in the fields,
cues.zh: 田野裡有鮮花，有多少民族都在欣賞這景象，

cues.text: the blissful world up here is one of pristine nature
cues.en: the blissful world up here is one of pristine nature
cues.zh: 這裡的幸福世界是原始的自然世界之一

cues.text: and happy hikers.
cues.en: and happy hikers.
cues.zh: 和快樂的徒步旅行者。

cues.text: These slopes are busy with skiers in the winter.
cues.en: These slopes are busy with skiers in the winter.
cues.zh: 冬天這些滑雪場擠滿了滑雪者。

cues.text: When planning, be aware that in early spring and late fall --
cues.en: When planning, be aware that in early spring and late fall --
cues.zh: 規劃時，請注意在早春和晚秋—

cues.text: that's between seasons here in the Dolomites -- many lifts, huts, and restaurants are shut down,
cues.en: that's between seasons here in the Dolomites -- many lifts, huts, and restaurants are shut down,
cues.zh: 那是在多洛米蒂山的季節之間——許多電梯、小屋和餐廳都關閉了，

cues.text: and trails can be covered in snow.
cues.en: and trails can be covered in snow.
cues.zh: 小徑可能會被雪覆蓋。

cues.text: We're here in summer, and everything's wide open.
cues.en: We're here in summer, and everything's wide open.
cues.zh: 我們來這裡是在夏天，一切都是開放的。

cues.text: Everywhere I look feels like an Alpine adventure awaiting my arrival.
cues.en: Everywhere I look feels like an Alpine adventure awaiting my arrival.
cues.zh: 我所看到的每一處都像是一場阿爾卑斯山探險在等待我的到來。

cues.text: ♪♪ One thing I love about Europe --
cues.en: ♪♪ One thing I love about Europe --
cues.zh: ♪♪ 我喜歡歐洲的一件事——

cues.text: I've been coming here all my life, and there's still places to discover.
cues.en: I've been coming here all my life, and there's still places to discover.
cues.zh: 我一生都來到這裡，但仍有地方值得探索。

cues.text: The town of Kastelruth feels like an Alpine village rather than a ski resort.
cues.en: The town of Kastelruth feels like an Alpine village rather than a ski resort.
cues.zh: 卡斯特魯斯鎮給人的感覺更像是阿爾卑斯山村莊，而不是滑雪勝地。

cues.text: That's why I feature it in my Italy guidebook as the ideal home base for exploring the Dolomites.
cues.en: That's why I feature it in my Italy guidebook as the ideal home base for exploring the Dolomites.
cues.zh: 這就是為什麼我在我的義大利旅遊指南中將其列為探索多洛米蒂山脈的理想大本營。

cues.text: The hyperactive bell tower seems to ring out the wisdom of honoring local traditions.
cues.en: The hyperactive bell tower seems to ring out the wisdom of honoring local traditions.
cues.zh: 熱鬧非凡的鐘樓似乎在訴說著尊重當地傳統的智慧。

cues.text: Buildings are painted with murals celebrating the town's rich heritage.
cues.en: Buildings are painted with murals celebrating the town's rich heritage.
cues.zh: 建築物上塗有壁畫，頌揚鎮上豐富的遺產。

cues.text: ♪♪ Clearly, fire has long been a concern.
cues.en: ♪♪ Clearly, fire has long been a concern.
cues.zh: ♪♪ 顯然，火災長期以來一直是人們關注的問題。

cues.text: Saint Florian, the patron of firefighters, is shown all over town putting out fires.
cues.en: Saint Florian, the patron of firefighters, is shown all over town putting out fires.
cues.zh: 聖弗洛裡安（Saint Florian）是消防員的守護神，他在鎮上各處滅火。

cues.text: The town cemetery is like a lovingly tended garden.
cues.en: The town cemetery is like a lovingly tended garden.
cues.zh: 小鎮的墓園就像一個精心照料的花園。

cues.text: Entire families share a common plot.
cues.en: Entire families share a common plot.
cues.zh: 整個家庭都有一個共同的地盤。

cues.text: ♪♪ Cobbled lanes lead past friendly shops
cues.en: ♪♪ Cobbled lanes lead past friendly shops
cues.zh: ♪♪ 鵝卵石小巷經過友善的商店

cues.text: to the welcoming town square.
cues.en: to the welcoming town square.
cues.zh: 前往熱情的城鎮廣場。

cues.text: And for generations, the fountain, with its metal cup,
cues.en: And for generations, the fountain, with its metal cup,
cues.zh: 世世代代，噴泉及其金屬杯，

cues.text: has invited all for a refreshing drink.
cues.en: has invited all for a refreshing drink.
cues.zh: 邀請大家喝一杯清涼飲料。

cues.text: The fountain also watered horses, back when coaching inns lined the square.
cues.en: The fountain also watered horses, back when coaching inns lined the square.
cues.zh: 當馬車旅館遍佈廣場時，噴泉還可以給馬匹飲水。

cues.text: ♪♪ Here in the region of South Tirol,
cues.en: ♪♪ Here in the region of South Tirol,
cues.zh: ♪♪ 在南蒂羅爾地區，

cues.text: even though we're in Italy, locals speak German first and Italian second.
cues.en: even though we're in Italy, locals speak German first and Italian second.
cues.zh: 即使我們在義大利，當地人會先講德語，然後講義大利語。

cues.text: That's because for centuries it was in the Austrian Habsburg realm ruled from Vienna.
cues.en: That's because for centuries it was in the Austrian Habsburg realm ruled from Vienna.
cues.zh: 這是因為幾個世紀以來它一直處於維也納統治的奧地利哈布斯堡王朝的領土內。

cues.text: After World War I, South Tirol ended up as part of Italy.
cues.en: After World War I, South Tirol ended up as part of Italy.
cues.zh: 第一次世界大戰後，南蒂羅爾最終成為義大利的一部分。

cues.text: Mussolini did what he could to Italianize the region.
cues.en: Mussolini did what he could to Italianize the region.
cues.zh: 墨索里尼竭盡全力使該地區義大利化。

cues.text: He even gave each city a new Italian name.
cues.en: He even gave each city a new Italian name.
cues.zh: 他甚至為每個城市取了一個新的義大利名字。

cues.text: This town, Kastelruth, became Castelrotto.
cues.en: This town, Kastelruth, became Castelrotto.
cues.zh: 這個小鎮，卡斯特魯斯 (Kastelruth)，後來成為卡斯特羅託 (Castelrotto)。

cues.text: But the region's Germanic heritage endures.
cues.en: But the region's Germanic heritage endures.
cues.zh: 但該地區的日耳曼遺產依然存在。

cues.text: You can see it in its prosperity and in its lively folk culture.
cues.en: You can see it in its prosperity and in its lively folk culture.
cues.zh: 你可以從它的繁榮和熱鬧的民俗文化中看到它。

cues.text: Amateur folk bands have fun keeping that heritage alive.
cues.en: Amateur folk bands have fun keeping that heritage alive.
cues.zh: 業餘民謠樂團樂於保留這項傳統。

cues.text: The instruments are traditional, as are the costumes.
cues.en: The instruments are traditional, as are the costumes.
cues.zh: 樂器是傳統的，服裝也是傳統的。

cues.text: The blue aprons come from a time when humble workers needed to protect their precious clothing.
cues.en: The blue aprons come from a time when humble workers needed to protect their precious clothing.
cues.zh: 藍色圍裙來自卑微的工人需要保護他們珍貴的衣服的時代。

cues.text: ♪♪ It's nice to think that these boys
cues.en: ♪♪ It's nice to think that these boys
cues.zh: ♪♪ 很高興想到這些男孩

cues.text: are both modern and traditional, and their traditions are clearly
cues.en: are both modern and traditional, and their traditions are clearly
cues.zh: 既現代又傳統，而且他們的傳統很明顯

cues.text: surviving into the next generation.
cues.en: surviving into the next generation.
cues.zh: 生存到下一代。

cues.text: Whoo!
cues.en: Whoo!
cues.zh: 呼！

cues.text: Kastelruth is the gateway to Europe's largest Alpine meadow,
cues.en: Kastelruth is the gateway to Europe's largest Alpine meadow,
cues.zh: 卡斯特魯斯 (Kastelruth) 是通往歐洲最大高山草甸的門戶，

cues.text: the Alpe di Siusi.
cues.en: the Alpe di Siusi.
cues.zh: 阿爾卑斯休斯山。

cues.text: As automobiles are generally not allowed, visitors approach by cable car.
cues.en: As automobiles are generally not allowed, visitors approach by cable car.
cues.zh: 由於一般不允許汽車通行，遊客只能搭乘纜車前往。

cues.text: Landing at Compatsch, the commercial hub of the meadow, hikers can hop a lift or a shuttle bus
cues.en: Landing at Compatsch, the commercial hub of the meadow, hikers can hop a lift or a shuttle bus
cues.zh: 抵達草地商業中心 Compatsch 後，健行者可以搭乘電梯或穿梭巴士

cues.text: to the trailhead of their choice.
cues.en: to the trailhead of their choice.
cues.zh: 到他們選擇的起點。

cues.text: The Alpe di Siusi is a natural preserve at the foot of the mighty Sassolungo
cues.en: The Alpe di Siusi is a natural preserve at the foot of the mighty Sassolungo
cues.zh: Alpe di Siusi 是位於雄偉的 Sassolungo 腳下的自然保護區

cues.text: and Sasso Piatto peaks.
cues.en: and Sasso Piatto peaks.
cues.zh: 和薩索皮亞託峰。

cues.text: The meadow is 3 miles wide by 7 miles long, and seems to float at 6,000 feet above sea level.
cues.en: The meadow is 3 miles wide by 7 miles long, and seems to float at 6,000 feet above sea level.
cues.zh: 這片草地寬 3 英里，長 7 英里，似乎漂浮在海拔 6,000 英尺的地方。

cues.text: It's dotted by farm huts and wildflowers, surrounded by dramatic Dolomite peaks,
cues.en: It's dotted by farm huts and wildflowers, surrounded by dramatic Dolomite peaks,
cues.zh: 這裡點綴著農場小屋和野花，周圍環繞著雄偉的白雲石山峰，

cues.text: and crisscrossed by meadow trails -- ideal for equestrians, flower lovers, and walkers.
cues.en: and crisscrossed by meadow trails -- ideal for equestrians, flower lovers, and walkers.
cues.zh: 草地小徑縱橫交錯，非常適合馬術愛好者、花卉愛好者和步行者。

cues.text: It's also just right for someone needing a lazy beer with a spectacular view.
cues.en: It's also just right for someone needing a lazy beer with a spectacular view.
cues.zh: 對於那些需要一邊欣賞壯麗景色一邊悠閒地喝啤酒的人來說，這裡也很合適。

cues.text: And completing this storybook Dolomite setting, the spooky Mount Schlern, home of mythical witches,
cues.en: And completing this storybook Dolomite setting, the spooky Mount Schlern, home of mythical witches,
cues.zh: 完成這本故事書的白雲石背景，幽靈般的施勒恩山，神話女巫的故鄉，

cues.text: looks boldly into the haze of the Italian peninsula.
cues.en: looks boldly into the haze of the Italian peninsula.
cues.zh: 大膽地觀察義大利半島的陰霾。

kYXiegTXsEs.title: The value of travel | Rick Steves | TEDxRainier
kYXiegTXsEs.speaker: TEDx Talks
kYXiegTXsEs.zh: 【TEDx Talks】旅行的價值|瑞克史蒂夫斯 | TEDx雷尼爾（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Translator: Natalie Thibault Reviewer: Sarah El_Gayyar
cues.en: Translator: Natalie Thibault Reviewer: Sarah El_Gayyar
cues.zh: 譯者：Natalie Thibault 審稿人：Sarah El_Gayyar

cues.text: Thank you very much.
cues.en: Thank you very much.
cues.zh: 非常感謝。

cues.text: You know, I have spent a third of my adult life living out of a suitcase.
cues.en: You know, I have spent a third of my adult life living out of a suitcase.
cues.zh: 你知道，我成年後三分之一的時間都在行李箱裡度過。

cues.text: And looking back on those 30 years, four months every year of traveling,
cues.en: And looking back on those 30 years, four months every year of traveling,
cues.zh: 回顧這30年，每年四個月的旅行，

cues.text: it occurs to me, it's really clear that travel, thoughtful travel, is well worth the time and the money.
cues.en: it occurs to me, it's really clear that travel, thoughtful travel, is well worth the time and the money.
cues.zh: 我覺得，很明顯，旅行，深思熟慮的旅行，是非常值得花時間和金錢的。

cues.text: And I'd like to take just a few minutes to explain to you why.
cues.en: And I'd like to take just a few minutes to explain to you why.
cues.zh: 我想花幾分鐘向您解釋原因。

cues.text: Travel opens us up to the wonders of our world.
cues.en: Travel opens us up to the wonders of our world.
cues.zh: 旅行讓我們領略世界的奇蹟。

cues.text: In so many ways, it helps you appreciate nature.
cues.en: In so many ways, it helps you appreciate nature.
cues.zh: 在很多方面，它可以幫助您欣賞大自然。

cues.text: I mean for me, a great day is walking high in the Swiss Alps, like tightroping on a ridge,
cues.en: I mean for me, a great day is walking high in the Swiss Alps, like tightroping on a ridge,
cues.zh: 我的意思是對我來說，美好的一天就是在瑞士阿爾卑斯山高處行走，就像在山脊上走鋼索一樣，

cues.text: on one side I've got lakes stretching all the way to Germany, on the other side the most incredible alpine panorama anywhere,
cues.en: on one side I've got lakes stretching all the way to Germany, on the other side the most incredible alpine panorama anywhere,
cues.zh: 一側有一直延伸到德國的湖泊，另一側則是世界上最令人難以置信的高山全景，

cues.text: the Eiger Mönch Jungfrau: cut glass peaks against that blue sky.
cues.en: the Eiger Mönch Jungfrau: cut glass peaks against that blue sky.
cues.zh: 艾格峰與尚少女峰：藍天映襯下的切割玻璃山峰。

cues.text: And ahead of me I hear the long legato tones of an alphorn announcing that the helicopter-stocked mountain hut is open,
cues.en: And ahead of me I hear the long legato tones of an alphorn announcing that the helicopter-stocked mountain hut is open,
cues.zh: 在我前面，我聽到阿爾卑斯號的長連音，宣佈裝有直升機的山間小屋已經開放，

cues.text: it's just around the corner and the coffee schnapps is on.
cues.en: it's just around the corner and the coffee schnapps is on.
cues.zh: 就在轉角處，咖啡琴酒已經上桌了。

cues.text: That connects you with nature, and that connects you with culture.
cues.en: That connects you with nature, and that connects you with culture.
cues.zh: 這將您與自然聯絡起來，並將您與文化聯絡起來。

cues.text: And when I'm traveling I love this whole idea that travel connects us with culture.
cues.en: And when I'm traveling I love this whole idea that travel connects us with culture.
cues.zh: 當我旅行時，我喜歡旅行將我們與文化聯絡起來的整個想法。

cues.text: When I am traveling I find that there are different slices of culture that I never realized people could be evangelical about.
cues.en: When I am traveling I find that there are different slices of culture that I never realized people could be evangelical about.
cues.zh: 當我旅行時，我發現有一些我從未意識到人們可以傳福音的不同文化。

cues.text: Cheese, for instance.
cues.en: Cheese, for instance.
cues.zh: 以乳酪為例。

cues.text: You go to France and they're crazy about cheese!
cues.en: You go to France and they're crazy about cheese!
cues.zh: 你去法國，他們對起司很著迷！

cues.text: I like being a bumpkin in my travels.
cues.en: I like being a bumpkin in my travels.
cues.zh: 我喜歡在旅行中當鄉巴佬。

cues.text: For me, cheese was always just orange and in the shape of the bread.
cues.en: For me, cheese was always just orange and in the shape of the bread.
cues.zh: 對我來說，起司總是橘色的，呈現麵包的形狀。

cues.text: There you go: cheese sandwich.
cues.en: There you go: cheese sandwich.
cues.zh: 給你：起司三明治。

cues.text: Then I meet these people and, I mean, there's a different cheese for every day of the year!
cues.en: Then I meet these people and, I mean, there's a different cheese for every day of the year!
cues.zh: 然後我遇到了這些人，我的意思是，一年中的每一天都有不同的起司！

cues.text: You step into a cheese shop and it's just a festival of mold.
cues.en: You step into a cheese shop and it's just a festival of mold.
cues.zh: 當你走進一家起司店時，你會發現這簡直就是黴菌的節日。

cues.text: I love going shopping with my Parisian friends, they'll take me into a cheese shop, put up a moldy wad of goat cheese
cues.en: I love going shopping with my Parisian friends, they'll take me into a cheese shop, put up a moldy wad of goat cheese
cues.zh: 我喜歡和我的巴黎朋友一起去購物，他們會帶我去一家起司店，放一團發黴的山羊起司

cues.text: take a deep whiff: "Oh Rick! Smell this cheese! It smells like the feet of angels!"
cues.en: take a deep whiff: "Oh Rick! Smell this cheese! It smells like the feet of angels!"
cues.zh: 深深地吸了一口：“哦，瑞克！聞聞這個乳酪！聞起來像天使的腳！”

cues.text: Okay! Well when you're traveling you open up to new things that might smell like the feet of angels.
cues.en: Okay! Well when you're traveling you open up to new things that might smell like the feet of angels.
cues.zh: 好的！好吧，當你旅行時，你會接觸新事物，這些新事物可能聞起來像天使的腳。

cues.text: A great thing about travel is that it connects you with people.
cues.en: A great thing about travel is that it connects you with people.
cues.zh: 旅行的一大好處是它可以將您與人們聯絡起來。

cues.text: And, if I am making a tour, or a guidebook or a TV show, and I am not connecting people with people
cues.en: And, if I am making a tour, or a guidebook or a TV show, and I am not connecting people with people
cues.zh: 而且，如果我正在旅遊、製作旅遊指南或電視節目，而我並沒有將人與人聯絡起來

cues.text: I am kind of nervous, because it's going to be a flat experience.
cues.en: I am kind of nervous, because it's going to be a flat experience.
cues.zh: 我有點緊張，因為這會是一次平淡的經驗。

cues.text: It's people that really make your experience vital.
cues.en: It's people that really make your experience vital.
cues.zh: 真正讓您的體驗變得至關重要的是人。

cues.text: That's the mark of a good trip.
cues.en: That's the mark of a good trip.
cues.zh: 這是一次愉快旅行的標誌。

cues.text: It doesn't need to be earth-shaking encounters, they can be just silly encounters.
cues.en: It doesn't need to be earth-shaking encounters, they can be just silly encounters.
cues.zh: 不需要是驚天動地的遭遇，它們可以只是愚蠢的遭遇。

cues.text: I was in Italy recently and I met this little kid.
cues.en: I was in Italy recently and I met this little kid.
cues.zh: 我最近在義大利，遇到了這個小孩。

cues.text: He was just staring at me, he was kind of rude.
cues.en: He was just staring at me, he was kind of rude.
cues.zh: 他只是盯著我看，有點粗魯。

cues.text: Finally his dad said: "Excuse my son, he stares at Americans."
cues.en: Finally his dad said: "Excuse my son, he stares at Americans."
cues.zh: 最後他爸爸說：“對不起，我的兒子，他盯著美國人看。”

cues.text: I said: "Why's that?" and he said: "Last week, we were at McDonald's having our hamburger,
cues.en: I said: "Why's that?" and he said: "Last week, we were at McDonald's having our hamburger,
cues.zh: 我說：「為什麼呢？」他說：「上週，我們在麥當勞吃漢堡，

cues.text: and my son, noticing the fluffy white bun, said: "Dad?
cues.en: and my son, noticing the fluffy white bun, said: "Dad?
cues.zh: 我的兒子注意到了蓬鬆的白麵包，說：「爸爸？

cues.text: Why do Americans have such soft bread?" and the dad said: "Son, that's because Americans have no teeth."
cues.en: Why do Americans have such soft bread?" and the dad said: "Son, that's because Americans have no teeth."
cues.zh: 為什麼美國人的麵包這麼軟？爸爸說：「兒子，那是因為美國人沒有牙齒。 」

cues.text: So, I showed him my teeth and I sort of straightened out a little misunderstanding
cues.en: So, I showed him my teeth and I sort of straightened out a little misunderstanding
cues.zh: 所以，我向他展示了我的牙齒，我有點澄清了一些誤會

cues.text: between peoples there and it occurred to me: that there are so many misunderstandings between people,
cues.en: between peoples there and it occurred to me: that there are so many misunderstandings between people,
cues.zh: 那裡的人與人之間，我突然想到：人與人之間有這麼多的誤解，

cues.text: and when we travel we straighten them out.
cues.en: and when we travel we straighten them out.
cues.zh: 當我們旅行時，我們會把它們理順。

cues.text: I don't know about you, but I was raised thinking the world is a pyramid, with us on top and everybody else trying to figure it out.
cues.en: I don't know about you, but I was raised thinking the world is a pyramid, with us on top and everybody else trying to figure it out.
cues.zh: 我不瞭解你的想法，但我從小就認為世界是一座金字塔，我們位於金字塔的頂端，其他人都在試圖弄清楚它。

cues.text: Then I travelled and I realized we have the American dream, that's a great thing, but other people have their own dream.
cues.en: Then I travelled and I realized we have the American dream, that's a great thing, but other people have their own dream.
cues.zh: 然後我去旅行，我意識到我們有美國夢，這是一件偉大的事情，但其他人有他們自己的夢想。

cues.text: Norwegians have the Norwegian dream. Bulgarians have the Bulgarian dream.
cues.en: Norwegians have the Norwegian dream. Bulgarians have the Bulgarian dream.
cues.zh: 挪威人有挪威夢。保加利亞人有保加利亞夢。

cues.text: These people have the Sri Lankan dream.
cues.en: These people have the Sri Lankan dream.
cues.zh: 這些人有斯里蘭卡夢。

cues.text: Travel wallops my ethnocentricity, and I'm very thankful for that. It's something to celebrate!
cues.en: Travel wallops my ethnocentricity, and I'm very thankful for that. It's something to celebrate!
cues.zh: 旅行打擊了我的民族中心主義，對此我非常感激。這是值得慶祝的事！

cues.text: Our dream is beautiful, but so is theirs.
cues.en: Our dream is beautiful, but so is theirs.
cues.zh: 我們的夢想很美好，他們的也一樣美好。

cues.text: In my travels I have really been impressed by the amount of pride on this planet.
cues.en: In my travels I have really been impressed by the amount of pride on this planet.
cues.zh: 在我的旅行中，我對這個星球上的自豪感印象深刻。

cues.text: Wonderful pride.
cues.en: Wonderful pride.
cues.zh: 美妙的驕傲。

cues.text: I was in Afghanistan once, in a cafeteria where the backpackers were hanging out,
cues.en: I was in Afghanistan once, in a cafeteria where the backpackers were hanging out,
cues.zh: 我曾經去過阿富汗，在揹包客們閒逛的自助餐廳裡，

cues.text: a man sat down next to me and said: "Can I join you?", I said: "You already have."
cues.en: a man sat down next to me and said: "Can I join you?", I said: "You already have."
cues.zh: 一個人在我旁邊坐下，說：“我可以加入你嗎？”，我說：“你已經加入了。”

cues.text: "You're an American, aren't you?" I said: "Yeah", "I'm a professor here in Afghanistan,
cues.en: "You're an American, aren't you?" I said: "Yeah", "I'm a professor here in Afghanistan,
cues.zh: “你是美國人，不是嗎？”我說：“是的”，“我是阿富汗的教授，

cues.text: I want you to know that a third of the people on this planet eat with spoons and forks like you do.
cues.en: I want you to know that a third of the people on this planet eat with spoons and forks like you do.
cues.zh: 我想讓你知道，這個星球上有三分之一的人像你一樣用湯匙和叉子吃飯。

cues.text: A third of the people eat with chopsticks, and a third eat with their fingers, like I do,
cues.en: A third of the people eat with chopsticks, and a third eat with their fingers, like I do,
cues.zh: 三分之一的人用筷子吃飯，三分之一的人用手指吃飯，就像我一樣，

cues.text: and we are all civilized just the same".
cues.en: and we are all civilized just the same".
cues.zh: 我們都是同樣文明的人」。

cues.text: He had a chip on his shoulder.
cues.en: He had a chip on his shoulder.
cues.zh: 他的肩膀上有一個晶片。

cues.text: He thought I thought less of him because he ate with his fingers.
cues.en: He thought I thought less of him because he ate with his fingers.
cues.zh: 他以為我因為他用手指吃飯而看不起他。

cues.text: That lesson stuck with me and for the rest of my trip through South Asia I was aware of that.
cues.en: That lesson stuck with me and for the rest of my trip through South Asia I was aware of that.
cues.zh: 這個教訓一直困擾著我，在我接下來的南亞之旅中我也意識到了這一點。

cues.text: I went to restaurants, fine restaurants with well-dressed professional local people that had no spoons and forks.
cues.en: I went to restaurants, fine restaurants with well-dressed professional local people that had no spoons and forks.
cues.zh: 我去了餐館，高階餐館裡有穿著考究的專業當地人，但沒有湯匙和叉子。

cues.text: They had like a ceremonial sink in the middle of the restaurant, people would wash their hands and eat using their fingers
cues.en: They had like a ceremonial sink in the middle of the restaurant, people would wash their hands and eat using their fingers
cues.zh: 他們在餐廳中間有一個儀式水槽，人們會洗手並用手指吃飯

cues.text: the way God intended them to be used.
cues.en: the way God intended them to be used.
cues.zh: 上帝希望它們被使用的方式。

cues.text: It actually became quite natural for me.
cues.en: It actually became quite natural for me.
cues.zh: 這對我來說實際上變得很自然。

cues.text: I had to be re-trained when I got home.
cues.en: I had to be re-trained when I got home.
cues.zh: 回家後我必須重新接受訓練。

cues.text: But these are the lessons you pick up and it is so fun to change something that you thought was a basic truth.
cues.en: But these are the lessons you pick up and it is so fun to change something that you thought was a basic truth.
cues.zh: 但這些都是你學到的教訓，改變你認為是基本事實的東西是非常有趣的。

cues.text: Well, in the adulthood you realize: Hey! Other people, smart people, can see it differently.
cues.en: Well, in the adulthood you realize: Hey! Other people, smart people, can see it differently.
cues.zh: 好吧，成年後你會意識到：嘿！其他人，聰明的人，會有不同的看法。

cues.text: I'm impressed how many heroic struggles are going on this planet all the time
cues.en: I'm impressed how many heroic struggles are going on this planet all the time
cues.zh: 令我印象深刻的是，這個星球上一直在進行著多少英勇的鬥爭

cues.text: that I am completely oblivious to.
cues.en: that I am completely oblivious to.
cues.zh: 我完全沒有註意到。

cues.text: Every year, eight or ten distinct languages go extinct.
cues.en: Every year, eight or ten distinct languages go extinct.
cues.zh: 每年都有八到十種不同的語言滅絕。

cues.text: That's eight or ten ethnic groups that lose a long struggle.
cues.en: That's eight or ten ethnic groups that lose a long struggle.
cues.zh: 那是八個或十個民族在長期鬥爭中失敗了。

cues.text: I was raised thinking Nathan Hale, Ethan Allen, Patrick Henry they were the ultimate. Ah!
cues.en: I was raised thinking Nathan Hale, Ethan Allen, Patrick Henry they were the ultimate. Ah!
cues.zh: 我從小就認為內森·黑爾、伊森·艾倫、派崔克·亨利是終極的。啊!

cues.text: Well you know they are great, but they're certainly not unique.
cues.en: Well you know they are great, but they're certainly not unique.
cues.zh: 你知道它們很棒，但它們肯定不是獨一無二的。

cues.text: They're a dime a dozen on this planet.
cues.en: They're a dime a dozen on this planet.
cues.zh: 他們在這個星球上是一毛錢一打。

cues.text: It doesn't diminish ours but it's really important for us to remember in our travels that there are other heroes and other causes.
cues.en: It doesn't diminish ours but it's really important for us to remember in our travels that there are other heroes and other causes.
cues.zh: 它不會削弱我們的英雄，但對我們來說，在旅行中記住還有其他英雄和其他事業非常重要。

cues.text: One great way to make your travels more meaningful is to relate to, to embrace a contemporary Nathan Hale,
cues.en: One great way to make your travels more meaningful is to relate to, to embrace a contemporary Nathan Hale,
cues.zh: 讓你的旅行更有意義的一個好方法是與當代的內森黑爾建立聯絡，擁抱他，

cues.text: in a different country. Get into it.
cues.en: in a different country. Get into it.
cues.zh: 在另一個國家。進入其中。

cues.text: An easy one is: Archbishop Oscar Romero.
cues.en: An easy one is: Archbishop Oscar Romero.
cues.zh: 一個簡單的例子是：大主教奧斯卡羅梅羅。

cues.text: Go down to San Salvador, El Salvador, and learn about Archbishop Oscar Romero.
cues.en: Go down to San Salvador, El Salvador, and learn about Archbishop Oscar Romero.
cues.zh: 前往薩爾瓦多聖薩爾瓦多，瞭解大主教奧斯卡羅梅羅。

cues.text: A present-day Nathan Hale.
cues.en: A present-day Nathan Hale.
cues.zh: 現在的內森·黑爾。

cues.text: A few years ago I was due for a vacation. I was heading for Mazatlán, and I was just needy for a nice stretch of pristine beach,
cues.en: A few years ago I was due for a vacation. I was heading for Mazatlán, and I was just needy for a nice stretch of pristine beach,
cues.zh: 幾年前，我本來要去度假。我正前往馬薩特蘭，我只是需要一片美麗的原始海灘，

cues.text: swept free of local riffraff.
cues.en: swept free of local riffraff.
cues.zh: 掃除了當地的痞子。

cues.text: I was gonna have a plastic strap on my wrist, giving me unlimited margaritas,
cues.en: I was gonna have a plastic strap on my wrist, giving me unlimited margaritas,
cues.zh: 我的手腕上有一條塑膠帶，可以給我無限量的瑪格麗特酒，

cues.text: never have to dirty my fingers with coins, you know what that's like, I was ready.
cues.en: never have to dirty my fingers with coins, you know what that's like, I was ready.
cues.zh: 永遠不必用硬幣弄髒我的手指，你知道那是什麼感覺，我已經準備好了。

cues.text: And then some friends invited me to go to San Salvador for the 25th anniversary of the assassination of Archbishop Oscar Romero.
cues.en: And then some friends invited me to go to San Salvador for the 25th anniversary of the assassination of Archbishop Oscar Romero.
cues.zh: 然後一些朋友邀請我去聖薩爾瓦多參加大主教奧斯卡·羅梅羅被刺殺25週年。

cues.text: He marched with his people.
cues.en: He marched with his people.
cues.zh: 他與他的人民一起遊行。

cues.text: He stood by his people during the Civil war that they lost.
cues.en: He stood by his people during the Civil war that they lost.
cues.zh: 在內戰期間，他與人民站在一起，但他們失敗了。

cues.text: These were the landless peasants.
cues.en: These were the landless peasants.
cues.zh: 這些人就是失地農民。

cues.text: He said: "I'll probably be killed, and when I'm killed I'll raise again in my people".
cues.en: He said: "I'll probably be killed, and when I'm killed I'll raise again in my people".
cues.zh: 他說：「我可能會被殺，當我被殺時，我會在我的人民中再次復活」。

cues.text: And I wanted to see Romero in his people,
cues.en: And I wanted to see Romero in his people,
cues.zh: 我想在他的人民中看到羅梅羅，

cues.text: 25 years after his assassination.
cues.en: 25 years after his assassination.
cues.zh: 他被刺殺 25 年後。

cues.text: And I went to El Salvador. Two days into that trip I was covered with bug bites,
cues.en: And I went to El Salvador. Two days into that trip I was covered with bug bites,
cues.zh: 我去了薩爾瓦多。那次旅行兩天後我全身被蟲咬了，

cues.text: in a sweaty dorm bunk bed, eating rice and beans one day and beans and rice the next,
cues.en: in a sweaty dorm bunk bed, eating rice and beans one day and beans and rice the next,
cues.zh: 在汗流浹背的宿舍雙層床上，一天吃米飯和豆子，第二天吃豆子和米飯，

cues.text: and I was having the greatest travel experience you can ever have.
cues.en: and I was having the greatest travel experience you can ever have.
cues.zh: 我正在享受有史以來最棒的旅行體驗。

cues.zh: 在曼谷 24 小時吃泰國街頭小吃的唯一限制是你的胃的大小。

cues.text: But I think we did pretty well.
cues.en: But I think we did pretty well.
cues.zh: 但我認為我們做得很好。

cues.text: What's amazing is we only ate a fraction of the diversity and the variety of different Thai street food
cues.en: What's amazing is we only ate a fraction of the diversity and the variety of different Thai street food
cues.zh: 令人驚訝的是我們只吃了泰國街頭美食多樣性和多樣性的一小部分

cues.text: that's available.
cues.en: that's available.
cues.zh: 這是可用的。

cues.text: There's still so much more for you to discover.
cues.en: There's still so much more for you to discover.
cues.zh: 還有很多東西等您去發現。

cues.text: Stay tuned, because on the next Nat Geo Challenge, we're gonna have a meal that couldn't be more different
cues.en: Stay tuned, because on the next Nat Geo Challenge, we're gonna have a meal that couldn't be more different
cues.zh: 請繼續關注，因為在下一次國家地理挑戰賽中，我們將享受一頓截然不同的美食

cues.text: from the crazy streets of Bangkok.
cues.en: from the crazy streets of Bangkok.
cues.zh: 來自曼谷瘋狂的街道。

7glld8yO3Xo.title: Rick Steves Iceland
7glld8yO3Xo.speaker: Rick Steves' Europe
7glld8yO3Xo.zh: 【Rick Steves' Europe】裡克史蒂夫斯 冰島（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Hi. I'm Rick Steves on the wild and western fringe of Europe.
cues.en: Hi. I'm Rick Steves on the wild and western fringe of Europe.
cues.zh: 你好。我是裡克史蒂夫斯，生活在歐洲西部荒野邊緣。

cues.text: It's Iceland--the land of thunderous waterfalls, fiery volcanoes, and the midnight sun.
cues.en: It's Iceland--the land of thunderous waterfalls, fiery volcanoes, and the midnight sun.
cues.zh: 這就是冰島——這片土地上有雷鳴般的瀑布、熾熱的火山和午夜的太陽。

cues.text: With a resilient culture and epic natural thrills, we'll see why this little island
cues.en: With a resilient culture and epic natural thrills, we'll see why this little island
cues.zh: 憑藉著富有活力的文化和史詩般的自然刺激，我們將瞭解為什麼這個小島

cues.text: is so dang popular.
cues.en: is so dang popular.
cues.zh: 太受歡迎了。

cues.text: Thanks for joining us!
cues.en: Thanks for joining us!
cues.zh: 感謝您加入我們！

cues.text: To fully experience Iceland, we start in the capital city,
cues.en: To fully experience Iceland, we start in the capital city,
cues.zh: 為了充分體驗冰島，我們從首都開始，

cues.text: Reykjavík, then we day-trip deep into the blustery interior
cues.en: Reykjavík, then we day-trip deep into the blustery interior
cues.zh: 雷克雅未克，然後我們深入狂風大作的內陸一日遊

cues.text: to sample the power of nature on the famed Golden Circle,
cues.en: to sample the power of nature on the famed Golden Circle,
cues.zh: 在著名的黃金圈體驗大自然的力量，

cues.text: and then we do the epic road trip: Iceland's 800-mile Ring Road
cues.en: and then we do the epic road trip: Iceland's 800-mile Ring Road
cues.zh: 然後我們開始史詩般的公路旅行：冰島 800 英里的環路

cues.text: circling this unforgettable island.
cues.en: circling this unforgettable island.
cues.zh: 環繞著這座令人難忘的島嶼。

cues.text: Rick, voice-over: Reykjavík, with its landmark church, ruddy urban charm,
cues.en: Rick, voice-over: Reykjavík, with its landmark church, ruddy urban charm,
cues.zh: 瑞克（Rick），畫外音：雷克雅維克，有著地標的教堂，紅潤的都市魅力，

cues.text: and determined cultural life is our springboard.
cues.en: and determined cultural life is our springboard.
cues.zh: 而堅定的文化生活就是我們的跳板。

cues.text: After soaking with the locals in a thermal pool and enjoying an Icelandic feast,
cues.en: After soaking with the locals in a thermal pool and enjoying an Icelandic feast,
cues.zh: 與當地人一起泡溫泉、享用冰島大餐後，

cues.text: we do the famous Golden Circle day trip.
cues.en: we do the famous Golden Circle day trip.
cues.zh: 我們進行著名的黃金圈一日遊。

cues.text: We'll see the gorge where Europe meets America,
cues.en: We'll see the gorge where Europe meets America,
cues.zh: 我們會看到歐洲與美洲交會處的峽谷，

cues.text: thrill under the original "geyser," and feel the spray of a thundering waterfall.
cues.en: thrill under the original "geyser," and feel the spray of a thundering waterfall.
cues.zh: 在原始的「間歇泉」下驚險刺激，感受雷鳴般的瀑布噴射出的水花。

cues.text: Then we hit the road-- the Ring Road-- and circle the entire island.
cues.en: Then we hit the road-- the Ring Road-- and circle the entire island.
cues.zh: 然後我們上路——環路——並環繞整個島嶼。

cues.text: With help from Cameron Hewitt, my friend and fellow guidebook author, we'll do it all:
cues.en: With help from Cameron Hewitt, my friend and fellow guidebook author, we'll do it all:
cues.zh: 在我的朋友兼旅遊指南作者卡梅倫·休伊特 (Cameron Hewitt) 的幫助下，我們將完成這一切：

cues.text: exploring waterfalls, hiking through steaming geothermal fields, cruising lagoons bobbing with icebergs,
cues.en: exploring waterfalls, hiking through steaming geothermal fields, cruising lagoons bobbing with icebergs,
cues.zh: 探索瀑布，徒步穿越熱氣騰騰的地熱田，巡遊冰山起伏的潟湖，

cues.text: fording glacial rivers, gathering eggs local style...
cues.en: fording glacial rivers, gathering eggs local style...
cues.zh: 涉水冰川河流，採集當地風格的雞蛋...

cues.text: and wandering evocative black-sand beaches.
cues.en: and wandering evocative black-sand beaches.
cues.zh: 以及漫步令人回味的黑沙灘。

cues.text: We'll chase rainbows, elusive whales, roaming horses, and the cutest puffins.
cues.en: We'll chase rainbows, elusive whales, roaming horses, and the cutest puffins.
cues.zh: 我們將追逐彩虹、難以捉摸的鯨魚、漫遊的馬匹和最可愛的海雀。

cues.text: Iceland, about the size of Virginia with just 400,000 people, sits between Greenland and Norway.
cues.en: Iceland, about the size of Virginia with just 400,000 people, sits between Greenland and Norway.
cues.zh: 冰島面積與維吉尼亞州相當，人口只有 40 萬，位於格陵蘭和挪威之間。

cues.text: From Reykjavík, after the Golden Circle day trip, we hit the Ring Road.
cues.en: From Reykjavík, after the Golden Circle day trip, we hit the Ring Road.
cues.zh: 從雷克雅未克出發，結束了黃金圈一日遊，我們踏上環城公路。

cues.text: We explore the South Coast, side-tripping up Thorsmork valley
cues.en: We explore the South Coast, side-tripping up Thorsmork valley
cues.zh: 我們探索南海岸，順便爬上索斯莫克山谷

cues.text: and sailing to the Westman Islands.
cues.en: and sailing to the Westman Islands.
cues.zh: 並航行至韋斯特曼群島。

cues.text: After Vík, we see glacial lagoons, the rugged Eastfjords,
cues.en: After Vík, we see glacial lagoons, the rugged Eastfjords,
cues.zh: 維克之後，我們看到冰河潟湖、崎嶇的東峽灣、

cues.text: geothermal hot zones around Lake Myvatn, the fishing village of Húsavík in the far north,
cues.en: geothermal hot zones around Lake Myvatn, the fishing village of Húsavík in the far north,
cues.zh: 米湖周圍的地熱熱點地區，遠北的胡薩維克漁村，

cues.text: and Snaefellsnes Peninsula before finishing back where we started.
cues.en: and Snaefellsnes Peninsula before finishing back where we started.
cues.zh: 和斯奈山半島，然後回到我們出發的地方。

cues.text: ♪ Reykjavík, by far the biggest city in the country,
cues.en: ♪ Reykjavík, by far the biggest city in the country,
cues.zh: ♪ 雷克雅未克，迄今為止全國最大的城市，

cues.text: is still small--it's about the size of Berkeley, or Fargo.
cues.en: is still small--it's about the size of Berkeley, or Fargo.
cues.zh: 仍然很小——大約有伯克利或法戈那麼大。

cues.text: With a hard-scrabble heritage and a vibrant culture, today it offers a tourist- friendly mix of old and new.
cues.en: With a hard-scrabble heritage and a vibrant culture, today it offers a tourist- friendly mix of old and new.
cues.zh: 憑藉艱苦奮鬥的遺產和充滿活力的文化，今天它提供了新舊融合的旅遊友好型。

cues.text: Rick, voice-over: While short on world-class sights, Reykjavík certainly has an urban vitality,
cues.en: Rick, voice-over: While short on world-class sights, Reykjavík certainly has an urban vitality,
cues.zh: 瑞克（畫外音）：雖然雷克雅維克缺乏世界一流的景點，但它確實擁有城市活力，

cues.text: with plenty of restaurants and shopping to keep visitors entertained.
cues.en: with plenty of restaurants and shopping to keep visitors entertained.
cues.zh: 有大量的餐廳和購物場所供遊客娛樂。

cues.text: It's unexpectedly cosmopolitan, with an artistic, bohemian flair.
cues.en: It's unexpectedly cosmopolitan, with an artistic, bohemian flair.
cues.zh: 它出乎意料地具有國際化氣息，具有藝術氣息和波西米亞風格。

cues.text: And it's blustery.
cues.en: And it's blustery.
cues.zh: 而且風很大。

cues.text: Iceland can be cold even in summer.
cues.en: Iceland can be cold even in summer.
cues.zh: 冰島即使在夏天也會很冷。

cues.text: This is a typical day in July...and so is this.
cues.en: This is a typical day in July...and so is this.
cues.zh: 這是七月中典型的一天……這也是。

cues.text: If you don't like the weather, just wait a few minutes.
cues.en: If you don't like the weather, just wait a few minutes.
cues.zh: 如果您不喜歡現在的天氣，請等待幾分鐘。

cues.text: ♪ Reykjavík's neighborhoods are enlivened by street art.
cues.en: ♪ Reykjavík's neighborhoods are enlivened by street art.
cues.zh: ♪ 街頭藝術讓雷克雅未克的街區充滿活力。

cues.text: A blank wall will just get tagged with graffiti anyway, so, instead, homeowners hire talented street artists
cues.en: A blank wall will just get tagged with graffiti anyway, so, instead, homeowners hire talented street artists
cues.zh: 無論如何，空白的牆壁都會被塗鴉標記，因此，房主會聘請才華橫溢的街頭藝術家

cues.text: to create colorful murals.
cues.en: to create colorful murals.
cues.zh: 創作色彩繽紛的壁畫。

cues.text: ♪ It seems every street leads to Hallgríms Church,
cues.en: ♪ It seems every street leads to Hallgríms Church,
cues.zh: ♪ 似乎每條街道都通往哈爾格林姆斯教堂，

cues.text: crowning a hill in the town center.
cues.en: crowning a hill in the town center.
cues.zh: 位於鎮中心的一座小山上。

cues.text: Designed by Iceland's state architect in the 1930s, the church represents the national style.
cues.en: Designed by Iceland's state architect in the 1930s, the church represents the national style.
cues.zh: 教堂由冰島國家建築師於1930年代設計，代表了民族風格。

cues.text: Stark and utilitarian, yet beautiful, it evokes the island's volcanic landscape.
cues.en: Stark and utilitarian, yet beautiful, it evokes the island's volcanic landscape.
cues.zh: 它樸素而實用，但又美麗，讓人想起島上的火山景觀。

cues.text: Stairstepped gables echo Iceland's basalt cliffs.
cues.en: Stairstepped gables echo Iceland's basalt cliffs.
cues.zh: 階梯式山牆與冰島的玄武岩懸崖遙相呼應。

cues.text: ♪ The interior is Lutheran-- serene and austere.
cues.en: ♪ The interior is Lutheran-- serene and austere.
cues.zh: ♪ 內部是路德會風格－寧靜而樸實。

cues.text: The glass is clear, not stained...
cues.en: The glass is clear, not stained...
cues.zh: 玻璃是透明的，沒有染色...

cues.text: and the altar is a simple table.
cues.en: and the altar is a simple table.
cues.zh: 祭壇是一張簡單的桌子。

cues.text: ♪ An elevator whisks visitors to the top of the tower
cues.en: ♪ An elevator whisks visitors to the top of the tower
cues.zh: ♪ 電梯將遊客帶到塔頂

cues.text: for panoramic views over all of Reykjavík.
cues.en: for panoramic views over all of Reykjavík.
cues.zh: 欣賞整個雷克雅未克的全景。

cues.text: ♪ Two out of every 3 Icelanders lives within sight of this steeple.
cues.en: ♪ Two out of every 3 Icelanders lives within sight of this steeple.
cues.zh: ♪ 每 3 個冰島人中就有 2 個住在這座尖塔的視野範圍內。

cues.text: ♪ In front of the church stands a statue of Leif Erikson.
cues.en: ♪ In front of the church stands a statue of Leif Erikson.
cues.zh: ♪ 教堂前矗立著雷夫‧艾瑞克森的雕像。

cues.text: Born here in Iceland, this Viking explorer is believed to be the first European to set foot
cues.en: Born here in Iceland, this Viking explorer is believed to be the first European to set foot
cues.zh: 這位出生於冰島的維京探險家被認為是第一個踏足冰島的歐洲人

cues.text: in the Americas-- about 5 centuries before Christopher Columbus.
cues.en: in the Americas-- about 5 centuries before Christopher Columbus.
cues.zh: 在美洲——大約比克里斯多福哥倫布早 5 個世紀。

cues.text: ♪ The modern sculpture called "The Sea Voyager"
cues.en: ♪ The modern sculpture called "The Sea Voyager"
cues.zh: ♪ 現代雕塑“航海家號”

cues.text: is an homage to those Scandinavian adventurers who, beginning in the ninth century,
cues.en: is an homage to those Scandinavian adventurers who, beginning in the ninth century,
cues.zh: 是對那些從九世紀開始的斯堪的納維亞冒險家的敬意，

cues.text: loaded up their ships, set sail into an uncharted ocean,
cues.en: loaded up their ships, set sail into an uncharted ocean,
cues.zh: 裝滿船隻，揚帆駛向未知的海洋，

cues.text: and brought civilization to this uninhabited island.
cues.en: and brought civilization to this uninhabited island.
cues.zh: 並為這個無人島帶來了文明。

cues.text: ♪ Iceland, so harsh and desolate, steaming with volcanoes, was settled
cues.en: ♪ Iceland, so harsh and desolate, steaming with volcanoes, was settled
cues.zh: ♪ 冰島，如此嚴酷荒涼，火山爆發，已定居

cues.text: over 1,000 years ago by early Norse farmers.
cues.en: over 1,000 years ago by early Norse farmers.
cues.zh: 1000 多年前，由早期挪威農民發明。

cues.text: ♪ Imagine the original Icelanders-- hardy folk eking out a living on remote farms,
cues.en: ♪ Imagine the original Icelanders-- hardy folk eking out a living on remote farms,
cues.zh: ♪ 想像一下最初的冰島人——在偏遠農場勉強維持生計的頑強人民，

cues.text: living in isolation.
cues.en: living in isolation.
cues.zh: 生活在孤立之中。

cues.text: They chronicled their lives in "the Sagas"-- a blending of historical records,
cues.en: They chronicled their lives in "the Sagas"-- a blending of historical records,
cues.zh: 他們在「傳奇」中記錄了自己的生活——混合了歷史記錄，

cues.text: tall tales, and legends.
cues.en: tall tales, and legends.
cues.zh: 荒誕的故事和傳說。

cues.text: ♪ From the age of the Vikings, the country grew slowly.
cues.en: ♪ From the age of the Vikings, the country grew slowly.
cues.zh: ♪ 從維京人時代開始，這個國家就緩慢發展。

cues.text: By the mid-1700s, all of Iceland still only had about 50,000 people, and Reykjavík was just a big farm.
cues.en: By the mid-1700s, all of Iceland still only had about 50,000 people, and Reykjavík was just a big farm.
cues.zh: 到1700年代中期，整個冰島仍然只有大約5萬人口，雷克雅維克只是一個大農場。

cues.text: As trade, mostly fishing, increased, and towns began to form,
cues.en: As trade, mostly fishing, increased, and towns began to form,
cues.zh: 隨著貿易（主要是漁業）的增加，城鎮開始形成，

cues.text: Reykjavík emerged as the capital city.
cues.en: Reykjavík emerged as the capital city.
cues.zh: 雷克雅未克成為首都。

cues.text: Rick, voice-over: The National Museum collects artifacts from these early days of Iceland.
cues.en: Rick, voice-over: The National Museum collects artifacts from these early days of Iceland.
cues.zh: 瑞克（畫外音）：國立博物館收藏冰島早期的文物。

cues.text: A society made of wood doesn't leave much behind.
cues.en: A society made of wood doesn't leave much behind.
cues.zh: 一個由木頭組成的社會不會留下太多東西。

cues.text: ♪ But a few exquisite items, like these ornamental horns,
cues.en: ♪ But a few exquisite items, like these ornamental horns,
cues.zh: ♪ 但有一些精緻的物品，像是這些裝飾性的角，

cues.text: and these whalebone carvings, survive.
cues.en: and these whalebone carvings, survive.
cues.zh: 這些鯨骨雕刻品得以存活。

cues.text: ♪ Pagan Iceland converted to Christianity
cues.en: ♪ Pagan Iceland converted to Christianity
cues.zh: ♪ 異教冰島皈依基督教

cues.text: in about the year 1000.
cues.en: in about the year 1000.
cues.zh: 大約在1000年。

cues.text: Until relatively modern times, Icelandic settlers lived in rustic cottages.
cues.en: Until relatively modern times, Icelandic settlers lived in rustic cottages.
cues.zh: 直到近代，冰島定居者都住在鄉村小屋裡。

cues.text: Existence may have been bleak, but families were tight-knit.
cues.en: Existence may have been bleak, but families were tight-knit.
cues.zh: 生活可能很黯淡，但家庭卻很緊密。

cues.text: Many Icelanders lived simple lives, much like this,
cues.en: Many Icelanders lived simple lives, much like this,
cues.zh: 許多冰島人過著簡單的生活，就像這樣，

cues.text: until the early 20th century.
cues.en: until the early 20th century.
cues.zh: 直到20世紀初。

cues.text: ♪ Life was tied to the sea.
cues.en: ♪ Life was tied to the sea.
cues.zh: ♪ 生命與大海息息相關。

cues.text: Icelanders sailed in open boats, fished for cod,
cues.en: Icelanders sailed in open boats, fished for cod,
cues.zh: 冰島人開著敞篷船航行，捕捉鱈魚，

cues.text: and hunted shark for their valuable liver oil.
cues.en: and hunted shark for their valuable liver oil.
cues.zh: 並捕獵鯊魚以獲取寶貴的肝油。

cues.text: ♪ More and more, symbols like an official national costume
cues.en: ♪ More and more, symbols like an official national costume
cues.zh: ♪ 越來越多的符號像官方民族服裝

cues.text: and its own flag demonstrated a growing sense of national identity.
cues.en: and its own flag demonstrated a growing sense of national identity.
cues.zh: 其國旗也顯示出日益增長的民族認同感。

cues.text: Iceland remained part of Denmark through the 1800s.
cues.en: Iceland remained part of Denmark through the 1800s.
cues.zh: 在整個 1800 年代，冰島一直是丹麥的一部分。

cues.text: Iceland-born politician Jón Sigurdsson lobbied in Copenhagen for independence,
cues.en: Iceland-born politician Jón Sigurdsson lobbied in Copenhagen for independence,
cues.zh: 冰島出生的政治家喬恩·西於爾松 (Jón Sigurdsson) 在哥本哈根遊說獨立，

cues.text: which Denmark finally granted in 1918.
cues.en: which Denmark finally granted in 1918.
cues.zh: 丹麥最終於 1918 年批准。

cues.text: ♪ Iceland's parliament, called the Althing, may seem humble.
cues.en: ♪ Iceland's parliament, called the Althing, may seem humble.
cues.zh: ♪ 冰島議會，稱為 Althing，可能看起來很謙虛。

cues.text: But it represents a thousand- year journey in this society from rustic farmsteads to today's
cues.en: But it represents a thousand- year journey in this society from rustic farmsteads to today's
cues.zh: 但它代表了這個社會從鄉村農莊到今天的一千年的歷程。

cues.text: modern, democratic nation.
cues.en: modern, democratic nation.
cues.zh: 現代、民主國家。

cues.text: ♪ Rick, voice-over: For locals, Parliament Square remains a place to make your voice heard...
cues.en: ♪ Rick, voice-over: For locals, Parliament Square remains a place to make your voice heard...
cues.zh: ♪ 裡克，畫外音：對當地人來說，議會廣場仍然是一個讓人們聽到你的聲音的地方...

cues.text: or to just hang out.
cues.en: or to just hang out.
cues.zh: 或者只是閒逛。

cues.text: ♪ Reykjavík still has a hardworking harbor,
cues.en: ♪ Reykjavík still has a hardworking harbor,
cues.zh: ♪ 雷克雅未克仍有一個勤奮的港口，

cues.text: busy with both industrial vessels and sightseeing boats.
cues.en: busy with both industrial vessels and sightseeing boats.
