cues.text: Quantum Computers Explained – Limits of Human Technology For most of our history, human technology consisted of our brains, fire, and sharp sticks.
cues.en: Quantum Computers Explained – Limits of Human Technology For most of our history, human technology consisted of our brains, fire, and sharp sticks.
cues.zh: 從我們的歷史來看 人類的科技大都建立在腦、火與尖銳的棒子上

cues.text: While fire and sharp sticks became power plants and nuclear weapons,
cues.en: While fire and sharp sticks became power plants and nuclear weapons,
cues.zh: 人類的科技大都建立在腦、火與尖銳的棒子上 當火和尖銳棒狀物變成發電廠和核武時

cues.text: the biggest upgrade has happened to our brains.
cues.en: the biggest upgrade has happened to our brains.
cues.zh: 當火和尖銳棒狀物變成發電廠和核武時 腦的大進化已經開始發生 自從 1960 年來，電腦的運算能力呈獻指數性的成長

cues.text: Since the 1960's, the power of our brain machines has kept growing exponentially,
cues.en: Since the 1960's, the power of our brain machines has kept growing exponentially,
cues.zh: 自從 1960 年來，電腦的運算能力呈獻指數性的成長

cues.text: allowing computers to get smaller and more powerful at the same time.
cues.en: allowing computers to get smaller and more powerful at the same time.
cues.zh: 自從 1960 年來，電腦的運算能力呈獻指數性的成長 使得電腦愈來愈小，同時愈來愈強大

cues.text: But this process is about to meet its physical limits.
cues.en: But this process is about to meet its physical limits.
cues.zh: 但是演化已經快碰到了物理上的極限

cues.text: Computer parts are approaching the size of an atom.
cues.en: Computer parts are approaching the size of an atom.
cues.zh: 但是演化已經快碰到了物理上的極限 電腦元件尺寸正在趨近於原子的大小

cues.text: To understand why this is a problem, we have to clear up some basics.
cues.en: To understand why this is a problem, we have to clear up some basics.
cues.zh: 為了說明這為什麼是個問題 我們必須要先講解一些基本知識

cues.text: In a Nutshell - By Kurzgesagt A computer is made up of very simple components
cues.en: In a Nutshell - By Kurzgesagt A computer is made up of very simple components
cues.zh: 電腦是由執行簡單功能的簡單元件所組合而成

cues.text: doing very simple things.
cues.en: doing very simple things.
cues.zh: 電腦是由執行簡單功能的簡單元件所組合而成 以呈獻資料、提供處理的方式、與控制機制

cues.text: Representing data, the means of processing it, and control mechanisms.
cues.en: Representing data, the means of processing it, and control mechanisms.
cues.zh: 以呈獻資料、提供處理的方式、與控制機制

cues.text: Computer chips contain modules, which contain logic gates, which contain transistors.
cues.en: Computer chips contain modules, which contain logic gates, which contain transistors.
cues.zh: 晶片包含模組，模組包含邏輯閘，邏輯閘包含電晶體 電晶體代表著電腦的處理器裡一個最簡單的型態

cues.text: A transistor is the simplest form of a data processor in computers,
cues.en: A transistor is the simplest form of a data processor in computers,
cues.zh: 電晶體代表著電腦的處理器裡一個最簡單的型態

cues.text: basically a switch that can either block, or open the way for information coming through.
cues.en: basically a switch that can either block, or open the way for information coming through.
cues.zh: 電晶體代表著電腦的處理器裡一個最簡單的型態 簡單說是個可以阻擋、透過資訊的開關

cues.text: This information is made up of bits which can be set to either 0 or 1.
cues.en: This information is made up of bits which can be set to either 0 or 1.
cues.zh: 簡單說是個可以阻擋、透過資訊的開關 而此資訊是由位元構成，它可以設為 0 或者 1

cues.text: Combinations of several bits are used to represent more complex information.
cues.en: Combinations of several bits are used to represent more complex information.
cues.zh: 而此資訊是由位元構成，它可以設為 0 或者 1 多個位元的組合通常代表著更複雜的資訊

cues.text: Transistors are combined to create logic gates which still do very simple stuff.
cues.en: Transistors are combined to create logic gates which still do very simple stuff.
cues.zh: 多個位元的組合通常代表著更複雜的資訊 將電晶體組合後會變成邏輯閘，它還是隻有簡單的功能

cues.text: For example, an AND Gate sends an output of 1 if all of its inputs are 1, and a output of 0 otherwise.
cues.en: For example, an AND Gate sends an output of 1 if all of its inputs are 1, and a output of 0 otherwise.
cues.zh: 將電晶體組合後會變成邏輯閘，它還是隻有簡單的功能 例如，一個 AND 閘只有在輸入值皆為 1 時才會輸出 1 否則就會輸出 0

cues.text: Combinations of logic gates finally form meaningful modules, say, for adding two numbers.
cues.en: Combinations of logic gates finally form meaningful modules, say, for adding two numbers.
cues.zh: 最終組合不同的邏輯閘形成了有意義的模組 比方說加法的功能模組

cues.text: Once you can add, you can also multiply, and once you can multiply, you can basically do anything.
cues.en: Once you can add, you can also multiply, and once you can multiply, you can basically do anything.
cues.zh: 比方說加法的功能模組 一旦你能夠使用加法，你也可以使用乘法 一旦可以使用乘法，基本上什麼都可以做了

cues.text: Since all basic operations are literally simpler than first grade math,
cues.en: Since all basic operations are literally simpler than first grade math,
cues.zh: 自從所有基本運算都比一年級的數學簡單

cues.text: you can imagine a computer as a group of 7-year-olds answering really basic math questions.
cues.en: you can imagine a computer as a group of 7-year-olds answering really basic math questions.
cues.zh: 自從所有基本運算都比一年級的數學簡單 你可將電腦想像為一群在回答基礎數學題的 7 歲小孩

cues.text: A large enough bunch of them could compute anything from astrophysics to Zelda.
cues.en: A large enough bunch of them could compute anything from astrophysics to Zelda.
cues.zh: 你可將電腦想像為一群在回答基礎數學題的 7 歲小孩 足夠數量的小孩可以計算所有的東西 不論是天文物理或薩爾達傳說

cues.text: However, with parts getting tinier and tinier, quantum physics are making things tricky.
cues.en: However, with parts getting tinier and tinier, quantum physics are making things tricky.
cues.zh: 然而隨著元件愈變愈小，量子力學讓事情變得很詭異

cues.text: In a nutshell, a transistor is just an electric switch.
cues.en: In a nutshell, a transistor is just an electric switch.
cues.zh: 簡而言之，一個電晶體只是一個電流開關

cues.text: Electricity is electrons moving from one place to another.
cues.en: Electricity is electrons moving from one place to another.
cues.zh: 電流表示電子由一端流向另一端

cues.text: So, a switch is a passage that can block electrons from moving in one direction.
cues.en: So, a switch is a passage that can block electrons from moving in one direction.
cues.zh: 電流表示電子由一端流向另一端 所以開關就是可決定是否讓電子流過的單向通道

cues.text: Today, a typical scale for transistors is 14 nanometers,
cues.en: Today, a typical scale for transistors is 14 nanometers,
cues.zh: 現今的電晶體尺寸大約是 14 奈米

cues.text: which is about 8 times less than the HIV virus' diameter, and 500 times smaller than a red blood cell.
cues.en: which is about 8 times less than the HIV virus' diameter, and 500 times smaller than a red blood cell.
cues.zh: 是 HIV 病毒直徑的 1/8 倍 然後是紅血球的 1/500 倍

cues.text: As transistors are shrinking to the size of only a few atoms,
cues.en: As transistors are shrinking to the size of only a few atoms,
cues.zh: 然後是紅血球的 1/500 倍 當電晶體小到僅幾顆原子大的尺寸時

cues.text: electrons may just transfer themselves to the other side of a blocked passage
cues.en: electrons may just transfer themselves to the other side of a blocked passage
cues.zh: 當電晶體小到僅幾顆原子大的尺寸時 電子會無視阻擋將自己傳送到另一端

cues.text: via a process called Quantum Tunneling.
cues.en: via a process called Quantum Tunneling.
cues.zh: 電子會無視阻擋將自己傳送到另一端 這現象稱作量子穿隧效應

cues.text: In the quantum realm, physics works quite differently from the predictable ways we're used to,
cues.en: In the quantum realm, physics works quite differently from the predictable ways we're used to,
cues.zh: 在量子世界裡 物理運作方式和我們平常看到的不太一樣

cues.text: and traditional computers just stop making sense.
cues.en: and traditional computers just stop making sense.
cues.zh: 物理運作方式和我們平常看到的不太一樣 而傳統的電腦就開始沒邏輯了

cues.text: We are approaching a real physical barrier for our technological progress.
cues.en: We are approaching a real physical barrier for our technological progress.
cues.zh: 我們的科技正一步步接近物理的極限

cues.text: To solve this problem, scientists are trying to use these unusual quantum properties to their advantage
cues.en: To solve this problem, scientists are trying to use these unusual quantum properties to their advantage
cues.zh: 我們的科技正一步步接近物理的極限 為瞭解決這問題 科學家嘗試利用量子物理不尋常的特性中的優點

cues.text: by building quantum computers.
cues.en: by building quantum computers.
cues.zh: 科學家嘗試利用量子物理不尋常的特性中的優點 方法就是製造臺量子電腦

cues.text: In normal computers, bits are the smallest unit of information.
cues.en: In normal computers, bits are the smallest unit of information.
cues.zh: 方法就是製造臺量子電腦 在一般電腦中，位元代表著資訊的最小單位

cues.text: Quantum computers use qubits which can also be set to one of two values.
cues.en: Quantum computers use qubits which can also be set to one of two values.
cues.zh: 量子電腦使用的是量子位元 他同樣可以設成 0 和 1

cues.text: A qubit can be any two level quantum system, such as a spin and a magnetic field, or a single photon.
cues.en: A qubit can be any two level quantum system, such as a spin and a magnetic field, or a single photon.
cues.zh: 一個量子位元可以是任何二階的量子系統 像是自旋和磁場，或是單一的光子

cues.text: 0 and 1 are this system's possible states, like the photons horizontal or vertical polarization.
cues.en: 0 and 1 are this system's possible states, like the photons horizontal or vertical polarization.
cues.zh: 0 和 1 是系統中可能存在的狀態 就像是光子橫向或縱向的偏振

cues.text: In the quantum world, the qubit doesn't have to be just one of those,
cues.en: In the quantum world, the qubit doesn't have to be just one of those,
cues.zh: 在量子世界裡，量子位元不一定是這兩種狀態之一

cues.text: it can be in any proportions of both states at once.
cues.en: it can be in any proportions of both states at once.
cues.zh: 在量子世界裡，量子位元不一定是這兩種狀態之一 他可以在他們間同時表現出所有的偏振狀態

cues.text: This is called superposition.
cues.en: This is called superposition.
cues.zh: 這被稱作為量子疊加

cues.text: But as soon as you test its value, say, by sending the photon through a filter,
cues.en: But as soon as you test its value, say, by sending the photon through a filter,
cues.zh: 這被稱作為量子疊加 但當你想把一個光子送到濾波器做測試時

cues.text: it has to decide to be either vertically or horizontally polarized.
cues.en: it has to decide to be either vertically or horizontally polarized.
cues.zh: 它必須決定自己是縱向或橫向偏振

cues.text: So as long as it's unobserved, the qubit is in a superposition of probabilities for 0 and 1, and you can't predit which it'll be.
cues.en: So as long as it's unobserved, the qubit is in a superposition of probabilities for 0 and 1, and you can't predit which it'll be.
cues.zh: 所以當它被觀測之前 量子位元就代表著 1 和 0 間所有可能的疊加狀態 你無法預期是哪個狀態

cues.text: But the instant you measure it, it collapses into one of the definite states.
cues.en: But the instant you measure it, it collapses into one of the definite states.
cues.zh: 但當你測量它的瞬間，它將會塌陷為一個固定的狀態

cues.text: Superposition is a game changer.
cues.en: Superposition is a game changer.
cues.zh: 量子疊加狀態改變了遊戲的規則

cues.text: Four classical bits can be in one of two to the power of four different configurations at a time.
cues.en: Four classical bits can be in one of two to the power of four different configurations at a time.
cues.zh: 量子疊加狀態改變了遊戲的規則 四個傳統位元中，每個位元各自表示兩種狀態中的一種

cues.text: That's 16 possible combinations, out of which you can use just one.
cues.en: That's 16 possible combinations, out of which you can use just one.
cues.zh: 這共包含了 16 種不同的組合，但只能使用其的一組

cues.text: Four qubits in superposition, however, can be in all of those 16 combinations at once.
cues.en: Four qubits in superposition, however, can be in all of those 16 combinations at once.
cues.zh: 四個量子位元則可以同時代表著 16 種狀態

cues.text: This number grows exponentially with each extra qubit.
cues.en: This number grows exponentially with each extra qubit.
cues.zh: 四個量子位元則可以同時代表著 16 種狀態 每增加額外的量子位元，組合數將會是指數性的成長

cues.text: Twenty of them can already store a million values in parallel.
cues.en: Twenty of them can already store a million values in parallel.
cues.zh: 20 個量子位元就可以平行儲存 100 萬個數值

cues.text: A really weird and unintuitive property qubits can have is Entanglement,
cues.en: A really weird and unintuitive property qubits can have is Entanglement,
cues.zh: 量子位元還有一個詭異並不確定性的特性 那就是量子糾纏

cues.text: a close connection that makes each of the qubits react to a change in the other's state instantaneously,
cues.en: a close connection that makes each of the qubits react to a change in the other's state instantaneously,
cues.zh: 那就是量子糾纏 他使另一組糾纏狀態的量子位元呈獻與自己相反的狀態

cues.text: no matter how far they are apart.
cues.en: no matter how far they are apart.
cues.zh: 他使另一組糾纏狀態的量子位元呈獻與自己相反的狀態 就算他們之間被分開多遠都一樣

cues.text: This means when measuring just one entangled qubit, you can directly deduce properties of it's partners
cues.en: This means when measuring just one entangled qubit, you can directly deduce properties of it's partners
cues.zh: 就算他們之間被分開多遠都一樣 這意味著只要測量其中一個糾纏態的量子位元 利用這特性就能不用觀測而得知另一組結果

cues.text: without having to look.
cues.en: without having to look.
cues.zh: 利用這特性就能不用觀測而得知另一組結果

cues.text: Qubit Manipulation is a mind bender as well.
cues.en: Qubit Manipulation is a mind bender as well.
cues.zh: 操控量子位元就像是腦筋急轉彎

cues.text: A normal logic gate gets a simple set of inputs and produces one definite output.
cues.en: A normal logic gate gets a simple set of inputs and produces one definite output.
cues.zh: 一個普通的邏輯閘有著單純的輸入， 並產生一個固定的輸出

cues.text: A quantum gate manipulates an input of superpositions, rotates probabilities,
cues.en: A quantum gate manipulates an input of superpositions, rotates probabilities,
cues.zh: 量子閘輸入一個疊加 旋轉他改變機率，輸出另一個疊加

cues.text: and produces another superposition as its output.
cues.en: and produces another superposition as its output.
cues.zh: 旋轉他改變機率，輸出另一個疊加

cues.text: So a quantum computer sets up some qubits, applies quantum gates to entangle them and manipulate probabilities,
cues.en: So a quantum computer sets up some qubits, applies quantum gates to entangle them and manipulate probabilities,
cues.zh: 所以一臺量子電腦操作部份的量子閘產生糾纏 並控制機率，最後測量輸出

cues.text: then finally measures the outcome, collapsing superpositions to an actual sequence of 0s and 1s.
cues.en: then finally measures the outcome, collapsing superpositions to an actual sequence of 0s and 1s.
cues.zh: 並控制機率，最後測量輸出 讓疊加狀態崩潰後得出最後結果的 0 和 1

cues.text: What this means is that you get the entire lot of calculations that are possible with your setup, all done at the same time.
cues.en: What this means is that you get the entire lot of calculations that are possible with your setup, all done at the same time.
cues.zh: 讓疊加狀態崩潰後得出最後結果的 0 和 1 這意味著你可以將這麼多種可能性同時進行運算

cues.text: Ultimately, you can only measure one of the results and it'll only probably be the one you want,
cues.en: Ultimately, you can only measure one of the results and it'll only probably be the one you want,
cues.zh: 這意味著你可以將這麼多種可能性同時進行運算 最終你只會測量到一個結果 而這結果只是有很高的機率可能就是你要的

cues.text: so you may have to double check and try again.
cues.en: so you may have to double check and try again.
cues.zh: 而這結果只是有很高的機率可能就是你要的 所以你可能要多計算幾次以檢查結果

cues.text: But by cleverly exploiting superposition and entanglement, this can be exponentially more efficient than would ever be possible on a normal computer.
cues.en: But by cleverly exploiting superposition and entanglement, this can be exponentially more efficient than would ever be possible on a normal computer.
cues.zh: 但巧妙地運用疊加和量子糾纏 效率相比一般電腦將會是指數性的成長

cues.text: So, while quantum computers will not probably not replace our home computers,
cues.en: So, while quantum computers will not probably not replace our home computers,
cues.zh: 所以量子電腦雖然無法取代現在的電腦

cues.text: in some areas, they are vastly superior.
cues.en: in some areas, they are vastly superior.
cues.zh: 在某些領域他們是非常優越的

cues.text: One of them is database searching.
cues.en: One of them is database searching.
cues.zh: 其中之一就是資料庫搜尋

cues.text: To find something in a database, a normal computer may have to test every single one of its entries.
cues.en: To find something in a database, a normal computer may have to test every single one of its entries.
cues.zh: 一般電腦再資料庫中搜尋可能要搜尋每一份資料

cues.text: Quantum computers algorithms need only the square root of that time, which for large databases, is a huge difference
cues.en: Quantum computers algorithms need only the square root of that time, which for large databases, is a huge difference
cues.zh: 量子演演算法只需要原來運算時間開根號的時間 這在大型資料庫上會有著極大的差距

cues.text: The most famous use of quantum computers is ruining IT security.
cues.en: The most famous use of quantum computers is ruining IT security.
cues.zh: 量子電腦中最著名的用法就是破解資訊安全機制

cues.text: Right now, your browsing, email, and banking data is being kept secure by an encryption system
cues.en: Right now, your browsing, email, and banking data is being kept secure by an encryption system
cues.zh: 量子電腦中最著名的用法就是破解資訊安全機制 現在你瀏覽的銀行郵件還是被加密系統給保護著

cues.text: in which you give everyone a public key to encode messages only you can decode.
cues.en: in which you give everyone a public key to encode messages only you can decode.
cues.zh: 現在你瀏覽的銀行郵件還是被加密系統給保護著 藉由你給其它使用者不同組的公鑰 ，來加密只有你能解密的訊息

cues.text: The problem is that this public key can actually be used to calculate your secret private key.
cues.en: The problem is that this public key can actually be used to calculate your secret private key.
cues.zh: ，來加密只有你能解密的訊息 問題是拿到公鑰的人可以計算出你的金鑰

cues.text: Luckily, doing the necessary math on any normal computer would literally take years of trial and error.
cues.en: Luckily, doing the necessary math on any normal computer would literally take years of trial and error.
cues.zh: 幸運的是使用一般的電腦必須花上數年運算， 不斷地嘗試錯誤才有辦法解開

cues.text: But a quantum computer with exponential speed-up could do it in a breeze.
cues.en: But a quantum computer with exponential speed-up could do it in a breeze.
cues.zh: 不斷地嘗試錯誤才有辦法解開 但對於量子電腦，由於運算速率是指數性的成長 可能只是小菜一碟

cues.text: Another really exciting new use is simulations.
cues.en: Another really exciting new use is simulations.
cues.zh: 另一個著名的用法就是當作模擬器

cues.text: Simulations of the quantum world are very intense on resources,
cues.en: Simulations of the quantum world are very intense on resources,
cues.zh: 模擬量子環境非常地吃資源

cues.text: and even for bigger structures, such as molecules, they often lack accuracy.
cues.en: and even for bigger structures, such as molecules, they often lack accuracy.
cues.zh: 更或者一些巨大的結構體，例如分子結構 他們通常缺乏精準度

cues.text: So why not simulate quantum physics with actual quantum physics?
cues.en: So why not simulate quantum physics with actual quantum physics?
cues.zh: 他們通常缺乏精準度 所以為何不用真實的量子電腦來模擬量子物理環境呢？

cues.text: Quantum simulations could provide new insights on proteins that might revolutionize medicine.
cues.en: Quantum simulations could provide new insights on proteins that might revolutionize medicine.

mZsaaturR6E.title: Fusion Power Explained – Future or Failure
mZsaaturR6E.speaker: Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell
mZsaaturR6E.zh: 【Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell】聚變發電的解釋－未來或失敗（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: The fundamental currency of our universe is energy.
cues.en: The fundamental currency of our universe is energy.
cues.zh: 我們宇宙的基礎貨幣是能量

cues.text: It lights our homes, grows our food, powers our computers.
cues.en: It lights our homes, grows our food, powers our computers.
cues.zh: 能量可以點亮我們的家、生長食物、讓我們的電腦運作

cues.text: We can get it lots of ways: Burning fossil fuels, splitting atoms,
cues.en: We can get it lots of ways: Burning fossil fuels, splitting atoms,
cues.zh: 有很多有很多方式可以獲得能量： 燃燒化石燃料、分裂原子、

cues.text: or sunlight striking photovoltaics.
cues.en: or sunlight striking photovoltaics.
cues.zh: 或是太陽能發電

cues.text: But there's a downside to everything Fossil fuels are extremely toxic,
cues.en: But there's a downside to everything Fossil fuels are extremely toxic,
cues.zh: 但每種方法都有缺點 化石燃料會極度汙染

cues.text: Nuclear waste is... well, nuclear waste, And, there are not enough batteries to store sunlight for cloudy days yet.
cues.en: Nuclear waste is... well, nuclear waste, And, there are not enough batteries to store sunlight for cloudy days yet.
cues.zh: 核廢料…嗯，就是核廢料 而且，現在還沒有足夠的電池 可以儲存足夠的陽光給陰天的時候用呢

cues.text: And yet the sun seems to have virtually limitless free energy.
cues.en: And yet the sun seems to have virtually limitless free energy.
cues.zh: 然而，太陽似乎有幾乎無限的免費能量

cues.text: Is there a way we could build a sun on Earth?
cues.en: Is there a way we could build a sun on Earth?
cues.zh: 有沒有辦法在地球上製造一顆太陽呢？

cues.text: Can we bottle a star?
cues.en: Can we bottle a star?
cues.zh: 我們能否把星星裝進瓶子裡？

cues.text: The sun shines because of nuclear fusion.
cues.en: The sun shines because of nuclear fusion.
cues.zh: 太陽的光來自核融合。

cues.text: In a nutshell, fusion is a thermonuclear process.
cues.en: In a nutshell, fusion is a thermonuclear process.
cues.zh: 簡而言之，核融合是一種熱核融合反應

cues.text: Meaning that the ingredients have to be incredibly hot.
cues.en: Meaning that the ingredients have to be incredibly hot.
cues.zh: 這意味著材料一定要熱得不得了

cues.text: So hot, that the atoms are stripped of their electrons Making a plasma where nuclei and electrons bounce around freely.
cues.en: So hot, that the atoms are stripped of their electrons Making a plasma where nuclei and electrons bounce around freely.
cues.zh: 熱到讓原子上的電子離家出走 他們就變成電漿了，在電漿裡 原子核和電子會自由地彈跳

cues.text: Since nuclei are all positively charged, They repel each other.
cues.en: Since nuclei are all positively charged, They repel each other.
cues.zh: 由於原子核都帶正電， 它們之間會相互排斥

cues.text: In order to overcome this repulsion, The particles have to be going very, very fast
cues.en: In order to overcome this repulsion, The particles have to be going very, very fast
cues.zh: 要克服這個斥力 該粒子必須動的非常非常快

cues.text: In this context, very fast means "very hot" Millions of degrees
cues.en: In this context, very fast means "very hot" Millions of degrees
cues.zh: 在這種情況下，非常快的意思是「非常熱」 好幾百萬度

cues.text: Stars cheat to reach these temperatures.
cues.en: Stars cheat to reach these temperatures.
cues.zh: 星星會作弊來達到這些溫度

cues.text: They are so massive, that the pressure in their cores Generates the heat to squeeze the nuclei together
cues.en: They are so massive, that the pressure in their cores Generates the heat to squeeze the nuclei together
cues.zh: 他們是如此龐大，在他們核心裡的壓力 產生的熱會把原子核擠成一團

cues.text: Until they merge and fuse Creating heavier nuclei and releasing energy in the process.
cues.en: Until they merge and fuse Creating heavier nuclei and releasing energy in the process.
cues.zh: 然後他們就融合在一起了 這樣會創造出較重的原子核，並在過程中釋放能量

cues.text: It is this energy release that scientists hope to harness
cues.en: It is this energy release that scientists hope to harness
cues.zh: 科學家想要採集的正是這種能量的釋放

cues.text: In a new generation of power plant, The fusion reactor.
cues.en: In a new generation of power plant, The fusion reactor.
cues.zh: 就在新型的發電廠 也就是核融合反應爐裡

cues.text: On earth it's not feasible to use this brute force method to create fusion.
cues.en: On earth it's not feasible to use this brute force method to create fusion.
cues.zh: 在地球上，像太陽一樣使用暴力來產生融合是不可行的

cues.text: So if we wanted to build a reactor that generates energy from fusion, We have to get clever.
cues.en: So if we wanted to build a reactor that generates energy from fusion, We have to get clever.
cues.zh: 因此，如果我們想建立從核融合產生能量的反應爐 我們就要略施小計

cues.text: To date, scientists have invented two ways of making plasmas hot enough to fuse:
cues.en: To date, scientists have invented two ways of making plasmas hot enough to fuse:
cues.zh: 迄今為止，科學家已經發明瞭兩種 使電漿熱到足以產生融合的方式

cues.text: The first type of reactor uses a magnetic field to Squeeze a plasma in a doughnut shaped chamber
cues.en: The first type of reactor uses a magnetic field to Squeeze a plasma in a doughnut shaped chamber
cues.zh: 第一型別的反應爐的使用磁場來 把電漿擠壓在甜甜圈形狀的空間裡

cues.text: Where the reactions take place.
cues.en: Where the reactions take place.
cues.zh: 這裡面就會發生核反應

cues.text: These magnetic confinement reactors Such as the I.T.E.R. reactor in France,
cues.en: These magnetic confinement reactors Such as the I.T.E.R. reactor in France,
cues.zh: 這些磁力可以約束反應爐 如法國的 I.T.E.R 反應爐

cues.text: Use superconducting electromagnets cooled with liquid helium To within a few degrees of absolute zero.
cues.en: Use superconducting electromagnets cooled with liquid helium To within a few degrees of absolute zero.
cues.zh: 透過液態氦冷卻的超導體電磁鐵 使其溫度被降到離絕對零度不到幾度

cues.text: Meaning that they host some of the biggest temperature gradients in the known universe.
cues.en: Meaning that they host some of the biggest temperature gradients in the known universe.
cues.zh: 這意味著裡面有已知的宇宙裡 最大的溫差

cues.text: The second type called "Inertial confinement" Uses pulses from super-powered lasers
cues.en: The second type called "Inertial confinement" Uses pulses from super-powered lasers
cues.zh: 第二類被稱為「慣性約束」 使用超高能的雷射的脈衝

cues.text: To heat the surface of a pellet of fuel Imploding it, briefly making the fuel hot and dense enough to fuse.
cues.en: To heat the surface of a pellet of fuel Imploding it, briefly making the fuel hot and dense enough to fuse.
cues.zh: 來加熱燃料丸的表面 使其內爆，短暫使燃料夠熱、夠密到足以產生融合

cues.text: In fact, one of the of the most powerful lasers in the world Is used for fusion experiments
cues.en: In fact, one of the of the most powerful lasers in the world Is used for fusion experiments
cues.zh: 事實上，世界上最強大的雷射之一 正是用於核融合實驗

cues.text: At the National Ignition Facility in the U.S.
cues.en: At the National Ignition Facility in the U.S.
cues.zh: 它位在美國的國家點火設施

cues.text: These experiments and others like them around the world are today, just experiments.
cues.en: These experiments and others like them around the world are today, just experiments.
cues.zh: 這些實驗以及其他世界各地的類似設施 到目前為止都還只是實驗

cues.text: Scientists are still developing the technology, And although they can achieve fusion,
cues.en: Scientists are still developing the technology, And although they can achieve fusion,
cues.zh: 科學家們仍在開發這項科技， 雖然他們可以實現融合

cues.text: Right now, it costs more energy to do the experiment Then they produce in fusion.
cues.en: Right now, it costs more energy to do the experiment Then they produce in fusion.
cues.zh: 目前，做這實驗要花的電 比核融合產生的電還多

cues.text: The technology has a long way to go before it's commercially viable,
cues.en: The technology has a long way to go before it's commercially viable,
cues.zh: 在有商業價值之前，這項科技還有很長的路要走

cues.text: and maybe it never will be.
cues.en: and maybe it never will be.
cues.zh: 也許這永遠不會成功

cues.text: It might just be impossible to make a viable fusion reactor on earth,
cues.en: It might just be impossible to make a viable fusion reactor on earth,
cues.zh: 也許在地球上建造一個可行的核融合反應爐是不可能的

cues.text: But if it gets there, it will be so efficient That a single glass of sea water, could be used to produce
cues.en: But if it gets there, it will be so efficient That a single glass of sea water, could be used to produce
cues.zh: 但如果我們做到了，它的效能會非常高 一杯海水就可以產生

cues.text: as much energy as burning a barrel of oil, with no waste to speak of.
cues.en: as much energy as burning a barrel of oil, with no waste to speak of.
cues.zh: 跟一桶油一樣多的能量，而且不會產生廢氣

cues.text: This is because fusion reactors would use hydrogen or helium as fuel
cues.en: This is because fusion reactors would use hydrogen or helium as fuel
cues.zh: 這是因為核融合反應爐 將使用氫或氦作為燃料

cues.text: And sea water is loaded with hydrogen But not just any hydrogen will do.
cues.en: And sea water is loaded with hydrogen But not just any hydrogen will do.
cues.zh: 而海水有滿滿的氫 但不是任何的氫都可以用

cues.text: Specific isotopes with extra neutrons called Deuterium and Tritium
cues.en: Specific isotopes with extra neutrons called Deuterium and Tritium
cues.zh: 必須使用具備額外中子的氫同位素 就是所謂的氘和氚

cues.text: Are needed to make the right reactions.
cues.en: Are needed to make the right reactions.
cues.zh: 才能產生正確的反應

cues.text: Deuterium is stable and can be found in abundance in sea water,
cues.en: Deuterium is stable and can be found in abundance in sea water,
cues.zh: 氘是穩定的 在海水裡就可以找到很多

cues.text: Though Tritium is a bit trickier.
cues.en: Though Tritium is a bit trickier.
cues.zh: 不過氚有點難對付

cues.text: It's radioactive And there may only be 20 kilograms of it in the world
cues.en: It's radioactive And there may only be 20 kilograms of it in the world
cues.zh: 它有放射性 並且全球可能只有20公斤的氚

cues.text: Mostly in nuclear warheads Which makes it incredibly expensive.
cues.en: Mostly in nuclear warheads Which makes it incredibly expensive.
cues.zh: 大多在核彈頭裡 所以它非常昂貴

cues.text: So we made need another fusion buddy for Deuterium instead of Tritium.
cues.en: So we made need another fusion buddy for Deuterium instead of Tritium.
cues.zh: 因此，我們需要氘的核融合好友 我們不用氚

cues.text: Helium-3, an isotope of Helium, might be a great substitute.
cues.en: Helium-3, an isotope of Helium, might be a great substitute.
cues.zh: 而是用氦的同位素，氦-3 它可能是一個很棒的替代品

cues.text: Unfortunately, it's also incredibly rare on earth.
cues.en: Unfortunately, it's also incredibly rare on earth.
cues.zh: 不幸的是，它在地球上極其稀少

cues.text: But here, the moon might have the answer.
cues.en: But here, the moon might have the answer.
cues.zh: 但在月球這裡可能有答案

cues.text: Over billions of years, the solar wind may have built up huge deposits
cues.en: Over billions of years, the solar wind may have built up huge deposits
cues.zh: 幾十億年間 太陽風可能已經在月球上堆滿了

cues.text: Of Helium-3 on the moon.
cues.en: Of Helium-3 on the moon.
cues.zh: 太陽風可能已經在月球上堆滿了 大量的氦-3

cues.text: Instead of making Helium-3, we can mine it.
cues.en: Instead of making Helium-3, we can mine it.
cues.zh: 我們不用親自生產氦-3，我們可以去挖掘它

cues.text: If we could sift the lunar dust for helium, We'd have enough fuel to power the entire world for thousands of years.
cues.en: If we could sift the lunar dust for helium, We'd have enough fuel to power the entire world for thousands of years.
cues.zh: 如果我們可以把月球塵埃過篩，尋找氦 那我們就會有足夠的燃料讓全世界使用幾千年

cues.text: One more argument for establishing a moon base, if you weren't convinced already.
cues.en: One more argument for establishing a moon base, if you weren't convinced already.
cues.zh: 如果你不支援月球基地的話 這是建立月球基地的又一個理由

cues.text: Ok, maybe you think building a mini sun Still sound kind of dangerous
cues.en: Ok, maybe you think building a mini sun Still sound kind of dangerous
cues.zh: 好吧，也許你認為製造一個小型太陽 聽起來有點危險

cues.text: But they'd actually be much safer than most other types of powerplants A fusion reactor is not like a nuclear plant,
cues.en: But they'd actually be much safer than most other types of powerplants A fusion reactor is not like a nuclear plant,
cues.zh: 但他們實際上比大多數其他型別的發電廠更安全 核融合反應爐並不像普通的核電廠，

cues.text: Which can melt down catastrophically.
cues.en: Which can melt down catastrophically.
cues.zh: 它不會災難性的融解

cues.text: If the confinement failed, then the plasma would expand and cool,
cues.en: If the confinement failed, then the plasma would expand and cool,
cues.zh: 如果約束失敗了，那麼裡面的電漿將擴大並冷卻

cues.text: And the reaction would stop.
cues.en: And the reaction would stop.
cues.zh: 導致核反應停止

cues.text: Put simply, it's not a bomb.
cues.en: Put simply, it's not a bomb.
cues.zh: 簡單地說，它不會變成炸彈

cues.text: The release of radioactive fuel, like Tritium, Could pose a threat to the environment.
cues.en: The release of radioactive fuel, like Tritium, Could pose a threat to the environment.
cues.zh: 放射性燃料的釋放，比如說氚 可能對環境造成威脅

cues.text: Tritium could bond with oxygen making radioactive water, Which could be dangerous as it seeps into the environment.
cues.en: Tritium could bond with oxygen making radioactive water, Which could be dangerous as it seeps into the environment.
cues.zh: 氚可以與和氧結合，產生有放射性的水 這可能是危險的，因為它會滲透到環境裡

cues.text: Fortunately, there's no more than a few grams in use at a given time,
cues.en: Fortunately, there's no more than a few grams in use at a given time,
cues.zh: 幸運的是，我們每次使用的量 不會超過幾公克，所以洩漏物很快會被稀釋掉

cues.text: So a leak would be quickly diluted.
cues.en: So a leak would be quickly diluted.
cues.zh: 不會超過幾公克，所以洩漏物很快會被稀釋掉

cues.text: So we've just told you that theres nearly unlimited energy to be had At no expense to the environment
cues.en: So we've just told you that theres nearly unlimited energy to be had At no expense to the environment
cues.zh: 所以，我們剛告訴你世界上有幾乎無限的能量 又不必犧牲環境

cues.text: In something as simple as water.
cues.en: In something as simple as water.
cues.zh: 就存在在水裡

cues.text: So, whats the catch?
cues.en: So, whats the catch?
cues.zh: 那麼，我們為什麼不用？

cues.text: Cost. We simply don't know if fusion power will ever be commercially viable.
cues.en: Cost. We simply don't know if fusion power will ever be commercially viable.
cues.zh: 答案是成本。我們根本不知道核融合 有沒有商業價值

cues.text: Even if they work, they might be too expensive to ever build.
cues.en: Even if they work, they might be too expensive to ever build.
cues.zh: 即使有可能建造，它們可能貴到蓋不出來

cues.text: The main drawback, is that it's unproven technology Its a 10 billion dollar gamble
cues.en: The main drawback, is that it's unproven technology Its a 10 billion dollar gamble
cues.zh: 它的主要缺點是，它是未經驗證的技術 它是百億美元的豪賭 而這些錢用在其他 已經證實可行的乾淨能源上

cues.text: And that money might be better spent on other clean energy That's already proven itself.
cues.en: And that money might be better spent on other clean energy That's already proven itself.
cues.zh: 而這些錢用在其他 已經證實可行的乾淨能源上 可能會更好

cues.text: Maybe we should cut out losses Or maybe, when the payoff is unlimited clean energy for everyone,
cues.en: Maybe we should cut out losses Or maybe, when the payoff is unlimited clean energy for everyone,
cues.zh: 也許我們應該現在收手不幹 又或許，當成果可以讓每個人 享有無限乾淨能源時

cues.text: It might be worth the risk.
cues.en: It might be worth the risk.
cues.zh: 這可能是值得冒險的

cues.text: Videos like this one take hundreds of hours to make and are made possible by your contributions on patreon.com
cues.en: Videos like this one take hundreds of hours to make and are made possible by your contributions on patreon.com
cues.zh: 像這樣的影片要花費數百個小時製作 全都靠大家在 patreon.com 上的貢獻才能完成

cues.text: If you want to learn more about global energy, Here's a playlist about nuclear energy, fracking and solar power.
cues.en: If you want to learn more about global energy, Here's a playlist about nuclear energy, fracking and solar power.
cues.zh: 如果您想了解更多有關全球能源的議題 這裡有一個關於核能，水力裂解 和太陽能發電的播放列表

cues.text: Let us know in the comments if there are other technologies you want us to explain.
cues.en: Let us know in the comments if there are other technologies you want us to explain.
cues.zh: 如果有其他科技是你要我們講解的 請在底下留言

6tw_JVz_IEc.title: How CRISPR lets you edit DNA - Andrea M. Henle
6tw_JVz_IEc.speaker: TED-Ed
6tw_JVz_IEc.zh: 【TED-Ed】CRISPR 如何讓您編輯 DNA - Andrea M. Henle（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: From the smallest single-celled organism to the largest creatures on earth,
cues.en: From the smallest single-celled organism to the largest creatures on earth,
cues.zh: 從最小的單細胞有機體， 到地球上最大的動物，

cues.text: every living thing is defined by its genes.
cues.en: every living thing is defined by its genes.
cues.zh: 到地球上最大的動物， 所有生物都是 由它的基因所定義的。

cues.text: The DNA contained in our genes acts like an instruction manual for our cells.
cues.en: The DNA contained in our genes acts like an instruction manual for our cells.
cues.zh: 我們基因中的 DNA 就像是 給我們細胞看的說明書。 四種叫做「鹼基」的積木， 會依照特定的順序串在一起，

cues.text: Four building blocks called bases are strung together in precise sequences,
cues.en: Four building blocks called bases are strung together in precise sequences,
cues.zh: 四種叫做「鹼基」的積木， 會依照特定的順序串在一起， 告訴細胞該做出什麼行為，

cues.text: which tell the cell how to behave and form the basis for our every trait.
cues.en: which tell the cell how to behave and form the basis for our every trait.
cues.zh: 告訴細胞該做出什麼行為， 並形成我們每一項特點的基礎。 但靠著近期在基因工具的進展，

cues.text: But with recent advancements in gene editing tools, scientists can change an organism’s fundamental features in record time.
cues.en: But with recent advancements in gene editing tools, scientists can change an organism’s fundamental features in record time.
cues.zh: 但靠著近期在基因工具的進展， 科學家能夠在最短時間內 改變有機體的基本特徵。 他們能設計出抗旱的作物，

cues.text: They can engineer drought-resistant crops and create apples that don’t brown.
cues.en: They can engineer drought-resistant crops and create apples that don’t brown.
cues.zh: 他們能設計出抗旱的作物， 創造出不會變成褐色的蘋果。 他們甚至可能可以預防 感染性疾病爆發的擴散，

cues.text: They might even prevent the spread of infectious outbreaks and develop cures for genetic diseases.
cues.en: They might even prevent the spread of infectious outbreaks and develop cures for genetic diseases.
cues.zh: 他們甚至可能可以預防 感染性疾病爆發的擴散， 並開發出基因疾病的解藥。 CRISPR 是最快速、最簡單， 且最便宜的基因編輯工具，

cues.text: CRISPR is the fastest, easiest, and cheapest of the gene editing tools
cues.en: CRISPR is the fastest, easiest, and cheapest of the gene editing tools
cues.zh: CRISPR 是最快速、最簡單， 且最便宜的基因編輯工具， 會有這一波科學新潮流， 就是因為它。

cues.text: responsible for this new wave of science.
cues.en: responsible for this new wave of science.
cues.zh: 會有這一波科學新潮流， 就是因為它。 但這項醫學奇蹟是從哪裡來的？

cues.text: But where did this medical marvel come from?
cues.en: But where did this medical marvel come from?
cues.zh: 但這項醫學奇蹟是從哪裡來的？

cues.text: How does it work?
cues.en: How does it work?
cues.zh: 但這項醫學奇蹟是從哪裡來的？ 它如何運作？它能做什麼？

cues.text: And what can it do?
cues.en: And what can it do?
cues.zh: 它如何運作？它能做什麼？ 很讓人訝異的是，CRISPR 其實是一種自然過程，

cues.text: Surprisingly, CRISPR is actually a natural process that’s long functioned as a bacterial immune system.
cues.en: Surprisingly, CRISPR is actually a natural process that’s long functioned as a bacterial immune system.
cues.zh: 很讓人訝異的是，CRISPR 其實是一種自然過程， 長久以來就以細菌 免疫系統的形式在運作。 最早發現它會保護 單細胞細菌和古菌，

cues.text: Originally found defending single-celled bacteria and archaea against invading viruses,
cues.en: Originally found defending single-celled bacteria and archaea against invading viruses,
cues.zh: 長久以來就以細菌 免疫系統的形式在運作。 最早發現它會保護 單細胞細菌和古菌， 抵抗來襲的病毒，

cues.text: naturally occurring CRISPR uses two main components.
cues.en: naturally occurring CRISPR uses two main components.
cues.zh: 抵抗來襲的病毒， 自然發生的 CRISPR 會使用兩種主要元件。

cues.text: The first are short snippets of repetitive DNA sequences
cues.en: The first are short snippets of repetitive DNA sequences
cues.zh: 自然發生的 CRISPR 會使用兩種主要元件。 第一種是重覆 DNA 序列的片斷，

cues.text: called “clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats,” or simply, CRISPRs.
cues.en: called “clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats,” or simply, CRISPRs.
cues.zh: 第一種是重覆 DNA 序列的片斷， 叫做「群聚且有規律間隔的 短迴文重覆序列」， 或簡稱為 CRISPRs。

cues.text: The second are Cas, or “CRISPR-associated” proteins which chop up DNA like molecular scissors.
cues.en: The second are Cas, or “CRISPR-associated” proteins which chop up DNA like molecular scissors.
cues.zh: 或簡稱為 CRISPRs。 第二種是 Cas， 即 CRISPR 關聯蛋白， 它像是分子剪刀一樣 可以切碎 DNA。

cues.text: When a virus invades a bacterium, Cas proteins cut out a segment of the viral DNA
cues.en: When a virus invades a bacterium, Cas proteins cut out a segment of the viral DNA
cues.zh: 當病毒攻擊細菌時， Cas 蛋白會把病毒 DNA 的一部分切下來，

cues.text: to stitch into the bacterium’s CRISPR region, capturing a chemical snapshot of the infection.
cues.en: to stitch into the bacterium’s CRISPR region, capturing a chemical snapshot of the infection.
cues.zh: Cas 蛋白會把病毒 DNA 的一部分切下來， 將它縫到細菌的 CRISPR 區域， 取得感染的化學快照。

cues.text: Those viral codes are then copied into short pieces of RNA.
cues.en: Those viral codes are then copied into short pieces of RNA.
cues.zh: 接著，那些病毒碼 會被複製成短的 RNA。

cues.text: This molecule plays many roles in our cells, but in the case of CRISPR,
cues.en: This molecule plays many roles in our cells, but in the case of CRISPR,
cues.zh: RNA 這種分子在我們的 細胞中扮演許多角色， 但就 CRISPR 的情況來說，

cues.text: RNA binds to a special protein called Cas9.
cues.en: RNA binds to a special protein called Cas9.
cues.zh: RNA 會和特別的蛋白質 Cas9 結合 。 產生出來的複合物， 功能就像是偵察兵，

cues.text: The resulting complexes act like scouts, latching onto free-floating genetic material
cues.en: The resulting complexes act like scouts, latching onto free-floating genetic material
cues.zh: 產生出來的複合物， 功能就像是偵察兵， 佔據自由浮動的基因材料， 搜尋和病毒一模一樣的目標。

cues.text: and searching for a match to the virus.
cues.en: and searching for a match to the virus.
cues.zh: 佔據自由浮動的基因材料， 搜尋和病毒一模一樣的目標。

cues.text: If the virus invades again, the scout complex recognizes it immediately,
cues.en: If the virus invades again, the scout complex recognizes it immediately,
cues.zh: 搜尋和病毒一模一樣的目標。 如果病毒再次侵襲， 偵察兵複合物就會馬上認出它，

cues.text: and Cas9 swiftly destroys the viral DNA.
cues.en: and Cas9 swiftly destroys the viral DNA.
cues.zh: 如果病毒再次侵襲， 偵察兵複合物就會馬上認出它， Cas9 會快速地摧毀病毒 DNA。

cues.text: Lots of bacteria have this type of defense mechanism.
cues.en: Lots of bacteria have this type of defense mechanism.
cues.zh: 很多細菌都有這種防禦機制。 但，2012 年，科學家 找出了方法來劫持 CRISPR，

cues.text: But in 2012, scientists figured out how to hijack CRISPR
cues.en: But in 2012, scientists figured out how to hijack CRISPR
cues.zh: 但，2012 年，科學家 找出了方法來劫持 CRISPR， 讓它的目標不只是病毒 DNA，

cues.text: to target not just viral DNA, but any DNA in almost any organism.
cues.en: to target not just viral DNA, but any DNA in almost any organism.
cues.zh: 讓它的目標不只是病毒 DNA， 而是幾乎任何 有機體中的任何 DNA。 用對了工具，這種病毒免疫系統

cues.text: With the right tools, this viral immune system becomes a precise gene-editing tool,
cues.en: With the right tools, this viral immune system becomes a precise gene-editing tool,
cues.zh: 用對了工具，這種病毒免疫系統 就變成了精確的基因編輯工具， 能用來修改 DNA， 改變特定的基因，

cues.text: which can alter DNA and change specific genes almost as easily as fixing a typo.
cues.en: which can alter DNA and change specific genes almost as easily as fixing a typo.
cues.zh: 能用來修改 DNA， 改變特定的基因， 幾乎就像打錯字的修改一樣容易。 在實驗室中，它是這樣運作的：

cues.text: Here’s how it works in the lab: scientists design a “guide” RNA to match the gene they want to edit,
cues.en: Here’s how it works in the lab: scientists design a “guide” RNA to match the gene they want to edit,
cues.zh: 在實驗室中，它是這樣運作的： 科學家設計出一個「嚮導」RNA， 符合他們想要編輯的基因，

cues.text: and attach it to Cas9.
cues.en: and attach it to Cas9.
cues.zh: 將它附著到 Cas9 上。 就像 CRISPR 免疫系統中的病毒 RNA，

cues.text: Like the viral RNA in the CRISPR immune system, the guide RNA directs Cas9 to the target gene,
cues.en: Like the viral RNA in the CRISPR immune system, the guide RNA directs Cas9 to the target gene,
cues.zh: 就像 CRISPR 免疫系統中的病毒 RNA， 嚮導 RNA 會指示 Cas9 去找目標基因， 該蛋白質的分子剪刀會切斷 DNA。

cues.text: and the protein’s molecular scissors snip the DNA.
cues.en: and the protein’s molecular scissors snip the DNA.
cues.zh: 該蛋白質的分子剪刀會切斷 DNA。 這就是 CRISPR 如此強大的關鍵：

cues.text: This is the key to CRISPR’s power: just by injecting Cas9 bound to a short piece of custom guide RNA
cues.en: This is the key to CRISPR’s power: just by injecting Cas9 bound to a short piece of custom guide RNA
cues.zh: 這就是 CRISPR 如此強大的關鍵： 只要把 Cas9 注射到短短一小段 訂製的嚮導 RNA 中， 科學家就可以編輯 基因組中的幾乎任何基因。

cues.text: scientists can edit practically any gene in the genome.
cues.en: scientists can edit practically any gene in the genome.
cues.zh: 科學家就可以編輯 基因組中的幾乎任何基因。

cues.text: Once the DNA is cut, the cell will try to repair it.
cues.en: Once the DNA is cut, the cell will try to repair it.
cues.zh: 一旦 DNA 被切斷， 細胞會嘗試修復它。

cues.text: Typically, proteins called nucleases trim the broken ends and join them back together.
cues.en: Typically, proteins called nucleases trim the broken ends and join them back together.
cues.zh: 通常，叫做核酸酶的蛋白質 會把破裂的邊緣修整好， 將它們重新接合起來。

cues.text: But this type of repair process, called nonhomologous end joining,
cues.en: But this type of repair process, called nonhomologous end joining,
cues.zh: 但這種修復過程， 也就是「非同源染色體末端連線」，

cues.text: is prone to mistakes and can lead to extra or missing bases.
cues.en: is prone to mistakes and can lead to extra or missing bases.
cues.zh: 很容易犯錯，且可能會導致 鹼基多出來或不足。 結果產生出來的基因通常不能用， 會被關掉（去活化）。

cues.text: The resulting gene is often unusable and turned off.
cues.en: The resulting gene is often unusable and turned off.
cues.zh: 結果產生出來的基因通常不能用， 會被關掉（去活化）。

cues.text: However, if scientists add a separate sequence of template DNA
cues.en: However, if scientists add a separate sequence of template DNA
cues.zh: 然而，如果科學家將一個 個別的模板 DNA 序列 加到他們的 CRISPR 雞尾酒裡，

cues.text: to their CRISPR cocktail, cellular proteins can perform a different DNA repair process,
cues.en: to their CRISPR cocktail, cellular proteins can perform a different DNA repair process,
cues.zh: 加到他們的 CRISPR 雞尾酒裡， 細胞蛋白質就能執行 一種不同的 DNA 修復過程，

cues.text: called homology directed repair.
cues.en: called homology directed repair.
cues.zh: 細胞蛋白質就能執行 一種不同的 DNA 修復過程， 稱為同源介導修復。

cues.text: This template DNA is used as a blueprint to guide the rebuilding process,
cues.en: This template DNA is used as a blueprint to guide the rebuilding process,
cues.zh: 稱為同源介導修復。 這種模板 DNA 被用來當作藍圖， 引導重建的過程。

cues.text: repairing a defective gene or even inserting a completely new one.
cues.en: repairing a defective gene or even inserting a completely new one.
cues.zh: 這種模板 DNA 被用來當作藍圖， 引導重建的過程。 修復缺陷基因， 或甚至插入全新的基因。

cues.text: The ability to fix DNA errors means that CRISPR could potentially create new treatments for diseases
cues.en: The ability to fix DNA errors means that CRISPR could potentially create new treatments for diseases
cues.zh: 有修復 DNA 錯誤的能力， 就表示可能可以用 CRISPR 來創造新的療法， 治療與特定基因錯誤有關的疾病，

cues.text: linked to specific genetic errors, like cystic fibrosis or sickle cell anemia.
cues.en: linked to specific genetic errors, like cystic fibrosis or sickle cell anemia.
cues.zh: 治療與特定基因錯誤有關的疾病， 比如囊腫性纖維化 或鐮狀細胞性貧血癥。 既然它不只限於人類，

cues.text: And since it’s not limited to humans, the applications are almost endless.
cues.en: And since it’s not limited to humans, the applications are almost endless.
cues.zh: 既然它不只限於人類， 應用範圍幾乎是無限大的。 CRISPR 可以創造出 果實更大的植物，

cues.text: CRISPR could create plants that yield larger fruit,
cues.en: CRISPR could create plants that yield larger fruit,
cues.zh: CRISPR 可以創造出 果實更大的植物， 不會傳播瘧疾的蚊子，

cues.text: mosquitoes that can’t transmit malaria, or even reprogram drug-resistant cancer cells.
cues.en: mosquitoes that can’t transmit malaria, or even reprogram drug-resistant cancer cells.
cues.zh: 不會傳播瘧疾的蚊子， 或甚至將有抗藥性的 癌細胞重新程式設計。 在研究基因組方面， 它也是強大的工具，

cues.text: It’s also a powerful tool for studying the genome, allowing scientists to watch what happens when genes are turned off
cues.en: It’s also a powerful tool for studying the genome, allowing scientists to watch what happens when genes are turned off
cues.zh: 或甚至將有抗藥性的 癌細胞重新程式設計。 在研究基因組方面， 它也是強大的工具， 讓科學家可以看到， 當基因被關掉時， 或在有機體內改變時， 會發生什麼事。

cues.text: or changed within an organism.
cues.en: or changed within an organism.
cues.zh: 或在有機體內改變時， 會發生什麼事。

cues.text: CRISPR isn’t perfect yet.
cues.en: CRISPR isn’t perfect yet.
cues.zh: CRISPR 還不完美。

cues.text: It doesn’t always make just the intended changes, and since it’s difficult to predict the long-term implications of a CRISPR edit,
cues.en: It doesn’t always make just the intended changes, and since it’s difficult to predict the long-term implications of a CRISPR edit,
cues.zh: CRISPR 還不完美。 它不見得能只做出 我們想要做的改變， 且因為很難預測長期來看 CRISPR 編輯會有什麼意涵，

cues.text: this technology raises big ethical questions.
cues.en: this technology raises big ethical questions.
cues.zh: 且因為很難預測長期來看 CRISPR 編輯會有什麼意涵， 這項技術免不了會有 很大的倫理問題。 我們要決定未來 怎麼走才是最好的，

cues.text: It’s up to us to decide the best course forward as CRISPR leaves single-celled organisms behind
cues.en: It’s up to us to decide the best course forward as CRISPR leaves single-celled organisms behind
cues.zh: 我們要決定未來 怎麼走才是最好的， 因為 CRISPR 不再 只用於單細胞有機體， 它已經要邁入全世界的 實驗室、農田、

cues.text: and heads into labs, farms, hospitals, and organisms around the world.
cues.en: and heads into labs, farms, hospitals, and organisms around the world.
cues.zh: 它已經要邁入全世界的 實驗室、農田、 醫院，以及生物。

9OVtk6G2TnQ.speaker: TED-Ed

cues.text: You probably know the feeling.
cues.en: You probably know the feeling.

cues.en: Your phone utters its final plaintive "bleep" and cuts out in the middle of your call.

cues.text: In that moment, you may feel more like throwing your battery across the room

cues.en: than singing its praises, but batteries are a triumph of science.

cues.text: They allow smartphones and other technologies to exist without anchoring us to an infernal tangle of power cables.
cues.en: They allow smartphones and other technologies to exist without anchoring us to an infernal tangle of power cables.

cues.text: Yet even the best batteries will diminish daily, slowly losing capacity until they finally die.
cues.en: Yet even the best batteries will diminish daily, slowly losing capacity until they finally die.

cues.text: So why does this happen, and how do our batteries even store so much charge in the first place?
cues.en: So why does this happen, and how do our batteries even store so much charge in the first place?

cues.text: It all started in the 1780s with two Italian scientists,
cues.en: It all started in the 1780s with two Italian scientists,

cues.text: Luigi Galvani and Alessandro Volta, and a frog.
cues.en: Luigi Galvani and Alessandro Volta, and a frog.
cues.zh: 「路易吉．賈法尼」 以及「亞歷山卓．伏打」 還有一隻青蛙 據說當賈法尼正在研究青蛙的大腿時

cues.text: Legend has it that as Galvani was studying a frog's leg, he brushed a metal instrument up against one of its nerves,
cues.en: Legend has it that as Galvani was studying a frog's leg, he brushed a metal instrument up against one of its nerves,
cues.zh: 據說當賈法尼正在研究青蛙的大腿時 他把金屬儀器輕碰上蛙腿的一條神經 使得蛙腿肌肉抽動

cues.text: making the leg muscles jerk.
cues.en: making the leg muscles jerk.
cues.zh: 他把金屬儀器輕碰上蛙腿的一條神經 使得蛙腿肌肉抽動

cues.text: Galvani called this animal electricity, believing that a type of electricity was stored in the very stuff of life.
cues.en: Galvani called this animal electricity, believing that a type of electricity was stored in the very stuff of life.
cues.zh: 使得蛙腿肌肉抽動 賈法尼稱其為「動物電」 他認為有一種電力型態 被儲存在生命體裡面

cues.text: But Volta disagreed, arguing that it was the metal itself that made the leg twitch.
cues.en: But Volta disagreed, arguing that it was the metal itself that made the leg twitch.
cues.zh: 他認為有一種電力型態 被儲存在生命體裡面 但是伏打不認同 他指出是金屬本身使得蛙腿抽搐

cues.en: The debate was eventually settled with Volta's groundbreaking experiment.
cues.zh: 他指出是金屬本身使得蛙腿抽搐 該爭論最終平息於 「伏打」開創性的實驗下

cues.text: He tested his idea with a stack of alternating layers of zinc and copper,
cues.en: He tested his idea with a stack of alternating layers of zinc and copper,
cues.zh: 該爭論最終平息於 「伏打」開創性的實驗下 他用了一堆交疊的鋅片與銅片 來驗證他的想法 用被鹽水試劑浸濕的紙或布料隔開

cues.text: separated by paper or cloth soaked in a salt water solution.
cues.en: separated by paper or cloth soaked in a salt water solution.
cues.zh: 用被鹽水試劑浸濕的紙或布料隔開 在伏打的電池裡所發生的是化學家 現在稱做「氧化、還原」的現象

cues.text: What happened in Volta's cell is something chemists now call oxidation and reduction.
cues.en: What happened in Volta's cell is something chemists now call oxidation and reduction.
cues.zh: 在伏打的電池裡所發生的是化學家 現在稱做「氧化、還原」的現象 鋅片氧化代表它失去了電子

cues.text: The zinc oxidizes, which means it loses electrons,
cues.en: The zinc oxidizes, which means it loses electrons,
cues.zh: 鋅片氧化代表它失去了電子 該電子接著被水中的離子在叫做 「還原」的過程中取得

cues.text: which are, in turn, gained by the ions in the water in a process called reduction,
cues.en: which are, in turn, gained by the ions in the water in a process called reduction,
cues.zh: 該電子接著被水中的離子在叫做 「還原」的過程中取得 而產生出氫氣

cues.text: producing hydrogen gas.
cues.en: producing hydrogen gas.

cues.text: Volta would have been shocked to learn that last bit.
cues.en: Volta would have been shocked to learn that last bit.
cues.zh: 伏打要是得知最後這一部分 也會感到吃驚的 他以為該反應發生在銅片裡面

cues.text: He thought the reaction was happening in the copper, rather than the solution.
cues.en: He thought the reaction was happening in the copper, rather than the solution.
cues.zh: 他以為該反應發生在銅片裡面 而不是鹽水試劑中 儘管如此我們仍透過把電力的 標準單位命名為「伏特」

cues.text: None the less, we honor Volta's discovery today by naming our standard unit of electric potential "the volt."
cues.en: None the less, we honor Volta's discovery today by naming our standard unit of electric potential "the volt."
cues.zh: 儘管如此我們仍透過把電力的 標準單位命名為「伏特」 來紀念伏打的發現 該「氧化、還原」迴圈 在這兩種物質之間產生電流

cues.en: This oxidation-reduction cycle creates a flow of electrons between two substances

cues.text: and if you hook a lightbulb or vacuum cleaner up between the two,
cues.en: and if you hook a lightbulb or vacuum cleaner up between the two,
cues.zh: 如果你掛個燈泡或是吸塵器 在兩種物質間的上方

cues.text: you'll give it power.
cues.en: you'll give it power.
cues.zh: 如果你掛個燈泡或是吸塵器 在兩種物質間的上方 你將會給它電力 自從十八世紀以來科學家們已經在 伏打的設計上做了改進

cues.text: Since the 1700s, scientists have improved on Volta's design.
cues.en: Since the 1700s, scientists have improved on Volta's design.
cues.zh: 自從十八世紀以來科學家們已經在 伏打的設計上做了改進 他們以裝填了化學粘料的乾電池 取代了化學試劑

cues.en: They've replaced the chemical solution with dry cells filled with chemical paste,
cues.zh: 他們以裝填了化學粘料的乾電池 取代了化學試劑

cues.text: but the principle is the same.
cues.en: but the principle is the same.
cues.zh: 他們以裝填了化學粘料的乾電池 取代了化學試劑 不過原理是一樣的 一端的金屬氧化送出電子

cues.text: A metal oxidizes, sending electrons to do some work
cues.en: A metal oxidizes, sending electrons to do some work
cues.zh: 一端的金屬氧化送出電子 在它們被另一項物質 重新取得還原前來做些「功」

cues.text: before they are regained by a substance being reduced.
cues.en: before they are regained by a substance being reduced.
cues.zh: 在它們被另一項物質 重新取得還原前來做些「功」 但是任何電池的金屬量是有限的

cues.text: But any battery has a finite supply of metal, and once most of it has oxidized, the battery dies.
cues.en: But any battery has a finite supply of metal, and once most of it has oxidized, the battery dies.
cues.zh: 但是任何電池的金屬量是有限的 一旦大部分的金屬已經氧化掉了 該電池也就掛點了 所以充電電池給了我們一個 針對這問題的短暫解決方法

cues.text: So rechargeable batteries give us a temporary solution to this problem
cues.en: So rechargeable batteries give us a temporary solution to this problem
cues.zh: 一旦大部分的金屬已經氧化掉了 該電池也就掛點了 所以充電電池給了我們一個 針對這問題的短暫解決方法

cues.text: by making the oxidation-reduction process reversible.
cues.en: by making the oxidation-reduction process reversible.
cues.zh: 透過讓「氧化、還原」過程 能倒過頭來做的 電子可以憑藉電力的運用來流回相反方向

cues.text: Electrons can flow back in the opposite direction with the application of electricity.
cues.en: Electrons can flow back in the opposite direction with the application of electricity.
cues.zh: 電子可以憑藉電力的運用來流回相反方向 插上充電器從牆上的插座把電力匯出

cues.text: Plugging in a charger draws the electricity from a wall outlet that drives the reaction to regenerate the metal,
cues.en: Plugging in a charger draws the electricity from a wall outlet that drives the reaction to regenerate the metal,
cues.zh: 插上充電器從牆上的插座把電力匯出 帶動反應來讓金屬再生 使得你在下次需要它們的時候 氧化時能有更多電子可取得

cues.text: making more electrons available for oxidation the next time you need them.
cues.en: making more electrons available for oxidation the next time you need them.
cues.zh: 使得你在下次需要它們的時候 氧化時能有更多電子可取得 但就算是充電電池也沒辦法永保安康

cues.text: But even rechargeable batteries don't last forever.
cues.en: But even rechargeable batteries don't last forever.
cues.zh: 但就算是充電電池也沒辦法永保安康 長時間下來重複這個過程

cues.text: Over time, the repetition of this process causes imperfections
cues.en: Over time, the repetition of this process causes imperfections
cues.zh: 長時間下來重複這個過程 造成金屬的表面有瑕疵、不規則 使它不能好好地氧化、

cues.text: and irregularities in the metal's surface that prevent it from oxidizing properly.
cues.en: and irregularities in the metal's surface that prevent it from oxidizing properly.
cues.zh: 造成金屬的表面有瑕疵、不規則 使它不能好好地氧化、

cues.text: The electrons are no longer available to flow through a circuit and the battery dies.
cues.en: The electrons are no longer available to flow through a circuit and the battery dies.
cues.zh: 電子不再能夠在迴路上流動 這個電池就掛點了 有些每天充電的電池

cues.text: Some everyday rechargeable batteries will die after only hundreds of discharge-recharge cycles,
cues.en: Some everyday rechargeable batteries will die after only hundreds of discharge-recharge cycles,
cues.zh: 有些每天充電的電池 只做幾百回充、放電迴圈後就會掛點掉 同一時間比較新、先進的電池 可以撐過執行數千回的迴圈

cues.text: while newer, advanced batteries can survive and function for thousands.
cues.en: while newer, advanced batteries can survive and function for thousands.
cues.zh: 同一時間比較新、先進的電池 可以撐過執行數千回的迴圈 未來的電池可能是既輕又薄的薄片

cues.text: Batteries of the future may be light, thin sheets that operate on the principles of quantum physics
cues.en: Batteries of the future may be light, thin sheets that operate on the principles of quantum physics
cues.zh: 未來的電池可能是既輕又薄的薄片 在量子物理學的原理下運作 而且撐過幾十萬回的充電迴圈

cues.text: and last for hundreds of thousands of charge cycles.
cues.en: and last for hundreds of thousands of charge cycles.

cues.text: But until scientists find a way to take advantage of motion to recharge your cell battery, like cars do,
cues.en: But until scientists find a way to take advantage of motion to recharge your cell battery, like cars do,
cues.zh: 不過直到科學家們找到方法 利用動能來讓你的手機電池充電以前 就像汽車的動能回充 或是把太陽能板裝進 你的電子裝置的某處以前

cues.en: or fit solar panels somewhere on your device, plugging your charger into the wall,

cues.en: rather than expending one battery to charge another is your best bet to forestall that fatal "bleep."

iHzzSao6ypE.title: Traffic Has a Perfect Solution. Humans Are the Problem.
iHzzSao6ypE.speaker: CGP Grey
iHzzSao6ypE.zh: 【CGP Grey】交通有完美的解決方案。人類是問題所在。（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Stuck at an intersection, you always watch unfold the Fundamental Problem of Traffic.
cues.en: Stuck at an intersection, you always watch unfold the Fundamental Problem of Traffic.
cues.zh: 陷於車陣時 你總是納悶著為何會塞車

cues.text: On green, the first car accelerates, and then the next, and then the next, and then the next, and then you,
cues.en: On green, the first car accelerates, and then the next, and then the next, and then the next, and then you,
cues.zh: 綠燈時，第一臺車加速，然後下一臺 然後下一臺、下一臺、直到你 只有你被紅燈卡住

cues.text: only to catch the red.
cues.en: only to catch the red.
cues.zh: 只有你被紅燈卡住

cues.text: Had the cars accelerated simultaneously you would have made it through.
cues.en: Had the cars accelerated simultaneously you would have made it through.
cues.zh: 假設所有車同時起步 你就能透過這個路口 協調才是問題，而不是車輛

cues.text: Coordination - not cars - is the problem, because we are monkey drivers with slow reaction times
cues.en: Coordination - not cars - is the problem, because we are monkey drivers with slow reaction times
cues.zh: 協調才是問題，而不是車輛 因為我們是反應慢的駕駛

cues.text: and short attention spans.
cues.en: and short attention spans.
cues.zh: 而且無法長時間維持專注力

cues.text: Even if we tried getting everyone to press the pedal on 3-2-1-now
cues.en: Even if we tried getting everyone to press the pedal on 3-2-1-now
cues.zh: 即使我們嘗試所有人同時起步 一、二、三，走

cues.text: would be challenging.
cues.en: would be challenging.
cues.zh: 還是很困難

cues.text: This dis-coordination limits how many cars can get through an intersection and when one backs up to the next,
cues.en: This dis-coordination limits how many cars can get through an intersection and when one backs up to the next,
cues.zh: 不協調限制了透過路口的車輛數 而且，當一個路口塞到另一個路口

cues.text: that's when city-sized gridlock cascades happen, taking forever to clear.
cues.en: that's when city-sized gridlock cascades happen, taking forever to clear.

cues.text: In general, more intersections equals more dis-coordination which equals more traffic.
cues.en: In general, more intersections equals more dis-coordination which equals more traffic.
cues.zh: 總而言之，越多路口導致越多不協調，然後導致越多塞車 這就是高速公路的原理，沒有路口

cues.text: This is the motive behind big highways: no intersections.
cues.en: This is the motive behind big highways: no intersections.
cues.zh: 這就是高速公路的原理，沒有路口

cues.text: Splits and merges, yes. Intersections, no.
cues.en: Splits and merges, yes. Intersections, no.
cues.zh: 有分道跟合併，但沒有路口

cues.text: No stopping, no coordination problems, no traffic Well that's the theory anyway.
cues.en: No stopping, no coordination problems, no traffic Well that's the theory anyway.
cues.zh: 沒有停車，沒有協調問題，沒有塞車 但，這是隻是個理論

cues.text: Intersections outside of a highway will back up onto it.
cues.en: Intersections outside of a highway will back up onto it.
cues.zh: 平面道路的十字路口還是會塞回高速公路

cues.text: Again, because human reaction times limit how many cars can escape the off-ramp
cues.en: Again, because human reaction times limit how many cars can escape the off-ramp
cues.zh: 當燈號變換時 又因為人類反應時間

cues.text: when the light changes.
cues.en: when the light changes.
cues.zh: 限制了匝道的流量

cues.text: But, even without intersections, there would still be traffic on the highway.
cues.en: But, even without intersections, there would still be traffic on the highway.
cues.zh: 但即使沒有路口，高速公路仍會塞車 塞車可以無中生有

cues.text: Traffic can just appear.
cues.en: Traffic can just appear.

cues.text: Take a one lane highway with happy cars flowing until a chicken crosses the road.
cues.en: Take a one lane highway with happy cars flowing until a chicken crosses the road.
cues.zh: 假設有一條一線道高速公路 一隻雞穿過馬路

cues.text: The driver who sees it brakes a little, the driver behind him doesn't notice immediately and brakes a little harder than necessary,
cues.en: The driver who sees it brakes a little, the driver behind him doesn't notice immediately and brakes a little harder than necessary,
cues.zh: 看見雞的駕駛稍微踩了煞車 後車沒有馬上注意到，煞車踩得大力些

cues.text: the driver behind him does the same until someone comes to a complete stop
cues.en: the driver behind him does the same until someone comes to a complete stop
cues.zh: 下一臺車也一樣，直到某人完全停止

cues.text: and, oh look, cars approaching at highway speeds must now stop as well.
cues.en: and, oh look, cars approaching at highway speeds must now stop as well.
cues.zh: 原本在速限的來車 都必須減速至停止

cues.text: Though the chicken is long gone, it left a phantom intersection on the highway.
cues.en: Though the chicken is long gone, it left a phantom intersection on the highway.
cues.zh: 即使雞早已經走了 牠卻留下一個隱形路口

cues.text: This is what's happened when you're stuck in traffic for hours thinking, "There must be a deadly pile up ahead" and then suddenly, the traffic's over
cues.en: This is what's happened when you're stuck in traffic for hours thinking, "There must be a deadly pile up ahead" and then suddenly, the traffic's over
cues.zh: 這就是為什麼塞車時 你總是在思考 「前面一定發生了嚴重的連環車禍」 但車流紓解後

cues.text: with no wreckage in sight, to your relief if you're a good person and mild annoyance if you aren't.
cues.en: with no wreckage in sight, to your relief if you're a good person and mild annoyance if you aren't.
cues.zh: 卻沒看到車禍 如果你是個好人，你會鬆一口氣 反之你會有點不爽

cues.text: You just pass through a phantom intersection, the cause of which is long gone.
cues.en: You just pass through a phantom intersection, the cause of which is long gone.
cues.zh: 你只是經過了一個隱形路口 塞車的原因早已消失

cues.text: And this phantom intersection moves.
cues.en: And this phantom intersection moves.
cues.zh: 而這個隱形路口還會移動

cues.text: It's really a traffic snake slithering down the road eating oncoming cars at one end and pooping them out the other.
cues.en: It's really a traffic snake slithering down the road eating oncoming cars at one end and pooping them out the other.
cues.zh: 這就像一條貪食蛇 吃下來車並且從另一端拉出來

cues.text: On a ring road, a single car slowing down will start an Ouroboros of traffic that will last forever,
cues.en: On a ring road, a single car slowing down will start an Ouroboros of traffic that will last forever,
cues.zh: 在環形道路上 一臺車減速 會製造出銜尾蛇 永遠地塞下去

cues.text: even though there's no problem with the road.
cues.en: even though there's no problem with the road.
cues.zh: 即使道路上沒有任何問題

cues.text: If the drivers could coordinate to accelerate and separate simultaneously,
cues.en: If the drivers could coordinate to accelerate and separate simultaneously,
cues.zh: 如果駕駛可以互相協調 同時加速和保持距離 交通就能恢復順暢

cues.text: easy driving would return.
cues.en: easy driving would return.
cues.zh: 交通就能恢復順暢

cues.text: But they can't, so traffic eternal.
cues.en: But they can't, so traffic eternal.
cues.zh: 但駕駛們不行 所以只能一直塞車

cues.text: On highways, traffic snakes grow if cars are eaten faster than excreted,
cues.en: On highways, traffic snakes grow if cars are eaten faster than excreted,
cues.zh: 高速公路上 貪食蛇吃多拉少就會變長

cues.text: and they shrink if excreted faster than eaten, dying when the last car accelerates away before the next car must stop.
cues.en: and they shrink if excreted faster than eaten, dying when the last car accelerates away before the next car must stop.
cues.zh: 反之縮短 當最後一輛車在後車煞車前加速 貪食蛇就會消失

cues.text: Now, in multi-lane highways, there needs be no chicken to start gridlock.
cues.en: Now, in multi-lane highways, there needs be no chicken to start gridlock.
cues.zh: 多線道的高速公路 沒有雞也可能造成問題

cues.text: A driver crossing lanes quickly with cars too close behind is enough
cues.en: A driver crossing lanes quickly with cars too close behind is enough
cues.zh: 一個駕駛變快速換車道 卻沒注意安全距離

cues.text: to birth a traffic snake that lives for hours and leagues.
cues.en: to birth a traffic snake that lives for hours and leagues.
cues.zh: 就會製造出貪食車 需要數小時才會消失

cues.text: It's this quick crossing that causes drivers behind to over-brake and begin a chain reaction.
cues.en: It's this quick crossing that causes drivers behind to over-brake and begin a chain reaction.
cues.zh: 快速變換車道會導致過度煞車 引發連鎖反應

cues.text: But we *can* make traffic snakes less likely by changing the way we drive.
cues.en: But we *can* make traffic snakes less likely by changing the way we drive.
cues.zh: 但改變開車方式 我們「可以」讓貪食蛇幾乎消失

cues.text: Your goal as a driver is to stay the same distance from the car ahead as from the car behind at all times.
cues.en: Your goal as a driver is to stay the same distance from the car ahead as from the car behind at all times.
cues.zh: 目標是駕駛 與前後車保持相同距離 緊跟著前車是個問題 不只是因為提高車禍率

cues.text: Tailgating is trouble. Not just because it makes accidents more likely but because you as the tailgater can start a traffic snake if the driver ahead brakes.
cues.en: Tailgating is trouble. Not just because it makes accidents more likely but because you as the tailgater can start a traffic snake if the driver ahead brakes.
cues.zh: 緊跟著前車是個問題 不只是因為提高車禍率 而且當前車減速時 容易製造出貪食蛇 所以永遠保持在中間！

cues.text: Always in the middle!
cues.en: Always in the middle!
cues.zh: 所以永遠保持在中間！ 這樣給你最多的時間 避免過度煞車

cues.text: This gives you the most time to prevent over-braking but also gives the driver behind you the most time as well.
cues.en: This gives you the most time to prevent over-braking but also gives the driver behind you the most time as well.
cues.zh: 這樣給你最多的時間 避免過度煞車 而且也給後車最多時間反應 而且 當塞車時

cues.text: And when stuck in traffic, this rule would get all cars to pull apart the snake faster.
cues.en: And when stuck in traffic, this rule would get all cars to pull apart the snake faster.
cues.zh: 而且 當塞車時 這個原則可以讓加速拉開貪食蛇 這就是個簡單的方法解決塞車 讓人們改變行為

cues.text: That's the simple solution to traffic: getting humans to change their behavior,
cues.en: That's the simple solution to traffic: getting humans to change their behavior,
cues.zh: 這就是個簡單的方法解決塞車 讓人們改變行為

cues.text: perhaps by sharing this video to show how and why traffic happens, why tailgaters are trouble, and how we can work together to make the roads better for all.
cues.en: perhaps by sharing this video to show how and why traffic happens, why tailgaters are trouble, and how we can work together to make the roads better for all.
cues.zh: 分享這個影片也有幫助 解釋塞車如何發生 為什麼跟車太近會造成問題 而且我們要如何做 可以讓交通環境更好

cues.text: The End.
cues.en: The End.
cues.zh: 以上

cues.text: Except, yeah...
cues.en: Except, yeah...
cues.zh: 嗯，除了...

cues.text: wishing upon a star that people are better than they are is a terrible solution.
cues.en: wishing upon a star that people are better than they are is a terrible solution.
cues.zh: 向星星許願 希望人們變得更好

cues.text: Every time.
cues.en: Every time.
cues.zh: 是不切實際的 反之 真正有效的方法是 結構性地系統性解決方案

cues.text: Instead, what works is a structurally systematized solution which is exactly what self-driving cars are.
cues.en: Instead, what works is a structurally systematized solution which is exactly what self-driving cars are.
cues.zh: 是不切實際的 反之 真正有效的方法是 結構性地系統性解決方案 這就是為什麼我們需要自動駕駛 自動駕駛可以被設計成

cues.text: Self-driving cars can just be programmed to stay in the middle and accelerate simultaneously.
cues.en: Self-driving cars can just be programmed to stay in the middle and accelerate simultaneously.
cues.zh: 自動駕駛可以被設計成 保持在前後車中間 且同時加速

cues.text: They'll just do it.
cues.en: They'll just do it.
cues.zh: 這樣就可以了 路口有越多自動駕駛 就越有效率

cues.text: The more self-driving cars at an intersection, the more efficient the intersection gets.
cues.en: The more self-driving cars at an intersection, the more efficient the intersection gets.
cues.zh: 這樣就可以了 路口有越多自動駕駛 就越有效率

cues.text: A solid lane of self-driving cars vastly increases throughput.
cues.en: A solid lane of self-driving cars vastly increases throughput.
cues.zh: 只有自動駕駛的車道 會大幅增加車流量

cues.text: Hmm, actually!
cues.en: Hmm, actually!
cues.zh: 事實上

cues.en: If you ban humans from the road you can get rid of the intersection entirely.
cues.zh: 如果禁止人類駕駛 （我們早該這麼做了） 你可以完全消除十字路口造成的影響

cues.text: After all, a traffic light is just a tool for drivers on one road to communicate with drivers
cues.en: After all, a traffic light is just a tool for drivers on one road to communicate with drivers
cues.zh: 畢竟 紅綠燈只是駕駛們溝通的工具 既拙劣又簡陋

cues.text: on another, poorly and coarsely.
cues.en: on another, poorly and coarsely.
cues.zh: 既拙劣又簡陋

cues.text: Red equals "Don't go now, we are coming through the intersection." Green equals "good to go."
cues.en: Red equals "Don't go now, we are coming through the intersection." Green equals "good to go."

cues.text: But self-driving cars can talk to each other at the speed of light.
cues.en: But self-driving cars can talk to each other at the speed of light.
cues.zh: 但自動駕駛可以用光速溝通

cues.en: with that kind of coordination, no traffic light necessary.
cues.zh: 有這樣的協調機制 就不需要交通號誌了

cues.text: Just as with the highway, the best intersection is no intersection.
cues.en: Just as with the highway, the best intersection is no intersection.

cues.text: Humans will never drive this precisely.
cues.en: Humans will never drive this precisely.
cues.zh: 人類永遠不可能如此精準地駕駛

cues.text: At the intersection, the fundamental problem with traffic that you watch unfold, as well as everything, is people.
cues.en: At the intersection, the fundamental problem with traffic that you watch unfold, as well as everything, is people.
cues.zh: 交通的癥結點 也是所有問題的癥結點 「人類」

cues.text: So the real simple solution to traffic: is no more monkeys driving cars.
cues.en: So the real simple solution to traffic: is no more monkeys driving cars.
cues.zh: 所以交通問題的根本解藥是 別再讓人類開車了

HxkHu4kdEeg.title: How Warren Buffett Changed Investing Forever
HxkHu4kdEeg.speaker: Bloomberg Originals

cues.text: People from all over the planet, look up to him, read his biography, hop on a plane to go see him talk.
cues.en: People from all over the planet, look up to him, read his biography, hop on a plane to go see him talk.
cues.zh: 來自世界各地的人們尊敬他，閱讀他的傳記，跳上飛機去看他演講。

cues.text: He took a failing textile mill and turned it into a trillion dollar conglomerate.
cues.en: He took a failing textile mill and turned it into a trillion dollar conglomerate.
cues.zh: 他接管了一家瀕臨破產的紡織廠，並將其變成了價值數萬億美元的企業集團。

cues.text: It has insurance companies, Dairy Queen, railroads and energy businesses.
cues.en: It has insurance companies, Dairy Queen, railroads and energy businesses.
cues.zh: 它擁有保險公司、冰雪皇后、鐵路和能源業務。

cues.text: For decades, Buffett's investment savvy has led Berkshire Hathaway to beat benchmarks.
cues.en: For decades, Buffett's investment savvy has led Berkshire Hathaway to beat benchmarks.
cues.zh: 幾十年來，巴菲特的投資頭腦帶領波克夏海瑟威超越了基準。

cues.text: One of the biggest asset managers today, which is Vanguard.
cues.en: One of the biggest asset managers today, which is Vanguard.
cues.zh: 先鋒集團是當今最大的資產管理公司之一。

cues.text: The entire philosophy is: no one's really gonna be able to beat the market.
cues.en: The entire philosophy is: no one's really gonna be able to beat the market.
cues.zh: 整個哲學是：沒有人能夠真正打敗市場。

cues.text: So you might as well not even try.
cues.en: So you might as well not even try.
cues.zh: 所以你最好還是不要嘗試。

cues.text: Well, okay, no one besides Warren Buffett.
cues.en: Well, okay, no one besides Warren Buffett.
cues.zh: 好吧，除了華倫巴菲特之外沒有人。

cues.text: If you look at the total returns, Berkshire blows the S&P 500 away.
cues.en: If you look at the total returns, Berkshire blows the S&P 500 away.

cues.en: So when the 95-year-old announced he would retire at the end of 2025...
