cues.en: Have a good opening line, such as, let me tell you about a time I rescued the organization,
cues.zh: 有一個好的開場白，例如，讓我告訴你我拯救該組織的一次經歷，

cues.text: then tell them about any obstacles or issues that arose and how you overcame them.
cues.en: then tell them about any obstacles or issues that arose and how you overcame them.
cues.zh: 然後告訴他們出現的任何障礙或問題以及您如何克服它們。

cues.text: Keep the story short but interesting and impactful.
cues.en: Keep the story short but interesting and impactful.
cues.zh: 故事要簡短，但有趣且有影響力。

cues.text: An important note-- not all stories have to show total perfection.
cues.en: An important note-- not all stories have to show total perfection.
cues.zh: 重要的一點是──並非所有的故事都必須表現出完美。

cues.text: You will make a real impression and seem more relatable if you can share stories of challenges and even mistakes,
cues.en: You will make a real impression and seem more relatable if you can share stories of challenges and even mistakes,
cues.zh: 如果您能夠分享挑戰甚至錯誤的故事，您會給人留下真實的印象，並且看起來更容易產生共鳴，

cues.text: as long as you remember to show what you learned from them.
cues.en: as long as you remember to show what you learned from them.
cues.zh: 只要你記得展示你從他們身上學到了什麼。

cues.text: Practice, practice-- Once you select your stories, you need to rehearse.
cues.en: Practice, practice-- Once you select your stories, you need to rehearse.
cues.zh: 練習，練習－一旦你選擇了你的故事，你就需要排練。

cues.text: Just like an actor prepares for the stage or screen, you are preparing a character, a confident, competent, likable,
cues.en: Just like an actor prepares for the stage or screen, you are preparing a character, a confident, competent, likable,
cues.zh: 就像演員為舞臺或銀幕做準備一樣，你也在準備一個角色，一個自信、有能力、討人喜歡、

cues.text: flexible version of yourself to perform in the interview.
cues.en: flexible version of yourself to perform in the interview.
cues.zh: 在面試中展現自己的靈活版本。

cues.text: I'm not saying you should be inauthentic or overexaggerate your experiences or skills.
cues.en: I'm not saying you should be inauthentic or overexaggerate your experiences or skills.
cues.zh: 我並不是說你應該不真實或過度誇大你的經驗或技能。

cues.text: But author and coach Cathy Salit writes, "You are literally auditioning for a new role."
cues.en: But author and coach Cathy Salit writes, "You are literally auditioning for a new role."
cues.zh: 但作家兼教練凱西·薩利特寫道：“你實際上是在試鏡一個新角色。”

cues.text: You are presenting the best possible version of yourself.
cues.en: You are presenting the best possible version of yourself.
cues.zh: 您正在展示自己最好的版本。

cues.text: And since you've done your homework, you know what parts of your personality and experience
cues.en: And since you've done your homework, you know what parts of your personality and experience
cues.zh: 既然你已經做了功課，你就知道你的個性和經歷的哪些部分

cues.text: to emphasize for each position.
cues.en: to emphasize for each position.
cues.zh: 強調每個位置。

cues.text: So what exactly should you practice?
cues.en: So what exactly should you practice?
cues.zh: 那麼具體該練習什麼呢？

cues.text: Well, for one, practice your opening.
cues.en: Well, for one, practice your opening.
cues.zh: 嗯，一方面，練習你的開場白。

cues.text: First impressions really matter here.
cues.en: First impressions really matter here.
cues.zh: 第一印像在這裡真的很重要。

cues.text: In fact, research shows that people form opinions about your personality and intelligence
cues.en: In fact, research shows that people form opinions about your personality and intelligence
cues.zh: 事實上，研究顯示人們會對你的個性和智力形成看法

cues.text: in the first 30 seconds of the interview, 30 seconds.
cues.en: in the first 30 seconds of the interview, 30 seconds.
cues.zh: 訪談的前30秒，30秒。

cues.text: So in front of a mirror, pretend you are introducing yourself and assess things like your posture, tone,
cues.en: So in front of a mirror, pretend you are introducing yourself and assess things like your posture, tone,
cues.zh: 因此，在鏡子前，假裝您正在自我介紹，並評估您的姿勢、語氣、

cues.text: and body language.
cues.en: and body language.
cues.zh: 和肢體語言。

cues.text: You want to communicate a balance of ease, clarity, and confidence.
cues.en: You want to communicate a balance of ease, clarity, and confidence.
cues.zh: 您希望傳達輕鬆、清晰和自信的平衡。

cues.text: The most important thing is to practice telling your stories with energy and enthusiasm.
cues.en: The most important thing is to practice telling your stories with energy and enthusiasm.
cues.zh: 最重要的是練習充滿活力和熱情地講述你的故事。

cues.text: You want to be ready to share them as confident, clear, and straightforward responses to relevant interview questions.
cues.en: You want to be ready to share them as confident, clear, and straightforward responses to relevant interview questions.
cues.zh: 您希望準備好將它們作為對相關面試問題的自信、清晰和直接的回答來分享。

cues.text: You can even practice in front of a friend or record yourself on video.
cues.en: You can even practice in front of a friend or record yourself on video.
cues.zh: 您甚至可以在朋友面前練習或將自己錄製成影片。

cues.text: You can then use the feedback to make any necessary adjustments to your appearance or your delivery
cues.en: You can then use the feedback to make any necessary adjustments to your appearance or your delivery

cues.text: before the actual interview.
cues.en: before the actual interview.
cues.zh: 在實際面試之前。

cues.text: Have a great conversation.
cues.en: Have a great conversation.
cues.zh: 愉快地交談。

cues.text: Once you're comfortable telling your stories, Cathy Salit has another unique piece of advice.
cues.en: Once you're comfortable telling your stories, Cathy Salit has another unique piece of advice.
cues.zh: 一旦您能夠輕鬆地講述自己的故事，Cathy Salit 就會給出另一個獨特的建議。

cues.text: Instead of performing as someone who is trying really hard to get the job, perform as someone who wants to have
cues.en: Instead of performing as someone who is trying really hard to get the job, perform as someone who wants to have
cues.zh: 不要表現得像一個非常努力地想要得到這份工作的人，而要表現得像一個想要得到這份工作的人

cues.text: a great conversation with the person across from you.
cues.en: a great conversation with the person across from you.
cues.zh: 與你對面的人進行一次愉快的交談。

cues.text: First, be curious or at least perform curiosity
cues.en: First, be curious or at least perform curiosity
cues.zh: 首先，保持好奇心或至少表現出好奇心

cues.text: if you need to.
cues.en: if you need to.
cues.zh: 如果你需要的話。

cues.text: Ask open-ended questions connected to what you've heard.
cues.en: Ask open-ended questions connected to what you've heard.
cues.zh: 提出與您所聽到的內容相關的開放式問題。

cues.text: This will allow the conversation to unfold more naturally.
cues.en: This will allow the conversation to unfold more naturally.
cues.zh: 這將使對話更加自然地展開。

cues.text: Side note, if you need some ideas, check out the links for another HBR video on 38 smart questions
cues.en: Side note, if you need some ideas, check out the links for another HBR video on 38 smart questions

cues.text: to ask in an interview.
cues.en: to ask in an interview.
cues.zh: 在訪談中詢問。

cues.text: Be ready to improvise.
cues.en: Be ready to improvise.
cues.zh: 準備好即興發揮。

cues.text: I know I've just told you to prepare and rehearse your stories, but they aren't just talking points
cues.en: I know I've just told you to prepare and rehearse your stories, but they aren't just talking points
cues.zh: 我知道我剛剛告訴你要準備並排練你的故事，但它們不僅僅是談話要點

cues.text: to be rattled off.
cues.en: to be rattled off.
cues.zh: 被喋喋不休。

cues.text: You also need to listen attentively and be ready to accept every conversational opening with the classic improv
cues.en: You also need to listen attentively and be ready to accept every conversational opening with the classic improv
cues.zh: 您還需要專心聆聽，並準備好接受每個對話開頭以及經典的即興表演

cues.text: phrase, "yes, and" as a way to build upon the conversation.
cues.en: phrase, "yes, and" as a way to build upon the conversation.
cues.zh: 短語“是的，並且”作為對話的一種方式。

cues.text: Also, as author John Lees reminds us, be flexible, read the room, and adjust accordingly.
cues.en: Also, as author John Lees reminds us, be flexible, read the room, and adjust accordingly.
cues.zh: 此外，正如作者約翰·利斯（John Lees）提醒我們的那樣，要靈活，閱讀房間，並做出相應的調整。

cues.text: If your radar is telling you that your stories aren't working, you may need to supply different answers,
cues.en: If your radar is telling you that your stories aren't working, you may need to supply different answers,
cues.zh: 如果你的雷達告訴你你的故事不起作用，你可能需要提供不同的答案，

cues.text: adjust your tone, or stop speaking altogether because, well, some interviewers just love
cues.en: adjust your tone, or stop speaking altogether because, well, some interviewers just love
cues.zh: 調整你的語氣，或乾脆停止說話，因為有些面試官就是喜歡

cues.text: to hear themselves talk.
cues.en: to hear themselves talk.
cues.zh: 聽自己說話。

cues.text: Pay attention and change course as needed.
cues.en: Pay attention and change course as needed.
cues.zh: 注意並根據需要改變路線。

cues.text: When things go wrong-- despite your best efforts to prepare,
cues.en: When things go wrong-- despite your best efforts to prepare,
cues.zh: 當事情出錯時——儘管你盡了最大努力做好準備，

cues.text: interviews don't always go as planned.
cues.en: interviews don't always go as planned.
cues.zh: 面試並不總是按計劃進行。

cues.text: Here are some potential pitfalls and what you can do about them.
cues.en: Here are some potential pitfalls and what you can do about them.
cues.zh: 以下是一些潛在的陷阱以及您可以採取的措施。

cues.text: Lack of direct experience-- If there are areas where your past achievements don't directly
cues.en: Lack of direct experience-- If there are areas where your past achievements don't directly
cues.zh: 缺乏直接經驗－如果有些領域與你過去的成就不直接相關

cues.text: correlate to the job, redirect the focus away from where your experience might
cues.en: correlate to the job, redirect the focus away from where your experience might
cues.zh: 與工作相關，將注意力從你的經驗可能的地方轉移開

cues.text: fall short and towards an emphasis on your potential and overall competence.
cues.en: fall short and towards an emphasis on your potential and overall competence.
cues.zh: 不足並強調您的潛力和整體能力。

cues.text: If you can demonstrate your ability to learn a skill or adapt to a situation, this could convince an interviewer
cues.en: If you can demonstrate your ability to learn a skill or adapt to a situation, this could convince an interviewer
cues.zh: 如果您能夠展現自己學習技能或適應情況的能力，這可以說服面試官

cues.text: to ignore any potential holes in your CV.
cues.en: to ignore any potential holes in your CV.
cues.zh: 忽略履歷中任何潛在的漏洞。

cues.text: One side note-- taking charge of the interview in this way can help steer interviewers away from unconscious biases
cues.en: One side note-- taking charge of the interview in this way can help steer interviewers away from unconscious biases

cues.text: that favor experience over competence.
cues.en: that favor experience over competence.
cues.zh: 優先考慮經驗而不是能力。

cues.text: Tough questions about your resume-- If there are some less-than-perfect situations
cues.en: Tough questions about your resume-- If there are some less-than-perfect situations
cues.zh: 關於你的履歷的棘手問題——如果有一些不太完美的情況

cues.text: on your CV, like a long pause in your work history or a short stay at a recent job, John Lees
cues.en: on your CV, like a long pause in your work history or a short stay at a recent job, John Lees
cues.zh: 在你的履歷中，例如你的工作經驗中的長時間停頓或在最近的工作中短暫停留，John Lees

cues.text: recommends preparing multiple ways to reply so that you aren't left struggling for an answer.
cues.en: recommends preparing multiple ways to reply so that you aren't left struggling for an answer.
cues.zh: 建議準備多種回覆方式，這樣您就不會苦苦尋找答案。

cues.text: First, prepare a simple, straightforward response that doesn't go into too much detail.
cues.en: First, prepare a simple, straightforward response that doesn't go into too much detail.
cues.zh: 首先，準備一個簡單、直接的答覆，不要涉及太多細節。

cues.text: Then have an additional reply ready if the interviewer follows up.
cues.en: Then have an additional reply ready if the interviewer follows up.
cues.zh: 如果面試官跟進，請準備好額外的答案。

cues.text: For example, if you didn't finish a degree that would have been helpful to the job,
cues.en: For example, if you didn't finish a degree that would have been helpful to the job,
cues.zh: 例如，如果你沒有完成對工作有幫助的學位，

cues.text: be ready to answer an initial question with something like, I felt it was better to go straight into the workforce.
cues.en: be ready to answer an initial question with something like, I felt it was better to go straight into the workforce.
cues.zh: 準備好回答最初的問題，例如「我覺得最好直接進入勞動市場」。

cues.text: If the interviewer pushes further, be ready with another level of detail, such as I
cues.en: If the interviewer pushes further, be ready with another level of detail, such as I
cues.zh: 如果面試官進一步提出要求，請準備好另一個層次的細節，例如我

cues.text: thought about it carefully.
cues.en: thought about it carefully.
cues.zh: 仔細想了一下。

cues.text: I knew it would carry negative connotations, but I was confident that I would learn a lot more
cues.en: I knew it would carry negative connotations, but I was confident that I would learn a lot more
cues.zh: 我知道它會帶有負面意義，但我有信心我會學到更多

cues.text: with direct work experience.
cues.en: with direct work experience.
cues.zh: 具有直接工作經驗。

cues.text: Mistakes happen.
cues.en: Mistakes happen.
cues.zh: 錯誤會發生。

cues.text: If you notice your interviewer losing interest or you've stumbled over some answers,
cues.en: If you notice your interviewer losing interest or you've stumbled over some answers,
cues.zh: 如果您發現面試官失去了興趣或您偶然發現了一些答案，

cues.text: don't dwell on the mistakes.
cues.en: don't dwell on the mistakes.
cues.zh: 不要糾纏於錯誤。

cues.text: Just keep going and stay focused.
cues.en: Just keep going and stay focused.
cues.zh: 繼續前進並保持專注。

cues.text: Answer the current question as if it's the first one.
cues.en: Answer the current question as if it's the first one.
cues.zh: 像回答第一個問題一樣回答當前問題。

cues.text: Even acknowledging the situation with a corrective statement like, am I giving you what you need,
cues.en: Even acknowledging the situation with a corrective statement like, am I giving you what you need,
cues.zh: 即使透過糾正性宣告來承認這種情況，例如，我是否給了你你需要的東西，

cues.text: is there other information I could give you, and then following their cues can help dig you out
cues.en: is there other information I could give you, and then following their cues can help dig you out
cues.zh: 我可以向您提供其他資訊嗎？然後按照他們的提示可以幫助您找到答案

cues.text: of the current hole and get the conversation back on track.
cues.en: of the current hole and get the conversation back on track.
cues.zh: 當前的漏洞並使對話回到正軌。

cues.text: A note on preparing virtual interviews-- Many interviews these days take place virtually.
cues.en: A note on preparing virtual interviews-- Many interviews these days take place virtually.
cues.zh: 關於準備虛擬面試的注意事項—如今許多面試都是虛擬進行的。

cues.text: If that's the case for you, here are some specific things you should do to prepare.
cues.en: If that's the case for you, here are some specific things you should do to prepare.
cues.zh: 如果您屬於這種情況，那麼您應該做以下一些具體準備。

cues.text: First, prepare your space.
cues.en: First, prepare your space.
cues.zh: 首先，準備好你的空間。

cues.text: You want your background to be clean and uncluttered.
cues.en: You want your background to be clean and uncluttered.
cues.zh: 您希望您的背景乾淨整潔。

cues.text: Clean up the area around you, too, even if it's not visible on camera.
cues.en: Clean up the area around you, too, even if it's not visible on camera.
cues.zh: 即使在相機上看不到，也要清理周圍的區域。

cues.text: Research shows that when our space is messy, so is our thinking.
cues.en: Research shows that when our space is messy, so is our thinking.
cues.zh: 研究表明，當我們的空間混亂時，我們的思維也會混亂。

cues.text: A clean environment will boost your mood and make you feel less stressed.
cues.en: A clean environment will boost your mood and make you feel less stressed.
cues.zh: 乾淨的環境會提振你的心情，減輕你的壓力。

cues.text: These are things your interviewer can see, and it will make a big difference in your performance.
cues.en: These are things your interviewer can see, and it will make a big difference in your performance.
cues.zh: 這些是你的面試官可以看到的東西，這將對你的表現產生很大的影響。

cues.text: Your face should be well lit and visible.
cues.en: Your face should be well lit and visible.
cues.zh: 您的臉應該光線充足且清晰可見。

cues.text: Make sure your internet speed is in good shape.
cues.en: Make sure your internet speed is in good shape.
cues.zh: 確保您的網路速度良好。

cues.text: Pro tip, Google internet speed test and check to make sure the Wi-Fi you are using
cues.en: Pro tip, Google internet speed test and check to make sure the Wi-Fi you are using
cues.zh: 專業提示，Google 網路速度測試並檢查以確保您正在使用的 Wi-Fi

cues.text: can handle the call.
cues.en: can handle the call.
cues.zh: 可以處理呼叫。

cues.text: Next, prepare yourself.
cues.en: Next, prepare yourself.
cues.zh: 接下來，做好準備。

cues.text: Even though it's virtual, you should dress for the interview.
cues.en: Even though it's virtual, you should dress for the interview.
cues.zh: 儘管是虛擬的，但您還是應該穿著參加面試。

cues.text: Unless the organization is an all-suit situation, experts recommend a business casual outfit in neutral colors
cues.en: Unless the organization is an all-suit situation, experts recommend a business casual outfit in neutral colors
cues.zh: 除非組織是全西裝場合，否則專家建議穿著中性色調的商務休閒服裝

cues.text: to appear more authentic, trustworthy, creative, and knowledgeable.
cues.en: to appear more authentic, trustworthy, creative, and knowledgeable.
cues.zh: 顯得更加真實、值得信賴、富有創造力和知識淵博。

cues.text: Wear something comfortable.
cues.en: Wear something comfortable.
cues.zh: 穿一些舒服的衣服。

cues.text: You don't want to be fidgeting with your clothes while on camera.
cues.en: You don't want to be fidgeting with your clothes while on camera.
cues.zh: 您不想在鏡頭前擺弄自己的衣服。

cues.text: Use your computer's camera to check yourself and your space ahead of time so you
cues.en: Use your computer's camera to check yourself and your space ahead of time so you
cues.zh: 使用電腦的攝影機提前檢查您自己和您的空間，以便您

cues.text: can see what your interviewers will see and make any necessary tweaks.
cues.en: can see what your interviewers will see and make any necessary tweaks.
cues.zh: 可以看到面試官會看到什麼並做出必要的調整。

cues.text: OK, let's review.
cues.en: OK, let's review.
cues.zh: 好的，我們回顧一下。

cues.text: Here's a quick wrap-up of the do's and don'ts so you can stand out in your next interview.
cues.en: Here's a quick wrap-up of the do's and don'ts so you can stand out in your next interview.
cues.zh: 以下是該做什麼和不該做什麼的快速總結，以便您可以在下次面試中脫穎而出。

cues.text: All of these strategies are based on articles linked in the description.
cues.en: All of these strategies are based on articles linked in the description.
cues.zh: 所有這些策略都基於描述中連結的文章。

cues.text: Do you have any advice on how to stand out in an interview?
cues.en: Do you have any advice on how to stand out in an interview?
cues.zh: 您對如何在面試中脫穎而出有什麼建議嗎？

cues.text: Or do you have other big topics you'd like me to cover?
cues.en: Or do you have other big topics you'd like me to cover?
cues.zh: 或是您有其他重要主題希望我介紹嗎？

cues.text: Comment below.
cues.en: Comment below.
cues.zh: 請在下面評論。

cues.text: Bye for now.
cues.en: Bye for now.
cues.zh: 暫時再見。

1U8DzVfiAJc.title: How to Enhance Your Personal Brand
1U8DzVfiAJc.speaker: Forbes
1U8DzVfiAJc.zh: 【Forbes】如何提升您的個人品牌（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: I'm often asked by professionals, what are some steps that you can take today to enhance
cues.en: I'm often asked by professionals, what are some steps that you can take today to enhance
cues.zh: 專業人士經常問我，您今天可以採取哪些步驟來增強

cues.text: your personal brand?
cues.en: your personal brand?
cues.zh: 你的個人品牌？

cues.text: It's a cause of a lot of stress for people because you have to do your job.
cues.en: It's a cause of a lot of stress for people because you have to do your job.

cues.en: allows us to operate a very efficient operation and that creates a lot of value.

9XCKnN6o19k.title: Why China's Shein is beating ASOS, H&M and Zara at fast fashion
9XCKnN6o19k.speaker: CNBC International

cues.text: Fashion has had to constantly evolve.
cues.en: Fashion has had to constantly evolve.
cues.zh: 時尚必須不斷發展。

cues.text: But the industry radically changed in the 1990s when brands like Zara, H&M and Topshop led the way with what we now know as fast fashion.
cues.en: But the industry radically changed in the 1990s when brands like Zara, H&M and Topshop led the way with what we now know as fast fashion.
cues.zh: 但這個產業在 20 世紀 90 年代發生了根本性的變化，Zara、H&M 和 Topshop 等品牌引領了我們現在所說的快時尚的潮流。

cues.text: They mastered the process of taking expensive clothes that were on the catwalk
cues.en: They mastered the process of taking expensive clothes that were on the catwalk
cues.zh: 他們掌握了在T臺上挑選昂貴衣服的過程

cues.text: and mass producing them in as little as three weeks.
cues.en: and mass producing them in as little as three weeks.
cues.zh: 並在短短三週內批次生產它們。

cues.text: Fashion had never been this cheap and accessible before.
cues.en: Fashion had never been this cheap and accessible before.
cues.zh: 時尚從未如此廉價和觸手可及。

cues.text: Then, at the turn of the century online-only giants like Asos and Boohoo
cues.en: Then, at the turn of the century online-only giants like Asos and Boohoo
cues.zh: 然後，在世紀之交出現了像 Asos 和 Boohoo 這樣的純線上巨頭

cues.text: took this model to the next level, shortening production time to as little as a week.
cues.en: took this model to the next level, shortening production time to as little as a week.
cues.zh: 將該模型提升到了一個新的水平，將生產時間縮短至短短一週。

cues.text: Industry experts call these online-only brands, ultra fast fashion.
cues.en: Industry experts call these online-only brands, ultra fast fashion.
cues.zh: 行業專家將這些僅線上品牌稱為“超快時尚”。

cues.text: And now we're in a new era: Real-time retail.
cues.en: And now we're in a new era: Real-time retail.
cues.zh: 現在我們正處於一個新時代：即時零售。

cues.text: Companies disrupting the status quo produce clothes in as little as three days.
cues.en: Companies disrupting the status quo produce clothes in as little as three days.
cues.zh: 打破現狀的公司只需三天就能生產衣服。

cues.zh: 而這個時代的領導者呢？嗯，這是一家中國公司，名叫Shein。

cues.en: Shein launches around three to four thousand new female apparel products every day so it is

cues.en: a very huge amount and the product is at pretty low price ranging from two dollars USD to $30.

cues.text: much more frequently and at a higher volume than any other fast fashion brand.

cues.zh: 一小瓶藥10英鎊！

cues.text: It’s worth it. Listen, if you won’t cough up, I’ll give you the £10 back if you promise to buy it.
cues.en: It’s worth it. Listen, if you won’t cough up, I’ll give you the £10 back if you promise to buy it.
cues.zh: 這是值得的。聽著，如果你不肯付錢，如果你答應買的話我就還給你 10 英鎊。

cues.text: That’s very kind.
cues.en: That’s very kind.
cues.zh: 這非常友善。

cues.text: Not a problem.
cues.en: Not a problem.
cues.zh: 不是問題。

cues.text: And while you go to the pharmacy, I’m going to practise presenting the
cues.en: And while you go to the pharmacy, I’m going to practise presenting the
cues.zh: 當你去藥局時，我將練習展示

cues.text: programme standing on my head.
cues.en: programme standing on my head.
cues.zh: 程式站在我的頭上。

cues.text: It’s good for blood circulation, apparently.
cues.en: It’s good for blood circulation, apparently.
cues.zh: 顯然，這對血液迴圈有好處。

cues.text: Standing on your head is one thing, but presenting a whole programme? No way.
cues.en: Standing on your head is one thing, but presenting a whole programme? No way.
cues.zh: 倒立是一回事，但是呈現一個完整的方案呢？決不。

cues.text: Are you sure! £10 says I can!
cues.en: Are you sure! £10 says I can!
cues.zh: 你確定嗎！ 10 英鎊說我可以！

cues.text: Haha. OK then. Bye.
cues.en: Haha. OK then. Bye.
cues.zh: 哈哈。那麼好吧。再見。

cues.text: Bye.
cues.en: Bye.
cues.zh: 再見。

cues.text: Hello and welcome to The English We Speak.
cues.en: Hello and welcome to The English We Speak.
cues.zh: 您好，歡迎來到我們說的英語。

cues.text: I'm Neil and… Erm, hi everyone. Erm, I’m Feifei and I've just …
cues.en: I'm Neil and… Erm, hi everyone. Erm, I’m Feifei and I've just …
cues.zh: 我是尼爾，…呃，大家好。呃，我是菲菲，我剛剛…

cues.text: Err… well… Feifei is here with me… Feifei, what's going on?
cues.en: Err… well… Feifei is here with me… Feifei, what's going on?
cues.zh: 呃……呃……菲菲在我身邊……菲菲，怎麼了？

cues.text: Um, yes, and today we are here, with you,
cues.en: Um, yes, and today we are here, with you,
cues.zh: 嗯，是的，今天我們在這裡，和你在一起，

cues.text: dear learners of the wonderful English language… What are you looking for?
cues.en: dear learners of the wonderful English language… What are you looking for?
cues.zh: 親愛的美妙英語學習者…您在尋找什麼？

cues.text: The script, Neil. I misplaced it somewhere… Just wing it!
cues.en: The script, Neil. I misplaced it somewhere… Just wing it!
cues.zh: 劇本，尼爾.我把它放錯地方了…就用它吧！

cues.text: Wing it? Wing, like a bird?
cues.en: Wing it? Wing, like a bird?
cues.zh: 翼它？翅膀，像鳥嗎？

cues.text: Yes, the air is fresh and I flap my wings…
cues.en: Yes, the air is fresh and I flap my wings…
cues.zh: 是的，空氣很新鮮，我拍打著翅膀…

cues.text: What are you doing? What are you doing?
cues.en: What are you doing? What are you doing?
cues.zh: 你在做什麼？你在幹什麼？

cues.text: You told me to pretend I was a bird.
cues.en: You told me to pretend I was a bird.
cues.zh: 你讓我假裝自己是一隻鳥。

cues.text: Or to tell the story of a bird or… I know lots of bird jokes.
cues.en: Or to tell the story of a bird or… I know lots of bird jokes.
cues.zh: 或講述一隻鳥的故事或…我知道很多關於鳥的笑話。

cues.text: No, that's not it.
cues.en: No, that's not it.
cues.zh: 不，不是這樣的。

cues.text: In English 'to wing' something means to improvise.
cues.en: In English 'to wing' something means to improvise.
cues.zh: 在英語中，「to wing」的意思是即興創作。

cues.text: This informal expression is thought to come from the theatre and it refers to performances
cues.en: This informal expression is thought to come from the theatre and it refers to performances
cues.zh: 這種非正式的表達被認為是來自劇院，指的是表演

cues.text: given by actors who had to learn their lines quickly while waiting in the wings.
cues.en: given by actors who had to learn their lines quickly while waiting in the wings.
cues.zh: 演員們在等待時必須快速記住臺詞。

cues.text: Ah! The wings are the space on each side of the stage, where actors wait
cues.en: Ah! The wings are the space on each side of the stage, where actors wait
cues.zh: 啊!側翼是舞臺兩側的空間，演員在此等候

cues.text: before coming onto the stage.
cues.en: before coming onto the stage.
cues.zh: 在上臺之前。

cues.text: Sometimes someone gives them their lines from there as support.
cues.en: Sometimes someone gives them their lines from there as support.
cues.zh: 有時有人會從那裡給他們臺詞作為支援。

cues.text: That's right. Let's hear how this expression is used.
cues.en: That's right. Let's hear how this expression is used.
cues.zh: 這是正確的。我們來聽聽這個表達方式是如何使用的。

cues.text: Mary spent all weekend partying instead of studying.
cues.en: Mary spent all weekend partying instead of studying.
cues.zh: 瑪麗整個週末都在聚會而不是學習。

cues.text: When I asked her why she wasn't concerned about the exam, she told me she'd just wing it.
cues.en: When I asked her why she wasn't concerned about the exam, she told me she'd just wing it.
cues.zh: 當我問她為什麼不關心考試時，她告訴我她只是即興發揮。

cues.text: The minister is a great orator.
cues.en: The minister is a great orator.
cues.zh: 部長是一位偉大的演說家。

cues.text: He's never had a speech ready, he just wings it and people love it.
cues.en: He's never had a speech ready, he just wings it and people love it.
cues.zh: 他從來沒有準備好演講，他只是即興發揮，人們喜歡他。

cues.text: So a theatrical expression for you.
cues.en: So a theatrical expression for you.
cues.zh: 所以給你一個戲劇性的表達。

cues.text: Now Feifei, do you know lots of jokes about birds? Tell me one.
cues.en: Now Feifei, do you know lots of jokes about birds? Tell me one.
cues.zh: 現在菲菲，你知道很多關於鳥的笑話嗎？告訴我一個。

cues.text: Why did the little bird get in trouble at school?
cues.en: Why did the little bird get in trouble at school?
cues.zh: 小鳥為什麼在學校遇到麻煩？

cues.text: Mmmm… no idea… Because he was caught tweeting during the test.
cues.en: Mmmm… no idea… Because he was caught tweeting during the test.
cues.zh: 嗯……不知道……因為他在測試期間發推文被抓到。

cues.text: Yes, very funny… Bye.
cues.en: Yes, very funny… Bye.
cues.zh: 是的，非常有趣……再見。

cues.text: Hi everyone, we hope you enjoyed that video and thank you very much for watching.
cues.en: Hi everyone, we hope you enjoyed that video and thank you very much for watching.
cues.zh: 大家好，我們希望您喜歡該影片，非常感謝您的觀看。

cues.text: We have so many more just like it so if you don't want to miss a single one,
cues.en: We have so many more just like it so if you don't want to miss a single one,
cues.zh: 我們還有很多類似的，所以如果你不想錯過任何一個，

cues.text: make sure to subscribe and we will see you regularly.
cues.en: make sure to subscribe and we will see you regularly.
cues.zh: 請務必訂閱，我們會定期見到您。

cues.text: Hope to see you soon. Bye guys!
cues.en: Hope to see you soon. Bye guys!
cues.zh: 希望很快能見到你。再見，夥計們！

wY2zyhDgeto.title: Learn To Think In English | Speak Clearly & Naturally
wY2zyhDgeto.speaker: mmmEnglish
wY2zyhDgeto.zh: 【mmmEnglish】學會用英語思考|說話清晰自然（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Learning to think in English will make you more confident speaking English
cues.en: Learning to think in English will make you more confident speaking English
cues.zh: 學習以英文思考會讓你講英語更有自信

cues.text: because you'll speak more naturally and fluently with less hesitation.
cues.en: because you'll speak more naturally and fluently with less hesitation.
cues.zh: 因為這樣你會講得更自然流利不猶豫

cues.text: I can already hear you saying "But Emma, I need to think in my native language to
cues.en: I can already hear you saying "But Emma, I need to think in my native language to
cues.zh: 我知道你一定會說， 但是Emma，我需要以母語思考然後翻譯成英語

cues.text: translate! It's too hard, I don't know enough vocabulary to do it!"
cues.en: translate! It's too hard, I don't know enough vocabulary to do it!"
cues.zh: 但是Emma，我需要以母語思考然後翻譯成英語 這太難了！我的字彙量不足以這麼做

cues.text: But listen, that is the long, slow and painful road to English fluency. When you do this, your
cues.en: But listen, that is the long, slow and painful road to English fluency. When you do this, your
cues.zh: 聽好了，試圖以那樣的方式達到英語流利， 是條既漫長又痛苦的的路 當你那麼做，你的英語聽起來就不自然

cues.text: English sounds unnatural because the sentence structure is different in your
cues.en: English sounds unnatural because the sentence structure is different in your
cues.zh: 當你那麼做，你的英語聽起來就不自然 因為你母語的文句結構不同

cues.text: language and it probably takes you a long time to say what you need to say
cues.en: language and it probably takes you a long time to say what you need to say
cues.zh: 因為你母語的文句結構不同 而且你大概會花滿多時間來說出你想表達的

cues.text: because you're translating in your head as you speak. We're going to learn a few
cues.en: because you're translating in your head as you speak. We're going to learn a few
cues.zh: 因為你一邊講話一邊在腦中翻譯 我們將學習幾個訓練大腦以英語思考的方法

cues.text: strategies to help train your brain to think in English.
cues.en: strategies to help train your brain to think in English.
cues.zh: 我們將學習幾個訓練大腦以英語思考的方法

cues.text: So start with very simple vocabulary. When you're at home, think about the English word for things
cues.en: So start with very simple vocabulary. When you're at home, think about the English word for things
cues.zh: 首先從簡單的字彙開始 你在家時，想想你身旁那些東西的英文單字：

cues.text: that you see around you. Shoes, flowers, desk, door.
cues.en: that you see around you. Shoes, flowers, desk, door.
cues.zh: 你在家時，想想你身旁那些東西的英文單字： shoes（鞋）, flowers（花）, desk（書桌）, door（門）

cues.text: When you're on the train or you're driving to work, look out the window and think of the English word for
cues.en: When you're on the train or you're driving to work, look out the window and think of the English word for
cues.zh: 你搭車或開車上班途中，從車窗往外看， 想想你看到的東西的英文單字：

cues.text: the things that you see. Dog, factory, busy, windy, people.
cues.en: the things that you see. Dog, factory, busy, windy, people.
cues.zh: 想想你看到的東西的英文單字： dog（狗）, factory（工廠）, busy（忙碌的）, windy（颳風的）, people（人們）

cues.text: In fact, we're going to try it right now!
cues.en: In fact, we're going to try it right now!
cues.zh: 我們現在立刻就來練習一下

cues.text: So, I want you to close your eyes, take a deep breath. Because when you
cues.en: So, I want you to close your eyes, take a deep breath. Because when you
cues.zh: 我要你閉上眼睛，深呼吸 當你睜開眼睛時你將看看身處的房間四周

cues.text: open your eyes you're going to look around the room in front of you
cues.en: open your eyes you're going to look around the room in front of you
cues.zh: 當你睜開眼睛時你將看看身處的房間四周

cues.text: and think in English - only in English - not in your native language. You're going to
cues.en: and think in English - only in English - not in your native language. You're going to
cues.zh: 並以英語思考，只用英語，而非你的母語 就用英語去想你在周遭看到的一切事物的英文，好嗎？

cues.text: think in English of the words for everything that you see around you.
cues.en: think in English of the words for everything that you see around you.
cues.zh: 就用英語去想你在周遭看到的一切事物的英文，好嗎？

cues.text: Okay, so take that deep breath again. And open your eyes and look around you.
cues.en: Okay, so take that deep breath again. And open your eyes and look around you.
cues.zh: 就用英語去想你在周遭看到的一切事物的英文，好嗎？ 現在再次深呼吸，睜開眼睛，看看四周

cues.text: Thinking of the English words only.
cues.en: Thinking of the English words only.
cues.zh: 心中只用英語單字去想

cues.text: Great! Now, if that was easy, we can move on to the next level. If it was hard
cues.en: Great! Now, if that was easy, we can move on to the next level. If it was hard
cues.zh: 好極了！若你覺得容易，那我們可進入下個階段 若你覺得困難，那也沒關係

cues.text: that's okay too! But you'll need to practise every day
cues.en: that's okay too! But you'll need to practise every day
cues.zh: 若你覺得困難，那也沒關係 不過你便需要每天在不同地方重複這個練習

cues.text: doing the same thing in different places - it will become easier. You're training
cues.en: doing the same thing in different places - it will become easier. You're training
cues.zh: 不過你便需要每天在不同地方重複這個練習 你就會覺得越來越容易了 你在訓練自己用英語去想

cues.text: yourself to think in English. So you can do it at home or at work, on the train or
cues.en: yourself to think in English. So you can do it at home or at work, on the train or
cues.zh: 你在訓練自己用英語去想 不論是在家、辦公室、通勤時 還是在咖啡聽等朋友時，都可進行練習

cues.text: when you're at the cafe waiting for a friend.
cues.en: when you're at the cafe waiting for a friend.
cues.zh: 還是在咖啡聽等朋友時，都可進行練習

cues.text: Then you can move on to simple sentences. For example, your hair's really long or what's he eating for lunch?
cues.en: Then you can move on to simple sentences. For example, your hair's really long or what's he eating for lunch?
cues.zh: 之後你便可以推進到簡單的句子 例如：（你的頭髮好長）或（他午餐在吃什麼？）

cues.text: Or that chair looks really uncomfortable.
cues.en: Or that chair looks really uncomfortable.
cues.zh: （那張椅子看起來真不舒服）

cues.text: So do the same thing now. I want you to look around the room and make three
cues.en: So do the same thing now. I want you to look around the room and make three
cues.zh: 現在進行剛才的練習，我要你望向房間四周 並就你所見造三個簡單的句子

cues.text: simple sentences about what you see. Remember, no translating! You're not
cues.en: simple sentences about what you see. Remember, no translating! You're not
cues.zh: 並就你所見造三個簡單的句子 注意！不許翻譯 不許用母語去想任何東西

cues.text: allowed to think in your native language at all. And if this is too difficult, go
cues.en: allowed to think in your native language at all. And if this is too difficult, go
cues.zh: 不許用母語去想任何東西 若覺得這樣太困難，就回復到字彙練習

cues.text: back to thinking of simple vocabulary words. Okay, so close your eyes,
cues.en: back to thinking of simple vocabulary words. Okay, so close your eyes,
cues.zh: 若覺得這樣太困難，就回復到字彙練習 好，眼睛閉上，深呼吸，開始

cues.text: take a deep breath, go.
cues.en: take a deep breath, go.
cues.zh: 好，眼睛閉上，深呼吸，開始

cues.text: Okay, if that was easy, you can move to the next level which is to plan your day
cues.en: Okay, if that was easy, you can move to the next level which is to plan your day
cues.zh: 若你覺得很容易，那你便可進入下個階段 用英語去想，用英語計劃你的一天

cues.text: in English - thinking in English. So when you wake up in the morning and you're
cues.en: in English - thinking in English. So when you wake up in the morning and you're
cues.zh: 用英語去想，用英語計劃你的一天 當你在早晨醒來還躺在床上時

cues.text: still lying in bed, think about everything that you need to
cues.en: still lying in bed, think about everything that you need to
cues.zh: 當你在早晨醒來還躺在床上時 用英語去想你當天要做的每一件事

cues.text: do that day - in English.
cues.en: do that day - in English.
cues.zh: 用英語去想你當天要做的每一件事

cues.text: After I eat breakfast I'll walk to the bus stop
cues.en: After I eat breakfast I'll walk to the bus stop
cues.zh: （吃完早餐後，我將走到公車站牌）

cues.text: and I'll catch the bus to work. On the bus, I'm going to read my book.
cues.en: and I'll catch the bus to work. On the bus, I'm going to read my book.
cues.zh: （並搭乘公車去工作） （在公車上我將讀我的書）

cues.text: I'm meeting Matilda for lunch today and I think we're going to get takeaway and eat it
cues.en: I'm meeting Matilda for lunch today and I think we're going to get takeaway and eat it
cues.zh: （今天我會與Matilda一起午餐） （我想我們會買外帶到公園用餐）

cues.text: in the park. It's going to be such a nice day.
cues.en: in the park. It's going to be such a nice day.
cues.zh: （今天我會與Matilda一起午餐） （我想我們會買外帶到公園用餐）

cues.text: So when thinking in English sentences and planning your day with simple sentences becomes easy, move on to
cues.en: So when thinking in English sentences and planning your day with simple sentences becomes easy, move on to
cues.zh: 當你覺得，用英語去想， 並用簡單語句計劃你的一天變容易了 就進到假想會話

cues.text: thinking in conversation. Now, this is great when you're sunbaking on the beach
cues.en: thinking in conversation. Now, this is great when you're sunbaking on the beach
cues.zh: 就進到假想會話 這麼做會很棒。當你在海灘做日光浴，

cues.text: or hiking up a mountain or you're in the shower getting ready for your day
cues.en: or hiking up a mountain or you're in the shower getting ready for your day
cues.zh: 或在登山健行，或在淋浴，為一天做準備 腦中有自己獨處的時間，沒有其他東西使你分心

cues.text: and you have some time alone in your head. So there's nothing to distract you!
cues.en: and you have some time alone in your head. So there's nothing to distract you!
cues.zh: 腦中有自己獨處的時間，沒有其他東西使你分心

cues.text: Now thinking in conversation is really great because you're asking the questions then
cues.en: Now thinking in conversation is really great because you're asking the questions then
cues.zh: 練習假想會話很棒，因為你不僅發問 也思考著問題的答案，還想著如何讓對話進行下去

cues.text: thinking of answers to those same questions and also ways to keep the
cues.en: thinking of answers to those same questions and also ways to keep the
cues.zh: 也思考著問題的答案，還想著如何讓對話進行下去

cues.text: conversation going, so it's really great conversation practice.
cues.en: conversation going, so it's really great conversation practice.
cues.zh: 也思考著問題的答案，還想著如何讓對話進行下去 所以是很好的對話練習 如果在腦中與自己講話聽起來怪怪的或很蠢......

cues.text: Now, if talking to yourself in your head sounds strange or silly...
cues.en: Now, if talking to yourself in your head sounds strange or silly...
cues.zh: 如果在腦中與自己講話聽起來怪怪的或很蠢......

cues.text: well I guess it probably is! Get one of your friends to help. And no, I don't mean
cues.en: well I guess it probably is! Get one of your friends to help. And no, I don't mean
cues.zh: 我想確實是有一點 那就叫你的朋友幫忙！ ㄟ不是，我不是指叫你朋友跟你一起淋浴

cues.text: ask one of your friends to have a shower with you, that would get maybe a little
cues.en: ask one of your friends to have a shower with you, that would get maybe a little
cues.zh: ㄟ不是，我不是指叫你朋友跟你一起淋浴 那樣可能會有點莫名其妙且尷尬

cues.text: bit weird and awkward. You might not have the same relationship again after that.
cues.en: bit weird and awkward. You might not have the same relationship again after that.
cues.zh: 那樣可能會有點莫名其妙且尷尬 之後你們的關係可能就回不去了

cues.zh: 嗯，正如我所說，44，我相當有信心它是 44 左右。

cues.text: Ah, you knew it all the time, Callum.
cues.en: Ah, you knew it all the time, Callum.
cues.zh: 啊，你一直都知道，卡勒姆。

cues.text: Well, that's all we've got time for today.
cues.en: Well, that's all we've got time for today.
cues.zh: 好了，我們今天的時間就到此為止。

cues.text: Join us again next time for more 6 Minute English.
cues.en: Join us again next time for more 6 Minute English.
cues.zh: 下次再加入我們，觀看更多 6 分鐘英語。

cues.text: Goodbye.
cues.en: Goodbye.
cues.zh: 再見。

cues.text: BBC Learning English dot com.
cues.en: BBC Learning English dot com.
cues.zh: BBC 學習英語 .com。

AG2kYShBZl0.title: Asking for help – 21 – English at Work gets you the help you need
AG2kYShBZl0.speaker: BBC Learning English
AG2kYShBZl0.zh: 【BBC Learning English】尋求協助 – 21 – 工作英語為您提供所需的協助（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Hello, welcome back to Tip Top Trading where everyone is gossiping about Paul's announcement.
cues.en: Hello, welcome back to Tip Top Trading where everyone is gossiping about Paul's announcement.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎回到 Tip Top Trading，這裡每個人都在討論 Paul 的宣告。

cues.text: Anna is to lead the company's new stock management system for the new laser-curved fruit.
cues.en: Anna is to lead the company's new stock management system for the new laser-curved fruit.
cues.zh: 安娜將負責領導公司針對新型雷射彎曲水果的新庫存管理系統。

cues.text: Yes, Anna. The new girl. She's done really well, although I don't know what experience she's got.
cues.en: Yes, Anna. The new girl. She's done really well, although I don't know what experience she's got.
cues.zh: 是的，安娜。新來的女孩。她做得很好，雖然我不知道她有什麼經驗。

cues.text: Anyway, about the hairdresser you mentioned. Oh, I loved his aftershave.
cues.en: Anyway, about the hairdresser you mentioned. Oh, I loved his aftershave.
cues.zh: 不管怎樣，關於你提到的理髮師。哦，我喜歡他的須後水。

cues.text: I can't understand it. I've got all the experience and all the ideas. She's just such a…
cues.en: I can't understand it. I've got all the experience and all the ideas. She's just such a…
cues.zh: 我無法理解。我擁有所有的經驗和所有的想法。她就是這樣一個…

cues.text: Tom, sorry to interrupt. I just wanted to check you're OK with me leading this strategy for stock management.
cues.en: Tom, sorry to interrupt. I just wanted to check you're OK with me leading this strategy for stock management.
cues.zh: 湯姆，抱歉打擾了。我只是想看看您是否同意我領導這個庫存管理策略。

cues.text: Oh, of course. Yeah, you deserve it.
cues.en: Oh, of course. Yeah, you deserve it.
cues.zh: 哦，當然。是的，你值得擁有。

cues.text: That was a nice touch, Anna.
cues.en: That was a nice touch, Anna.
cues.zh: 這是一個很好的接觸，安娜。

cues.text: But, Tom, now you must help me.
cues.en: But, Tom, now you must help me.
cues.zh: 但是，湯姆，現在你必須幫助我。

cues.text: Eh?
cues.en: Eh?
cues.zh: 呃？

cues.text: Anna, that's not the best way to ask for help.
cues.en: Anna, that's not the best way to ask for help.
cues.zh: 安娜，這不是尋求幫助的最佳方式。

cues.text: Remember what I've always told you about politeness.
cues.en: Remember what I've always told you about politeness.
cues.zh: 記住我一直告訴你的關於禮貌的話。

cues.text: Be polite. Yes, you keep telling me that.
cues.en: Be polite. Yes, you keep telling me that.
cues.zh: 要有禮貌。是的，你一直這麼告訴我。

cues.text: And if you want someone to help you, ask them. Don't tell them. Even if it is, Tom.
cues.en: And if you want someone to help you, ask them. Don't tell them. Even if it is, Tom.
cues.zh: 如果您需要有人幫助您，請詢問他們。不要告訴他們。即使是這樣，湯姆。

cues.text: Oh, right. I'm in a bit of a panic. I've never done this before. I don't know where to begin.
cues.en: Oh, right. I'm in a bit of a panic. I've never done this before. I don't know where to begin.
cues.zh: 哦，對了。我有點恐慌。我以前從未這樣做過。我不知道從哪裡開始。

cues.text: Well, start by asking your colleagues for help, like this.
cues.en: Well, start by asking your colleagues for help, like this.
cues.zh: 好吧，首先向你的同事尋求幫助，就像這樣。

cues.text: I would be most grateful if you could give me some help.
cues.en: I would be most grateful if you could give me some help.
cues.zh: 如果您能給我一些幫助，我將不勝感激。

cues.text: Please, could I ask you for some advice?
cues.en: Please, could I ask you for some advice?
cues.zh: 請問，我可以向你尋求一些建議嗎？

cues.text: I know you're busy.
cues.en: I know you're busy.
cues.zh: 我知道你很忙。

cues.text: But could you spare me a few minutes of your time, please?
cues.en: But could you spare me a few minutes of your time, please?
cues.zh: 但是你能抽出我幾分鐘的時間嗎？

cues.text: Go on. Give it a try.
cues.en: Go on. Give it a try.
cues.zh: 繼續。嘗試一下。

cues.text: Right. Thanks. I'll try.
cues.en: Right. Thanks. I'll try.
cues.zh: 正確的。謝謝。我會盡力。

cues.text: Mmm. Excuse me, Tom. Sorry about earlier.
cues.en: Mmm. Excuse me, Tom. Sorry about earlier.
cues.zh: 嗯。對不起，湯姆。之前的事情很抱歉。

cues.text: I'm a little nervous about leading this strategy thing.
cues.en: I'm a little nervous about leading this strategy thing.
cues.zh: 我對領導這項策略工作有點緊張。

cues.text: And I would be most grateful if you could give me some help. Please?
cues.en: And I would be most grateful if you could give me some help. Please?
cues.zh: 如果您能給我一些幫助，我將不勝感激。請？

cues.text: Of course, Anna. Why didn't you say? I'd be delighted.
cues.en: Of course, Anna. Why didn't you say? I'd be delighted.
cues.zh: 當然，安娜。為什麼不說？我會很高興。

cues.text: I've lost count of the number of projects I've led over the years.
cues.en: I've lost count of the number of projects I've led over the years.
cues.zh: 我已經記不清這些年來我領導過的專案有多少了。

cues.text: Great. Thanks. So, where do you think I should begin?
cues.en: Great. Thanks. So, where do you think I should begin?
cues.zh: 偉大的。謝謝。那麼，你認為我該從哪裡開始呢？

cues.text: Well, give me a few minutes and I'll just find some of the excellent work I did last year.
cues.en: Well, give me a few minutes and I'll just find some of the excellent work I did last year.
cues.zh: 好吧，請給我幾分鐘時間，我會找到一些我去年所做的出色工作。

cues.text: Basically, you'll just need to copy it. Hold on.
cues.en: Basically, you'll just need to copy it. Hold on.
cues.zh: 基本上，您只需要複製它。堅持，稍等。

cues.text: Oh, Anna. Just popping out for some biscuits.
cues.en: Oh, Anna. Just popping out for some biscuits.
cues.zh: 哦，安娜。只是出去吃一些餅乾。

cues.text: How's the stock management strategy coming along?
cues.en: How's the stock management strategy coming along?
cues.zh: 庫存管理策略進度如何？

cues.text: Oh, very good, Paul.
cues.en: Oh, very good, Paul.
cues.zh: 哦，很好，保羅。

cues.text: Actually, could I ask you for some advice, please?
cues.en: Actually, could I ask you for some advice, please?
cues.zh: 事實上，我可以請你給我一些建議嗎？

cues.text: Yes, of course. Although I don't know if I'll be of much use.
cues.en: Yes, of course. Although I don't know if I'll be of much use.
cues.zh: 是的當然。雖然我不知道我是否會有多大用處。

cues.text: Now, where did I put those damn documents?
cues.en: Now, where did I put those damn documents?
cues.zh: 現在，我把那些該死的檔案放在哪裡了？

cues.text: I'm very grateful for this opportunity, but I'm a little unsure of where to start.
cues.en: I'm very grateful for this opportunity, but I'm a little unsure of where to start.
cues.zh: 我非常感謝這個機會，但我有點不確定從哪裡開始。

cues.text: Tom is looking for some of his old work, but…
cues.en: Tom is looking for some of his old work, but…
cues.zh: 湯姆正在尋找他的一些舊作品，但…

cues.text: Really? To be honest, this isn't Tom's speciality. At a time like this, I would ask Denise.
cues.en: Really? To be honest, this isn't Tom's speciality. At a time like this, I would ask Denise.
cues.zh: 真的嗎？說實話，這不是湯姆的專長。在這種時候，我會問丹妮絲。

cues.text: Denise?
cues.en: Denise?
cues.zh: 丹妮絲？

cues.text: Yes. She may only be the office assistant, but she always has words of wisdom.
cues.en: Yes. She may only be the office assistant, but she always has words of wisdom.
cues.zh: 是的。她也許只是辦公室助理，但她總是有智慧之言。

cues.text: Right. Custard creams or chocolate digestives?
cues.en: Right. Custard creams or chocolate digestives?
cues.zh: 正確的。奶凍還是巧克力消化劑？

cues.text: What?
cues.en: What?
cues.zh: 什麼？

cues.text: Biscuits.
cues.en: Biscuits.
cues.zh: 餅乾。

cues.text: Oh, custard creams, please.
cues.en: Oh, custard creams, please.
cues.zh: 哦，請給我奶凍。

cues.text: Uh, Denise, I know you're busy, but could you spare a few minutes of your time, please?
cues.en: Uh, Denise, I know you're busy, but could you spare a few minutes of your time, please?
cues.zh: 呃，丹尼斯，我知道你很忙，但是你能抽出幾分鐘嗎？

cues.text: Of course, Anna. Always happy to help you.
cues.en: Of course, Anna. Always happy to help you.
cues.zh: 當然，安娜。總是很樂意為您提供協助。

cues.text: Well, you know the stock management control system.
cues.en: Well, you know the stock management control system.
cues.zh: 嗯，您知道庫存管理控制系統。

cues.text: The one you've now got to work out? Well done for getting that.
cues.en: The one you've now got to work out? Well done for getting that.
cues.zh: 你現在要鍛鍊的那個？做得很好。

cues.text: Thanks. It was okay writing it down for Paul. But how do I put it into practice? There's just too much to do.
cues.en: Thanks. It was okay writing it down for Paul. But how do I put it into practice? There's just too much to do.
cues.zh: 謝謝。為保羅寫下來是可以的。但我如何付諸實行呢？有太多事情要做。

cues.text: Calm down, Anna. You'll be fine. The first thing you need to do is look at our current system.
cues.en: Calm down, Anna. You'll be fine. The first thing you need to do is look at our current system.
cues.zh: 冷靜點，安娜。你會沒事的。您需要做的第一件事是檢視我們目前的系統。

cues.text: Look at our current system. How do I do that?
cues.en: Look at our current system. How do I do that?
cues.zh: 看看我們現在的系統。我該怎麼做？

cues.text: Easy. Just take the lift down to the warehouse and speak to Mr. Ingl and then write down what you find
cues.en: Easy. Just take the lift down to the warehouse and speak to Mr. Ingl and then write down what you find
cues.zh: 簡單的。只需搭乘電梯到倉庫並與 Ingl 先生交談，然後寫下您發現的內容

cues.text: and draw up an action plan of tasks you need to do, like a shopping list. I'm very good at those.
cues.en: and draw up an action plan of tasks you need to do, like a shopping list. I'm very good at those.
cues.zh: 並制定您需要完成的任務的行動計劃，例如購物清單。我很擅長這些。

cues.text: Go and see Mr. Ingl. Do I have to?
cues.en: Go and see Mr. Ingl. Do I have to?
cues.zh: 去見英格先生。我必須這樣做嗎？

cues.text: He's okay, really, Anna. If you approach him in the right way, he won't bite your head off.
cues.en: He's okay, really, Anna. If you approach him in the right way, he won't bite your head off.
cues.zh: 他真的很好，安娜。如果你以正確的方式接近他，他就不會咬掉你的頭。

cues.text: What? Bite my head off? Oh, well, if he won't bite me, then I suppose I should go and see him.
cues.en: What? Bite my head off? Oh, well, if he won't bite me, then I suppose I should go and see him.
cues.zh: 什麼？把我的頭咬下來？哦，好吧，如果他不咬我，那我想我應該去看他。

cues.text: Thanks for your advice, Denise. I could kiss you. Right. I'm going to go and see him right now.
cues.en: Thanks for your advice, Denise. I could kiss you. Right. I'm going to go and see him right now.
cues.zh: 謝謝你的建議，丹妮絲。我可以吻你。正確的。我現在就去見他。

cues.text: Make an action plan. A good idea. Well done, Denise. You're smarter than you look.
cues.en: Make an action plan. A good idea. Well done, Denise. You're smarter than you look.
cues.zh: 制定行動計劃。好主意。幹得好，丹妮絲。你比你看起來更聰明。

cues.text: And well done, Anna. You eventually got the help you needed by using these phrases.
cues.en: And well done, Anna. You eventually got the help you needed by using these phrases.
cues.zh: 幹得好，安娜。您最終透過使用這些短語獲得了所需的幫助。

cues.text: I would be most grateful if you could give me some help. Please, could I ask you for some advice?
cues.en: I would be most grateful if you could give me some help. Please, could I ask you for some advice?
cues.zh: 如果您能給我一些幫助，我將不勝感激。請問，我可以向你尋求一些建議嗎？

cues.text: I know you're busy, but could you spare me a few minutes of your time, please?
cues.en: I know you're busy, but could you spare me a few minutes of your time, please?
cues.zh: 我知道您很忙，但是您能抽出幾分鐘給我嗎？

cues.text: Remember, if you're stuck for ideas, just ask for help. But maybe not, Tom. I wonder how he's getting on.
cues.en: Remember, if you're stuck for ideas, just ask for help. But maybe not, Tom. I wonder how he's getting on.
cues.zh: 請記住，如果您找不到想法，請尋求協助。但也許不是，湯姆。我想知道他過得怎麼樣。

cues.text: Here, Anna, I've got them. Look, all my ideas from my last stock control project. Pages and pages of them.
cues.en: Here, Anna, I've got them. Look, all my ideas from my last stock control project. Pages and pages of them.
cues.zh: 安娜，在這裡，我已經拿到了。看，我所有的想法都來自我上一個庫存控制專案。一頁又一頁。

cues.text: Just copy these. They're brilliant. Anna? Anna!
cues.en: Just copy these. They're brilliant. Anna? Anna!
cues.zh: 只需複製這些即可。他們很聰明。安娜？安娜！

cues.text: Too late. I've just seen her in the lift. Fancy a custard cream, Tom?
cues.en: Too late. I've just seen her in the lift. Fancy a custard cream, Tom?
cues.zh: 為時已晚。我剛剛在電梯裡見過她。湯姆，想要奶凍嗎？

cues.text: So, Anna is off to speak to the prickly Mr. Ingl. Let's hope she uses those phrases to ask for help.
cues.en: So, Anna is off to speak to the prickly Mr. Ingl. Let's hope she uses those phrases to ask for help.
cues.zh: 所以，安娜要去和易怒的英格先生說話。希望她能用這些短語來尋求幫助。

cues.text: Otherwise, she might get her head bitten off. And it could get very messy. See you next time.
cues.en: Otherwise, she might get her head bitten off. And it could get very messy. See you next time.
cues.zh: 不然她的頭可能會被咬掉。它可能會變得非常混亂。下次見。

78YSJaWPzhg.title: The Secret to Understand Fast-Talking Native English Speakers
78YSJaWPzhg.speaker: mmmEnglish
78YSJaWPzhg.zh: 【mmmEnglish】理解語速很快的英語母語人士的秘訣（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Well hey there I'm Emma from mmmEnglish and this is a lesson I'm excited about because we're going to be
cues.en: Well hey there I'm Emma from mmmEnglish and this is a lesson I'm excited about because we're going to be
cues.zh: 嘿，我是來自 mmmEnglish 的艾瑪，這是我很興奮的一課，因為我們將

cues.text: working on your listening skills, especially to help you understand
cues.en: working on your listening skills, especially to help you understand
cues.zh: 努力提升你的聽力技巧，尤其是幫助你理解

cues.text: fast-talking native English speakers.
cues.en: fast-talking native English speakers.
cues.zh: 以英語為母語的人，語速很快。

cues.text: The secret is reductions. I know that for so many of my students,
cues.en: The secret is reductions. I know that for so many of my students,
cues.zh: 秘訣就是減少。我知道對我的許多學生來說

cues.text: it is hard to understand native English speakers in real life,
cues.en: it is hard to understand native English speakers in real life,
cues.zh: 在現實生活中很難理解以英語為母語的人，

cues.text: when you're watching movies or you're watching TV because some of us speak so quickly.
cues.en: when you're watching movies or you're watching TV because some of us speak so quickly.
cues.zh: 當你看電影或看電視時，因為我們中的一些人說話太快了。

cues.text: We connect words, we delete, we change sounds.
cues.en: We connect words, we delete, we change sounds.
cues.zh: 我們連線單字、刪除單字、改變聲音。

cues.text: There is a huge difference between the word that you expect
cues.en: There is a huge difference between the word that you expect
cues.zh: 與你期望的字詞有很大差異

cues.text: to hear, the word that you learned and then the word that actually
cues.en: to hear, the word that you learned and then the word that actually
cues.zh: 聽到你學到的單詞，然後是實際聽到的單詞

cues.text: comes out of our mouths, right? So to help you understand
cues.en: comes out of our mouths, right? So to help you understand
cues.zh: 從我們嘴裡說出來，對嗎？所以為了幫助你理解

cues.text: native English speakers, I'm going to help you to practise
cues.en: native English speakers, I'm going to help you to practise
cues.zh: 以英語為母語的人，我會幫你練習

cues.text: and to recognise the most common reductions, the ones that you hear native speakers use every day,
cues.en: and to recognise the most common reductions, the ones that you hear native speakers use every day,
cues.zh: 並認識到最常見的縮減方式，即您每天聽到母語人士使用的縮減方式，

cues.text: I'm going to help you to practise hearing them but also practise
cues.en: I'm going to help you to practise hearing them but also practise
cues.zh: 我會幫你練習聽它們，同時也練習

cues.text: using them if you want to.
cues.en: using them if you want to.
cues.zh: 如果你願意的話可以使用它們。

cues.text: You'll also find a PDF download with all of the
cues.en: You'll also find a PDF download with all of the
cues.zh: 您還可以找到包含所有內容的 PDF 下載

cues.text: expressions that we'll practise in today's lesson including the pronunciation notes and some example sentences
cues.en: expressions that we'll practise in today's lesson including the pronunciation notes and some example sentences
cues.zh: 我們將在今天的課程中練習的表達方式，包括發音註釋和一些例句

cues.text: that you can practise with at home.
cues.en: that you can practise with at home.
cues.zh: 您可以在家練習。

cues.text: There's also the answers to the quiz which is going to be at the end of this video so make sure you stick with me until the end,
cues.en: There's also the answers to the quiz which is going to be at the end of this video so make sure you stick with me until the end,
cues.zh: 還有測驗的答案，該答案將在本影片的結尾處提供，因此請務必跟著我直到最後，

cues.text: grab the workbook, the link is down in the description below.
cues.en: grab the workbook, the link is down in the description below.
cues.zh: 取得工作簿，連結位於下面的描述中。

cues.text: What makes listening to native English speakers so hard?
cues.en: What makes listening to native English speakers so hard?
cues.zh: 是什麼讓聽以英語為母語的人說話如此困難？

cues.text: I think there are a few different answers to this question but one in particular that I want to highlight for you
cues.en: I think there are a few different answers to this question but one in particular that I want to highlight for you
cues.zh: 我認為這個問題有幾個不同的答案，但我想特別向您強調一個

cues.text: is that you learn English at school like this:
cues.en: is that you learn English at school like this:
cues.zh: 你在學校學英文是這樣的：

cues.text: What are you doing this afternoon?
cues.en: What are you doing this afternoon?
cues.zh: 今天下午你在做什麼？

cues.text: And then you go out into the real world and you hear this:
cues.en: And then you go out into the real world and you hear this:
cues.zh: 然後你走進現實世界，你會聽到這樣的聲音：

fyqR1yb09CQ.title: What is a conditional? Grammar: Conditionals with Georgie
fyqR1yb09CQ.speaker: BBC Learning English
fyqR1yb09CQ.zh: 【BBC Learning English】什麼是條件句？語法：Georgie 的條件句（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: So if it rains, I'll probably just stay inside and watch a film.
cues.en: So if it rains, I'll probably just stay inside and watch a film.
cues.zh: 所以如果下雨，我可能會待在家裡看電影。

cues.text: Hello and welcome to Conditionals with Georgie - that's me!
cues.en: Hello and welcome to Conditionals with Georgie - that's me!
cues.zh: 您好，歡迎來到 Georgie 的條件句 - 這就是我！

cues.text: Conditionals can be tricky.
cues.en: Conditionals can be tricky.
cues.zh: 條件句可能很棘手。

cues.text: We sometimes think of them like they're mathematical equations:
cues.en: We sometimes think of them like they're mathematical equations:
cues.zh: 我們有時會將它們視為數學方程式：

cues.text: use this structure plus this structure, in this situation,
cues.en: use this structure plus this structure, in this situation,
cues.zh: 使用這個結構加上這個結構，在這種情況下，

cues.text: but not this situation.
cues.en: but not this situation.
cues.zh: 但不是這種情況。

cues.text: But sometimes, it's best to just relax, get your head out of the books,
cues.en: But sometimes, it's best to just relax, get your head out of the books,
cues.zh: 但有時候，最好放鬆一下，把注意力從書本上移開，

cues.text: and hear how they're used in real life.
cues.en: and hear how they're used in real life.
cues.zh: 並聽聽它們在現實生活中如何使用。

cues.text: So, what is a conditional?
cues.en: So, what is a conditional?
cues.zh: 那麼，什麼是條件式呢？

cues.text: Conditionals have two parts - the condition or a situation,
cues.en: Conditionals have two parts - the condition or a situation,
cues.zh: 條件句有兩個部分－條件或情況，

cues.text: and the possible consequences or results of that situation.
cues.en: and the possible consequences or results of that situation.
cues.zh: 以及該情況可能產生的後果或結果。

cues.text: If this happens, this happens.
cues.en: If this happens, this happens.
cues.zh: 如果發生這種情況，就會發生這種情況。

cues.text: Look: Usually, when I finish work, I play guitar.
cues.en: Look: Usually, when I finish work, I play guitar.
cues.zh: 看：通常，當我完成工作時，我會彈吉他。

cues.text: So, if I don't do that, then I kind of feel a bit stressed out, maybe.
cues.en: So, if I don't do that, then I kind of feel a bit stressed out, maybe.
cues.zh: 所以，如果我不這樣做，那麼我可能會感到有點壓力。

cues.text: Now, there are different types of conditionals that express different things.
cues.en: Now, there are different types of conditionals that express different things.
cues.zh: 現在，有不同型別的條件語句表達不同的事物。

cues.text: The type in the first example expresses things that are generally true or facts.
cues.en: The type in the first example expresses things that are generally true or facts.
cues.zh: 第一個範例中的型別表達了通常真實的事物或事實。

cues.text: If George doesn't play the guitar, he usually feels stressed out, in general.
cues.en: If George doesn't play the guitar, he usually feels stressed out, in general.
cues.zh: 一般來說，如果喬治不彈吉他，他通常會感到壓力很大。

cues.text: But what else can you do with conditionals?
cues.en: But what else can you do with conditionals?
cues.zh: 但是條件語句還能做什麼呢？

cues.text: Well, you can use conditionals to express a likely future situation and
cues.en: Well, you can use conditionals to express a likely future situation and
cues.zh: 嗯，你可以使用條件句來表達未來可能的情況

cues.text: the possible consequences of that.
cues.en: the possible consequences of that.
cues.zh: 可能產生的後果。

cues.text: If all the Tubes are cancelled, then I will cry, and get three buses home.
cues.en: If all the Tubes are cancelled, then I will cry, and get three buses home.
cues.zh: 如果所有地鐵都取消了，我會哭，然後搭三班公車回家。

cues.text: If all the tubes - that's underground trains - are cancelled,
cues.en: If all the tubes - that's underground trains - are cancelled,
cues.zh: 如果所有的地鐵——也就是地鐵——都被取消，

cues.text: which is a likely situation in London, Andrew will cry,
cues.en: which is a likely situation in London, Andrew will cry,
cues.zh: 這在倫敦很可能發生，安德魯會哭，

cues.text: but only if the tubes are cancelled.
cues.en: but only if the tubes are cancelled.
cues.zh: 但前提是這些管道被取消。

cues.text: It depends on that condition.
cues.en: It depends on that condition.
cues.zh: 這取決於那個條件。

cues.text: You can talk about situations that are unlikely to happen in the future -
cues.en: You can talk about situations that are unlikely to happen in the future -
cues.zh: 你可以談論未來不太可能發生的情況——

cues.text: hypothetical scenarios - and the consequences of that.
cues.en: hypothetical scenarios - and the consequences of that.
cues.zh: 假設的場景 - 以及其後果。

cues.text: If I won a million pounds, I'd probably go travelling all round the world.
cues.en: If I won a million pounds, I'd probably go travelling all round the world.
cues.zh: 如果我贏得一百萬英鎊，我可能會環遊世界。

cues.text: Now, it's unlikely Pippa will win a million pounds, but she's kind of imagining and dreaming about what she could do
cues.en: Now, it's unlikely Pippa will win a million pounds, but she's kind of imagining and dreaming about what she could do
cues.zh: 現在，皮帕不太可能贏得一百萬英鎊，但她有點想像和夢想她能做什麼

cues.text: if she won a million pounds.
cues.en: if she won a million pounds.
cues.zh: 如果她贏得一百萬英鎊。

cues.text: Why weren't you at the meeting?
cues.en: Why weren't you at the meeting?
cues.zh: 為什麼沒有參加會議？

cues.text: Because you didn't tell me about it.
cues.en: Because you didn't tell me about it.
cues.zh: 因為你沒有告訴我這件事。

cues.text: If you'd told me about it, I would have been there.
cues.en: If you'd told me about it, I would have been there.
cues.zh: 如果你告訴我這件事，我就會在那裡。

cues.text: You can use conditionals for past situations too.
cues.en: You can use conditionals for past situations too.
cues.zh: 您也可以對過去的情況使用條件句。

cues.text: So these are things that have already happened, so you can't change them,
cues.en: So these are things that have already happened, so you can't change them,
cues.zh: 所以這些都是已經發生的事情，所以你無法改變它們，

cues.text: but you're imagining alternative situations and their results.
cues.en: but you're imagining alternative situations and their results.
cues.zh: 但你正在想像其他情況及其結果。

cues.text: So I've given you a quick overview of the main conditionals.
cues.en: So I've given you a quick overview of the main conditionals.
cues.zh: 我已經向您快速概述了主要條件。

cues.text: And, now later in the series, we'll look at them in more detail,
cues.en: And, now later in the series, we'll look at them in more detail,
cues.zh: 現在，在本系列的後面部分，我們將更詳細地瞭解它們，

cues.text: not forgetting about the mixed conditionals too.
cues.en: not forgetting about the mixed conditionals too.
cues.zh: 不要忘記混合條件。

cues.text: Don't forget to check out our website and download the free worksheet to help you practise. See you next time!
cues.en: Don't forget to check out our website and download the free worksheet to help you practise. See you next time!
cues.zh: 不要忘記檢視我們的網站並下載免費的工作表來幫助您練習。下次見！

jwmKjgwlMk8.title: Present perfect and past simple -  6 Minute Grammar
jwmKjgwlMk8.speaker: BBC Learning English
jwmKjgwlMk8.zh: 【BBC Learning English】現在完成式和一般過去式 - 6 分鐘語法（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: six-minute grammar from bbclearningenglish.com
cues.en: six-minute grammar from bbclearningenglish.com
cues.zh: 來自 bbclearningenglish.com 的六分鐘語法

cues.text: Hello and welcome to six-minute grammar with me, Catherine.
cues.en: Hello and welcome to six-minute grammar with me, Catherine.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎和我一起學習六分鐘文法，凱瑟琳。

cues.text: And me, Neil. Hello.
cues.en: And me, Neil. Hello.
cues.zh: 還有我，尼爾。你好。

cues.text: Today we're talking about the present perfect and the past simple tenses.
cues.en: Today we're talking about the present perfect and the past simple tenses.
cues.zh: 今天我們討論現在完成式和過去簡單式。

cues.text: Yes, we're going to tell you how to form them and give you three rules
cues.en: Yes, we're going to tell you how to form them and give you three rules
cues.zh: 是的，我們將告訴您如何形成它們並給您三個規則

cues.text: to help you decide which one to use and when.
cues.en: to help you decide which one to use and when.
cues.zh: 幫助您決定使用哪一種以及何時使用。

cues.text: We'll also look at using ever and never with the present perfect.
cues.en: We'll also look at using ever and never with the present perfect.
cues.zh: 我們還將考慮使用ever和never與現在完成式一起使用。

cues.text: And we'll finish with a quiz.
cues.en: And we'll finish with a quiz.
cues.zh: 最後我們將進行一個測驗。

cues.text: Right then, let's start with the present perfect and here's our first example.
cues.en: Right then, let's start with the present perfect and here's our first example.
cues.zh: 那麼，讓我們從現在完成式開始，這是我們的第一個例子。

cues.text: I've looked at the cells figures. They've shot up by 20%.
cues.en: I've looked at the cells figures. They've shot up by 20%.
cues.zh: 我看過細胞資料。他們的股價上漲了 20%。

cues.text: So it's subject plus have or has plus a past participle.
cues.en: So it's subject plus have or has plus a past participle.
cues.zh: 所以它的主詞加上have或has加上過去分詞。

cues.text: To make past participles of regular verbs, add ed to the main verb.
cues.en: To make past participles of regular verbs, add ed to the main verb.
cues.zh: 要製作規則動詞的過去分詞，請在主要動詞後面加上 ed。

cues.text: So look becomes looked.
cues.en: So look becomes looked.
cues.zh: 所以看起來就變成看起來了。

cues.text: But some verbs like shoot are irregular.
cues.en: But some verbs like shoot are irregular.
cues.zh: 但有些動詞如shoot是不規則的。

cues.text: The past participle of shoot is shot.
cues.en: The past participle of shoot is shot.
cues.zh: shot的過去分詞是shot。

cues.text: You just have to learn your irregular verbs.
cues.en: You just have to learn your irregular verbs.
cues.zh: 你只需要學習不規則動詞。

cues.text: That's right and we often use short forms in the present perfect like I've,
cues.en: That's right and we often use short forms in the present perfect like I've,
cues.zh: 是的，我們經常像我一樣使用現在完成式的縮寫形式，

cues.text: he's and they've.
cues.en: he's and they've.
cues.zh: 他是，他們也是。

cues.text: Now, here's an example of the past simple.
cues.en: Now, here's an example of the past simple.
cues.zh: 現在，這是一個簡單過去式的例子。

cues.text: I looked at the cells figures this morning.
cues.en: I looked at the cells figures this morning.
cues.zh: 今天早上我看了細胞資料。

cues.text: They shot up by 20% last month.
cues.en: They shot up by 20% last month.
cues.zh: 上個月它們飆升了 20%。

cues.text: For the past simple of regular verbs, add ed to the main verb.
cues.en: For the past simple of regular verbs, add ed to the main verb.
cues.zh: 對於規則動詞的過去簡單形式，在主要動詞後面加上 ed。

cues.text: So look becomes looked.
cues.en: So look becomes looked.
cues.zh: 所以看起來就變成看起來了。

cues.text: But don't forget those irregular verbs.
cues.en: But don't forget those irregular verbs.
cues.zh: 但不要忘記那些不規則動詞。

cues.text: The past simple of go is went.
cues.en: The past simple of go is went.
cues.zh: go 的過去簡單形式是 gone。

cues.text: Now, it's often difficult to know which tense to use.
cues.en: Now, it's often difficult to know which tense to use.
cues.zh: 現在，通常很難知道該使用哪種時態。

cues.text: It can be.
cues.en: It can be.
cues.zh: 可以的。

cues.text: So we've got some rules for you.
cues.en: So we've got some rules for you.
cues.zh: 所以我們為您制定了一些規則。

cues.text: Listen to the first example again.
cues.en: Listen to the first example again.
cues.zh: 再聽一遍第一個例子。

cues.text: I've looked at the cells figures.
cues.en: I've looked at the cells figures.
cues.zh: 我看過細胞資料。

cues.text: They've shot up by 20%.
cues.en: They've shot up by 20%.
cues.zh: 他們的股價上漲了 20%。

cues.text: And it's present perfect here because we're focusing on what happened, not when.
cues.en: And it's present perfect here because we're focusing on what happened, not when.
cues.zh: 它在這裡是完美的，因為我們關注的是發生的事情，而不是時間。

cues.text: But in the second example...
cues.en: But in the second example...
cues.zh: 但在第二個例子中...

cues.text: I looked at the cells figures this morning.
cues.en: I looked at the cells figures this morning.
cues.zh: 今天早上我看了細胞資料。

cues.text: They shot up by 20% last month.
cues.en: They shot up by 20% last month.
cues.zh: 上個月它們飆升了 20%。

cues.text: It's the past simple because we say when the actions happened.
cues.en: It's the past simple because we say when the actions happened.
cues.zh: 這是簡單過去式，因為我們說的是動作發生的時間。

cues.text: So that's rule one.
cues.en: So that's rule one.
cues.zh: 這就是第一條規則。

cues.text: Use the present perfect to say what happened,
cues.en: Use the present perfect to say what happened,
cues.zh: 用現在完成式說出發生了什麼，

cues.text: but the past simple for when or where something happened.
cues.en: but the past simple for when or where something happened.
cues.zh: 但一般過去式表示某事發生的時間或地點。

cues.text: Now, Neil, just a minute, because I actually...
cues.en: Now, Neil, just a minute, because I actually...
cues.zh: 現在，尼爾，請等一下，因為我實際上...

cues.text: I haven't eaten this morning.
cues.en: I haven't eaten this morning.
cues.zh: 我今天早上還沒吃飯。

cues.text: And that's an example of the present perfect with a time phrase.
cues.en: And that's an example of the present perfect with a time phrase.
cues.zh: 這是現在完成式與時間短語的範例。

cues.text: So sometimes we can use the present perfect to say when something happened,
cues.en: So sometimes we can use the present perfect to say when something happened,
cues.zh: 所以有時我們可以用現在完成式來表示某事發生時，

cues.text: when a situation started in the past and is still true or still happening now.
cues.en: when a situation started in the past and is still true or still happening now.
cues.zh: 當某種情況從過去開始並且現在仍然存在或仍在發生時。

cues.text: Here's a biscuit, Catherine, because you haven't eaten anything this morning.
cues.en: Here's a biscuit, Catherine, because you haven't eaten anything this morning.
cues.zh: 這是一塊餅乾，凱瑟琳，因為你今天早上沒有吃任何東西。

cues.text: I haven't.
cues.en: I haven't.
cues.zh: 我沒有。

cues.text: But if I said I didn't eat anything this morning with the past simple,
cues.en: But if I said I didn't eat anything this morning with the past simple,
cues.zh: 但如果我用一般過去式說我今天早上沒吃任何東西

cues.text: it would mean it isn't morning anymore.
cues.en: it would mean it isn't morning anymore.
cues.zh: 這意味著現在已經不是早上了。

cues.text: Now it's the afternoon or the evening.
cues.en: Now it's the afternoon or the evening.
cues.zh: 現在是下午或晚上。

cues.text: Yes, the action started and finished in the past.
cues.en: Yes, the action started and finished in the past.
cues.zh: 是的，動作在過去開始和結束。

cues.text: You must be starving.
cues.en: You must be starving.
cues.zh: 你一定是餓壞了。

cues.text: Go on.
cues.en: Go on.
cues.zh: 繼續。

cues.text: Here you go. Have another biscuit.
cues.en: Here you go. Have another biscuit.
cues.zh: 幹得好。再吃一塊餅乾。

cues.text: Thank you very much.
cues.en: Thank you very much.
cues.zh: 非常感謝。

cues.text: So that's rule two.
cues.en: So that's rule two.
cues.zh: 這就是第二條規則。

cues.text: Use the present perfect for events that started in the past and are continuing now.
cues.en: Use the present perfect for events that started in the past and are continuing now.
cues.zh: 對過去開始且現在仍在繼續的事件使用現在完成式。

cues.text: And the past simple for actions that started and finished in the past.
cues.en: And the past simple for actions that started and finished in the past.
cues.zh: 簡單過去式表示過去開始和結束的動作。

cues.text: Nice biscuits, Neil.
cues.en: Nice biscuits, Neil.
cues.zh: 不錯的餅乾，尼爾。

cues.text: And we're talking about when to use the present perfect and the past simple.
cues.en: And we're talking about when to use the present perfect and the past simple.
cues.zh: 我們正在討論何時使用現在完成式和一般過去式。

cues.text: Now, we often use the present perfect with ever and never for life experiences,
cues.en: Now, we often use the present perfect with ever and never for life experiences,
cues.zh: 現在，我們經常將現在完成式與ever和never一起用於生活經歷，

cues.text: things we've done at some point in the past.
cues.en: things we've done at some point in the past.
cues.zh: 我們過去某個時刻做過的事。

cues.text: Here's a question for you, Catherine.
cues.en: Here's a question for you, Catherine.
cues.zh: 這是要問你的問題，凱瑟琳。

cues.text: Have you ever eaten insects?
cues.en: Have you ever eaten insects?
cues.zh: 你吃過昆蟲嗎？

cues.text: Funnily enough, Neil, no.
cues.en: Funnily enough, Neil, no.
cues.zh: 有趣的是，尼爾，不。

cues.text: I've never eaten an insect
cues.en: I've never eaten an insect
cues.zh: 我從來沒有吃過昆蟲

cues.text: and I don't think I ever will.
cues.en: and I don't think I ever will.
cues.zh: 我想我永遠不會。

cues.text: How about you?
cues.en: How about you?
cues.zh: 你呢？

cues.text: Oh yes, actually I have eaten insects.
cues.en: Oh yes, actually I have eaten insects.
cues.zh: 哦，是的，其實我吃過昆蟲。

cues.text: Yes, I've eaten ants that were given to me by a friend from Colombia.
cues.en: Yes, I've eaten ants that were given to me by a friend from Colombia.
cues.zh: 是的，我吃過哥倫比亞朋友送給我的螞蟻。

cues.text: Very good.
cues.en: Very good.
cues.zh: 非常好。

cues.text: So, rule three.
cues.en: So, rule three.
cues.zh: 所以，規則三。

cues.text: Use ever with the present perfect to ask about a past experience
cues.en: Use ever with the present perfect to ask about a past experience
cues.zh: 與現在完成式一起使用來詢問過去的經歷

cues.text: and never to talk about an experience you haven't had.
cues.en: and never to talk about an experience you haven't had.
cues.zh: 並且永遠不要談論你沒有經歷過的經歷。

cues.text: But if you add information about time and place,
cues.en: But if you add information about time and place,
cues.zh: 但如果加上時間地點的訊息

cues.text: use the past simple.
cues.en: use the past simple.
cues.zh: 使用一般過去式。

cues.text: I ate insects last summer in Colombia.
cues.en: I ate insects last summer in Colombia.
cues.zh: 去年夏天我在哥倫比亞吃過昆蟲。

cues.text: And Neil used present perfect in I have eaten insects
cues.en: And Neil used present perfect in I have eaten insects
cues.zh: 尼爾在《我吃過昆蟲》中使用了現在完成式

cues.text: because he was focusing on the event itself, not when it happened.
cues.en: because he was focusing on the event itself, not when it happened.
cues.zh: 因為他關注的是事件本身，而不是事情發生的時間。

cues.text: Well, actually I wasn't focusing on anything.
cues.en: Well, actually I wasn't focusing on anything.
cues.zh: 好吧，實際上我並沒有專注於任何事情。

cues.text: I kept my eyes shut the whole time.
cues.en: I kept my eyes shut the whole time.
cues.zh: 我自始至終都閉著眼睛。

cues.text: They didn't look very nice.
cues.en: They didn't look very nice.
cues.zh: 他們看起來不太好。

cues.text: Right, but they tasted all right.
cues.en: Right, but they tasted all right.
cues.zh: 是的，但味道還不錯。

cues.text: They tasted OK, yeah.
cues.en: They tasted OK, yeah.
cues.zh: 他們嘗起來還不錯，是的。

cues.text: Good.
cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.text: It's now time for a quiz.
cues.en: It's now time for a quiz.
cues.zh: 現在是測驗時間。

cues.text: Which is correct?
cues.en: Which is correct?
cues.zh: 哪個才是正確的？

cues.text: Number one.
cues.en: Number one.
cues.zh: 第一。

cues.text: I've been for a job interview last week.
cues.en: I've been for a job interview last week.
cues.zh: 我上週去參加了一次工作面試。

cues.text: I went for a job interview last week.
cues.en: I went for a job interview last week.
cues.zh: 上週我去參加了一次工作面試。

cues.text: And it's B.
cues.en: And it's B.
cues.zh: 而且是B。

cues.text: I went for a job interview last week.
cues.en: I went for a job interview last week.
cues.zh: 上週我去參加了一次工作面試。

cues.text: Use the past simple when you say when something happened.
cues.en: Use the past simple when you say when something happened.
cues.zh: 當你說某件事發生時，使用簡單過去式。

cues.text: Number two.
cues.en: Number two.
cues.zh: 第二。

cues.text: I never went for a job interview.
cues.en: I never went for a job interview.
cues.zh: 我從未參加過工作面試。

cues.text: I have never been for a job interview.
cues.en: I have never been for a job interview.
cues.zh: 我從未參加過工作面試。

cues.text: And it's B.
cues.en: And it's B.
cues.zh: 而且是B。

cues.text: I have never been for a job interview.
cues.en: I have never been for a job interview.
cues.zh: 我從未參加過工作面試。

cues.text: We use the present perfect with never.
cues.en: We use the present perfect with never.
cues.zh: 我們將現在完成式與 never 一起使用。

cues.text: And the last one.
cues.en: And the last one.
cues.zh: 還有最後一張。

cues.text: A. Who has eaten all my biscuits?
cues.en: A. Who has eaten all my biscuits?
cues.zh: A. 誰吃了我所有的餅乾？

cues.text: Or B. Who ate all my biscuits?
cues.en: Or B. Who ate all my biscuits?
cues.zh: 或 B. 誰吃了我所有的餅乾？

cues.text: And that's a trick question because actually both are correct.
cues.en: And that's a trick question because actually both are correct.
cues.zh: 這是一個棘手的問題，因為實際上兩者都是正確的。

cues.text: And by the way, Neil, it wasn't me.
cues.en: And by the way, Neil, it wasn't me.
cues.zh: 順便說一句，尼爾，那不是我。

cues.text: I didn't eat all your biscuits.
cues.en: I didn't eat all your biscuits.
cues.zh: 我沒有吃完你的餅乾。

cues.text: Yeah, I'm sure.
cues.en: Yeah, I'm sure.
cues.zh: 是的，我確定。

cues.text: That means we have now come to the end of our programme.
cues.en: That means we have now come to the end of our programme.
cues.zh: 這意味著我們的計劃現在已經結束。

cues.text: There's more about this on our website at bbclearningenglish.com.
cues.en: There's more about this on our website at bbclearningenglish.com.
cues.zh: 我們的網站 bbclearningenglish.com 上有更多相關資訊。

cues.text: Join us again for more 6 Minute Grammar.
cues.en: Join us again for more 6 Minute Grammar.
cues.zh: 再次加入我們，瞭解更多 6 分鐘文法。

cues.text: bbclearningenglish.com
cues.en: bbclearningenglish.com
cues.zh: 英國廣播公司學習英語網

cues.en: "I help companies identify high potential leads "and I'm responsible for US$121 million
