cues.text: "in acquisition revenue, "representing a 78% growth year-on-year."
cues.en: "in acquisition revenue, "representing a 78% growth year-on-year."
cues.zh: 「在收購收入方面，」年增 78%。

cues.text: Two quick things.
cues.en: Two quick things.
cues.zh: 兩件快事。

cues.text: Number one, if you're a student, focus on your internships and extracurriculars
cues.en: Number one, if you're a student, focus on your internships and extracurriculars
cues.zh: 第一，如果您是學生，請專注於實習和課外活動

cues.text: and make sure to include metrics.
cues.en: and make sure to include metrics.
cues.zh: 並確保包含指標。

cues.text: To give an extreme example, it's better to write "my presentation scored 24% higher than the class average"
cues.en: To give an extreme example, it's better to write "my presentation scored 24% higher than the class average"
cues.zh: 舉個極端的例子，最好寫“我的演講得分比全班平均分數高出24%”

cues.text: than to simply write "I led a team presentation".
cues.en: than to simply write "I led a team presentation".
cues.zh: 而不是簡單地寫「我領導了一次團隊演示」。

cues.text: Number two, I would usually stay away from fluffy buzzwords, such as innovative, but Austin cleverly addresses this issue
cues.en: Number two, I would usually stay away from fluffy buzzwords, such as innovative, but Austin cleverly addresses this issue
cues.zh: 第二，我通常會遠離空洞的流行語，例如創新，但奧斯汀巧妙地解決了這個問題

cues.text: by giving you a chance to provide proof in the next section of your LinkedIn summary,
cues.en: by giving you a chance to provide proof in the next section of your LinkedIn summary,
cues.zh: 讓您有機會在 LinkedIn 摘要的下一部分提供證據，

cues.text: case study bullet points.
cues.en: case study bullet points.
cues.zh: 案例研究要點。

cues.text: In this part I would cherry pick three specific examples that best showcase how your existing skillset
cues.en: In this part I would cherry pick three specific examples that best showcase how your existing skillset
cues.zh: 在這一部分中，我將挑選三個最能展示您現有技能的具體範例

cues.text: will be a great match for the role that you're hoping to land.
cues.en: will be a great match for the role that you're hoping to land.
cues.zh: 將非常適合您希望獲得的職位。

cues.text: Broadly speaking, the structure here will be similar to the bullet point structure found in your resume.
cues.en: Broadly speaking, the structure here will be similar to the bullet point structure found in your resume.
cues.zh: 一般來說，這裡的結構與履歷中的要點結構類似。

cues.text: In the interest of time, I'm just gonna link my resume video down below, so make sure to check that out after this one.
cues.en: In the interest of time, I'm just gonna link my resume video down below, so make sure to check that out after this one.
cues.zh: 由於時間關係，我將在下面連結我的簡歷影片，因此請務必在這之後檢視。

cues.text: Finally, the last section of your summary should speak directly to the opportunities you're looking for,
cues.en: Finally, the last section of your summary should speak directly to the opportunities you're looking for,
cues.zh: 最後，摘要的最後一部分應該直接說明您正在尋找的機會，

cues.text: but without specifically saying you're looking for new opportunities.
cues.en: but without specifically saying you're looking for new opportunities.
cues.zh: 但沒有明確表示您正在尋找新的機會。

cues.text: Austin gives a great tip here by painting a picture of you and your boss at a bar,
cues.en: Austin gives a great tip here by painting a picture of you and your boss at a bar,
cues.zh: 奧斯汀在這裡給了一個很好的建議，他畫了一張你和你老闆在酒吧的照片，

cues.text: along with a recruiter at your dream company.
cues.en: along with a recruiter at your dream company.
cues.zh: 與您夢想公司的招募人員一起。

cues.text: And in order to tip off the recruiter without your manager getting suspicious,
cues.en: And in order to tip off the recruiter without your manager getting suspicious,
cues.zh: 為了在你的經理不產生懷疑的情況下向招聘人員通風報信，

cues.text: you simply mention the type of work that gets you excited.
cues.en: you simply mention the type of work that gets you excited.
cues.zh: 您只需提及讓您感到興奮的工作型別即可。

cues.text: For example, "I love applying my B2B LeadGen experience "to help tech companies reach high growth SMBs
cues.en: For example, "I love applying my B2B LeadGen experience "to help tech companies reach high growth SMBs
cues.zh: 例如，「我喜歡運用我的 B2B LeadGen 經驗」來幫助科技公司實現高成長的中小企業

cues.text: "to further scale their businesses." And any recruiter looking at your profile
cues.en: "to further scale their businesses." And any recruiter looking at your profile
cues.zh: 「進一步擴大他們的業務。」以及任何正在檢視您個人資料的招聘人員

cues.text: will know exactly what you want without you actually saying it.
cues.en: will know exactly what you want without you actually saying it.
cues.zh: 無需你真正說出來，他就會確切地知道你想要什麼。

cues.text: In case my manager is watching this video, that was clearly a hypothetical example.
cues.en: In case my manager is watching this video, that was clearly a hypothetical example.
cues.zh: 如果我的經理正在觀看這段影片，那麼這顯然是一個假設的例子。

cues.text: Let me know down the comment section below whether you're already following a similar structure for your LinkedIn summary
cues.en: Let me know down the comment section below whether you're already following a similar structure for your LinkedIn summary
cues.zh: 請在下面的評論部分告訴我您是否已採用類似的 LinkedIn 摘要結構

cues.text: or you're doing something different.
cues.en: or you're doing something different.
cues.zh: 或者你正在做一些不同的事情。

cues.text: I would love to see what other best practices are out there.
cues.en: I would love to see what other best practices are out there.
cues.zh: 我很想看看還有哪些最佳實踐。

cues.text: Now that we're familiar with three sections that make up an outstanding LinkedIn summary
cues.en: Now that we're familiar with three sections that make up an outstanding LinkedIn summary
cues.zh: 現在我們已經熟悉了構成優秀 LinkedIn 摘要的三個部分

cues.text: and have also seen a few examples, let's quickly go over the five practical tips
cues.en: and have also seen a few examples, let's quickly go over the five practical tips
cues.zh: 並且還看到了一些範例，讓我們快速瀏覽一下五個實用技巧

cues.text: you can apply immediately.
cues.en: you can apply immediately.
cues.zh: 您可以立即申請。

cues.text: Tip number one, LinkedIn recently expanded the limit for the summary section to 2,000 characters.
cues.en: Tip number one, LinkedIn recently expanded the limit for the summary section to 2,000 characters.
cues.zh: 第一個提示，LinkedIn 最近將摘要部分的限制擴大到 2,000 個字元。

cues.text: So first write out your draft, then paste it into a tool like WordCounter
cues.en: So first write out your draft, then paste it into a tool like WordCounter
cues.zh: 因此，先寫出草稿，然後將其貼到 WordCounter 等工具中

cues.text: to make sure you're within LinkedIn's limits.
cues.en: to make sure you're within LinkedIn's limits.
cues.zh: 確保您在 LinkedIn 的限制範圍內。

cues.text: I personally don't think there's a perfect range, but in Austin's examples,
cues.en: I personally don't think there's a perfect range, but in Austin's examples,
cues.zh: 我個人認為沒有一個完美的範圍，但在奧斯汀的例子中，

cues.text: these summaries are between 880 to 1,120 characters.
cues.en: these summaries are between 880 to 1,120 characters.
cues.zh: 這些摘要的長度在 880 到 1,120 個字元之間。

cues.text: Tip number two, since LinkedIn is a search engine just like Google, Amazon, and YouTube,
cues.en: Tip number two, since LinkedIn is a search engine just like Google, Amazon, and YouTube,
cues.zh: 第二點，因為 LinkedIn 是一個搜尋引擎，就像 Google、Amazon 和 YouTube 一樣，

cues.text: keywords play a pretty big role.
cues.en: keywords play a pretty big role.
cues.zh: 關鍵字起著相當大的作用。

cues.text: Recruiters are constantly searching for candidates and when they run a search,
cues.en: Recruiters are constantly searching for candidates and when they run a search,
cues.zh: 招募人員不斷地尋找候選人，當他們進行搜尋時，

cues.text: LinkedIn looks at the keywords and filters in their search and they match them up with the keywords
cues.en: LinkedIn looks at the keywords and filters in their search and they match them up with the keywords
cues.zh: LinkedIn 會檢視搜尋中的關鍵字和篩選器，然後將它們與關鍵字進行匹配

cues.text: on thousands of profiles.
cues.en: on thousands of profiles.
cues.zh: 在數千個個人資料上。

cues.text: To embed the right keywords in your LinkedIn summary, first find a role you're interested in
cues.en: To embed the right keywords in your LinkedIn summary, first find a role you're interested in
cues.zh: 要在 LinkedIn 摘要中嵌入正確的關鍵字，請先找到您感興趣的職位

cues.text: and paste the entire LinkedIn job description in a Word document.
cues.en: and paste the entire LinkedIn job description in a Word document.
cues.zh: 並將整個 LinkedIn 職位描述貼到 Word 檔案中。

cues.text: Do this 19 more times until you have 20 total, then paste those 20 job descriptions
cues.en: Do this 19 more times until you have 20 total, then paste those 20 job descriptions
cues.zh: 再重複 19 次，直到總共 20 份，然後貼上這 20 份職位描述

cues.text: in a word cloud generator like MonkeyLearn WordCloud generator, I'll link that down below,
cues.en: in a word cloud generator like MonkeyLearn WordCloud generator, I'll link that down below,
cues.zh: 在像 MonkeyLearn WordCloud 生成器這樣的詞雲生成器中，我將在下面連結它，

cues.text: and do your best to weave the top five keywords into your LinkedIn summary.
cues.en: and do your best to weave the top five keywords into your LinkedIn summary.
cues.zh: 並盡力將前五個關鍵字編入您的 LinkedIn 摘要中。

cues.text: Of course, this works best if you're very targeted in the type of role you're searching for,
cues.en: Of course, this works best if you're very targeted in the type of role you're searching for,
cues.zh: 當然，如果您對正在尋找的職位型別非常有針對性，那麼這種方法效果最好，

cues.text: for example, marketing for consumer, hardware, electronics.
cues.en: for example, marketing for consumer, hardware, electronics.
cues.zh: 例如，消費者、硬體、電子產品的行銷。

cues.text: If you copy paste job descriptions from 10 complete different unrelated industries and roles,
cues.en: If you copy paste job descriptions from 10 complete different unrelated industries and roles,
cues.zh: 如果您從 10 個完全不同的不相關行業和角色中複製貼上職位描述，

cues.text: you're gonna end up with keywords that are all over the place.
cues.en: you're gonna end up with keywords that are all over the place.
cues.zh: 你最終會得到到處都是的關鍵字。

cues.text: Tip number three, and this something I did not know before reading Austin's article,
cues.en: Tip number three, and this something I did not know before reading Austin's article,
cues.zh: 第三個技巧，這是我在閱讀奧斯汀的文章之前所不知道的，

cues.text: is that you can use a free tool called Unicode Text Converter to bold or italicize words in LinkedIn.
cues.en: is that you can use a free tool called Unicode Text Converter to bold or italicize words in LinkedIn.
cues.zh: 是您可以使用名為 Unicode 文字轉換器的免費工具將 LinkedIn 中的單字設定為粗體或斜體。

cues.text: Simply go to this link, I'll link it down below as well, and type in a sentence or two you'd like to emphasize
cues.en: Simply go to this link, I'll link it down below as well, and type in a sentence or two you'd like to emphasize
cues.zh: 只需轉到此連結，我也會在下面連結它，然後輸入您想要強調的一兩句話

cues.text: in your LinkedIn summary and copy/paste a bold or italicized version of it.
cues.en: in your LinkedIn summary and copy/paste a bold or italicized version of it.
cues.zh: 在您的 LinkedIn 摘要中，複製/貼上其粗體或斜體版本。

cues.text: You can also add emojis.
cues.en: You can also add emojis.
cues.zh: 您也可以新增表情符號。

cues.text: For Mac users, a shortcut is control-command-space and for Window users is the Windows-plus-period shortcut.
cues.en: For Mac users, a shortcut is control-command-space and for Window users is the Windows-plus-period shortcut.
cues.zh: 對於 Mac 使用者，快捷方式是 control-command-space；對於 Window 使用者，快捷方式是 Windows 加句點快捷方式。

cues.text: But for both the Unicode Text Converter and the emojis, I'd use those pretty sparingly.
cues.en: But for both the Unicode Text Converter and the emojis, I'd use those pretty sparingly.
cues.zh: 但對於 Unicode 文字轉換器和表情符號，我會相當謹慎地使用它們。

cues.text: Remember, if everything is highlighted, nothing is highlighted.
cues.en: Remember, if everything is highlighted, nothing is highlighted.
cues.zh: 請記住，如果所有內容都突出顯示，則沒有任何內容突出顯示。

cues.text: Tip number four, Austin recommends bringing up one or two personal interests
cues.en: Tip number four, Austin recommends bringing up one or two personal interests
cues.zh: 提示第四，奧斯汀建議提出一兩個個人興趣

cues.text: to create an instant connection with the reader.
cues.en: to create an instant connection with the reader.
cues.zh: 與讀者建立即時聯絡。

cues.text: Safe topics include food, travel, family, sports, hobbies, and learning.
cues.en: Safe topics include food, travel, family, sports, hobbies, and learning.
cues.zh: 安全的話題包括食物、旅行、家庭、運動、嗜好和學習。

cues.text: The trick here is to make sure to include a specific detail after the general interest.
cues.en: The trick here is to make sure to include a specific detail after the general interest.
cues.zh: 這裡的技巧是確保在一般興趣之後包含具體的細節。

cues.text: This could be something as simple as including a specific team name after mentioning you're a huge basketball fan.
cues.en: This could be something as simple as including a specific team name after mentioning you're a huge basketball fan.
cues.zh: 這可能很簡單，例如在提到您是超級籃球迷後新增一個特定的球隊名稱。

cues.text: Last but not least, tip number five is to use the Hemingway app to check your and spelling.
cues.en: Last but not least, tip number five is to use the Hemingway app to check your and spelling.
cues.zh: 最後但並非最不重要的一點是，第五條提示是使用海明威應用程式檢查您的拼字。

cues.text: Once you've followed all the steps in this video, paste your LinkedIn summary into the app,
cues.en: Once you've followed all the steps in this video, paste your LinkedIn summary into the app,
cues.zh: 完成本影片中的所有步驟後，將您的 LinkedIn 摘要貼到應用程式中，

cues.text: I'll link it down below, and Hemingway will show you misspelled words,
cues.en: I'll link it down below, and Hemingway will show you misspelled words,
cues.zh: 我將在下面連結它，海明威將向您展示拼寫錯誤的單詞，

cues.text: which sentences you can improve and how to improve them, and even give you a readability score.
cues.en: which sentences you can improve and how to improve them, and even give you a readability score.
cues.zh: 您可以改進哪些句子以及如何改進它們，甚至可以為您提供可讀性分數。

cues.text: Of course, other than your summary, a few other factors also contribute to a strong LinkedIn profile
cues.en: Of course, other than your summary, a few other factors also contribute to a strong LinkedIn profile
cues.zh: 當然，除了摘要之外，其他一些因素也有助於建立出色的 LinkedIn 個人資料

cues.text: and I address each one of those in my LinkedIn playlist here.
cues.en: and I address each one of those in my LinkedIn playlist here.
cues.zh: 我在這裡逐一介紹了我的 LinkedIn 播放清單中的這些內容。

cues.text: For example, I show you how to create a professional LinkedIn headshot using only free tools.
cues.en: For example, I show you how to create a professional LinkedIn headshot using only free tools.
cues.zh: 例如，我向您展示如何僅使用免費工具建立專業的 LinkedIn 頭像。

cues.text: See you on the next video.
cues.en: See you on the next video.
cues.zh: 下一個影片見。

cues.text: In the meantime, have a great one.
cues.en: In the meantime, have a great one.
cues.zh: 同時，祝你過得愉快。

ehUIlhKhzDA.title: Why Is the Sky Blue?
ehUIlhKhzDA.speaker: NASA Space Place
ehUIlhKhzDA.zh: 【NASA Space Place】天空為什麼是藍色的？（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Why Is the Sky Blue?
cues.en: Why Is the Sky Blue?
cues.zh: 天空為什麼是藍色的？

cues.text: In the middle of a bright, sunny day, the sky is usually a shade of blue.
cues.en: In the middle of a bright, sunny day, the sky is usually a shade of blue.
cues.zh: 在陽光燦爛的日子裡，天空通常是藍色的。

cues.text: Why blue—and not purple, green, or orange?
cues.en: Why blue—and not purple, green, or orange?
cues.zh: 為什麼是藍色，而不是紫色、綠色或橙色？

cues.text: Well, it’s all because of how the Sun’s light reaches Earth!
cues.en: Well, it’s all because of how the Sun’s light reaches Earth!
cues.zh: 好吧，這都是因為太陽光到達地球的方式！

cues.text: If you see light from the Sun hitting the ground, it probably looks like plain white
cues.en: If you see light from the Sun hitting the ground, it probably looks like plain white
cues.zh: 如果你看到太陽發出的光照射到地面上，它可能看起來像純白色

cues.text: light.
cues.en: light.
cues.zh: 光。

cues.text: However, that white light is made up of all the colors of the rainbow.
cues.en: However, that white light is made up of all the colors of the rainbow.
cues.zh: 然而，那白光是由彩虹的所有顏色組成的。

cues.text: You can actually separate and see all these colors if you shine sunlight through a specially
cues.en: You can actually separate and see all these colors if you shine sunlight through a specially
cues.zh: 如果你透過特殊的陽光照射，你實際上可以分開並看到所有這些顏色

cues.text: shaped crystal called a prism.
cues.en: shaped crystal called a prism.
cues.zh: 有形狀的晶體稱為稜鏡。

cues.text: Light energy travels in waves.
cues.en: Light energy travels in waves.
cues.zh: 光能以波的形式傳播。

cues.text: And different colors of light are created by different types of waves.
cues.en: And different colors of light are created by different types of waves.
cues.zh: 不同型別的波會產生不同顏色的光。

cues.text: For example, when our eyes recognize the color red, what we’re actually seeing is long,
cues.en: For example, when our eyes recognize the color red, what we’re actually seeing is long,
cues.zh: 例如，當我們的眼睛辨識出紅色時，我們實際上看到的是長的，

cues.text: stretched-out light waves with peaks that are far apart.
cues.en: stretched-out light waves with peaks that are far apart.
cues.zh: 波峰相距較遠的拉長光波。

cues.text: And when our eyes recognize the color blue, we’re really seeing shorter, choppier light
cues.en: And when our eyes recognize the color blue, we’re really seeing shorter, choppier light
cues.zh: 當我們的眼睛辨識出藍色時，我們確實看到了更短、更不穩定的光

cues.text: waves with peaks that are close together.
cues.en: waves with peaks that are close together.
cues.zh: 波峰靠得很近。

cues.text: The different colors of light are all determined by how stretched out the light waves are.
cues.en: The different colors of light are all determined by how stretched out the light waves are.
cues.zh: 光的不同顏色都是由光波的伸展程度決定的。

cues.text: Together, all the colors make up the spectrum of visible light—the light we can see.
cues.en: Together, all the colors make up the spectrum of visible light—the light we can see.
cues.zh: 所有顏色共同構成了可見光的光譜—我們可以看到的光。

cues.text: So, why do we only see blue light when we look up in the sky on a sunny day?
cues.en: So, why do we only see blue light when we look up in the sky on a sunny day?
cues.zh: 那麼，為什麼在晴天仰望天空時我們只能看到藍光呢？

cues.text: The blue color we see comes from sunlight hitting Earth’s atmosphere—a layer of
cues.en: The blue color we see comes from sunlight hitting Earth’s atmosphere—a layer of
cues.zh: 我們看到的藍色來自陽光照射到地球大氣層——一層

cues.text: gases that gives us air to breathe and keeps the planet warm enough to live on.
cues.en: gases that gives us air to breathe and keeps the planet warm enough to live on.
cues.zh: 氣體為我們提供呼吸空氣並使地球保持足夠溫暖以生存。

cues.text: When sunlight reaches Earth’s atmosphere, it is scattered in all directions by the gases
cues.en: When sunlight reaches Earth’s atmosphere, it is scattered in all directions by the gases
cues.zh: 當陽光到達地球大氣層時，它被氣體向各個方向散射

cues.text: in the air.
cues.en: in the air.
cues.zh: 在空氣中。

cues.text: The types of gases in Earth’s atmosphere mostly scatter the shorter, choppier waves
cues.en: The types of gases in Earth’s atmosphere mostly scatter the shorter, choppier waves
cues.zh: 地球大氣中的氣體型別主要散射較短、波動較大的波

cues.text: of blue light.
cues.en: of blue light.
cues.zh: 的藍光。

cues.text: So, when we see a blue sky, we’re really just seeing all of these blue light waves
cues.en: So, when we see a blue sky, we’re really just seeing all of these blue light waves
cues.zh: 所以，當我們看到藍天時，我們實際上只是看到所有這些藍色光波

cues.text: scattering in our atmosphere.
cues.en: scattering in our atmosphere.
cues.zh: 散射在我們的大氣中。

cues.text: But wait a minute: why is the sky a different color at sunset?
cues.en: But wait a minute: why is the sky a different color at sunset?
cues.zh: 但等一下：為什麼日落時天空的顏色不同？

cues.text: Well, as the Sun gets lower in the sky, its light is passing through more of the atmosphere
cues.en: Well, as the Sun gets lower in the sky, its light is passing through more of the atmosphere
cues.zh: 好吧，隨著太陽在天空中越來越低，它的光會穿過更多的大氣層

cues.text: to reach you.
cues.en: to reach you.
cues.zh: 來聯絡你。

cues.text: So, even more of the blue light is scattered away before it gets to you.
cues.en: So, even more of the blue light is scattered away before it gets to you.
cues.zh: 因此，更多的藍光在到達您之前就被散射掉了。

cues.text: This allows more of the orange and yellow light to pass straight through the atmosphere
cues.en: This allows more of the orange and yellow light to pass straight through the atmosphere
cues.zh: 這使得更多的橙色和黃光可以直接穿過大氣層

cues.text: and directly to your eyes.
cues.en: and directly to your eyes.
cues.zh: 並直接到達您的眼睛。

cues.text: However if the whole sky is glowing red, it could be due to particles of dust, pollution,
cues.en: However if the whole sky is glowing red, it could be due to particles of dust, pollution,
cues.zh: 然而，如果整個天空呈現紅色，可能是由於灰塵顆粒、汙染、

cues.text: or smoke in the air.
cues.en: or smoke in the air.
cues.zh: 或空氣中冒煙。

cues.text: These particles also scatter lots of blue light, which can lead to a very red sky.
cues.en: These particles also scatter lots of blue light, which can lead to a very red sky.
cues.zh: 這些粒子也會散射大量藍光，導致天空呈現非常紅色的效果。

cues.text: NASA’s Earth-observing satellites monitor how many of these particles—called aerosols—are
cues.en: NASA’s Earth-observing satellites monitor how many of these particles—called aerosols—are
cues.zh: 美國太空總署的地球觀測衛星監測這些顆粒（稱為氣溶膠）的數量

cues.text: in our air.
cues.en: in our air.
cues.zh: 在我們的空氣中。

cues.text: The information from these satellites help forecasters keep an eye on particles in the
cues.en: The information from these satellites help forecasters keep an eye on particles in the
cues.zh: 來自這些衛星的資訊幫助預報員密切關注大氣中的顆粒物

cues.text: air and make sure the air is safe to breathe.
cues.en: air and make sure the air is safe to breathe.
cues.zh: 空氣並確保空氣可以安全呼吸。

cues.text: In general, a blue sky is good news.
cues.en: In general, a blue sky is good news.
cues.zh: 一般來說，藍天是個好訊息。

cues.text: And now you know why!
cues.en: And now you know why!
cues.zh: 現在你知道為什麼了！

cues.text: Find out more about our home planet at NASA Space Place.
cues.en: Find out more about our home planet at NASA Space Place.
cues.zh: 在 NASA Space Place 瞭解更多關於我們的家園星球的資訊。

p4VHMsIuPmk.title: How do airplanes actually fly? - Raymond Adkins
p4VHMsIuPmk.speaker: TED-Ed
p4VHMsIuPmk.zh: 【TED-Ed】飛機實際上是如何飛行的？ ——雷蒙德‧阿德金斯（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: By 1917, Albert Einstein had explained the relationship between space and time.
cues.en: By 1917, Albert Einstein had explained the relationship between space and time.
cues.zh: 到了 1917 年時， 亞伯特‧愛因斯坦已經解釋了 空間和時間之間的關係。

cues.text: But, that year, he designed a flawed airplane wing.
cues.en: But, that year, he designed a flawed airplane wing.
cues.zh: 但那一年，他設計出了 有問題的機翼。

cues.text: His attempt was based on an incomplete theory of flight.
cues.en: His attempt was based on an incomplete theory of flight.
cues.zh: 但那一年，他設計出了 有問題的機翼。 他嘗試的做法是以一個 不完整的飛行理論為依據。

cues.text: Indeed, insufficient and inaccurate explanations still circulate today.
cues.en: Indeed, insufficient and inaccurate explanations still circulate today.
cues.zh: 的確，不充份和不正確的解釋 現今仍然在流傳著。

cues.text: So, where did Einstein go wrong?
cues.en: So, where did Einstein go wrong?
cues.zh: 那麼，愛因斯坦錯在哪裡？

cues.text: And how do planes fly?
cues.en: And how do planes fly?
cues.zh: 飛機又是怎麼飛起來的？

cues.text: Though we don’t always think of it this way, air is a fluid medium—
cues.en: Though we don’t always think of it this way, air is a fluid medium—
cues.zh: 雖然我們不見得都用這種角度思考， 但空氣是一種流體介質——

cues.text: it’s just less dense than liquids like water.
cues.en: it’s just less dense than liquids like water.
cues.zh: 只是它的密度比水這類液體還要低。

cues.text: Things that are lighter than air are buoyant within it, while heavier objects require an upward force, called lift, to stay aloft.
cues.en: Things that are lighter than air are buoyant within it, while heavier objects require an upward force, called lift, to stay aloft.
cues.zh: 比空氣輕的東西會浮在空氣中， 而較重的東西則需要向上的力量， 稱為升力，才能持續留在空中。

cues.text: For planes, this force is mostly generated by the wings.
cues.en: For planes, this force is mostly generated by the wings.
cues.zh: 就飛機來說，升力 多半是由機翼產生。

4NpG4F9yq00.title: Why is yawning contagious? - Claudia Aguirre
4NpG4F9yq00.speaker: TED-Ed
4NpG4F9yq00.zh: 【TED-Ed】為什麼打哈欠會傳染？ ——克勞蒂亞·阿吉雷（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Oh, excuse me!
cues.en: Oh, excuse me!
cues.zh: 不好意思！

cues.text: Have you ever yawned because somebody else yawned?
cues.en: Have you ever yawned because somebody else yawned?
cues.zh: 別人打哈欠 你會不會也打哈欠？

cues.text: You aren't especially tired, yet suddenly your mouth opens wide
cues.en: You aren't especially tired, yet suddenly your mouth opens wide
cues.zh: 其實沒有特別累 但突然就張大嘴巴

cues.text: and a big yawn comes out.
cues.en: and a big yawn comes out.
cues.zh: 一個大哈欠 就跑出來了

cues.text: This phenomenon is known as contagious yawning.
cues.en: This phenomenon is known as contagious yawning.
cues.zh: 這現象叫哈欠傳染

cues.text: And while scientists still don't fully understand why it happens, there are many hypotheses currently being researched.
cues.en: And while scientists still don't fully understand why it happens, there are many hypotheses currently being researched.
cues.zh: 對於背後的原因 科學家還不完全瞭解 但已經有人在研究各種假說

cues.text: Let's take a look at a few of the most prevalent ones, beginning with two physiological hypotheses
cues.en: Let's take a look at a few of the most prevalent ones, beginning with two physiological hypotheses
cues.zh: 讓我們來瞭解 一些廣為流傳的說法 先聽聽 2 種生理假說

cues.text: before moving to a psychological one.
cues.en: before moving to a psychological one.
cues.zh: 再看看 1 種心理假說

cues.text: Our first physiological hypothesis states that contagious yawning is triggered by a specific stimulus,
cues.en: Our first physiological hypothesis states that contagious yawning is triggered by a specific stimulus,
cues.zh: 第 1 種生理假說認為 哈欠傳染其來有自 會由特定刺激引起

cues.text: an initial yawn.
cues.en: an initial yawn.
cues.zh: 會由特定刺激引起 就是最初的哈欠

cues.text: This is called fixed action pattern.
cues.en: This is called fixed action pattern.
cues.zh: 就是最初的哈欠 這叫固定行為模式

cues.text: Think of fixed action pattern like a reflex.
cues.en: Think of fixed action pattern like a reflex.
cues.zh: 有點像反射動作

cues.text: Your yawn makes me yawn.
cues.en: Your yawn makes me yawn.
cues.zh: 有點像反射動作 你的哈欠讓我打哈欠

cues.text: Similar to a domino effect, one person's yawn triggers a yawn in a person nearby that has observed the act.
cues.en: Similar to a domino effect, one person's yawn triggers a yawn in a person nearby that has observed the act.
cues.zh: 你的哈欠讓我打哈欠 類似多米諾骨牌效應 一個人的哈欠 讓附近看到的人也打哈欠

cues.text: Once this reflex is triggered, it must run its course.
cues.en: Once this reflex is triggered, it must run its course.
cues.zh: 這效應一旦啟動 就會持續一定的時間

cues.text: Have you ever tried to stop a yawn once it has begun?
cues.en: Have you ever tried to stop a yawn once it has begun?
cues.zh: 快打哈欠時 你有試過阻止自己嗎？

cues.text: Basically impossible!
cues.en: Basically impossible!
cues.zh: 你有試過阻止自己嗎？ 根本不可能！

cues.text: Another physiological hypothesis is known as non-conscious mimicry,
cues.en: Another physiological hypothesis is known as non-conscious mimicry,
cues.zh: 第 2 種生理假說 叫無意識模仿

cues.text: or the chameleon effect.
cues.en: or the chameleon effect.
cues.zh: 又稱變色龍效應

cues.text: This occurs when you imitate someone's behavior without knowing it,
cues.en: This occurs when you imitate someone's behavior without knowing it,
cues.zh: 又稱變色龍效應 人會模仿他人的行為 下意識地 做出細微、自然的複製動作

cues.text: a subtle and unintentional copycat maneuver.
cues.en: a subtle and unintentional copycat maneuver.
cues.zh: 做出細微、自然的複製動作

cues.text: People tend to mimic each other's postures.
cues.en: People tend to mimic each other's postures.
cues.zh: 人會模仿他人的姿勢

cues.text: If you are seated across from someone that has their legs crossed,
cues.en: If you are seated across from someone that has their legs crossed,
cues.zh: 人會模仿他人的姿勢 像是對面的人翹腳 你看到了 很有可能也會翹起腳來

cues.text: you might cross your own legs.
cues.en: you might cross your own legs.
cues.zh: 很有可能也會翹起腳來

cues.text: This hypothesis suggests that we yawn when we see someone else yawn
cues.en: This hypothesis suggests that we yawn when we see someone else yawn
cues.zh: 這假說認為 看到別人打哈欠就跟進 是因為不知不覺中

cues.text: because we are unconsciously copying his or her behavior.
cues.en: because we are unconsciously copying his or her behavior.
cues.zh: 是因為不知不覺中 我們會模仿他人的行為

cues.text: Scientists believe that this chameleon effect is possible because of a special set of neurons known as mirror neurons.
cues.en: Scientists believe that this chameleon effect is possible because of a special set of neurons known as mirror neurons.
cues.zh: 科學家相信 變色龍效應可能和特殊的神經元有關 也就是映象神經元

cues.text: Mirror neurons are a type of brain cell that responds equally when we perform an action
cues.en: Mirror neurons are a type of brain cell that responds equally when we perform an action
cues.zh: 映象神經元是一群腦細胞 像鏡子一樣

cues.text: as when we see someone else perform the same action.
cues.en: as when we see someone else perform the same action.
cues.zh: 看到他人的動作後 我們會做出相同的動作

cues.text: These neurons are important for learning and self-awareness.
cues.en: These neurons are important for learning and self-awareness.
cues.zh: 這組神經元很重要 尤其對學習和自我覺察

cues.text: For example, watching someone do something physical, like knitting or putting on lipstick,
cues.en: For example, watching someone do something physical, like knitting or putting on lipstick,
cues.zh: 尤其對學習和自我覺察 例如，看到別人的動作 像是編織 或是擦口紅

cues.text: can help you do those same actions more accurately.
cues.en: can help you do those same actions more accurately.
cues.zh: 或是擦口紅 能讓我們精確地做出相同的動作

cues.text: Neuroimaging studies using fMRI, functional magnetic resonance imaging,
cues.en: Neuroimaging studies using fMRI, functional magnetic resonance imaging,
cues.zh: 腦神經影像利用醫學技術 也就是功能性核磁共振造影

cues.text: show us that when we seem someone yawn or even hear their yawn,
cues.en: show us that when we seem someone yawn or even hear their yawn,
cues.zh: 也就是功能性核磁共振造影 發現看到別人打哈欠 或只是聽到哈欠聲

cues.text: a specific area of the brain housing these mirror neurons tends to light up,
cues.en: a specific area of the brain housing these mirror neurons tends to light up,
cues.zh: 或只是聽到哈欠聲 我們腦中 有映象神經元的區塊 會有反應

cues.text: which, in turn, causes us to respond with the same action:
cues.en: which, in turn, causes us to respond with the same action:
cues.zh: 促使我們做出回應 重複相同的動作：打哈欠

cues.text: a yawn!
cues.en: a yawn!
cues.zh: 重複相同的動作：打哈欠

cues.text: Our psychological hypothesis also involves the work of these mirror neurons.
cues.en: Our psychological hypothesis also involves the work of these mirror neurons.
cues.zh: 最後要談的心理假說 也和映象神經元有關 稱為同理哈欠

cues.text: We will call it the empathy yawn.
cues.en: We will call it the empathy yawn.
cues.zh: 稱為同理哈欠

cues.text: Empathy is the ability to understand what someone else is feeling and partake in their emotion,
cues.en: Empathy is the ability to understand what someone else is feeling and partake in their emotion,
cues.zh: 同理心是種能力 能感知他人的感受 融入對方的情緒 對人這種社會性動物很重要

cues.text: a crucial ability for social animals like us.
cues.en: a crucial ability for social animals like us.
cues.zh: 對人這種社會性動物很重要

cues.text: Recently, neuroscientists have found that a subset of mirror neurons
cues.en: Recently, neuroscientists have found that a subset of mirror neurons
cues.zh: 近來，神經學家發現 映象神經元有組子集

cues.text: allows us to empathize with others' feelings at a deeper level.
cues.en: allows us to empathize with others' feelings at a deeper level.
cues.zh: 映象神經元有組子集 能讓我們同理他人 而且是深層同理

cues.text: Scientists discovered this empathetic response to yawning while testing the first hypothesis we mentioned,
cues.en: Scientists discovered this empathetic response to yawning while testing the first hypothesis we mentioned,
cues.zh: 事實上 同理哈欠現象 是在測試固定行為時 所發現的

cues.text: fixed action pattern.
cues.en: fixed action pattern.
cues.zh: 所發現的 這研究假設

cues.text: This study was set up to show that dogs would enact a yawn reflex
cues.en: This study was set up to show that dogs would enact a yawn reflex
cues.zh: 這研究假設 如果狗聽到人類打哈欠

cues.text: at the mere sound of a human yawn.
cues.en: at the mere sound of a human yawn.
cues.zh: 也會反射性地打起哈欠

cues.text: While their study showed this to be true, they found something else interesting.
cues.en: While their study showed this to be true, they found something else interesting.
cues.zh: 不僅證實了這種現象 還發現了其他有趣的事

cues.text: Dogs yawned more frequently at familiar yawns, such as from their owners,
cues.en: Dogs yawned more frequently at familiar yawns, such as from their owners,
cues.zh: 熟人的哈欠對狗比較有影響力 像是主人

cues.text: than at unfamiliar yawns from strangers.
cues.en: than at unfamiliar yawns from strangers.
cues.zh: 但對陌生人就不是了

cues.text: Following this research, other studies on humans and primates have also shown that contagious yawning
cues.en: Following this research, other studies on humans and primates have also shown that contagious yawning
cues.zh: 同樣地 以人類和靈長類為研究物件 也證實哈欠傳染 在熟人間發生的機率高於陌生人

cues.text: occurs more frequently among friends than strangers.
cues.en: occurs more frequently among friends than strangers.
cues.zh: 在熟人間發生的機率高於陌生人

cues.text: In fact, contagious yawning starts occurring when we are about four or five years old,
cues.en: In fact, contagious yawning starts occurring when we are about four or five years old,
cues.zh: 事實上，早在4、5 歲時 對哈欠傳染就有反應了

cues.text: at the point when children develop the ability to identify others' emotions properly.
cues.en: at the point when children develop the ability to identify others' emotions properly.
cues.zh: 對哈欠傳染就有反應了 那時 兒童開始能正確瞭解他人的情緒

cues.text: Still, while newer scientific studies aim to prove that contagious yawning
cues.en: Still, while newer scientific studies aim to prove that contagious yawning
cues.zh: 儘管相關研究推陳出新 想證明哈欠傳染的產生 是因為同理能力

cues.text: is based on this capacity for empathy, more research is needed to shed light on what exactly is going on.
cues.en: is based on this capacity for empathy, more research is needed to shed light on what exactly is going on.
cues.zh: 是因為同理能力 但其實 更需要研究的是背後的機制

cues.text: It's possible that the answer lies in another hypothesis altogether.
cues.en: It's possible that the answer lies in another hypothesis altogether.
cues.zh: 說不定真正的答案 就藏在其他假說裡

cues.text: The next time you get caught in a yawn, take a second to think about what just happened.
cues.en: The next time you get caught in a yawn, take a second to think about what just happened.
cues.zh: 下次打哈欠時 停下來想想剛才的情形

cues.text: Were you thinking about a yawn?
cues.en: Were you thinking about a yawn?
cues.zh: 是不是想到了哈欠這件事？

cues.text: Did someone near you yawn?
cues.en: Did someone near you yawn?
cues.zh: 附近有人打哈欠嗎？

cues.text: Was that person a stranger or someone close?
cues.en: Was that person a stranger or someone close?
cues.zh: 附近有人打哈欠嗎？ 是熟人？還是陌生人？

cues.text: And are you yawning right now?
cues.en: And are you yawning right now?
cues.zh: 你現在在打哈欠嗎？

lEXBxijQREo.title: How sugar affects the brain - Nicole Avena
lEXBxijQREo.speaker: TED-Ed
lEXBxijQREo.zh: 【TED-Ed】糖如何影響大腦 - Nicole Avena（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Picture warm, gooey cookies, crunchy candies, velvety cakes,
cues.en: Picture warm, gooey cookies, crunchy candies, velvety cakes,
cues.zh: 想像一個溫熱、黏膩的餅乾 爽脆的糖果 細緻可口的蛋糕

cues.text: waffle cones piled high with ice cream.
cues.en: waffle cones piled high with ice cream.
cues.zh: 甜筒上堆起的冰淇淋球

cues.text: Is your mouth watering?
cues.en: Is your mouth watering?
cues.zh: 甜筒上堆起的冰淇淋球 讓你口水直流了嗎？

cues.text: Are you craving dessert?
cues.en: Are you craving dessert?
cues.zh: 讓你想吃點心了嗎？ 為什麼？

cues.text: Why?
cues.en: Why?
cues.zh: 為什麼？ 是什麼讓你的腦子

cues.text: What happens in the brain that makes sugary foods so hard to resist?
cues.en: What happens in the brain that makes sugary foods so hard to resist?
cues.zh: 是什麼讓你的腦子 無法抗拒含糖食物呢？

cues.text: Sugar is a general term used to describe a class of molecules called carbohydrates,
cues.en: Sugar is a general term used to describe a class of molecules called carbohydrates,
cues.zh: 糖是對 碳水化合物分子的 總稱

cues.text: and it's found in a wide variety of food and drink.
cues.en: and it's found in a wide variety of food and drink.
cues.zh: 而它們存在許多食物、飲料中

cues.text: Just check the labels on sweet products you buy.
cues.en: Just check the labels on sweet products you buy.
cues.zh: 只要看看你買甜食上的標簽 葡萄糖

cues.text: Glucose, fructose, sucrose, maltose, lactose, dextrose, and starch
cues.en: Glucose, fructose, sucrose, maltose, lactose, dextrose, and starch
cues.zh: 葡萄糖 果糖 蔗糖 麥芽糖 乳糖 右旋糖 和澱粉 都是不同形態的糖類

cues.text: are all forms of sugar.
cues.en: are all forms of sugar.
cues.zh: 和澱粉 都是不同形態的糖類 果糖含量高的糖漿

cues.text: So are high-fructose corn syrup, fruit juice, raw sugar, and honey.
cues.en: So are high-fructose corn syrup, fruit juice, raw sugar, and honey.
cues.zh: 果糖含量高的糖漿 果汁 粗糖 和蜂蜜

cues.text: And sugar isn't just in candies and desserts, it's also added to tomato sauce,
cues.en: And sugar isn't just in candies and desserts, it's also added to tomato sauce,
cues.zh: 而且糖類不只在糖果、點心中 它也被加到番茄醬 優格

cues.text: yogurt, dried fruit, flavored waters, or granola bars.
cues.en: yogurt, dried fruit, flavored waters, or granola bars.
cues.zh: 優格 果乾 調味水 和燕麥棒中

cues.text: Since sugar is everywhere, it's important to understand how it affects the brain.
cues.en: Since sugar is everywhere, it's important to understand how it affects the brain.
cues.zh: 既然糖類無所不在 我們更要了解 糖對大腦的影響

cues.text: What happens when sugar hits your tongue?
cues.en: What happens when sugar hits your tongue?
cues.zh: 當糖沾上舌頭時 會造成什麼反應呢？

cues.text: And does eating a little bit of sugar make you crave more?
cues.en: And does eating a little bit of sugar make you crave more?
cues.zh: 當糖沾上舌頭時 會造成什麼反應呢？ 吃一點點糖 會不會讓你想吃更多？

cues.text: You take a bite of cereal.
cues.en: You take a bite of cereal.
cues.zh: 你吃一點麥片 其中所含的糖

cues.text: The sugars it contains activate the sweet-taste receptors, part of the taste buds on the tongue.
cues.en: The sugars it contains activate the sweet-taste receptors, part of the taste buds on the tongue.
cues.zh: 其中所含的糖 刺激了舌頭味蕾上的 甜味受器

cues.text: These receptors send a signal up to the brain stem, and from there, it forks off into many areas of the forebrain,
cues.en: These receptors send a signal up to the brain stem, and from there, it forks off into many areas of the forebrain,
cues.zh: 受器向大腦傳送訊號 在那訊號分支傳送到 前腦中的不同區域

cues.text: one of which is the cerebral cortex.
cues.en: one of which is the cerebral cortex.
cues.zh: 前腦中的不同區域 其中一個就是大腦皮層

cues.text: Different sections of the cerebral cortex process different tastes:
cues.en: Different sections of the cerebral cortex process different tastes:
cues.zh: 其中一個就是大腦皮層 大腦皮層中的不同分割槽 處理不同味覺訊號 苦味

cues.text: bitter, salty, umami, and, in our case, sweet.
cues.en: bitter, salty, umami, and, in our case, sweet.
cues.zh: 苦味 鹹味 鮮味 和我們討論的甜味

cues.text: From here, the signal activates the brain's reward system.
cues.en: From here, the signal activates the brain's reward system.
cues.zh: 和我們討論的甜味 訊號在這裡活化 大腦的報償系統

cues.text: This reward system is a series of electrical and chemical pathways
cues.en: This reward system is a series of electrical and chemical pathways
cues.zh: 這個報償系統是一系列 電子與化學的傳遞鏈

cues.text: across several different regions of the brain.
cues.en: across several different regions of the brain.
cues.zh: 電子與化學的傳遞鏈 橫跨大腦不同區域

cues.text: It's a complicated network, but it helps answer a single, subconscious question:
cues.en: It's a complicated network, but it helps answer a single, subconscious question:
cues.zh: 它是一個複雜的網路 但是它可以回答一個簡單 潛意識裡的問題 我要重複這個動作嗎？

cues.text: should I do that again?
cues.en: should I do that again?
cues.zh: 我要重複這個動作嗎？

cues.text: That warm, fuzzy feeling you get when you taste Grandma's chocolate cake?
cues.en: That warm, fuzzy feeling you get when you taste Grandma's chocolate cake?
cues.zh: 在品嘗奶奶巧克力蛋糕食 你這種溫暖、放鬆的感覺

cues.text: That's your reward system saying, "Mmm, yes!" And it's not just activated by food.
cues.en: That's your reward system saying, "Mmm, yes!" And it's not just activated by food.
cues.zh: 你這種溫暖、放鬆的感覺 這就是你的報償系統說： 「我還要！」 而且它不只可由食物啟動 社交

cues.text: Socializing, sexual behavior, and drugs are just a few examples of things and experiences
cues.en: Socializing, sexual behavior, and drugs are just a few examples of things and experiences
cues.zh: 社交 性行為 和藥物 只是其中幾件 事情或經驗 可以啟動報償系統的例子

cues.text: that also activate the reward system.
cues.en: that also activate the reward system.
cues.zh: 可以啟動報償系統的例子 但是過度活化報償系統

cues.text: But overactivating this reward system kickstarts a series of unfortunate events:
cues.en: But overactivating this reward system kickstarts a series of unfortunate events:
cues.zh: 但是過度活化報償系統 會造成許多不良後果： 失控

cues.text: loss of control, craving, and increased tolerance to sugar.
cues.en: loss of control, craving, and increased tolerance to sugar.
cues.zh: 失控 渴望 和對糖類耐受性增加

cues.text: Let's get back to our bite of cereal.
cues.en: Let's get back to our bite of cereal.
cues.zh: 讓我們回到剛所講的麥片 它向下進入到你的胃

cues.text: It travels down into your stomach and eventually into your gut.
cues.en: It travels down into your stomach and eventually into your gut.
cues.zh: 它向下進入到你的胃 再到達你的腸子

cues.text: And guess what?
cues.en: And guess what?
cues.zh: 再到達你的腸子 誰料的到呢？

cues.text: There are sugar receptors here, too.
cues.en: There are sugar receptors here, too.
cues.zh: 腸子也有糖類受器

cues.text: They are not taste buds, but they do send signals telling your brain that you're full
cues.en: They are not taste buds, but they do send signals telling your brain that you're full
cues.zh: 它們不是味蕾 但也能傳送訊號 告訴你的腦說 你已經吃飽了

cues.text: or that your body should produce more insulin to deal with the extra sugar you're eating.
cues.en: or that your body should produce more insulin to deal with the extra sugar you're eating.
cues.zh: 或告訴身體需要製造更多胰島素 去處理你多吃的糖

cues.text: The major currency of our reward system is dopamine, an important chemical or neurotransmitter.
cues.en: The major currency of our reward system is dopamine, an important chemical or neurotransmitter.
cues.zh: 報償系統中的 主要貨幣是多巴胺 它是重要的神經傳導物質

cues.text: There are many dopamine receptors in the forebrain, but they're not evenly distributed.
cues.en: There are many dopamine receptors in the forebrain, but they're not evenly distributed.
cues.zh: 它是重要的神經傳導物質 前腦中有很多多巴胺受體 但是分佈並不平均

cues.text: Certain areas contain dense clusters of receptors, and these dopamine hot spots are a part of our reward system.
cues.en: Certain areas contain dense clusters of receptors, and these dopamine hot spots are a part of our reward system.
cues.zh: 特定地方有密集、叢聚的受體 這些是多巴胺的熱點 也是報償系統的一部份

cues.text: Drugs like alcohol, nicotine, or heroin send dopamine into overdrive,
cues.en: Drugs like alcohol, nicotine, or heroin send dopamine into overdrive,
cues.zh: 藥物像是酒精 尼古丁 或海洛因 會造成多巴胺受體超載

cues.text: leading some people to constantly seek that high, in other words, to be addicted.
cues.en: leading some people to constantly seek that high, in other words, to be addicted.
cues.zh: 造成一些人持續追求這種快感 也就是成癮

cues.text: Sugar also causes dopamine to be released, though not as violently as drugs.
cues.en: Sugar also causes dopamine to be released, though not as violently as drugs.
cues.zh: 糖經由一種較藥物和緩的機制 促成多巴胺的釋放 有些食物含糖量較低

cues.text: And sugar is rare among dopamine-inducing foods.
cues.en: And sugar is rare among dopamine-inducing foods.
cues.zh: 有些食物含糖量較低 例如：花球甘藍就沒有作用

cues.text: Broccoli, for example, has no effect, which probably explains why it's so hard to get kids to eat their veggies.
cues.en: Broccoli, for example, has no effect, which probably explains why it's so hard to get kids to eat their veggies.
cues.zh: 例如：花球甘藍就沒有作用 這或許可以解釋 為什麼很難叫小孩吃青菜

cues.text: Speaking of healthy foods, let's say you're hungry and decide to eat a balanced meal.
cues.en: Speaking of healthy foods, let's say you're hungry and decide to eat a balanced meal.
cues.zh: 說到健康食物 假設你餓了 而且決定要吃一餐 你這麼做後 多巴胺量激增

cues.text: You do, and dopamine levels spike in the reward system hot spots.
cues.en: You do, and dopamine levels spike in the reward system hot spots.
cues.zh: 你這麼做後 多巴胺量激增 刺激報償系統的熱點

cues.text: But if you eat that same dish many days in a row, dopamine levels will spike less and less, eventually leveling out.
cues.en: But if you eat that same dish many days in a row, dopamine levels will spike less and less, eventually leveling out.
cues.zh: 但如果你一再吃同一道菜 多巴胺量會越來越低 最後和平常無異

cues.text: That's because when it comes to food, the brain evolved to pay special attention to new or different tastes.
cues.en: That's because when it comes to food, the brain evolved to pay special attention to new or different tastes.
cues.zh: 因為當刺激來自食物時 大腦演化出特別的機制 關注新、或不同的味道

cues.text: Why?
cues.en: Why?
cues.zh: 為什麼呢？ 有兩個原因

cues.text: Two reasons: first, to detect food that's gone bad.
cues.en: Two reasons: first, to detect food that's gone bad.
cues.zh: 有兩個原因 一、確定食物是否過期 二、因為如果我們的

cues.text: And second, because the more variety we have in our diet, the more likely we are to get all the nutrients we need.
cues.en: And second, because the more variety we have in our diet, the more likely we are to get all the nutrients we need.
cues.zh: 二、因為如果我們的 飲食越多樣化 我們就更有可能 得到所有所需營養

cues.text: To keep that variety up, we need to be able to recognize a new food,
cues.en: To keep that variety up, we need to be able to recognize a new food,
cues.zh: 為了保持多樣性 我們需要辨別新食物的能力

cues.text: and more importantly, we need to want to keep eating new foods.
cues.en: and more importantly, we need to want to keep eating new foods.
cues.zh: 我們需要辨別新食物的能力 更重要的是 我們必須想吃新食物

cues.text: And that's why the dopamine levels off when a food becomes boring.
cues.en: And that's why the dopamine levels off when a food becomes boring.
cues.zh: 我們必須想吃新食物 這就是為什麼食物相同時 多巴胺變化就不明顯

cues.text: Now, back to that meal.
cues.en: Now, back to that meal.
cues.zh: 回到我們所說的那一餐

cues.text: What happens if in place of the healthy, balanced dish, you eat sugar-rich food instead?
cues.en: What happens if in place of the healthy, balanced dish, you eat sugar-rich food instead?
cues.zh: 如果將健康、平衡的飲食 以高糖份的食物代替 會發生什麼事呢？

cues.text: If you rarely eat sugar or don't eat much at a time, the effect is similar to that of the balanced meal.
cues.en: If you rarely eat sugar or don't eat much at a time, the effect is similar to that of the balanced meal.
cues.zh: 如果你很少吃糖 或一次吃的不多 它的影響與均衡飲食相同

cues.text: But if you eat too much, the dopamine response does not level out.
cues.en: But if you eat too much, the dopamine response does not level out.
cues.zh: 它的影響與均衡飲食相同 如果你吃過量 多巴胺改變並不會逐漸下降

cues.text: In other words, eating lots of sugar will continue to feel rewarding.
cues.en: In other words, eating lots of sugar will continue to feel rewarding.
cues.zh: 換句話說，吃大量的糖 會繼續使人 有被回饋的感覺

cues.text: In this way, sugar behaves a little bit like a drug.
cues.en: In this way, sugar behaves a little bit like a drug.
cues.zh: 這麼說來，糖就像毒品一樣

cues.text: It's one reason people seem to be hooked on sugary foods.
cues.en: It's one reason people seem to be hooked on sugary foods.
cues.zh: 這麼說來，糖就像毒品一樣 這是為什麼有人會對 高糖食物成癮的原因

cues.text: So, think back to all those different kinds of sugar.
cues.en: So, think back to all those different kinds of sugar.
cues.zh: 高糖食物成癮的原因 想想各種不同的糖 每種都各有不同

cues.text: Each one is unique, but every time any sugar is consumed, it kickstarts a domino effect in the brain that sparks a rewarding feeling.
cues.en: Each one is unique, but every time any sugar is consumed, it kickstarts a domino effect in the brain that sparks a rewarding feeling.
cues.zh: 每種都各有不同 但是吃進不同的糖 都會刺激腦中的多巴胺釋放 造成被回饋的感覺

cues.text: Too much, too often, and things can go into overdrive.
cues.en: Too much, too often, and things can go into overdrive.
cues.zh: 吃太多或太頻繁 都會造成超載

cues.text: So, yes, overconsumption of sugar can have addictive effects on the brain,
cues.en: So, yes, overconsumption of sugar can have addictive effects on the brain,
cues.zh: 所以過量攝取糖類 也會造成大腦的成癮

cues.text: but a wedge of cake once in a while won't hurt you.
cues.en: but a wedge of cake once in a while won't hurt you.
cues.zh: 但是偶而吃塊蛋糕無傷大雅

K2sc_ck5BZU.title: What is schizophrenia? - Anees Bahji
K2sc_ck5BZU.speaker: TED-Ed
K2sc_ck5BZU.zh: 【TED-Ed】什麼是精神分裂症？ ——阿內斯·巴吉（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Schizophrenia was first identified more than a century ago,
cues.en: Schizophrenia was first identified more than a century ago,
cues.zh: 初次發現思覺失調症 是至少一個世紀以前的事，

cues.text: but we still don’t know its exact causes.
cues.en: but we still don’t know its exact causes.
cues.zh: 初次發現思覺失調症 是至少一個世紀以前的事， 但我們目前仍然不知道 它的確切成因。 它仍然是現今最被誤解 及汙名化的疾病之一。

cues.text: It remains one of the most misunderstood and stigmatized illnesses today.
cues.en: It remains one of the most misunderstood and stigmatized illnesses today.
cues.zh: 它仍然是現今最被誤解 及汙名化的疾病之一。

cues.text: So, let’s walk through what we do know— from symptoms to causes and treatments.
cues.en: So, let’s walk through what we do know— from symptoms to causes and treatments.
cues.zh: 那麼，咱們來談談那些已知的事實 從症狀到成因及治療。

cues.text: Schizophrenia is considered a syndrome, which means it may encompass a number of related disorders
cues.en: Schizophrenia is considered a syndrome, which means it may encompass a number of related disorders
cues.zh: 思覺失調症被認為是一種症候群， 意思就是說，它可能 包含多種相關的病徵，

cues.text: that have similar symptoms but varying causes.
cues.en: that have similar symptoms but varying causes.
cues.zh: 意思就是說，它可能 包含多種相關的病徵， 具有類似的症狀， 但各式各樣的成因。

cues.text: Every person with schizophrenia has slightly different symptoms,
cues.en: Every person with schizophrenia has slightly different symptoms,
cues.zh: 每位有思覺失調症的人 都有些微不同的症狀，

cues.text: and the first signs can be easy to miss— subtle personality changes, irritability,
cues.en: and the first signs can be easy to miss— subtle personality changes, irritability,
cues.zh: 每位有思覺失調症的人 都有些微不同的症狀， 且最初的徵兆很容易被忽視—— 人格發生些微改變、易怒，

cues.text: or a gradual encroachment of unusual thoughts.
cues.en: or a gradual encroachment of unusual thoughts.
cues.zh: 人格發生些微改變、易怒， 或漸漸被不尋常的想法給侵佔。

cues.text: Patients are usually diagnosed after the onset of psychosis,
cues.en: Patients are usually diagnosed after the onset of psychosis,
cues.zh: 病人通常是在精神病 發作之後才被診斷出來，

cues.text: which typically occurs in the late teens or early twenties for men
cues.en: which typically occurs in the late teens or early twenties for men
cues.zh: 病人通常是在精神病 發作之後才被診斷出來， 男性多半會發生在 接近二十歲或二十歲初頭時， 女性多半會發生在 接近三十歲或三十歲初頭時。

cues.text: and the late twenties or early thirties for women.
cues.en: and the late twenties or early thirties for women.
cues.zh: 女性多半會發生在 接近三十歲或三十歲初頭時。

cues.text: A first psychotic episode can feature delusions, hallucinations,
cues.en: A first psychotic episode can feature delusions, hallucinations,
cues.zh: 在第一次精神病發作時， 可能會有妄想、幻覺，

cues.text: and disordered speech and behavior.
cues.en: and disordered speech and behavior.
cues.zh: 在第一次精神病發作時， 可能會有妄想、幻覺， 以及錯亂的言行舉止。

cues.text: These are called positive symptoms, meaning they occur in people with schizophrenia
cues.en: These are called positive symptoms, meaning they occur in people with schizophrenia
cues.zh: 這些叫做正性症狀， 意即，思覺失調症患者才會有，

cues.text: but not in the general population.
cues.en: but not in the general population.
cues.zh: 一般人則不會。

cues.text: It’s a common misperception that people with schizophrenia
cues.en: It’s a common misperception that people with schizophrenia
cues.zh: 常見的錯誤觀念是， 有思覺失調症的人

cues.text: have multiple personalities, but these symptoms indicate a disruption of thought processes,
cues.en: have multiple personalities, but these symptoms indicate a disruption of thought processes,
cues.zh: 常見的錯誤觀念是， 有思覺失調症的人 就會有多重人格， 但實際上這些症狀是 思考過程被打斷的表現，

cues.text: rather than the manifestation of another personality.
cues.en: rather than the manifestation of another personality.
cues.zh: 但實際上這些症狀是 思考過程被打斷的表現， 而並非另一個人格的形成出現。

cues.text: Schizophrenia also has negative symptoms, these are qualities that are reduced in people with schizophrenia,
cues.en: Schizophrenia also has negative symptoms, these are qualities that are reduced in people with schizophrenia,
cues.zh: 思覺失調症也會出現負性症狀， 也就是有思覺失調症的人 身上會缺乏這些特性，

cues.text: such as motivation, expression of emotion, or speech.
cues.en: such as motivation, expression of emotion, or speech.
cues.zh: 也就是有思覺失調症的人 身上會缺乏這些特性， 比如動力、情緒表達，或語言能力。

cues.text: There are cognitive symptoms as well, like difficulty concentrating,
cues.en: There are cognitive symptoms as well, like difficulty concentrating,
cues.zh: 也有一些認知症狀， 比如難以集中注意力、 記住資訊，以及做決策。

cues.text: remembering information, and making decisions.
cues.en: remembering information, and making decisions.
cues.zh: 記住資訊，以及做決策。

cues.text: So what causes the onset of psychosis?
cues.en: So what causes the onset of psychosis?
cues.zh: 所以，造成精神病發作的原因是什麼？ 成因很可能不是單一的，

cues.text: There likely isn’t one single cause, but a combination of genetic and environmental risk factors that contribute.
cues.en: There likely isn’t one single cause, but a combination of genetic and environmental risk factors that contribute.
cues.zh: 成因很可能不是單一的， 而是基因與環境風險因子 結合在一起所導致。

cues.text: Schizophrenia has some of the strongest genetic links of any psychiatric illness.
cues.en: Schizophrenia has some of the strongest genetic links of any psychiatric illness.
cues.zh: 在所有的精神疾病中， 思覺失調症和基因的連結最強。

cues.text: Though about 1% of people have schizophrenia, children or siblings of people with schizophrenia are ten times likelier
cues.en: Though about 1% of people have schizophrenia, children or siblings of people with schizophrenia are ten times likelier
cues.zh: 在所有的精神疾病中， 思覺失調症和基因的連結最強。 雖然約有 1% 的人有思覺失調症， 思覺失調症患者的 孩子或手足的發病率， 可能會比其他人要高十倍。

cues.text: to develop the disease, and an identical twin of someone with schizophrenia
cues.en: to develop the disease, and an identical twin of someone with schizophrenia
cues.zh: 可能會比其他人要高十倍。 如果同卵雙生的雙胞胎中一人 有思覺失調症，

cues.text: has a 40% chance of being affected.
cues.en: has a 40% chance of being affected.
cues.zh: 如果同卵雙生的雙胞胎中一人 有思覺失調症， 另外一人則有四成的機會被影響到。

cues.text: Often, immediate relatives of people with schizophrenia exhibit milder versions of traits associated with the disorder—
cues.en: Often, immediate relatives of people with schizophrenia exhibit milder versions of traits associated with the disorder—
cues.zh: 通常，思覺失調症患者的直系親人 也會呈現出該病症的相關特質， 只是比較輕微——

cues.text: but not to an extent that requires treatment.
cues.en: but not to an extent that requires treatment.
cues.zh: 也會呈現出該病症的相關特質， 只是比較輕微—— 還沒有到需要治療的程度。

cues.text: Multiple genes almost certainly play a role, but we don’t know how many, or which ones.
cues.en: Multiple genes almost certainly play a role, but we don’t know how many, or which ones.
cues.zh: 幾乎可以確定思覺失調症 和多個基因相關， 但我們還不知道 基因的具體個數和型別。

cues.text: Environmental factors like exposure to certain viruses in early infancy
cues.en: Environmental factors like exposure to certain viruses in early infancy
cues.zh: 環境因子，如在嬰兒期 初期接觸到某些病毒，

cues.text: might increase the chance that someone will develop schizophrenia,
cues.en: might increase the chance that someone will develop schizophrenia,
cues.zh: 環境因子，如在嬰兒期 初期接觸到某些病毒， 可能會增加患思覺失調症的機會，

cues.text: and use of some drugs, including marijuana, may trigger the onset of psychosis
cues.en: and use of some drugs, including marijuana, may trigger the onset of psychosis
cues.zh: 可能會增加患思覺失調症的機會， 而服用某些藥物，包括大麻， 可能會促使易受影響者發病。

cues.text: in highly susceptible individuals.
cues.en: in highly susceptible individuals.
cues.zh: 可能會促使易受影響者發病。

cues.text: These factors don’t affect everyone the same way.
cues.en: These factors don’t affect everyone the same way.
cues.zh: 這些因子對每一個人的影響不同。

cues.text: For those with very low genetic risk, no amount of exposure to environmental risk factors
cues.en: For those with very low genetic risk, no amount of exposure to environmental risk factors
cues.zh: 對基因風險非常低的人來說， 不論暴露在多少量的 環境風險因子之下， 都不會讓他們發展出思覺失調症；

cues.text: will lead them to develop schizophrenia; for those with very high risk, moderate additional risk might tip the balance.
cues.en: will lead them to develop schizophrenia; for those with very high risk, moderate additional risk might tip the balance.
cues.zh: 都不會讓他們發展出思覺失調症； 至於風險非常高的人， 只要減少額外風險 就有可能會破壞平衡。

cues.text: The antipsychotic drugs used to treat schizophrenia have helped researchers
cues.en: The antipsychotic drugs used to treat schizophrenia have helped researchers
cues.zh: 用來治療思覺失調症的 抗精神疾病藥物能協助研究者

cues.text: work backwards to trace signatures of the disorder in the brain.
cues.en: work backwards to trace signatures of the disorder in the brain.
cues.zh: 用來治療思覺失調症的 抗精神疾病藥物能協助研究者 追蹤這種病症在大腦中的特徵。

cues.text: Traditional antipsychotics block dopamine receptors.
cues.en: Traditional antipsychotics block dopamine receptors.
cues.zh: 傳統的抗精神疾病藥物 會阻隔多巴胺受體。 對於減輕正性症狀很有效果，

cues.text: They can be very effective in reducing positive symptoms,
cues.en: They can be very effective in reducing positive symptoms,
cues.zh: 對於減輕正性症狀很有效果， 因為這些症狀和大腦中 特定通路的多巴胺含量過高有關。

cues.text: which are linked to an excess of dopamine in particular brain pathways.
cues.en: which are linked to an excess of dopamine in particular brain pathways.
cues.zh: 對於減輕正性症狀很有效果， 因為這些症狀和大腦中 特定通路的多巴胺含量過高有關。

cues.text: But the same drugs can make negative symptoms worse, and we’ve found that negative symptoms of schizophrenia may be tied
cues.en: But the same drugs can make negative symptoms worse, and we’ve found that negative symptoms of schizophrenia may be tied
cues.zh: 但，同樣的藥物也有可能 讓負性症狀更嚴重， 研究已經發現， 思覺失調症的負性症狀 可能和大腦其他區域的 多巴胺含量太低有關。

cues.text: to too little dopamine in other brain areas.
cues.en: to too little dopamine in other brain areas.
cues.zh: 可能和大腦其他區域的 多巴胺含量太低有關。 有些思覺失調症患者會出現 神經組織流失的狀況，

cues.text: Some people with schizophrenia show a loss of neural tissue, and it’s unclear whether this atrophy is a result of the disease itself
cues.en: Some people with schizophrenia show a loss of neural tissue, and it’s unclear whether this atrophy is a result of the disease itself
cues.zh: 有些思覺失調症患者會出現 神經組織流失的狀況， 我們仍不清楚這種萎縮 是該疾病本身的直接結果，

cues.text: or drug-induced suppression of signaling.
cues.en: or drug-induced suppression of signaling.
cues.zh: 我們仍不清楚這種萎縮 是該疾病本身的直接結果， 或是藥物導致訊號傳遞被壓制的結果。

cues.text: Fortunately, newer generations of antipsychotics aim to address
cues.en: Fortunately, newer generations of antipsychotics aim to address
cues.zh: 幸運的是，近幾代的抗精神病藥物 都是透過針對多種神經傳遞介質 來解決這些問題，

cues.text: some of these issues by targeting multiple neurotransmitters,
cues.en: some of these issues by targeting multiple neurotransmitters,
cues.zh: 都是透過針對多種神經傳遞介質 來解決這些問題，

cues.text: like serotonin in addition to dopamine.
cues.en: like serotonin in addition to dopamine.
cues.zh: 都是透過針對多種神經傳遞介質 來解決這些問題， 比如血清素加上多巴胺。

cues.text: It’s clear that no one transmitter system is responsible for all symptoms,
cues.en: It’s clear that no one transmitter system is responsible for all symptoms,
cues.zh: 可以確定的一點是，所有症狀 並不是單一傳遞介質系統造成，

cues.text: and because these drugs affect signaling throughout the brain and body,
cues.en: and because these drugs affect signaling throughout the brain and body,
cues.zh: 可以確定的一點是，所有症狀 並不是單一傳遞介質系統造成， 而且，因為這些藥物會影響 大腦和身體各處的訊號傳遞，

cues.text: they can have other side effects like weight gain.
cues.en: they can have other side effects like weight gain.
cues.zh: 而且，因為這些藥物會影響 大腦和身體各處的訊號傳遞， 服藥可能會引起其他 副作用，如體重增加。 儘管有併發症， 抗精神病藥物仍然非常有效，

cues.text: In spite of these complications, antipsychotics can be very effective,
cues.en: In spite of these complications, antipsychotics can be very effective,
cues.zh: 儘管有併發症， 抗精神病藥物仍然非常有效，

cues.text: especially when combined with other interventions like cognitive-behavioral therapy.
cues.en: especially when combined with other interventions like cognitive-behavioral therapy.
cues.zh: 儘管有併發症， 抗精神病藥物仍然非常有效， 特別是與其他醫療介入方式結合， 比如認知行為治療。

cues.text: Electroconvulsive therapy, though it provides relatively short-lived relief,
cues.en: Electroconvulsive therapy, though it provides relatively short-lived relief,
cues.zh: 雖然電痙攣療法僅能提供 相對短暫的舒緩，

cues.text: is also re-emerging as an effective treatment, especially when other options have failed.
cues.en: is also re-emerging as an effective treatment, especially when other options have failed.
cues.zh: 雖然電痙攣療法僅能提供 相對短暫的舒緩， 但也被再次用作有效治療方式， 特別是在其他療法都無效時。 早期介入治療也非常重要。

cues.text: Early intervention is also extremely important.
cues.en: Early intervention is also extremely important.
cues.zh: 早期介入治療也非常重要。 如果得了精神病後的 數個月或數年沒有去治療，

cues.text: After months or years of untreated psychosis, certain psychoses can become embedded in someone’s personality.
cues.en: After months or years of untreated psychosis, certain psychoses can become embedded in someone’s personality.
cues.zh: 如果得了精神病後的 數個月或數年沒有去治療， 某些精神異常可能就會 變成病人人格的一部分。 然而，由於精神病的診斷 會讓人背上沒人性的汙名，

cues.text: And yet, the dehumanizing stigma attached to this diagnosis
cues.en: And yet, the dehumanizing stigma attached to this diagnosis
cues.zh: 然而，由於精神病的診斷 會讓人背上沒人性的汙名，

cues.text: can prevent people from seeking help.
cues.en: can prevent people from seeking help.
cues.zh: 然而，由於精神病的診斷 會讓人背上沒人性的汙名， 人們會因此而選擇不去求助。 一般認為思覺失調症患者很危險，

cues.text: People with schizophrenia are often perceived as dangerous,
cues.en: People with schizophrenia are often perceived as dangerous,
cues.zh: 一般認為思覺失調症患者很危險， 但實際上，他們更有可能是 暴力的受害者

cues.text: but are actually much more likely to be the victims of violence
cues.en: but are actually much more likely to be the victims of violence
cues.zh: 但實際上，他們更有可能是 暴力的受害者 而並非加害者。

cues.text: than the perpetrators.
cues.en: than the perpetrators.
cues.zh: 而並非加害者。 適當的治療能協助降低

cues.text: And proper treatment may help reduce the likelihood of violence associated with schizophrenia.
cues.en: And proper treatment may help reduce the likelihood of violence associated with schizophrenia.
cues.zh: 適當的治療能協助降低 思覺失調症相關暴力 發生的可能性。

cues.text: That’s why education— for patients, their families, and their communities—
cues.en: That’s why education— for patients, their families, and their communities—
cues.zh: 那就是為什麼教育——對病人、 其家屬、其社群的教育——

cues.text: helps erode the stigma and improves access to treatment.
cues.en: helps erode the stigma and improves access to treatment.
cues.zh: 那就是為什麼教育——對病人、 其家屬、其社群的教育—— 能協助消除汙名， 並讓更多人得到治療。

Z8wLQ3NCBgg.speaker: TED-Ed
Z8wLQ3NCBgg.zh: 【TED-Ed】關於蝙蝠的真相 - 艾米雷（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Flying through the night, I watch over this world, a silent guardian, a watchful protector, a dark knight, I'm...
cues.en: Flying through the night, I watch over this world, a silent guardian, a watchful protector, a dark knight, I'm...
cues.zh: 飛翔在夜空之中，我守護著世界， 一名沉默的守衛、警覺的捍衛者、 黑暗的騎士，我就是.... 好啦好啦！我不是蝙蝠俠 我不過就是隻蝙蝠。

cues.text: Okay, fine. So, I'm not Batman. I'm just a bat.
cues.en: Okay, fine. So, I'm not Batman. I'm just a bat.
cues.zh: 好啦好啦！我不是蝙蝠俠 我不過就是隻蝙蝠。 不過就像蝙蝠俠一樣，我總是受人誤會，

cues.text: But like Batman, I'm often misunderstood.
cues.en: But like Batman, I'm often misunderstood.
cues.zh: 好啦好啦！我不是蝙蝠俠 我不過就是隻蝙蝠。 不過就像蝙蝠俠一樣，我總是受人誤會，

cues.text: People think I'm scary, strange and dangerous.
cues.en: People think I'm scary, strange and dangerous.
cues.zh: 不過就像蝙蝠俠一樣，我總是受人誤會， 人們認為我是可怕、詭異、危險的，

cues.text: If they only knew my story, though, I'd be cheered as a hero.
cues.en: If they only knew my story, though, I'd be cheered as a hero.
cues.zh: 人們認為我是可怕、詭異、危險的， 只要他們曉得了我的功蹟， 我將會被當成英雄受人仰頌。

cues.text: When people think of bats, many think of vampires who want to suck their blood.
cues.en: When people think of bats, many think of vampires who want to suck their blood.
cues.zh: 只要他們曉得了我的功蹟， 我將會被當成英雄受人仰頌。 當人們想起蝙蝠時， 許多人就想到 打算吸他們血的吸血鬼，

cues.text: But the truth is that out of over 1200 bat species, only three are vampire bats.
cues.en: But the truth is that out of over 1200 bat species, only three are vampire bats.
cues.zh: 許多人就想到 打算吸他們血的吸血鬼， 但是真相是：世上超過1,200個品種， 其中只有3種是吸血蝙蝠，

cues.text: Out of these three, only one prefers the blood of mammals, and even these bats mostly feed on cattle.
cues.en: Out of these three, only one prefers the blood of mammals, and even these bats mostly feed on cattle.
cues.zh: 當中又只有1種嗜吸哺乳類的血， 而牠們大多也只是吸牛血而已，

cues.text: Maybe that still doesn't seem so great, but vampire bats can be a great help to humans.
cues.en: Maybe that still doesn't seem so great, but vampire bats can be a great help to humans.
cues.zh: 而牠們大多也只是吸牛血而已， 也許那聽起來也算不上什麼好事； 但吸血蝙蝠能變得對人類極為有益，

cues.text: A chemical known as desmoteplase found in vampire bat saliva
cues.en: A chemical known as desmoteplase found in vampire bat saliva
cues.zh: 在蝙蝠唾液裡發現名為 「去氨普酶」的化學物質 有助於溶解血栓，

cues.text: helps break down blood clots, and is being tested by recovering stroke victims.
cues.en: helps break down blood clots, and is being tested by recovering stroke victims.
cues.zh: 有助於溶解血栓， 已被測試來治療中風患者。 其他一千多種蝙蝠大約有 70%是以昆蟲為食，

cues.text: Of the remaining 1000+ species of bats, about 70% feed on insects.
cues.en: Of the remaining 1000+ species of bats, about 70% feed on insects.
cues.zh: 已被測試來治療中風患者。 其他一千多種蝙蝠大約有 70%是以昆蟲為食，

cues.text: These bats help control the real vampires: mosquitos, whose nasty bites are not just annoying
cues.en: These bats help control the real vampires: mosquitos, whose nasty bites are not just annoying
cues.zh: 這些蝙蝠有助於管控 真正的吸血鬼「蚊子」， 其令人討厭的叮咬不僅煩人， 還會散佈像是西尼羅病毒之類的疾病，

cues.text: but spread diseases, like West Nile virus.
cues.en: but spread diseases, like West Nile virus.
cues.zh: 其令人討厭的叮咬不僅煩人， 還會散佈像是西尼羅病毒之類的疾病，

cues.text: A single little brown bat can eat 1000 insects every hour,
cues.en: A single little brown bat can eat 1000 insects every hour,
cues.zh: 一隻小型棕蝠每小時 能吃掉1000隻昆蟲， 一群墨西哥遊離尾蝠一個晚上

cues.text: and a colony of Mexican free-tailed bats can eat several tons of moths
cues.en: and a colony of Mexican free-tailed bats can eat several tons of moths
cues.zh: 一隻小型棕蝠每小時 能吃掉1000隻昆蟲， 一群墨西哥遊離尾蝠一個晚上

cues.text: in just one night.
cues.en: in just one night.
cues.zh: 就可以吃掉數噸重之飛蛾。 單單在美國，

cues.text: In the United States alone, bats provide an estimated 3.7 billion dollars worth
cues.en: In the United States alone, bats provide an estimated 3.7 billion dollars worth
cues.zh: 就可以吃掉數噸重之飛蛾。 單單在美國， 蝙蝠貢獻給農人們估計有 37億美元價值之不收費害蟲控制，

cues.text: of free pest control for farmers, which benefits everyone who eats the foods that they grow.
cues.en: of free pest control for farmers, which benefits everyone who eats the foods that they grow.
cues.zh: 37億美元價值之不收費害蟲控制， 嘉惠到食用這些食物的每一個人。 果蝠因為牠們的大尺寸 而被稱為巨蝠，

cues.text: Fruit bats, also called megabats because of their large size,
cues.en: Fruit bats, also called megabats because of their large size,
cues.zh: 果蝠因為牠們的大尺寸 而被稱為巨蝠，

cues.text: are important for the role they play in plant pollination.
cues.en: are important for the role they play in plant pollination.
cues.zh: 果蝠因為牠們的大尺寸 而被稱為巨蝠， 牠們在授粉上扮演重要的角色， 當覓食花蜜和果實時， 藉由在花朵間遊走，

cues.zh: 為什麼知道血型是重要的事？ 因為當人們需要輸血時， 找出適合的血型， 是件攸關生死的大問題。

cues.text: If someone with type A blood is given type B blood, or vice versa,
cues.en: If someone with type A blood is given type B blood, or vice versa,
cues.zh: 假若將 B 型血輸給 A 血型患者， 或是將 A 型血輸給 B 血型患者，

cues.text: their antibodies will reject the foreign antigens and attack them,
cues.en: their antibodies will reject the foreign antigens and attack them,
cues.zh: 假若將 B 型血輸給 A 血型患者， 或是將 A 型血輸給 B 血型患者， 抗體便會排斥和攻擊外來的抗原，

cues.text: potentially causing the transfused blood to clot.
cues.en: potentially causing the transfused blood to clot.
cues.zh: 抗體便會排斥和攻擊外來的抗原， 結果使血液產生凝結現象。 但是，AB 血型的患者體內， 同時具有 A 型和 B 型抗原，

cues.text: But because people with type AB blood produce both A and B antigens,
cues.en: But because people with type AB blood produce both A and B antigens,
cues.zh: 但是，AB 血型的患者體內， 同時具有 A 型和 B 型抗原， 因此抗體可以辨認兩種抗原， 而不會攻擊它。

cues.text: they don't make antibodies against them, so they will recognize either as safe,
cues.en: they don't make antibodies against them, so they will recognize either as safe,
cues.zh: 因此抗體可以辨認兩種抗原， 而不會攻擊它。 因此 AB 血型是萬能受血者。

cues.text: making them universal recipients.
cues.en: making them universal recipients.
cues.zh: 因此 AB 血型是萬能受血者。

cues.text: On the other hand, people with blood type O do not produce either antigen,
cues.en: On the other hand, people with blood type O do not produce either antigen,
cues.zh: 因此 AB 血型是萬能受血者。 另一方面， O 血型不能製造出 A 型和 B 型抗原， 所以他們可被稱為 「萬能捐血者」。

cues.text: which makes them universal donors, but will cause their immune system to make antibodies
cues.en: which makes them universal donors, but will cause their immune system to make antibodies
cues.zh: 所以他們可被稱為 「萬能捐血者」。 但 O 血型患者體內沒有抗原，

cues.text: that reject any other blood type.
cues.en: that reject any other blood type.
cues.zh: 所以免疫系統便會製造抗體， 排斥其他血型輸入。 不幸的是，現在醫生要替輸血者 與病患進行血型配對，

cues.text: Unfortunately, matching donors and recipients is a bit more complicated
cues.en: Unfortunately, matching donors and recipients is a bit more complicated
cues.zh: 不幸的是，現在醫生要替輸血者 與病患進行血型配對， 變得更為困難了， 因為又多了一種抗原系統，

cues.text: due to additional antigen systems, particular the Rh factor,
cues.en: due to additional antigen systems, particular the Rh factor,
cues.zh: 變得更為困難了， 因為又多了一種抗原系統， 我們稱為 Rh 因子。 科學家最早是從恆河猴身上 發現這種抗原並以此命名，

cues.text: named after the Rhesus monkeys in which it was first isolated.
cues.en: named after the Rhesus monkeys in which it was first isolated.
cues.zh: 科學家最早是從恆河猴身上 發現這種抗原並以此命名，

cues.text: Rh+ or Rh- refers to the presence or absence of the D antigen
cues.en: Rh+ or Rh- refers to the presence or absence of the D antigen
cues.zh: 在 Rh 血型系統當中， 分為 Rh+ 與 Rh- 兩類， Rh+ 前者具有 D 抗原， 而 Rh- 沒有 D 抗原。

cues.text: of the Rh blood group system.
cues.en: of the Rh blood group system.
cues.zh: Rh+ 前者具有 D 抗原， 而 Rh- 沒有 D 抗原。

cues.text: And in addition to impeding some blood transfusions, it can cause severe complications in pregnancy.
cues.en: And in addition to impeding some blood transfusions, it can cause severe complications in pregnancy.
cues.zh: Rh 血型系統， 可能會延遲病患輸血的時間， 或是為孕婦帶來致命的風險， 如果母親的血型是 Rh- ， 而胎兒是 Rh+ ，

cues.text: If an Rh- mother is carrying an Rh+ child,
cues.en: If an Rh- mother is carrying an Rh+ child,
cues.zh: 或是為孕婦帶來致命的風險， 如果母親的血型是 Rh- ， 而胎兒是 Rh+ ，

cues.text: her body will produce Rh antibodies that may cross the placenta
cues.en: her body will produce Rh antibodies that may cross the placenta
cues.zh: 如果母親的血型是 Rh- ， 而胎兒是 Rh+ ， 母親體內會製造出 Rh 抗體， 可能會進入胎盤，並且攻擊胎兒，

cues.text: and attack the fetus, a condition known as hemolytic disease of the newborn.
cues.en: and attack the fetus, a condition known as hemolytic disease of the newborn.
cues.zh: 可能會進入胎盤，並且攻擊胎兒， 這種情況稱為 「新生兒溶血癥」。

cues.text: Some cultures believe blood type to be associated with personality,
cues.en: Some cultures believe blood type to be associated with personality,
cues.zh: 在某些文明，人們相信 血型和人的性格有關， 雖然這並沒有科學根據。

cues.text: though this is not supported by science.
cues.en: though this is not supported by science.
cues.zh: 雖然這並沒有科學根據。

cues.text: And though the proportions of different blood types vary between human populations,
cues.en: And though the proportions of different blood types vary between human populations,
cues.zh: 各種血型的人數比例， 在不同人種 也有很大的差異， 科學家仍無法確定， 這種演變的原因為何？

cues.text: scientists aren't sure why they evolved; perhaps as protection against blood born diseases,
cues.en: scientists aren't sure why they evolved; perhaps as protection against blood born diseases,
cues.zh: 在不同人種 也有很大的差異， 科學家仍無法確定， 這種演變的原因為何？ 或許為了保護人們 對抗血液傳染疾病，

cues.text: or due to random genetic drift.
cues.en: or due to random genetic drift.
cues.zh: 或許為了保護人們 對抗血液傳染疾病， 也或許是因為 隨機遺傳變異。

cues.text: Finally, different species have different sets of antigens.
cues.en: Finally, different species have different sets of antigens.
cues.zh: 也或許是因為 隨機遺傳變異。 最後，不同種類的生物 具有不同的抗原組，

cues.text: In fact, the four main blood types shared by us apes
cues.en: In fact, the four main blood types shared by us apes
cues.zh: 最後，不同種類的生物 具有不同的抗原組， 事實上，我們和猿㺅一樣 都有四大類血型，

cues.text: seem paltry in comparison to the thirteen types found in dogs.
cues.en: seem paltry in comparison to the thirteen types found in dogs.
cues.zh: 但是和狗擁有 13 種血型相比， 就顯得不足為奇了。

cues.text: So they already conserve heat naturally without having to resort to behaviors like loafing.
cues.en: So they already conserve heat naturally without having to resort to behaviors like loafing.

cues.text: But here’s the really weird bit: like your plastic lawn ornament, a flamingo doesn’t actually have to be alive
cues.en: But here’s the really weird bit: like your plastic lawn ornament, a flamingo doesn’t actually have to be alive
cues.zh: 但真正奇怪的是：就像你的塑膠草坪裝飾一樣，火烈鳥其實不一定是活的

cues.text: to successfully maintain a one-legged standing position.
cues.en: to successfully maintain a one-legged standing position.
cues.zh: 成功地保持單腳站立姿勢。

cues.text: That somewhat horrible truth is the result of one very weird experiment.
cues.en: That somewhat horrible truth is the result of one very weird experiment.
cues.zh: 這個有點可怕的事實是一個非常奇怪的實驗的結果。

cues.text: Researchers were compelled to ask this macabre question because they knew that flamingos will often sleep
cues.en: Researchers were compelled to ask this macabre question because they knew that flamingos will often sleep
cues.zh: 研究人員被迫問這個可怕的問題，因為他們知道火烈鳥經常睡覺

cues.text: while standing on one leg.
cues.en: while standing on one leg.
cues.zh: 單腳站立時。

cues.text: Which would be exceedingly difficult if it wasn’t something that came really, really easily to them.
cues.en: Which would be exceedingly difficult if it wasn’t something that came really, really easily to them.
cues.zh: 如果這對他們來說不是非常非常容易的事情，那麼這將是極其困難的。

cues.text: I mean, like, have you even ever tried to prop up your own head while sleeping on an airplane?
cues.en: I mean, like, have you even ever tried to prop up your own head while sleeping on an airplane?
cues.zh: 我的意思是，你有沒有嘗試過在飛機上睡覺時支撐自己的頭？

cues.text: Like, you can’t even do that without...gah.
cues.en: Like, you can’t even do that without...gah.

cues.text: But as it turns out, flamingos don’t have to invest that much muscle power to stay upright.
cues.en: But as it turns out, flamingos don’t have to invest that much muscle power to stay upright.
cues.zh: 但事實證明，火烈鳥不需要投入那麼多的肌肉力量來保持直立。

cues.text: Scientists confirmed this by taking dead flamingos and propping them back up on one leg.
cues.en: Scientists confirmed this by taking dead flamingos and propping them back up on one leg.
cues.zh: 科學家們透過取出死去的火烈鳥並將它們用一條腿支撐起來證實了這一點。

cues.text: Which makes you wonder what they say when people ask them what they do for a living at a party.
cues.en: Which makes you wonder what they say when people ask them what they do for a living at a party.
cues.zh: 這讓你想知道當人們在聚會上問他們以什麼為生時他們會說什麼。

cues.text: If this sounds weird, though, it actually is probably a little bit more kind to use a cadaver than it would be to wrangle a live bird like this.
cues.en: If this sounds weird, though, it actually is probably a little bit more kind to use a cadaver than it would be to wrangle a live bird like this.

cues.text: They discovered that a fresh, floppy flamingo corpse was quite stable on one leg, despite, you know, being dead.
cues.en: They discovered that a fresh, floppy flamingo corpse was quite stable on one leg, despite, you know, being dead.
cues.zh: 他們發現一具新鮮的、鬆軟的火烈鳥屍體的一條腿相當穩定，儘管你知道，它已經死了。

cues.text: The most stable position was with the foot directly beneath the bird

cues.text: at the precise angle that triggers the joint lock that stops the bird from toppling over while sleeping.

cues.zh: 以精確的角度觸發關節鎖，防止鳥兒在睡覺時翻倒。

cues.text: Basically, it’s a system that’s based on gravity.
cues.en: Basically, it’s a system that’s based on gravity.
cues.zh: 基本上，這是一個基於重力的系統。

cues.text: The flamingo’s center of mass is in just the right place, in front of its knee, and the knee itself can only move in a limited way.
cues.en: The flamingo’s center of mass is in just the right place, in front of its knee, and the knee itself can only move in a limited way.
cues.zh: 火烈鳥的質心正好位於正確的位置，在它的膝蓋前面，而膝蓋本身只能以有限的方式移動。

cues.text: So when the foot is placed at just the right angle, the flamingo’s weight is all that’s needed to lock the joints in its leg,
cues.en: So when the foot is placed at just the right angle, the flamingo’s weight is all that’s needed to lock the joints in its leg,
cues.zh: 因此，當腳以正確的角度放置時，火烈鳥的重量就足以鎖定腿部的關節，

cues.text: thus making it possible for even a dead flamingo to stand on one leg with minimal assistance.
cues.en: thus making it possible for even a dead flamingo to stand on one leg with minimal assistance.
cues.zh: 因此，即使是一隻死去的火烈鳥也可以在最少的幫助下單腳站立。

cues.text: And, when propped up on two legs, the cadavers weren’t stable at all,
cues.en: And, when propped up on two legs, the cadavers weren’t stable at all,

cues.en: so that was a nice little bow to wrap on their very weird study.
cues.zh: 所以這是一個很好的小鞠躬來結束他們非常奇怪的研究。

cues.text: They did also test their theory on live flamingos, by the way, but more gently.
cues.en: They did also test their theory on live flamingos, by the way, but more gently.
cues.zh: 順便說一句，他們也在活火烈鳥身上測試了他們的理論，但更加溫和。

cues.text: They had their living subjects stand on force plates, devices that measure the forces generated by movement,
cues.en: They had their living subjects stand on force plates, devices that measure the forces generated by movement,
cues.zh: 他們讓活體受試者站在測力板上，這是一種測量運動產生的力量的裝置，

cues.text: and then waited for them to fall asleep.
cues.en: and then waited for them to fall asleep.
cues.zh: 然後等他們睡著了。

cues.text: The force plate data told the researchers what was happening in the flamingo’s foot when its body was in motion,
cues.en: The force plate data told the researchers what was happening in the flamingo’s foot when its body was in motion,
cues.zh: 測力板資料告訴研究人員當火烈鳥的身體運動時，其腳部發生了什麼，

cues.text: during both active and quiet moments.
cues.en: during both active and quiet moments.
cues.zh: 在活躍和安靜的時刻。

cues.text: The live flamingos were extremely stable on one leg, with the flamingo's center of gravity held just-so over its leg,
cues.en: The live flamingos were extremely stable on one leg, with the flamingo's center of gravity held just-so over its leg,
cues.zh: 活生生的火烈鳥單腳非常穩定，火烈鳥的重​​心正好保持在它的腿上，

cues.text: kind of like an upside down pendulum.
cues.en: kind of like an upside down pendulum.
cues.zh: 有點像是倒立的鐘擺。

cues.text: So what’s up with this?
cues.en: So what’s up with this?
cues.zh: 那麼這是怎麼回事呢？

cues.text: Well, the one legged posture saves energy, and is just easier for the birds.
cues.en: Well, the one legged posture saves energy, and is just easier for the birds.
cues.zh: 嗯，單腿姿勢可以節省能量，對鳥類來說更容易。

cues.text: In short, flamingos, whether alive, dead, or plastic,
cues.en: In short, flamingos, whether alive, dead, or plastic,
cues.zh: 簡而言之，火烈鳥，無論是活的、死的還是塑膠的，

cues.text: are perfectly adapted to standing on one leg, and that’s just fine by them.
cues.en: are perfectly adapted to standing on one leg, and that’s just fine by them.
cues.zh: 非常適合單腳站立，這對他們來說很好。

cues.en: Today, anesthesiologists often combine regional, inhalational and intravenous agents

cues.en: It was best known as a recreational drug until doctors started to realize that people sometimes didn't notice
