cues.text: This creates magnetic knots that build up enormous amounts of energy.
cues.en: This creates magnetic knots that build up enormous amounts of energy.
cues.zh: 這會產生積聚巨大能量的磁結。

cues.text: When the magnetic knots break—like a tangle of springs exploding outwards—
cues.en: When the magnetic knots break—like a tangle of springs exploding outwards—
cues.zh: 當磁結破裂時（如一團彈簧向外爆炸），

cues.text: the Sun can vomit plasma and other awful things into the Solar System.
cues.en: the Sun can vomit plasma and other awful things into the Solar System.
cues.zh: 太陽將把電漿和其他可怕的物質釋放進太陽系。

cues.text: These solar storms come in many types, like solar flares; a tidal wave of high-energy radiation.
cues.en: These solar storms come in many types, like solar flares; a tidal wave of high-energy radiation.
cues.zh: 這些太陽風暴有多種型別， 例如太陽耀斑；高能輻射的潮汐波。

cues.text: They race through the solar system at the speed of light, sweeping up protons in the solar wind,
cues.en: They race through the solar system at the speed of light, sweeping up protons in the solar wind,
cues.zh: 它們以光速在太陽系中蔓延， 在太陽風的帶領下掃起質子，

cues.text: accelerating them into a high-speed solar-proton storm.
cues.en: accelerating them into a high-speed solar-proton storm.
cues.zh: 從而加速了質子風暴。

cues.text: Then, there are coronal mass ejections, which rip millions or billions of tons of plasma from the Sun's atmosphere,
cues.en: Then, there are coronal mass ejections, which rip millions or billions of tons of plasma from the Sun's atmosphere,
cues.zh: 然後，有大量的物質噴出， 從太陽的大氣中逸出數百萬或數十億噸的電漿體，

cues.text: catapulting it through the solar system at speeds of up to 9 million km/h.
cues.en: catapulting it through the solar system at speeds of up to 9 million km/h.
cues.zh: 以高達900萬公里/小時的速度將其催化透過太陽系。

cues.text: When these monsters hit us, nothing happens on Earth.
cues.en: When these monsters hit us, nothing happens on Earth.
cues.zh: 當這些怪物襲擊我們時，地球上則會安然無事

cues.text: While even smaller storms can damage satellites, affect radio communication,
cues.en: While even smaller storms can damage satellites, affect radio communication,
cues.zh: 雖然減弱的風暴可能會損壞衛星， 影響無線電通訊

cues.text: or be dangerous to astronauts, for people on the surface, space weather is harmless.
cues.en: or be dangerous to astronauts, for people on the surface, space weather is harmless.
cues.zh: 或對宇航員造成危險，但對於地面人員而言，太空天氣是無害的。 但對於地面人員而言，太空天氣是無害的。

cues.text: Earth's atmosphere protects us from the worst effects of a solar flare
cues.en: Earth's atmosphere protects us from the worst effects of a solar flare
cues.zh: 地球大氣保護我們免受太陽風最嚴重的影響，

cues.text: by absorbing the blast of X-rays high up in the atmosphere, well before it reaches the surface.
cues.en: by absorbing the blast of X-rays high up in the atmosphere, well before it reaches the surface.
cues.zh: 地球大氣保護我們免受太陽風最嚴重的影響， 藉由吸收來自太陽的太陽風和X射線， 從而保護了我們。

cues.text: The electrified plasma from a CME is deflected by the Earth's magnetic field,
cues.en: The electrified plasma from a CME is deflected by the Earth's magnetic field,
cues.zh: 來自CME的帶電電漿體被地球磁場偏轉，

cues.text: diverting the energy storm to the North and South Poles, where energetic particles fall into the atmosphere,
cues.en: diverting the energy storm to the North and South Poles, where energetic particles fall into the atmosphere,
cues.zh: 將能量風暴轉移到南北兩極， 在那裡充滿能量的粒子墜入大氣，

cues.text: causing the atmosphere to glow and creating beautiful auroras.
cues.en: causing the atmosphere to glow and creating beautiful auroras.
cues.zh: 使大氣層發光並形成美麗的極光。

cues.text: As with any sort of weather— most of the time, things are fine.
cues.en: As with any sort of weather— most of the time, things are fine.
cues.zh: 與任何天氣一樣，大多數時候情況都很好。

cues.text: Sometimes, there are hurricanes, though.
cues.en: Sometimes, there are hurricanes, though.
cues.zh: 但有時候，那裡會有不尋常的風暴。

cues.text: Or in the case of the Sun, solar superstorms.
cues.en: Or in the case of the Sun, solar superstorms.
cues.zh: 或者在某些情況下，會有太陽風暴。

cues.text: And we know that they happen once or twice every century.
cues.en: And we know that they happen once or twice every century.
cues.zh: 據我們所知，它每世紀會發生一次或兩次。

cues.text: If one were to happen today, we would first detect strong solar flares,
cues.en: If one were to happen today, we would first detect strong solar flares,
cues.zh: 如果今天要發生的話， 我們將首先檢測到強烈的太陽耀斑，

cues.text: a sort of flash before the much more dangerous thunder.
cues.en: a sort of flash before the much more dangerous thunder.
cues.zh: 這是在更為危險的雷聲之前的一種閃光。

cues.text: The thunder is a CME, consisting of billions of tons of hot magnetic plasma
cues.en: The thunder is a CME, consisting of billions of tons of hot magnetic plasma
cues.zh: 這些雷是CME，由數十億噸的熱磁電漿體組成， 它們穿過了太陽和地球之間的1.5億公里，

cues.text: that crosses the 150 million kilometers between the Sun and Earth
cues.en: that crosses the 150 million kilometers between the Sun and Earth
cues.zh: 它們穿過了太陽和地球之間的1.5億公里，

cues.text: in less than a day.
cues.en: in less than a day.
cues.zh: 在不到一天的時間內。

cues.text: When it arrives, it causes a shockwave that violently compresses the Earth's magnetic field
cues.en: When it arrives, it causes a shockwave that violently compresses the Earth's magnetic field
cues.zh: 當它到達時， 它會產生衝擊波，猛烈地壓縮地球的磁場， 並將能量轉移到磁層中。

cues.text: and transfers energy into the magnetosphere.
cues.en: and transfers energy into the magnetosphere.
cues.zh: 並將能量轉移到磁層中。

cues.text: But it can get worse.
cues.en: But it can get worse.
cues.zh: 但這可能會變得更糟。

cues.text: If the magnetic field of the CME is aligned to Earth's in just the right way,
cues.en: If the magnetic field of the CME is aligned to Earth's in just the right way,
cues.zh: 如果CME的磁場以正確的方式與地球對齊，

cues.text: the two magnetic fields merge.
cues.en: the two magnetic fields merge.
cues.zh: 則這兩個磁場會合併。

cues.text: As the magnetic cloud passes over Earth, it stretches the Earth's field into a long tail.
cues.en: As the magnetic cloud passes over Earth, it stretches the Earth's field into a long tail.
cues.zh: 磁性雲層經過地球時，將地球磁場伸展成一條長長的尾巴。

cues.text: Eventually, the energy stored in the tail becomes too much to contain.
cues.en: Eventually, the energy stored in the tail becomes too much to contain.
cues.zh: 最終，儲存在尾巴中的能量將變得無法容納。

cues.text: It snaps and explosively releases its energy towards Earth.
cues.en: It snaps and explosively releases its energy towards Earth.
cues.zh: 它被扯斷並爆炸性地向地球釋放能量。

cues.text: A geomagnetic storm has begun.
cues.en: A geomagnetic storm has begun.
cues.zh: 地磁風暴已經開始了。

cues.text: A few hundred years ago, nobody would have cared.
cues.en: A few hundred years ago, nobody would have cared.
cues.zh: 幾百年前，沒有人會在意。

cues.text: This storm gushing over the Earth is not relevant for machines made out of meat and bones.
cues.en: This storm gushing over the Earth is not relevant for machines made out of meat and bones.
cues.zh: 這場席捲地球的風暴與由肉和骨頭製成的我們無關。

cues.text: But it's very relevant for machines made out of metal and wire.
cues.en: But it's very relevant for machines made out of metal and wire.
cues.zh: 但這對於由金屬和金屬絲製成的機器非常重要。

cues.text: Remember the dynamo?
cues.en: Remember the dynamo?
cues.zh: 還記得發電機嗎？

cues.text: Magnetism creates electric currents.
cues.en: Magnetism creates electric currents.
cues.zh: 磁場產生電流。

cues.text: Earth in the 21st century is covered in millions of kilometers of wires, transporting electricity,
cues.en: Earth in the 21st century is covered in millions of kilometers of wires, transporting electricity,
cues.zh: 21世紀的地球覆蓋著數百萬公里的電線， 用於運輸電力，

cues.text: and a complex grid of machines, like transformers, that make this transfer possible.
cues.en: and a complex grid of machines, like transformers, that make this transfer possible.
cues.zh: 以及復雜的機器網格，例如變壓器，使這種傳輸成為可能。

cues.text: A CME's energy can induce currents in our power grid that can either completely shut it down,
cues.en: A CME's energy can induce currents in our power grid that can either completely shut it down,
cues.zh: CME的能量可能會在我們的電網中感應出電流，這可能會完全關閉它，

cues.text: or worse, destroy the transformer stations that keep our grid running.
cues.en: or worse, destroy the transformer stations that keep our grid running.
cues.zh: 或者更糟的是，破壞我們正在執行的電網和變電站。

cues.text: This has happened already, like when the Quebec power grid failed after a strong solar storm in 1989.
cues.en: This has happened already, like when the Quebec power grid failed after a strong solar storm in 1989.
cues.zh: 這已經發生過了， 例如當1989年強烈的太陽風暴襲擊時，魁北克的電網就因此發生故障時。

cues.text: But in general, our engineers know how to deal with these storms, and so we usually don't even notice.
cues.en: But in general, our engineers know how to deal with these storms, and so we usually don't even notice.
cues.zh: 但整體來說，我們的工程師知道如何應對這些風暴， 以至於我們通常不會注意到。

cues.text: The last time a solar hurricane washed over Earth was in 1859:
cues.en: The last time a solar hurricane washed over Earth was in 1859:
cues.zh: 上一次太陽颶風襲擊地球是在1859年：

cues.text: The Carrington Event, the largest geomagnetic storms ever observed on Earth.
cues.en: The Carrington Event, the largest geomagnetic storms ever observed on Earth.
cues.zh: 卡靈頓事件， 這是地球上有史以來最大的地磁風暴。

cues.text: Massive auroras occurred as far south as the Caribbean.
cues.en: Massive auroras occurred as far south as the Caribbean.
cues.zh: 巨大的極光發生在南端的加勒比海。

cues.text: In some places, they were so bright that people got up, thinking the Sun was rising.
cues.en: In some places, they were so bright that people got up, thinking the Sun was rising.
cues.zh: 在某些地方，它們是如此明亮，以至於人們起床， 以為太陽升起了。

cues.text: Luckily, we only had one sort of modern technology: telegraph systems.
cues.en: Luckily, we only had one sort of modern technology: telegraph systems.
cues.zh: 幸運的是，我們只有一種因此被淘汰技術： 電報系統。

cues.text: They failed all over the world, shocking their operators and chucking out sparks.
cues.en: They failed all over the world, shocking their operators and chucking out sparks.
cues.zh: 他們在世界各地都失敗， 這震驚了他們的運營商，並解決這個問題。

cues.text: Today, we have a tad more technology, and our luck may run out soon.
cues.en: Today, we have a tad more technology, and our luck may run out soon.
cues.zh: 今天，我們有了更多的技術， 而我們的運氣可能很快就會耗盡。

cues.text: Another bad solar storm is bound to happen eventually.
cues.en: Another bad solar storm is bound to happen eventually.
cues.zh: 之後必然會發生另一場惡劣的太陽風暴。

cues.text: A storm as strong as the Carrington Event missed earth only by a small margin in 2012.
cues.en: A storm as strong as the Carrington Event missed earth only by a small margin in 2012.
cues.zh: 在2012年，像卡林頓賽事一樣強烈的風暴僅使地球失之交臂。

cues.text: Studies projected that it would've inflicted serious damage to electronic systems globally,
cues.en: Studies projected that it would've inflicted serious damage to electronic systems globally,
cues.zh: 研究預計，它將對全球的電子系統造成嚴重損害，

cues.text: costing up to $2.6 trillion to the US alone.
cues.en: costing up to $2.6 trillion to the US alone.
cues.zh: 單美國一項就損失高達2.6萬億美元。

cues.text: The time to replace all the damaged systems was estimated at between 4 and 10 years.
cues.en: The time to replace all the damaged systems was estimated at between 4 and 10 years.
cues.zh: 更換所有受損系統的時間估計為4至10年。

cues.text: It's hard to say how bad it could have been.
cues.en: It's hard to say how bad it could have been.
cues.zh: 很難說這會有多糟。

cues.text: Experts disagreed.
cues.en: Experts disagreed.
cues.zh: 因為有些專家意見不同

cues.text: Some assumed there would just be temporary blackouts, but others worried it could be much worse.
cues.en: Some assumed there would just be temporary blackouts, but others worried it could be much worse.
cues.zh: 有些人認為只會造成臨時停電， 但其他人則擔心情況可能會更糟。

cues.text: We won't know for sure until a big solar hurricane hits us.
cues.en: We won't know for sure until a big solar hurricane hits us.
cues.zh: 在風暴襲擊我們之前，我們無法確定。

cues.text: The probability of such an event is estimated to be 12% per decade.
cues.en: The probability of such an event is estimated to be 12% per decade.
cues.zh: 此類事件的機率估計為每十年 12％

cues.text: That's about a 50/50 chance of at least one in the next 50 years.
cues.en: That's about a 50/50 chance of at least one in the next 50 years.
cues.zh: 在接下來的50年中，至少有50%的機會。

cues.text: And, there is more unsettling news.
cues.en: And, there is more unsettling news.
cues.zh: 然而有更多另人不安的訊息

cues.text: A 2019 paper found that even calm stars, like our Sun,
cues.en: A 2019 paper found that even calm stars, like our Sun,
cues.zh: 一篇2019年的論文發現，就算是太陽這樣平靜的星星

cues.text: can create superflares every few thousand years.
cues.en: can create superflares every few thousand years.
cues.zh: 在每幾千年就可以產生出一次超級閃焰

cues.text: Eruptions orders of magnitude stronger than the strongest storms we have observed in the Solar System.
cues.en: Eruptions orders of magnitude stronger than the strongest storms we have observed in the Solar System.
cues.zh: 噴發出比目前太陽風暴還要更強的風暴 我們已經在太陽系中觀查到了

cues.text: If such a storm hits us unprepared, the consequences could be catastrophic.
cues.en: If such a storm hits us unprepared, the consequences could be catastrophic.
cues.zh: 如果這樣的風暴在我們搞不好備好的時候來襲 後果是災難性的

cues.text: It's hard to overstate how much we depend on electricity.
cues.en: It's hard to overstate how much we depend on electricity.
cues.zh: 這不是誇大我們對電力的依賴

cues.text: It's not just the lights at home.
cues.en: It's not just the lights at home.
cues.zh: 那不只是在家裡的燈炮

cues.text: It means no computers, no communication, no navigation.
cues.en: It means no computers, no communication, no navigation.
cues.zh: 意味著失去電腦運作 通訊裝置失效 導航系統無法運作

cues.text: A sustained power outage might lead to a breakdown of the supply chain,
cues.en: A sustained power outage might lead to a breakdown of the supply chain,
cues.zh: 持續性的停電可能打破我們的供應鍊

cues.text: water supply systems failing and hospital generators running dry,
cues.en: water supply systems failing and hospital generators running dry,
cues.zh: 供水系統失效 醫院的發電機燃料會用完

cues.text: supermarkets not being refilled while food rots in the fields.
cues.en: supermarkets not being refilled while food rots in the fields.
cues.zh: 超市無法補充貨物 食物在農田裡腐爛

cues.text: The lack of power might make it extremely hard to reboot our broken power grid,
cues.en: The lack of power might make it extremely hard to reboot our broken power grid,
cues.zh: 電力不足使我們在重啟殘破的電力網路時格外困難

cues.text: taking years or decades to restart our starving civilization.
cues.en: taking years or decades to restart our starving civilization.
cues.zh: 需要數年或數十年才重啟停滯很久的文明

cues.text: Okay, time to panic?
cues.en: Okay, time to panic?
cues.zh: 好的 該是驚慌了？

cues.text: As much as daily newspapers might like for solar storms to send us back to the Stone Age,
cues.en: As much as daily newspapers might like for solar storms to send us back to the Stone Age,
cues.zh: 許多新聞報紙表示太陽風暴會把我們送回石器時代

cues.text: they probably won't.
cues.en: they probably won't.
cues.zh: 其實並不會

cues.text: Fortunately, even though solar storms aren't preventable, virtually all of their nasty side effects are.
cues.en: Fortunately, even though solar storms aren't preventable, virtually all of their nasty side effects are.
cues.zh: 幸運的是，即使無法預防太陽風暴 但他的副作用是可以避免的

cues.text: Scientists observing the Sun have a few hours up to a few days to see a CME coming.
cues.en: Scientists observing the Sun have a few hours up to a few days to see a CME coming.
cues.zh: 科學家們觀察到CME從太陽過來需要小時到數天的時間

cues.text: And the engineers working the systems that keep the world running are well aware of the risks posed by solar storms.
cues.en: And the engineers working the systems that keep the world running are well aware of the risks posed by solar storms.
cues.zh: 工程師保持系統工作讓世界繼續運作 非常瞭解太陽風暴帶來的風險

cues.text: Transformers and substations can be taken offline— short preventative blackouts—
cues.en: Transformers and substations can be taken offline— short preventative blackouts—
cues.zh: 變電器與變電所可以切換成切斷 短暫的預防性停電

cues.text: or in other words, by unplugging stuff.
cues.en: or in other words, by unplugging stuff.
cues.zh: 換句話說，就像是拔掉插頭

cues.text: Engineers can open up extra lines to dissipate the extra power.
cues.en: Engineers can open up extra lines to dissipate the extra power.
cues.zh: 工程師可以開啟額外的線路使多餘的電力消散

cues.text: And with investment and upgrades cheap compared to those other natural disasters require,
cues.en: And with investment and upgrades cheap compared to those other natural disasters require,
cues.zh: 與其他自然災害相比，透過廉價的投資和升級，

cues.text: we could protect the world's electric grid against even the nastiest of storms.
cues.en: we could protect the world's electric grid against even the nastiest of storms.
cues.zh: 我們可以保護全世界的電網，甚至抵禦最惡劣的風暴。

cues.text: But we do need to prepare.
cues.en: But we do need to prepare.
cues.zh: 但我們需要準備

cues.text: While the risk is manageable, it is real.
cues.en: While the risk is manageable, it is real.
cues.zh: 僅管風險是可以控制的，但它是真實存在的

cues.text: For while our Sun bathes us in warm and pleasant light, one day, it might send a monster our way
cues.en: For while our Sun bathes us in warm and pleasant light, one day, it might send a monster our way
cues.zh: 當我們沐浴在溫暖宜人的陽光下時 也許有一天，它可能對著我們送出一頭怪物 我們最好有所準備

cues.text: that we better be ready for.
cues.en: that we better be ready for.
cues.zh: 我們最好有所準備

BHY0FxzoKZE.title: The Brain-Changing Benefits of Exercise | Wendy Suzuki | TED
BHY0FxzoKZE.speaker: TED
BHY0FxzoKZE.zh: 【TED】運動改變大腦的好處|溫蒂鈴木 |泰德（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: What if I told you there was something that you can do right now
cues.en: What if I told you there was something that you can do right now
cues.zh: 如果我告訴各位， 有件你們現在就可以做的事，

cues.text: that would have an immediate, positive benefit for your brain
cues.en: that would have an immediate, positive benefit for your brain
cues.zh: 對你的大腦會立即產生正面的好處，

cues.text: including your mood and your focus?
cues.en: including your mood and your focus?
cues.zh: 包括你的心情和專注都會受惠， 你會如何呢？

cues.text: And what if I told you that same thing could actually last a long time
cues.en: And what if I told you that same thing could actually last a long time
cues.zh: 如果我告訴各位， 這事能持續很久的時間，

cues.text: and protect your brain from different conditions like depression, Alzheimer's disease or dementia.
cues.en: and protect your brain from different conditions like depression, Alzheimer's disease or dementia.
cues.zh: 並保護你的大腦免於不同的病症， 比如憂鬱、阿茲海默症， 或失智症的侵擾，你會如何？

cues.text: Would you do it?
cues.en: Would you do it?
cues.zh: 你們願意做這件事嗎？

cues.text: Yes!
cues.en: Yes!
cues.zh: 願意！

cues.text: I am talking about the powerful effects of physical activity.
cues.en: I am talking about the powerful effects of physical activity.
cues.zh: 我談的是活動身體的強大效應。

cues.text: Simply moving your body, has immediate, long-lasting and protective benefits for your brain.
cues.en: Simply moving your body, has immediate, long-lasting and protective benefits for your brain.
cues.zh: 只要很單純地去動你的身體， 就能對你的大腦產生立即、 持久，且有保護作用的益處，

cues.text: And that can last for the rest of your life.
cues.en: And that can last for the rest of your life.
cues.zh: 且持續一生。

cues.text: So what I want to do today is tell you a story about how I used my deep understanding of neuroscience,
cues.en: So what I want to do today is tell you a story about how I used my deep understanding of neuroscience,
cues.zh: 所以，今天我要跟各位說個故事， 這故事有關身為神經科學教授的我，

cues.text: as a professor of neuroscience, to essentially do an experiment on myself
cues.en: as a professor of neuroscience, to essentially do an experiment on myself
cues.zh: 如何用我對於神經科學的深入瞭解， 在我自己身上實驗，

cues.text: in which I discovered the science underlying why exercise is the most transformative thing
cues.en: in which I discovered the science underlying why exercise is the most transformative thing
cues.zh: 從實驗中找到科學理由來說明， 為什麼在現今你能做的 所有事情當中，

cues.text: that you can do for your brain today.
cues.en: that you can do for your brain today.
cues.zh: 運動最能改變你的大腦。

cues.text: Now, as a neuroscientist, I know that our brains,
cues.en: Now, as a neuroscientist, I know that our brains,
cues.zh: 身為神經科學家， 我知道我們的大腦，

cues.text: that is the thing in our head right now, that is the most complex structure known to humankind.
cues.en: that is the thing in our head right now, that is the most complex structure known to humankind.
cues.zh: 也就是在我們頭裡面的那個東西， 是人類所知最複雜的結構。

cues.text: But it's one thing to talk about the brain, and it's another to see it.
cues.en: But it's one thing to talk about the brain, and it's another to see it.
cues.zh: 但，談論大腦是一回事， 看大腦又是另一回事了。

cues.text: So here is a real preserved human brain.
cues.en: So here is a real preserved human brain.
cues.zh: 這是一個真正儲存起來的人類大腦。

cues.text: And it's going to illustrate two key areas that we are going to talk about today.
cues.en: And it's going to illustrate two key areas that we are going to talk about today.
cues.zh: 它將會說明我們今天 要談到的兩個關鍵區域。

cues.text: The first is the prefrontal cortex, right behind your forehead,
cues.en: The first is the prefrontal cortex, right behind your forehead,
cues.zh: 第一個是「前額葉皮質」， 就在你的額頭後面，

cues.text: critical for things like decision-making, focus, attention and your personality.
cues.en: critical for things like decision-making, focus, attention and your personality.
cues.zh: 對決策、專注、注意力， 以及你的人格來說很重要。

cues.text: The second key area is located in the temporal lobe, shown right here.
cues.en: The second key area is located in the temporal lobe, shown right here.
cues.zh: 第二個關鍵區域位在「顳葉」， 就在圖上的這裡。

cues.text: You have two temporal lobes in your brain, the right and the left, and deep in the temporal lobe is a key structure
cues.en: You have two temporal lobes in your brain, the right and the left, and deep in the temporal lobe is a key structure
cues.zh: 你的大腦中有兩個顳葉，一右一左， 顳葉的深處是個關鍵的結構，

cues.text: critical for your ability to form and retain new long-term memories for facts and events.
cues.en: critical for your ability to form and retain new long-term memories for facts and events.
cues.zh: 重要功能是讓你能夠 針對事實和事件來形成 並維持新的長期記憶。

cues.text: And that structure is called the hippocampus.
cues.en: And that structure is called the hippocampus.
cues.zh: 那個結構就叫做「海馬迴」。

cues.text: So I've always been fascinated with the hippocampus.
cues.en: So I've always been fascinated with the hippocampus.
cues.zh: 我一直很迷海馬迴。

cues.text: How could it be that an event that lasts just a moment,
cues.en: How could it be that an event that lasts just a moment,
cues.zh: 怎麼有可能，一個短暫的事件，

cues.text: say, your first kiss, or the moment your first child was born,
cues.en: say, your first kiss, or the moment your first child was born,
cues.zh: 比如，你的初吻， 或是你的第一個孩子出生的那一刻，

cues.text: can form a memory that has changed your brain, that lasts an entire lifetime?
cues.en: can form a memory that has changed your brain, that lasts an entire lifetime?
cues.zh: 能夠形成一個記憶， 這記憶能改變你的大腦， 且一生都不會忘記？

cues.text: That's what I want to understand.
cues.en: That's what I want to understand.
cues.zh: 那是我想要了解的。

cues.text: I wanted to start and record the activity of individual brain cells
cues.en: I wanted to start and record the activity of individual brain cells
cues.zh: 我想要記下受試者在形成記憶時，

cues.text: in the hippocampus as subjects were forming new memories.
cues.en: in the hippocampus as subjects were forming new memories.
cues.zh: 海馬迴中的 每個腦細胞的活動。

cues.text: And essentially try and decode how those brief bursts of electrical activity,
cues.en: And essentially try and decode how those brief bursts of electrical activity,
cues.zh: 並真的試圖破解那些 短暫的突升電流活動，

cues.text: which is how neurons communicate with each other, how those brief bursts either allowed us to form a new memory, or did not.
cues.en: which is how neurons communicate with each other, how those brief bursts either allowed us to form a new memory, or did not.
cues.zh: 也就是神經元彼此溝通的方式， 那些短暫的突升怎麼讓我們 形成新記憶，或沒形成記憶？

cues.text: But a few years ago, I did something very unusual in science.
cues.en: But a few years ago, I did something very unusual in science.
cues.zh: 但幾年前，我做了一件 在科學中被認為很不尋常的事。

cues.text: As a full professor of neural science, I decided to completely switch my research program.
cues.en: As a full professor of neural science, I decided to completely switch my research program.
cues.zh: 身為神經科學的正教授， 我決定完全轉換我的研究計畫。

cues.text: Because I encountered something that was so amazing,
cues.en: Because I encountered something that was so amazing,
cues.zh: 因為我遇到了非常驚人的事，

cues.text: with the potential to change so many lives that I had to study it.
cues.en: with the potential to change so many lives that I had to study it.
cues.zh: 它有潛能可以改變許多人的生命， 我得要去研究它。

cues.text: I discovered and I experienced the brain-changing effects of exercise.
cues.en: I discovered and I experienced the brain-changing effects of exercise.
cues.zh: 我發現且體驗到 運動有改變大腦的效應。

cues.text: And I did it in a completely inadvertent way.
cues.en: And I did it in a completely inadvertent way.
cues.zh: 我完全是在無意間發現的。

cues.text: I was actually at the height of all the memory work that I was doing --
cues.en: I was actually at the height of all the memory work that I was doing --
cues.zh: 其實當時我正處於所進行的 記憶研究工作的頂峰，

cues.text: data was pouring in, I was becoming known in my field for all of this memory work.
cues.en: data was pouring in, I was becoming known in my field for all of this memory work.
cues.zh: 資料不斷地湧入， 在我的領域中，我開始因為 這項記憶研究而變得出名。

cues.text: And it should have been going great. It was, scientifically.
cues.en: And it should have been going great. It was, scientifically.
cues.zh: 本來應該很順利。 在科學上的確很順利。

cues.text: But when I stuck my head out of my lab door,
cues.en: But when I stuck my head out of my lab door,
cues.zh: 但當我從實驗室門探出頭，

cues.text: I noticed something.
cues.en: I noticed something.
cues.zh: 我注意到了某件事。

cues.text: I had no social life.
cues.en: I had no social life.
cues.zh: 我沒有社交生活。

cues.text: I spent too much time listening to those brain cells in a dark room, by myself.
cues.en: I spent too much time listening to those brain cells in a dark room, by myself.
cues.zh: 我花了太多時間， 獨自在黑暗的房間中 傾聽那些腦細胞。

cues.text: I didn't move my body at all.
cues.en: I didn't move my body at all.
cues.zh: 我完全沒動我的身體。

cues.text: I had gained 25 pounds.
cues.en: I had gained 25 pounds.
cues.zh: 我的體重增加了二十五磅。

cues.text: And actually, it took me many years to realize it, I was actually miserable.
cues.en: And actually, it took me many years to realize it, I was actually miserable.
cues.zh: 而且，我花了很多年，才瞭解到 我其實很悲慘。

cues.text: And I shouldn't be miserable.
cues.en: And I shouldn't be miserable.
cues.zh: 而我不應該如此悲慘。

cues.text: And I went on a river-rafting trip -- by myself, because I had no social life.
cues.en: And I went on a river-rafting trip -- by myself, because I had no social life.
cues.zh: 我參加一趟泛舟之旅── 自己一個人，因為我沒有社交生活。

cues.text: And I came back -- thinking, "Oh, my God, I was the weakest person on that trip."
cues.en: And I came back -- thinking, "Oh, my God, I was the weakest person on that trip."
cues.zh: 接著我回來了。 （笑聲） 心想：「我的天， 我是那趟旅行中最弱的人。」

cues.text: And I came back with a mission.
cues.en: And I came back with a mission.
cues.zh: 回來後我就有了一個使命。

cues.text: I said, "I'm never going to feel like the weakest person on a river-rafting trip again."
cues.en: I said, "I'm never going to feel like the weakest person on a river-rafting trip again."
cues.zh: 我說：「我再也不要覺得自己是 泛舟之旅中最弱的人了。」

cues.text: And that's what made me go to the gym.
cues.en: And that's what made me go to the gym.
cues.zh: 這就是我上健身房的動力來源。

cues.text: And I focused my type-A personality on going to all the exercise classes at the gym.
cues.en: And I focused my type-A personality on going to all the exercise classes at the gym.
cues.zh: 我把我的Ａ型人格專注在 去參加健身房中所有的運動課程。

cues.text: I tried everything.
cues.en: I tried everything.
cues.zh: 我什麼都嘗試了，

cues.text: I went to kickbox, dance, yoga, step class,
cues.en: I went to kickbox, dance, yoga, step class,
cues.zh: 我去試了自由搏擊、 跳舞、瑜伽、階梯課程，

cues.text: and at first it was really hard.
cues.en: and at first it was really hard.
cues.zh: 一開始真的很辛苦。

cues.text: But what I noticed is that after every sweat-inducing workout that I tried,
cues.en: But what I noticed is that after every sweat-inducing workout that I tried,
cues.zh: 但我注意到，在我每回嘗試 會讓我滿身大汗的運動之後，

cues.text: I had this great mood boost and this great energy boost.
cues.en: I had this great mood boost and this great energy boost.
cues.zh: 我的情緒和能量都會大大提升。

cues.text: And that's what kept me going back to the gym.
cues.en: And that's what kept me going back to the gym.
cues.zh: 這就是為什麼我會 一直持續回到健身房。

cues.text: Well, I started feeling stronger.
cues.en: Well, I started feeling stronger.
cues.zh: 我開始感覺比較強壯了。

cues.text: I started feeling better, I even lost that 25 pounds.
cues.en: I started feeling better, I even lost that 25 pounds.
cues.zh: 我開始感覺更好了， 我甚至把那二十五磅給減掉了。

cues.text: And now, fast-forward a year and a half into this regular exercise program
cues.en: And now, fast-forward a year and a half into this regular exercise program
cues.zh: 現在，從我開始做日常鍛鍊 至今已有一年半多了，

cues.text: and I noticed something that really made me sit up and take notice.
cues.en: and I noticed something that really made me sit up and take notice.
cues.zh: 我注意到一件事，它讓我 吃驚並吸引了我的注意。

cues.text: I was sitting at my desk, writing a research grant, and a thought went through my mind
cues.en: I was sitting at my desk, writing a research grant, and a thought went through my mind
cues.zh: 我坐在桌前寫研究補助申請書， 腦中浮現一個想法，

cues.text: that had never gone through my mind before.
cues.en: that had never gone through my mind before.
cues.zh: 那是我以前從來沒有想過的。

cues.text: And that thought was, "Gee, grant-writing is going well today."
cues.en: And that thought was, "Gee, grant-writing is going well today."
cues.zh: 那個想法就是： 「天，今天的研究補助 申請寫得真順利。」

cues.text: And all the scientists -- yeah, all the scientists always laugh when I say that,
cues.en: And all the scientists -- yeah, all the scientists always laugh when I say that,
cues.zh: 所有的科學家── （笑聲） 是啊，當我那麼說時， 科學家都會笑出來，

cues.text: because grant-writing never goes well.
cues.en: because grant-writing never goes well.
cues.zh: 因為寫補助申請從來就不會順利。

cues.text: It is so hard; you're always pulling your hair out, trying to come up with that million-dollar-winning idea.
cues.en: It is so hard; you're always pulling your hair out, trying to come up with that million-dollar-winning idea.
cues.zh: 它真的很難搞，你總是要想破頭， 試圖提個能贏得百萬美元的想法。

cues.text: But I realized that the grant-writing was going well, because I was able to focus and maintain my attention
cues.en: But I realized that the grant-writing was going well, because I was able to focus and maintain my attention
cues.zh: 但我發現，補助申請能寫得很順利， 是因為我專注和維持注意力的時間，

cues.text: for longer than I had before.
cues.en: for longer than I had before.
cues.zh: 都比以前更長。

cues.text: And my long-term memory -- what I was studying in my own lab --
cues.en: And my long-term memory -- what I was studying in my own lab --
cues.zh: 且我的長期記憶── 我的實驗室的研究主題──

cues.text: seemed to be better in me.
cues.en: seemed to be better in me.
cues.zh: 似乎在我身上也變得更好。

cues.text: And that's when I put it together.
cues.en: And that's when I put it together.
cues.zh: 就在那時，我把一切都連起來了。

cues.text: Maybe all that exercise that I had included and added to my life
cues.en: Maybe all that exercise that I had included and added to my life
cues.zh: 也許，我加在生活中的那些運動

cues.text: was changing my brain.
cues.en: was changing my brain.
cues.zh: 在改變我的大腦。

cues.text: Maybe I did an experiment on myself without even knowing it.
cues.en: Maybe I did an experiment on myself without even knowing it.
cues.zh: 也許我在自己身上 做了實驗而不自知。

cues.text: So as a curious neuroscientist, I went to the literature to see what I could find about what we knew
cues.en: So as a curious neuroscientist, I went to the literature to see what I could find about what we knew
cues.zh: 身為好奇的神經科學家， 我去查研究文獻， 看看有沒有什麼已知資訊 與運動對大腦的效應有關。

cues.text: about the effects of exercise on the brain.
cues.en: about the effects of exercise on the brain.
cues.zh: 與運動對大腦的效應有關。

cues.text: And what I found was an exciting and a growing literature
cues.en: And what I found was an exciting and a growing literature
cues.zh: 我發現的文獻很讓人興奮， 且還在不斷增加中，

cues.text: that was essentially showing everything that I noticed in myself.
cues.en: that was essentially showing everything that I noticed in myself.
cues.zh: 基本上，文獻完全點出了 我在身上注意到的所有改變。

cues.text: Better mood, better energy, better memory, better attention.
cues.en: Better mood, better energy, better memory, better attention.
cues.zh: 更好的心情、更高的能量、 更好的記憶、更佳的注意力。

cues.text: And the more I learned, the more I realized how powerful exercise was.
cues.en: And the more I learned, the more I realized how powerful exercise was.
cues.zh: 我學得越多， 我就越能瞭解運動有多強大。

cues.text: Which eventually led me to the big decision to completely shift my research focus.
cues.en: Which eventually led me to the big decision to completely shift my research focus.
cues.zh: 最終，這導致了我做出重大決定， 完全轉變我的研究重心。

cues.text: And so now, after several years of really focusing on this question,
cues.en: And so now, after several years of really focusing on this question,
cues.zh: 所以，在真正投入這個問題幾年後，

cues.text: I've come to the following conclusion: that exercise is the most transformative thing
cues.en: I've come to the following conclusion: that exercise is the most transformative thing
cues.zh: 我得到了下列的結論： 在現今你能做的所有事情當中，

cues.text: that you can do for your brain today for the following three reasons.
cues.en: that you can do for your brain today for the following three reasons.
cues.zh: 運動最能改變你的大腦， 理由是以下三個。

cues.text: Number one: it has immediate effects on your brain.
cues.en: Number one: it has immediate effects on your brain.
cues.zh: 第一：運動對你的大腦 有立即的效應。

cues.text: A single workout that you do will immediately increase levels of neurotransmitters
cues.en: A single workout that you do will immediately increase levels of neurotransmitters
cues.zh: 你做的每一次運動， 都會立即增加神經傳遞質的量，

cues.text: like dopamine, serotonin and noradrenaline.
cues.en: like dopamine, serotonin and noradrenaline.
cues.zh: 如多巴胺、血清素、正腎上腺素。

cues.text: That is going to increase your mood right after that workout, exactly what I was feeling.
cues.en: That is going to increase your mood right after that workout, exactly what I was feeling.
cues.zh: 這會在你運動之後 馬上提升你的心情， 那正是我的感受。

cues.text: My lab showed that a single workout can improve your ability to shift and focus attention,
cues.en: My lab showed that a single workout can improve your ability to shift and focus attention,
cues.zh: 我的實驗室顯示，單一次運動 就能改善你轉移和聚焦的能力，

cues.text: and that focus improvement will last for at least two hours.
cues.en: and that focus improvement will last for at least two hours.
cues.zh: 而那專注的改善 會持續至少兩個小時。

cues.text: And finally, studies have shown that a single workout will improve your reaction times
cues.en: And finally, studies have shown that a single workout will improve your reaction times
cues.zh: 最後，研究顯示， 單一次運動就會改善你的反應時間，

cues.text: which basically means that you are going to be faster at catching that cup of Starbucks
cues.en: which basically means that you are going to be faster at catching that cup of Starbucks
cues.zh: 基本上，那就表示 如果一杯星巴克咖啡從櫃臺滑落，

cues.text: that falls off the counter, which is very, very important.
cues.en: that falls off the counter, which is very, very important.
cues.zh: 你能更快速接住它， 這點是非常非常重要的。

cues.text: But these immediate effects are transient, they help you right after.
cues.en: But these immediate effects are transient, they help you right after.
cues.zh: 但這些立即的效應很短暫， 在運動剛結束時幫助你。

cues.text: What you have to do is do what I did, that is change your exercise regime, increase your cardiorespiratory function,
cues.en: What you have to do is do what I did, that is change your exercise regime, increase your cardiorespiratory function,
cues.zh: 你們得要做我所做的， 也就是改變你的運動規律， 增加你的心肺功能，

cues.text: to get the long-lasting effects.
cues.en: to get the long-lasting effects.
cues.zh: 才能得到持久的效應。

cues.text: And these effects are long-lasting because exercise actually changes the brain's anatomy,
cues.en: And these effects are long-lasting because exercise actually changes the brain's anatomy,
cues.zh: 這些效應之所以能持久， 是因為運動確實能改變大腦的結構、

cues.text: physiology and function.
cues.en: physiology and function.
cues.zh: 生理機能，以及功能。

cues.text: Let's start with my favorite brain area, the hippocampus.
cues.en: Let's start with my favorite brain area, the hippocampus.
cues.zh: 我們從我最愛的 大腦區域海馬迴開始。

cues.text: The hippocampus -- or exercise actually produces brand new brain cells,
cues.en: The hippocampus -- or exercise actually produces brand new brain cells,
cues.zh: 海馬迴── 運動確實能製造出全新的腦細胞，

cues.text: new brain cells in the hippocampus, that actually increase its volume,
cues.en: new brain cells in the hippocampus, that actually increase its volume,
cues.zh: 海馬迴中新的腦細胞能增加容積，

cues.text: as well as improve your long-term memory, OK?
cues.en: as well as improve your long-term memory, OK?
cues.zh: 還能改善你的長期記憶。

cues.text: And that including in you and me.
cues.en: And that including in you and me.
cues.zh: 對你我皆是如此。

cues.text: Number two: the most common finding in neuroscience studies,
cues.en: Number two: the most common finding in neuroscience studies,
cues.zh: 第二：在神經科學研究中 最常見的研究發現，

cues.text: looking at effects of long-term exercise, is improved attention function dependent on your prefrontal cortex.
cues.en: looking at effects of long-term exercise, is improved attention function dependent on your prefrontal cortex.
cues.zh: 在長期運動的效應這方面， 就是改善注意力功能， 而這功能取決於你的前額葉皮質。

cues.text: You not only get better focus and attention, but the volume of the hippocampus increases as well.
cues.en: You not only get better focus and attention, but the volume of the hippocampus increases as well.
cues.zh: 你不但會有更佳的專注和注意力， 海馬迴的容量也會增加。

cues.text: And finally, you not only get immediate effects of mood with exercise
cues.en: And finally, you not only get immediate effects of mood with exercise
cues.zh: 最後，你做運動會得到的 不只是心情上的立即效應，

cues.text: but those last for a long time.
cues.en: but those last for a long time.
cues.zh: 還會有長期的效應。

cues.text: So you get long-lasting increases in those good mood neurotransmitters.
cues.en: So you get long-lasting increases in those good mood neurotransmitters.
cues.zh: 所以，你的好心情神經 傳遞質就能得持續增加。

cues.text: But really, the most transformative thing that exercise will do
cues.en: But really, the most transformative thing that exercise will do
cues.zh: 但其實，運動能帶來最大的轉變，

cues.text: is its protective effects on your brain.
cues.en: is its protective effects on your brain.
cues.zh: 就是對大腦產生保護效應。

cues.text: Here you can think about the brain like a muscle.
cues.en: Here you can think about the brain like a muscle.
cues.zh: 可以把大腦想成是肌肉。

cues.text: The more you're working out, the bigger and stronger your hippocampus and prefrontal cortex gets.
cues.en: The more you're working out, the bigger and stronger your hippocampus and prefrontal cortex gets.
cues.zh: 你運動得越多， 你的海馬迴和前額葉皮質 就會更大、更強壯。

cues.text: Why is that important?
cues.en: Why is that important?
cues.zh: 為什麼那很重要？

cues.text: Because the prefrontal cortex and the hippocampus are the two areas that are most susceptible to neurodegenerative diseases
cues.en: Because the prefrontal cortex and the hippocampus are the two areas that are most susceptible to neurodegenerative diseases
cues.zh: 因為前額葉皮質和海馬迴 這兩個區域最容易因 神經退化性疾病和老化

cues.text: and normal cognitive decline in aging.
cues.en: and normal cognitive decline in aging.
cues.zh: 而使得正常認知退化。

cues.text: So with increased exercise over your lifetime, you're not going to cure dementia or Alzheimer's disease,
cues.en: So with increased exercise over your lifetime, you're not going to cure dementia or Alzheimer's disease,
cues.zh: 在你的一生中增加運動 並不能治癒失智症或阿茲海默症，

cues.text: but what you're going to do is you're going to create the strongest, biggest hippocampus and prefrontal cortex
cues.en: but what you're going to do is you're going to create the strongest, biggest hippocampus and prefrontal cortex
cues.zh: 但能創造出 最強壯、最大的海馬迴 和前額葉皮質，

cues.text: so it takes longer for these diseases to actually have an effect.
cues.en: so it takes longer for these diseases to actually have an effect.
cues.zh: 所以這些疾病要更長的時間 才會對你產生實際的影響。

cues.text: You can think of exercise, therefore, as a supercharged 401K for your brain, OK?
cues.en: You can think of exercise, therefore, as a supercharged 401K for your brain, OK?
cues.zh: 因此，你可以把運動想成是 大腦的加強版 401K 退休福利計畫。

cues.text: And it's even better, because it's free.
cues.en: And it's even better, because it's free.
cues.zh: 它還更好，因為它是免費的。

cues.text: So this is the point in the talk where everybody says, "That sounds so interesting, Wendy,
cues.en: So this is the point in the talk where everybody says, "That sounds so interesting, Wendy,
cues.zh: 演說到這個時點，大家通常會說： 「溫蒂，那聽起來好有趣，

cues.text: but I really will only want to know one thing.
cues.en: but I really will only want to know one thing.
cues.zh: 但我其實只想知道一件事，

cues.text: And that is, just tell me the minimum amount of exercise
cues.en: And that is, just tell me the minimum amount of exercise
cues.zh: 那就是隻要告訴我 最少要做多少運動

cues.text: I need to get all these changes." And so I'm going to tell you the answer to that question.
cues.en: I need to get all these changes." And so I'm going to tell you the answer to that question.
cues.zh: 才能得到所有這些改變。」 （笑聲） 所以，我會告訴各位 這個問題的答案。

cues.text: First, good news: you don't have to become a triathlete to get these effects.
cues.en: First, good news: you don't have to become a triathlete to get these effects.
cues.zh: 首先，好訊息：你不用變成鐵人三項 運動員也可以得到這些效應。

cues.text: The rule of thumb is you want to get three to four times a week exercise
cues.en: The rule of thumb is you want to get three to four times a week exercise
cues.zh: 經驗法則是，每週要運動三到四次，

cues.text: minimum 30 minutes an exercise session, and you want to get aerobic exercise in.
cues.en: minimum 30 minutes an exercise session, and you want to get aerobic exercise in.
cues.zh: 每次運動至少要有三十分鐘， 且你需要做一些有氧運動。

cues.text: That is, get your heart rate up.
cues.en: That is, get your heart rate up.
cues.zh: 也就是要讓你的心跳升高。

cues.text: And the good news is, you don't have to go to the gym to get a very expensive gym membership.
cues.en: And the good news is, you don't have to go to the gym to get a very expensive gym membership.
cues.zh: 好訊息是你不需要去健身房 付很貴的健身房會費。

cues.text: Add an extra walk around the block in your power walk.
cues.en: Add an extra walk around the block in your power walk.
cues.zh: 在你健走的時候， 再額外多走一個街區。

cues.text: You see stairs -- take stairs.
cues.en: You see stairs -- take stairs.
cues.zh: 如果你看見有樓梯可走，走樓梯。

cues.text: And power-vacuuming can be as good as the aerobics class
cues.en: And power-vacuuming can be as good as the aerobics class
cues.zh: power-vacuuming 是很好的有氧課程選擇，

cues.text: that you were going to take at the gym.
cues.en: that you were going to take at the gym.
cues.zh: 如果你到健身房運動的話。

cues.text: So I've gone from memory pioneer to exercise explorer.
cues.en: So I've gone from memory pioneer to exercise explorer.
cues.zh: 所以，我從記憶的先驅拓荒者， 變成了運動探索者。

cues.text: From going into the innermost workings of the brain,
cues.en: From going into the innermost workings of the brain,
cues.zh: 從進入大腦最深處的運作活動，

cues.text: to trying to understand how exercise can improve our brain function,
cues.en: to trying to understand how exercise can improve our brain function,
cues.zh: 變成試圖瞭解運動 如何能改善大腦功能，

cues.text: and my goal in my lab right now is to go beyond that rule of thumb that I just gave you --
cues.en: and my goal in my lab right now is to go beyond that rule of thumb that I just gave you --
cues.zh: 現在，我的實驗室的目標 是要超越我剛剛 跟各位說的經驗法則──

cues.text: three to four times a week, 30 minutes.
cues.en: three to four times a week, 30 minutes.
cues.zh: 每週三到四次，每次三十分鐘。

cues.text: I want to understand the optimum exercise prescription
cues.en: I want to understand the optimum exercise prescription
cues.zh: 我想要了解最理想的 運動處方是什麼，

cues.text: for you, at your age, at your fitness level,
cues.en: for you, at your age, at your fitness level,
cues.zh: 針對你，根據你的年齡、 你的健康程度、

cues.text: for your genetic background, to maximize the effects of exercise today
cues.en: for your genetic background, to maximize the effects of exercise today
cues.zh: 你的基因背景， 來把今天的運動效應給最大化，

cues.text: and also to improve your brain and protect your brain the best
cues.en: and also to improve your brain and protect your brain the best
cues.zh: 同時把改善及保護 你的大腦做到最好，

cues.text: for the rest of your life.
cues.en: for the rest of your life.
cues.zh: 讓你一生都能受益。

cues.text: But it's one thing to talk about exercise, and it's another to do it.
cues.en: But it's one thing to talk about exercise, and it's another to do it.
cues.zh: 但，「談」運動是一回事， 「做」運動是另一回事。

cues.text: So I'm going to invoke my power as a certified exercise instructor,
cues.en: So I'm going to invoke my power as a certified exercise instructor,
cues.zh: 所以，我要實行我身為 認證運動指導員的權力，

cues.text: to ask you all to stand up.
cues.en: to ask you all to stand up.
cues.zh: 請各位都站起來。

cues.text: We're going to do just one minute of exercise.
cues.en: We're going to do just one minute of exercise.
cues.zh: 我們只運動一分鐘。

cues.text: It's call-and-response, just do what I do, say what I say, and make sure you don't punch your neighbor, OK?
cues.en: It's call-and-response, just do what I do, say what I say, and make sure you don't punch your neighbor, OK?
cues.zh: 它類似「呼喊和回應」， 只要做我做的動作，說我說的話， 然後小心不要打到旁邊的人，好嗎？

cues.text: Music!
cues.en: Music!
cues.zh: 音樂！

cues.text: Five, six, seven, eight, it's right, left, right, left.
cues.en: Five, six, seven, eight, it's right, left, right, left.
cues.zh: 五、六、七、八，右、左、右、左。

cues.text: And I say, I am strong now.
cues.en: And I say, I am strong now.
cues.zh: 我說，我現在很強壯。

cues.text: Let's hear you.
cues.en: Let's hear you.
cues.zh: 換你們說。

cues.text: Audience: I am strong now.
cues.en: Audience: I am strong now.
cues.zh: 觀眾：我現在很強壯。

cues.text: Wendy Suzuki: Ladies, I am Wonder Woman-strong.
cues.en: Wendy Suzuki: Ladies, I am Wonder Woman-strong.
cues.zh: 溫蒂鈴木：女士們， 我是神力女超人── 強壯。

cues.text: Let's hear you!
cues.en: Let's hear you!
cues.zh: 換你們說！

cues.text: Audience: I am Wonder Woman-strong.
cues.en: Audience: I am Wonder Woman-strong.
cues.zh: 觀眾：我是神力女超人── 強壯。

cues.text: WS: New move -- uppercut, right and left.
cues.en: WS: New move -- uppercut, right and left.
cues.zh: 溫蒂：新動作── 上勾拳，右、左。

cues.text: I am inspired now. You say it!
cues.en: I am inspired now. You say it!
cues.zh: 我現在受到鼓舞。換你們說！

cues.text: Audience: I am inspired now.
cues.en: Audience: I am inspired now.
cues.zh: 觀眾：我現在受到鼓舞。

cues.text: WS: Last move -- pull it down, right and left, right and left.
cues.en: WS: Last move -- pull it down, right and left, right and left.
cues.zh: 溫蒂：最後一個動作── 拉下來，右、左、右、左。

cues.text: I say, I am on fire now! You say it.
cues.en: I say, I am on fire now! You say it.
cues.zh: 我說，我現在如火燃燒！換你們說。

cues.text: Audience: I am on fire now.
cues.en: Audience: I am on fire now.
cues.zh: 觀眾：我現在如火燃燒。

cues.text: WS: And done! OK, good job!
cues.en: WS: And done! OK, good job!
cues.zh: 溫蒂：完成！好，做得好！

cues.text: Thank you.
cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 謝謝。

cues.text: I want to leave you with one last thought.
cues.en: I want to leave you with one last thought.
cues.zh: 最後我想留給各位一個想法，

cues.text: And that is, bringing exercise in your life will not only give you a happier, more protective life today,
cues.en: And that is, bringing exercise in your life will not only give you a happier, more protective life today,
cues.zh: 就是把運動帶入你的生活 不僅讓你今天更快樂、更受保護，

cues.text: but it will protect your brain from incurable diseases.
cues.en: but it will protect your brain from incurable diseases.
cues.zh: 還能保護你的大腦， 不受無法治癒的疾病所侵害。

cues.text: And in this way it will change the trajectory of your life
cues.en: And in this way it will change the trajectory of your life
cues.zh: 這麼一來就能改變你人生的軌道，

cues.text: for the better.
cues.en: for the better.
cues.zh: 朝著更好的方向。

cues.text: Thank you very much.
cues.en: Thank you very much.
cues.zh: 非常謝謝。

cues.text: Thank you.
cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 謝謝。

cues.text: It's a silent sleep loss epidemic, and it's fast becoming one of the greatest public health challenges
cues.en: It's a silent sleep loss epidemic, and it's fast becoming one of the greatest public health challenges
cues.zh: 這個悄然無聲的睡眠不足疫情， 正迅速成為人們在 21 世紀面臨的

cues.text: that we face in the 21st century.
cues.en: that we face in the 21st century.
cues.zh: 公共衛生方面的最大挑戰之一。

cues.text: I believe it is now time for us to reclaim our right
cues.en: I believe it is now time for us to reclaim our right
cues.zh: 我相信現在是拿回權力的時候了，

cues.text: to a full night of sleep, and without embarrassment
cues.en: to a full night of sleep, and without embarrassment
cues.zh: 對每晚享有充足的睡眠 並不需要感到不好意思

cues.text: or that unfortunate stigma of laziness.
cues.en: or that unfortunate stigma of laziness.
cues.zh: 也不要擔心招來被視為懶惰的恥辱。

cues.text: And in doing so, we can be reunited with the most powerful elixir of life,
cues.en: And in doing so, we can be reunited with the most powerful elixir of life,
cues.zh: 這樣才能拿回生命賦予的 最強大的萬能藥，

cues.text: the Swiss Army knife of health, as it were.
cues.en: the Swiss Army knife of health, as it were.
cues.zh: 就像是一把健康專用方面的 萬能瑞士刀一樣。

cues.text: And with that soapbox rant over, I will simply say, good night, good luck,
cues.en: And with that soapbox rant over, I will simply say, good night, good luck,
cues.zh: 我在此登高一呼就到這裡為止， 最後祝各位晚安，好運，

cues.text: and above all ...
cues.en: and above all ...
cues.zh: 更重要的是……

cues.text: I do hope you sleep well.
cues.en: I do hope you sleep well.
cues.zh: 祝大家都睡得好。

cues.text: Thank you very much indeed.
cues.en: Thank you very much indeed.
cues.zh: 祝大家都睡得好。 非常謝謝各位。 （掌聲）

cues.text: Thank you.
cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 謝謝。

cues.text: Thank you so much.
cues.en: Thank you so much.
cues.zh: 非常謝謝大家。

cues.text: David Biello: No, no. Stay there for a second.
cues.en: David Biello: No, no. Stay there for a second.
cues.zh: 非常謝謝大家。 比艾羅：等等，先別走。

cues.text: Good job not running away, though. I appreciate that.
cues.en: Good job not running away, though. I appreciate that.
cues.zh: 謝謝留下來多講幾句話。

cues.text: So that was terrifying.
cues.en: So that was terrifying.
cues.zh: 今天的主題太可怕了。 馬特‧沃克：不客氣。 比艾羅：謝謝。

cues.text: Matt Walker: You're welcome. DB: Yes, thank you, thank you.
cues.en: Matt Walker: You're welcome. DB: Yes, thank you, thank you.
cues.zh: 馬特‧沃克：不客氣。 比艾羅：謝謝。

cues.text: Since we can't catch up on sleep, what are we supposed to do?
cues.en: Since we can't catch up on sleep, what are we supposed to do?
cues.zh: 比：如果補眠是沒有幫助的， 那我們能做什麼呢？ 例如，當我們晚上在床上 翻來覆去無法入睡，

cues.text: What do we do when we're, like, tossing and turning in bed late at night
cues.en: What do we do when we're, like, tossing and turning in bed late at night
cues.zh: 例如，當我們晚上在床上 翻來覆去無法入睡，

cues.text: or doing shift work or whatever else?
cues.en: or doing shift work or whatever else?
cues.zh: 或因為上夜班或其他因素 不能睡覺怎麼辦？

cues.text: MW: So you're right, we can't catch up on sleep.
cues.en: MW: So you're right, we can't catch up on sleep.
cues.zh: 馬：你說對了，補眠不能解決問題。

cues.text: Sleep is not like the bank.
cues.en: Sleep is not like the bank.
cues.zh: 睡眠跟銀行貸款不一樣。

cues.text: You can't accumulate a debt and then hope to pay it off at a later point in time.
cues.en: You can't accumulate a debt and then hope to pay it off at a later point in time.
cues.zh: 你不能累積債務， 期望之後再來一次還清。

cues.text: I should also note the reason that it's so catastrophic and that our health deteriorates so quickly,
cues.en: I should also note the reason that it's so catastrophic and that our health deteriorates so quickly,
cues.zh: 我應該也要指出問題之所以如此嚴重 以及健康惡化如此之快的原因，

cues.text: first, it's because human beings are the only species that deliberately deprive themselves of sleep
cues.en: first, it's because human beings are the only species that deliberately deprive themselves of sleep
cues.zh: 首先，人類這個物種大概是唯一 會自己剝奪自己的睡眠

cues.text: for no apparent reason.
cues.en: for no apparent reason.
cues.zh: 且沒有明顯的理由。

cues.text: DB: Because we're smart.
cues.en: DB: Because we're smart.
cues.zh: 比：因為我們很聰明。

cues.text: MW: And I make that point because it means that Mother Nature,
cues.en: MW: And I make that point because it means that Mother Nature,
cues.zh: 馬：我講這一點是因為大自然 在整個進化過程中，

cues.text: throughout the course of evolution, has never had to face the challenge of this thing called sleep deprivation.
cues.en: throughout the course of evolution, has never had to face the challenge of this thing called sleep deprivation.
cues.zh: 在整個進化過程中， 從來沒有面臨過 「睡眠剝奪」的挑戰。

cues.text: So she's never developed a safety net, and that's why when you undersleep,
cues.en: So she's never developed a safety net, and that's why when you undersleep,
cues.zh: 所以也沒有發展出安全網， 因此當你缺乏睡眠時，

cues.text: things just sort of implode so quickly, both within the brain and the body.
cues.en: things just sort of implode so quickly, both within the brain and the body.
cues.zh: 因此當你缺乏睡眠時， 你的腦部與身體 很快就崩潰無法招架。

cues.text: So you just have to prioritize.
cues.en: So you just have to prioritize.
cues.zh: 所以你只能用輕重緩急 決定優先順序。

cues.text: DB: OK, but tossing and turning in bed, what do I do?
cues.en: DB: OK, but tossing and turning in bed, what do I do?
cues.zh: 比：好，可是當我在床上輾轉難眠時， 我能做什麼？ 馬：當你躺在床上很久仍了無睡意，

cues.text: MW: So if you are staying in bed awake for too long,
cues.en: MW: So if you are staying in bed awake for too long,
cues.zh: 馬：當你躺在床上很久仍了無睡意，

cues.text: you should get out of bed and go to a different room and do something different.
cues.en: you should get out of bed and go to a different room and do something different.
cues.zh: 不如起床，去另一個房間 做點什麼不同的事。

cues.text: The reason is because your brain will very quickly associate your bedroom
cues.en: The reason is because your brain will very quickly associate your bedroom
cues.zh: 不然你的大腦很快就會把你的臥室

cues.text: with the place of wakefulness, and you need to break that association.
cues.en: with the place of wakefulness, and you need to break that association.
cues.zh: 跟清醒狀態連結在一起， 你必須打破那個連結。

cues.text: So only return to bed when you are sleepy, and that way you will relearn the association that you once had,
cues.en: So only return to bed when you are sleepy, and that way you will relearn the association that you once had,
cues.zh: 當你睡意來了再回去臥室， 那樣子你才能重建以前的連結──

cues.text: which is your bed is the place of sleep.
cues.en: which is your bed is the place of sleep.
cues.zh: 也就是床等於睡覺之處。

cues.text: So the analogy would be, you'd never sit at the dinner table, waiting to get hungry,
cues.en: So the analogy would be, you'd never sit at the dinner table, waiting to get hungry,
cues.zh: 也就是床等於睡覺之處。 這也有點類似， 你不會去坐在餐桌等飢餓感，

cues.text: so why would you lie in bed, waiting to get sleepy?
cues.en: so why would you lie in bed, waiting to get sleepy?
cues.zh: 所以你為什麼要躺在床上等睡意？

cues.text: DB: Well, thank you for that wake-up call.
cues.en: DB: Well, thank you for that wake-up call.
cues.zh: 比：嗯，謝謝你的醒世之喚。

cues.text: Great job, Matt.
cues.en: Great job, Matt.
cues.zh: 很棒的演說，馬特。 馬：不客氣。謝謝大家。

cues.text: MW: You're very welcome. Thank you very much.
cues.en: MW: You're very welcome. Thank you very much.
cues.zh: 馬：不客氣。謝謝大家。

OyK0oE5rwFY.title: The benefits of good posture - Murat Dalkilinç
OyK0oE5rwFY.speaker: TED-Ed
OyK0oE5rwFY.zh: 【TED-Ed】良好姿勢的好處 - Murat Dalkilinç（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Has anyone ever told you, "Stand up straight!" or scolded you for slouching at a family dinner?
cues.en: Has anyone ever told you, "Stand up straight!" or scolded you for slouching at a family dinner?
cues.zh: 有沒有人曾經告訴過你：“站直！” 或是和家人晚餐時 因為彎腰駝背而被訓斥？

cues.text: Comments like that might be annoying, but they're not wrong.
cues.en: Comments like that might be annoying, but they're not wrong.
cues.zh: 或是和家人晚餐時 因為彎腰駝背而被訓斥？ 雖說 “忠言逆耳”， 但他們並沒有錯

cues.text: Your posture, the way you hold your body when you're sitting or standing,
cues.en: Your posture, the way you hold your body when you're sitting or standing,
cues.zh: 雖說 “忠言逆耳”， 但他們並沒有錯 當你或坐或站時， 姿勢（維持身體的方式）

cues.text: is the foundation for every movement your body makes, and can determine how well your body adapts to the stresses on it.
cues.en: is the foundation for every movement your body makes, and can determine how well your body adapts to the stresses on it.
cues.zh: 當你或坐或站時， 姿勢（維持身體的方式） 是每個動作的基礎 且能決定你如何適應加諸身體的壓力

cues.text: These stresses can be things like carrying weight, or sitting in an awkward position.
cues.en: These stresses can be things like carrying weight, or sitting in an awkward position.
cues.zh: 這些壓力可能是搬運重物 或者彆扭的坐姿 而每天承受最大的壓力就是：重力

cues.text: And the big one we all experience all day every day: gravity.
cues.en: And the big one we all experience all day every day: gravity.
cues.zh: 而每天承受最大的壓力就是：重力 如果你的姿勢不良

cues.text: If your posture isn't optimal, your muscles have to work harder to keep you upright and balanced.
cues.en: If your posture isn't optimal, your muscles have to work harder to keep you upright and balanced.
cues.zh: 而每天承受最大的壓力就是：重力 如果你的姿勢不良 肌肉就需要更用力 來維持直立與平衡

cues.text: Some muscles will become tight and inflexbile.
cues.en: Some muscles will become tight and inflexbile.
cues.zh: 有些肌肉會變得緊繃而僵硬 有些則會受到抑制而鬆弛

cues.text: Others will be inhibited.
cues.en: Others will be inhibited.
cues.zh: 有些肌肉會變得緊繃而僵硬 有些則會受到抑制而鬆弛

cues.text: Over time, these dysfunctional adaptations impair your body's ability to deal with the forces on it.
cues.en: Over time, these dysfunctional adaptations impair your body's ability to deal with the forces on it.
cues.zh: 有些則會受到抑制而鬆弛 時間一久，這些不正常的協調動作 將會損害你身體對抗外力的能力

cues.text: Poor posture inflicts extra wear and tear on your joints and ligaments,
cues.en: Poor posture inflicts extra wear and tear on your joints and ligaments,
cues.zh: 將會損害你身體對抗外力的能力 不良姿勢會對關節 和韌帶造成更多磨損 增加意外的可能

cues.text: increases the likelihood of accidents, and makes some organs, like your lungs, less efficient.
cues.en: increases the likelihood of accidents, and makes some organs, like your lungs, less efficient.
cues.zh: 增加意外的可能 並且降低某些器官的效能，例如肺

cues.text: Researchers have linked poor posture to scoliosis, tension headaches,
cues.en: Researchers have linked poor posture to scoliosis, tension headaches,
cues.zh: 並且降低某些器官的效能，例如肺 研究者認為脊椎側凸、 緊張性頭痛 以及背痛都和姿勢不良有關

cues.text: and back pain, though it isn't the exclusive cause of any of them.
cues.en: and back pain, though it isn't the exclusive cause of any of them.
cues.zh: 以及背痛都和姿勢不良有關 雖然它並不是唯一的原因

cues.text: Posture can even influence your emotional state and your sensitivity to pain.
cues.en: Posture can even influence your emotional state and your sensitivity to pain.
cues.zh: 姿勢甚至可以影響情緒 和對疼痛的敏感度 所以保持良好的姿勢 並不是沒有道理的

cues.text: So there are a lot of reasons to aim for good posture.
cues.en: So there are a lot of reasons to aim for good posture.
cues.zh: 所以保持良好的姿勢 並不是沒有道理的

cues.text: But it's getting harder these days.
cues.en: But it's getting harder these days.
cues.zh: 所以保持良好的姿勢 並不是沒有道理的 但現在保持良好的姿勢越來越難了

cues.text: Sitting in an awkward position for a long time can promote poor posture,
cues.en: Sitting in an awkward position for a long time can promote poor posture,
cues.zh: 但現在保持良好的姿勢越來越難了 長時間用彆扭的坐姿會促成姿勢不良 使用電腦和其他行動裝置亦同

cues.text: and so can using computers or mobile devices, which encourage you to look downward.
cues.en: and so can using computers or mobile devices, which encourage you to look downward.
cues.zh: 使用電腦和其他行動裝置亦同 因為它們讓你變成低頭族 許多研究顯示， 一般人的姿勢變得越來越糟糕了

cues.text: Many studies suggest that, on average, posture is getting worse.
cues.en: Many studies suggest that, on average, posture is getting worse.
cues.zh: 許多研究顯示， 一般人的姿勢變得越來越糟糕了

cues.text: So what does good posture look like?
cues.en: So what does good posture look like?
cues.zh: 許多研究顯示， 一般人的姿勢變得越來越糟糕了 好姿勢看起來 是怎麼樣的呢？

cues.text: When you look at the spine from the front or the back, all 33 vertebrae should appear stacked in a straight line.
cues.en: When you look at the spine from the front or the back, all 33 vertebrae should appear stacked in a straight line.
cues.zh: 當從正面或背面來看脊椎時 33個脊椎骨看起來應該在一條直線上 從側面看，脊椎應當有三個彎

cues.text: From the side, the spine should have three curves: one at your neck, one at your shoulders, and one at the small of your back.
cues.en: From the side, the spine should have three curves: one at your neck, one at your shoulders, and one at the small of your back.
cues.zh: 從側面看，脊椎應當有三個彎 分別在脖子、肩膀以及腰背部

cues.text: You aren't born with this s-shaped spine.
cues.en: You aren't born with this s-shaped spine.
cues.zh: 人並不是天生就有這個 S 曲線的

cues.text: Babies' spines just have one curve like a "c." The other curves usually develop by 12-18 months
cues.en: Babies' spines just have one curve like a "c." The other curves usually develop by 12-18 months
cues.zh: 人並不是天生就有這個 S 曲線的 嬰兒的脊椎只有一個彎曲， 就像字母 C 其他的彎曲將會在 12-18 個月內

cues.text: as the muscles strengthen.
cues.en: as the muscles strengthen.
cues.zh: 隨著肌力的強化而形成 這些彎曲幫助我們直立 並幫我們分擔一些

cues.text: These curves help us stay upright and absorb some of the stress from activities like walking and jumping.
cues.en: These curves help us stay upright and absorb some of the stress from activities like walking and jumping.
cues.zh: 這些彎曲幫助我們直立 並幫我們分擔一些 來自於走路或跳躍的壓力 如果排列妥當

cues.text: If they are aligned properly, when you're standing up, you should be able to draw a straight line
cues.en: If they are aligned properly, when you're standing up, you should be able to draw a straight line
cues.zh: 如果排列妥當 當你直立時 從側面應當能畫一條直線

cues.text: from a point just in front of your shoulders, to behind your hip,
cues.en: from a point just in front of your shoulders, to behind your hip,
cues.zh: 從側面應當能畫一條直線 從肩膀前方開始 到臀部的後方

cues.text: to the front of your knee, to a few inches in front of your ankle.
cues.en: to the front of your knee, to a few inches in front of your ankle.
cues.zh: 到臀部的後方 到膝蓋前方 再到達腳踝前幾英吋的地方

cues.text: This keeps your center of gravity directly over your base of support,
cues.en: This keeps your center of gravity directly over your base of support,
cues.zh: 再到達腳踝前幾英吋的地方 這使得你的重心在支撐面的正上方

cues.text: which allows you to move efficiently with the least amount of fatigue and muscle strain.
cues.en: which allows you to move efficiently with the least amount of fatigue and muscle strain.
cues.zh: 讓你能有效率地移動 減少疲勞和肌肉緊張 坐著時，脖子應當豎直

cues.text: If you're sitting, your neck should be vertical, not tilted forward.
cues.en: If you're sitting, your neck should be vertical, not tilted forward.
cues.zh: 坐著時，脖子應當豎直 而不是前傾 肩膀應當放鬆，雙臂靠近軀幹

cues.text: Your shoulders should be relaxed with your arms close to your trunk.
cues.en: Your shoulders should be relaxed with your arms close to your trunk.
cues.zh: 而不是前傾 肩膀應當放鬆，雙臂靠近軀幹

cues.text: Your knees should be at a right angle with your feet flat on the floor.
cues.en: Your knees should be at a right angle with your feet flat on the floor.
cues.zh: 肩膀應當放鬆，雙臂靠近軀幹 膝蓋應該呈垂直彎曲， 腳掌平放在地面上

cues.text: But what if your posture isn't that great?
cues.en: But what if your posture isn't that great?
cues.zh: 膝蓋應該呈垂直彎曲， 腳掌平放在地面上 但如果你的姿勢並不是那樣好 嘗試重新設定所處的環境

cues.text: Try redesigning your environment.
cues.en: Try redesigning your environment.
cues.zh: 嘗試重新設定所處的環境 調整電腦螢幕， 使其與你的視線等高或略低

cues.text: Adjust your screen so it's at or slightly below eyelevel.
cues.en: Adjust your screen so it's at or slightly below eyelevel.
cues.zh: 調整電腦螢幕， 使其與你的視線等高或略低 確保你身體所有的部分

cues.text: Make sure all parts of your body, like your elbows and wrists, are supported,
cues.en: Make sure all parts of your body, like your elbows and wrists, are supported,
cues.zh: 調整電腦螢幕， 使其與你的視線等高或略低 確保你身體所有的部分 像肘部和手腕都有支撐

cues.text: using ergonomic aids if you need to.
cues.en: using ergonomic aids if you need to.
cues.zh: 像肘部和手腕都有支撐 必要時，使用人體工學的輔助裝置

cues.text: Try sleeping on your side with your neck supported and with a pillow between your legs.
cues.en: Try sleeping on your side with your neck supported and with a pillow between your legs.
cues.zh: 必要時，使用人體工學的輔助裝置 側睡時，試著讓脖子得到支撐 在雙腿之間夾一個枕頭

cues.text: Wear shoes with low heels and good arch support, and use a headset for phone calls.
cues.en: Wear shoes with low heels and good arch support, and use a headset for phone calls.
cues.zh: 在雙腿之間夾一個枕頭 穿低跟並保護足弓的鞋 並使用耳麥來接電話

cues.text: It's also not enough to just have good posture.
cues.en: It's also not enough to just have good posture.
cues.zh: 並使用耳麥來接電話 單單有好的姿勢是不夠的

cues.text: Keeping your muscles and joints moving is extremely important.
cues.en: Keeping your muscles and joints moving is extremely important.
cues.zh: 單單有好的姿勢是不夠的 保持肌肉和關節的運動很重要 事實上，長時間用好的姿勢保持靜止

cues.text: In fact, being stationary for long periods with good posture
cues.en: In fact, being stationary for long periods with good posture
cues.zh: 事實上，長時間用好的姿勢保持靜止

cues.text: can be worse than regular movement with bad posture.
cues.en: can be worse than regular movement with bad posture.
cues.zh: 可能比經常變換 不良的姿勢更加糟糕

cues.text: When you do move, move smartly.
