cues.text: Okay, we don’t care about visible light from the sun, we care about the higher energy
cues.en: Okay, we don’t care about visible light from the sun, we care about the higher energy
cues.zh: 好吧，我們不關心來自太陽的可見光，我們關心更高的能量

cues.text: ultraviolet radiation, or UV light.
cues.en: ultraviolet radiation, or UV light.
cues.zh: 紫外線輻射，或紫外線。

cues.text: Specifically, this part of UV called UVB.
cues.en: Specifically, this part of UV called UVB.
cues.zh: 具體來說，這部分紫外線稱為UVB。

cues.text: This is the same type that causes sunburns and skin cancer, but in small doses it’s
cues.en: This is the same type that causes sunburns and skin cancer, but in small doses it’s
cues.zh: 這與導致曬傷和皮膚癌的型別相同，但小劑量時它會

cues.text: fine.
cues.en: fine.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.text: Which sound a lot like my attempts at humor.
cues.en: Which sound a lot like my attempts at humor.
cues.zh: 這聽起來很像我的幽默嘗試。

cues.text: When UVB hits your skin, it stimulates a molecule in your skin called 7-dehydrocholesterol.
cues.en: When UVB hits your skin, it stimulates a molecule in your skin called 7-dehydrocholesterol.
cues.zh: 當 UVB 照射您的皮膚時，它會刺激皮膚中一種稱為 7-脫氫膽固醇的分子。

cues.text: This guy transforms into D3.
cues.en: This guy transforms into D3.
cues.zh: 這傢伙變身為D3。

cues.text: You could also eat a bunch of fatty fish and get D3, but either way, at this step, you’ve
cues.en: You could also eat a bunch of fatty fish and get D3, but either way, at this step, you’ve
cues.zh: 您也可以吃一堆富含脂肪的魚來獲取 D3，但無論哪種方式，在這一步，您都已經

cues.text: got a molecule called cholecalciferol, which doesn’t do anything yet.
cues.en: got a molecule called cholecalciferol, which doesn’t do anything yet.
cues.zh: 得到了一種叫做膽鈣化醇的分子，它還沒有任何作用。

cues.text: It has to go to the liver where its metabolized into a more useful form called 25-hydroxyvitamin
cues.en: It has to go to the liver where its metabolized into a more useful form called 25-hydroxyvitamin
cues.zh: 它必須進入肝臟，在那裡代謝成更有用的形式，稱為 25-羥基維生素

cues.text: D3, then the kidney converts it into a hormone called calcitriol which is the form that can
cues.en: D3, then the kidney converts it into a hormone called calcitriol which is the form that can
cues.zh: D3，然後腎臟將其轉化為一種稱為骨化三醇的激素，這種形式可以

cues.text: actually do stuff.
cues.en: actually do stuff.
cues.zh: 實際上做事。

cues.text: Some studies show that the vascular wall within blood vessels can do these conversions too,
cues.en: Some studies show that the vascular wall within blood vessels can do these conversions too,
cues.zh: 一些研究顯示血管內的血管壁也可以進行這些轉換，

cues.text: but at a much smaller level.
cues.en: but at a much smaller level.
cues.zh: 但水平小得多。

cues.text: But we end up with a vitamin D hormone, which is what throws people off.
cues.en: But we end up with a vitamin D hormone, which is what throws people off.
cues.zh: 但我們最終得到的是維生素 D 激素，這正是令人望而卻步的原因。

cues.text: Remember, a hormone is just a chemical that's secreted by a gland that travels through the bloodstream
cues.en: Remember, a hormone is just a chemical that's secreted by a gland that travels through the bloodstream
cues.zh: 請記住，荷爾蒙只是一種由腺體分泌並透過血液傳播的化學物質

cues.text: that have an effect somewhere else.
cues.en: that have an effect somewhere else.
cues.zh: 對其他地方有影響。

cues.text: And as a hormone, it subject to feedback loops and increased or decreased production when
cues.en: And as a hormone, it subject to feedback loops and increased or decreased production when
cues.zh: 作為一種激素，它會受到反饋迴圈的影響，並在以下情況下增加或減少產量：

cues.text: it’s needed, which it’s actually really good at.
cues.en: it’s needed, which it’s actually really good at.
cues.zh: 它是必需的，而且它實際上非常擅長。

cues.text: And you’ve probably heard of one of its biggest uses in the body — calcium absorption.
cues.en: And you’ve probably heard of one of its biggest uses in the body — calcium absorption.
cues.zh: 您可能聽說過它在體內最大的用途之一—鈣吸收。

cues.text: Ever notice that milk always has vitamin D in it?
cues.en: Ever notice that milk always has vitamin D in it?
cues.zh: 有沒有註意到牛奶中總是含有維生素 D？

cues.text: That’s to help your body absorb calcium.
cues.en: That’s to help your body absorb calcium.
cues.zh: 這是為了幫助你的身體吸收鈣質。

cues.text: Here’s the thing though, Hormone D has receptors on most of the cells in your body.
cues.en: Here’s the thing though, Hormone D has receptors on most of the cells in your body.
cues.zh: 但事實是，荷爾蒙 D 在您體內的大多數細胞上都有受體。

cues.text: So it’s way more useful that just helping you with calcium absorption.
cues.en: So it’s way more useful that just helping you with calcium absorption.
cues.zh: 所以它比僅僅幫助你吸收鈣更有用。

cues.text: According to a 2010 article in the journal Diabetes, people with low amounts of Vitamin
cues.en: According to a 2010 article in the journal Diabetes, people with low amounts of Vitamin
cues.zh: 根據 2010 年《糖尿病》雜誌上的一篇文章，維生素含量低的人

cues.text: D had a 60% higher chance of heart disease than people with higher concentrations.
cues.en: D had a 60% higher chance of heart disease than people with higher concentrations.
cues.zh: D比濃度較高的人罹患心臟病的機率高出60%。

cues.text: Same goes for high blood pressure.
cues.en: Same goes for high blood pressure.
cues.zh: 高血壓也是如此。

cues.text: Lower Vitamin D is heavily correlated with increased blood pressure.
cues.en: Lower Vitamin D is heavily correlated with increased blood pressure.
cues.zh: 維生素 D 水平較低與血壓升高密切相關。

cues.text: Vitamin D also has a role in brain function and might help against depression.
cues.en: Vitamin D also has a role in brain function and might help against depression.
cues.zh: 維生素 D 對大腦功能也有一定作用，可能有助於對抗憂鬱症。

cues.text: One study in 2008 found that a year of Vitamin D supplementation significantly improved symptoms
cues.en: One study in 2008 found that a year of Vitamin D supplementation significantly improved symptoms
cues.zh: 2008 年的一項研究發現，補充維生素 D 一年可顯著改善症狀

cues.text: of depression.
cues.en: of depression.
cues.zh: 憂鬱症。

cues.text: This was in pill form, not sunlight, so any improved mood wasn’t from lifestyle changes.
cues.en: This was in pill form, not sunlight, so any improved mood wasn’t from lifestyle changes.
cues.zh: 這是藥丸形式，而不是陽光，因此任何情緒的改善都不是來自生活方式的改變。

cues.text: Point is, Vitamin D is so much more useful than just helping with calcium absorption.
cues.en: Point is, Vitamin D is so much more useful than just helping with calcium absorption.
cues.zh: 重點是，維生素 D 比僅僅幫助鈣吸收更有用。

cues.text: It can help make insulin, stimulate our immune system, it’s involved in gene regulation,
cues.en: It can help make insulin, stimulate our immune system, it’s involved in gene regulation,
cues.zh: 它可以幫助製造胰島素，刺激我們的免疫系統，它參與基因調節，

cues.text: and can even help in preventing certain cancers.
cues.en: and can even help in preventing certain cancers.
cues.zh: 甚至可以幫助預防某些癌症。

cues.text: Which is ironic considering the whole sunlight and skin cancer thing.
cues.en: Which is ironic considering the whole sunlight and skin cancer thing.
cues.zh: 考慮到整個陽光和皮膚癌的事情，這很諷刺。

cues.text: A couple things to keep in mind though.
cues.en: A couple things to keep in mind though.
cues.zh: 不過，有幾件事要記住。

cues.text: Like as you get older, your ability to crank out D3 from sunlight goes down.
cues.en: Like as you get older, your ability to crank out D3 from sunlight goes down.
cues.zh: 就像隨著年齡的增長，您從陽光中提取 D3 的能力會下降。

cues.text: So if you’re an older adult, you may need a bit more sun to get their vitamin D.
cues.en: So if you’re an older adult, you may need a bit more sun to get their vitamin D.
cues.zh: 因此，如果您是老年人，可能需要多曬曬太陽才能獲取維生素 D。

cues.text: Luckily, that’s not a problem in America.
cues.en: Luckily, that’s not a problem in America.
cues.zh: 幸運的是，這在美國不是問題。

cues.text: Looking at you Florida.
cues.en: Looking at you Florida.
cues.zh: 看著你佛羅裡達。

cues.text: Plus, if you have darker skin, you have more of a pigment called melanin.
cues.en: Plus, if you have darker skin, you have more of a pigment called melanin.
cues.zh: 另外，如果你的皮膚較黑，你會有更多一種叫做黑色素的色素。

cues.text: This pigment absorbs UVB, which is good news because your skin has a naturally higher sun
cues.en: This pigment absorbs UVB, which is good news because your skin has a naturally higher sun
cues.zh: 這種色素吸收 UVB，這是個好訊息，因為您的皮膚天然具有更高的陽光照射

cues.text: protection factor, but it also means you’re more likely to have vitamin D deficiency.
cues.en: protection factor, but it also means you’re more likely to have vitamin D deficiency.
cues.zh: 保護因素，但這也意味著您更有可能缺乏維生素 D。

cues.text: So folks with darker skin have to balance the D3 they get from diet along with sun exposure
cues.en: So folks with darker skin have to balance the D3 they get from diet along with sun exposure
cues.zh: 因此，膚色較深的人必須平衡從飲食中獲取的維生素 D3 和陽光照射

cues.text: making sure they’re not overdoing it on either.
cues.en: making sure they’re not overdoing it on either.
cues.zh: 確保他們在這兩個方面都沒有做得太過分。

cues.text: Exposure to sunlight is still our most efficient way of making Vitamin D, and that process
cues.en: Exposure to sunlight is still our most efficient way of making Vitamin D, and that process
cues.zh: 暴露在陽光下仍然是我們製造維生素 D 最有效的方法，而這個過程

cues.text: starts in our skin, which is something I wanted to underline.
cues.en: starts in our skin, which is something I wanted to underline.
cues.zh: 始於我們的皮膚，這是我想強調的一點。

cues.text: Because oftentimes we see our skin as just like, a protective layer.
cues.en: Because oftentimes we see our skin as just like, a protective layer.
cues.zh: 因為我們經常將皮膚視為保護層。

cues.text: When in reality it’s the largest organ in our body and it’s really active in homeostasis.
cues.en: When in reality it’s the largest organ in our body and it’s really active in homeostasis.
cues.zh: 事實上，它是我們體內最大的器官，而且它在體內平衡方面非常活躍。

cues.text: I’ve got a bunch of traditional anatomy and physiology learning videos scheduled for
cues.en: I’ve got a bunch of traditional anatomy and physiology learning videos scheduled for
cues.zh: 我安排了一堆傳統解剖學和生理學學習影片

cues.text: the fall.
cues.en: the fall.
cues.zh: 秋天。

cues.text: I’m still writing those.
cues.en: I’m still writing those.
cues.zh: 我還在寫那些。

cues.text: Also, all of these videos go out a few days earlier for Patrons, if you’re into that,
cues.en: Also, all of these videos go out a few days earlier for Patrons, if you’re into that,
cues.zh: 另外，所有這些影片都會提前幾天向訂閱者發布，如果您對此感興趣的話，

cues.text: click here.
cues.en: click here.
cues.zh: 點這裡。

cues.text: Otherwise, subscribe and hit the bell for notifications.
cues.en: Otherwise, subscribe and hit the bell for notifications.
cues.zh: 否則，請訂閱並按下響鈴以獲取通知。

cues.text: Or you can watch more of my videos here and here.
cues.en: Or you can watch more of my videos here and here.
cues.zh: 或者您可以在這裡和這裡觀看更多我的影片。

cues.text: Have fun, be good.
cues.en: Have fun, be good.
cues.zh: 玩得開心，做個好人。

rBdhqBGqiMc.title: Reduce Anxiety & Stress with the Physiological Sigh | Huberman Lab Quantal Clip
rBdhqBGqiMc.speaker: Andrew Huberman
rBdhqBGqiMc.zh: 【Andrew Huberman】透過生理嘆息減輕焦慮和壓力| Huberman 實驗室量子夾（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Billions of people suffer from stress and there are tools to combat stress that involve things
cues.en: Billions of people suffer from stress and there are tools to combat stress that involve things
cues.zh: 數十億人承受著壓力，有一些工具可以緩解壓力，其中涉及一些事情

cues.text: like meditation, breath work, good nutrition, good social connections
cues.en: like meditation, breath work, good nutrition, good social connections
cues.zh: 例如冥想、呼吸練習、良好的營養、良好的社交關係

cues.text: and avoiding all bad things in life.
cues.en: and avoiding all bad things in life.
cues.zh: 並避免生活中所有不好的事情。

cues.text: And while those are powerful, the problem is, they require that people step away
cues.en: And while those are powerful, the problem is, they require that people step away
cues.zh: 雖然這些很強大，但問題是，它們要求人們離開

cues.text: from the stress inducing activity.
cues.en: from the stress inducing activity.
cues.zh: 來自誘發壓力的活動。

cues.text: By contrast, my lab and other laboratories have been very interested in developing tools that allow us to push back on stress.
cues.en: By contrast, my lab and other laboratories have been very interested in developing tools that allow us to push back on stress.
cues.zh: 相較之下，我的實驗室和其他實驗室對開發能夠幫助我們緩解壓力的工具非常感興趣。

cues.text: In other words, feel more calm in real time, meaning without having to disengage
cues.en: In other words, feel more calm in real time, meaning without having to disengage
cues.zh: 換句話說，即時感到更加平靜，這意味著無需脫離

cues.text: from the stress inducing activity.
cues.en: from the stress inducing activity.
cues.zh: 來自誘發壓力的活動。

cues.text: The best way that I am aware to do that is called the physiological sigh.
cues.en: The best way that I am aware to do that is called the physiological sigh.
cues.zh: 據我所知，做到這一點的最好方法稱為生理嘆息。

cues.text: A physiological sigh is a pattern of breathing that involves two inhales followed by an extended exhale.
cues.en: A physiological sigh is a pattern of breathing that involves two inhales followed by an extended exhale.
cues.zh: 生理嘆息是一種呼吸模式，涉及兩次吸氣，然後延長呼氣。

cues.text: Physiological sighs were discovered in the 1930s, as a pattern of breathing
cues.en: Physiological sighs were discovered in the 1930s, as a pattern of breathing
cues.zh: 生理嘆息在 20 世紀 30 年代被發現，是一種呼吸模式

cues.text: that people go into spontaneously when they're in claustrophobic environments
cues.en: that people go into spontaneously when they're in claustrophobic environments
cues.zh: 當人們處於幽閉恐怖環境時，他們會自發性地進入

cues.text: or in deep sleep, when there's a buildup of a gas called carbon dioxide in the blood stream.
cues.en: or in deep sleep, when there's a buildup of a gas called carbon dioxide in the blood stream.
cues.zh: 或是在深度睡眠時，血液中會累積一種叫做二氧化碳的氣體。

cues.text: Carbon dioxide triggers the impulse to breathe.
cues.en: Carbon dioxide triggers the impulse to breathe.
cues.zh: 二氧化碳觸發呼吸衝動。

cues.text: There are neurons in the brain that know when carbon dioxide levels have gotten too high.
cues.en: There are neurons in the brain that know when carbon dioxide levels have gotten too high.
cues.zh: 大腦中的神經元知道二氧化碳濃度何時過高。

cues.text: And when the levels get too high, they trigger inhale and exhale, or double inhale and exhale.
cues.en: And when the levels get too high, they trigger inhale and exhale, or double inhale and exhale.
cues.zh: 當水平過高時，它們會觸發吸氣和呼氣，或雙吸氣和呼氣。

cues.text: Now you can do physiological sighs voluntarily, anytime you're feeling too stressed
cues.en: Now you can do physiological sighs voluntarily, anytime you're feeling too stressed
cues.zh: 現在，無論何時您感到壓力過大，您都可以自願進行生理嘆息

cues.text: and you want to feel more calm.
cues.en: and you want to feel more calm.
cues.zh: 你想要感覺更平靜。

cues.text: You do it like this.
cues.en: You do it like this.
cues.zh: 你這樣做。

cues.text: So it's a double inhale.
cues.en: So it's a double inhale.
cues.zh: 所以這是雙吸氣。

cues.text: And typically, the first inhale is longer than the second but the second one is still important to do.
cues.en: And typically, the first inhale is longer than the second but the second one is still important to do.
cues.zh: 通常，第一次吸氣比第二次吸氣要長，但第二次吸氣仍然很重要。

cues.text: And then a very long, extended exhale.
cues.en: And then a very long, extended exhale.
cues.zh: 然後是很長很長的呼氣。

cues.text: Typically, both inhales are through the nose and the exhale is through the mouth.
cues.en: Typically, both inhales are through the nose and the exhale is through the mouth.
cues.zh: 通常，吸氣都是透過鼻子，呼氣是透過嘴巴。

cues.text: That's the most effective way to do the physiological sigh.
cues.en: That's the most effective way to do the physiological sigh.
cues.zh: 這是進行生理嘆息的最有效方法。

cues.text: However, you can't breathe through your nose or your mouth for whatever reason do it all through your mouth or all through your nose.
cues.en: However, you can't breathe through your nose or your mouth for whatever reason do it all through your mouth or all through your nose.
cues.zh: 但是，無論出於何種原因，您都無法透過鼻子或嘴巴呼吸，只能透過嘴巴或鼻子呼吸。

cues.text: The second inhale is really important because your lungs are not just two big bags of air.
cues.en: The second inhale is really important because your lungs are not just two big bags of air.
cues.zh: 第二次吸氣非常重要，因為你的肺部不只是兩大袋空氣。

cues.text: They're two big bags of air with lots of little sacks, millions of sacks.
cues.en: They're two big bags of air with lots of little sacks, millions of sacks.
cues.zh: 它們是兩個大空氣袋，裡面有很多小袋子，數百萬個袋子。

cues.text: And if you were to lay out those sacks, their volume is as big as a tennis court.
cues.en: And if you were to lay out those sacks, their volume is as big as a tennis court.
cues.zh: 如果你把這些麻袋攤開，它們的體積就跟一個網球場一樣大。

cues.text: And that allows both the intake of more oxygen but also the offload of carbon dioxide.
cues.en: And that allows both the intake of more oxygen but also the offload of carbon dioxide.
cues.zh: 這樣既可以吸收更多的氧氣，又可以排出二氧化碳。

cues.text: So when you do the double inhale, it reinflates any of these little sacks that have collapsed
cues.en: So when you do the double inhale, it reinflates any of these little sacks that have collapsed
cues.zh: 所以當你進行雙吸氣時，它會重新充氣這些已經塌陷的小袋子

cues.text: and in doing so, it allows you to offload more carbon dioxide.
cues.en: and in doing so, it allows you to offload more carbon dioxide.
cues.zh: 這樣做可以讓你排出更多的二氧化碳。

cues.text: So if you're feeling stressed in any circumstance, inhale twice through the nose and then exhale long
cues.en: So if you're feeling stressed in any circumstance, inhale twice through the nose and then exhale long
cues.zh: 因此，如果您在任何情況下感到壓力，請透過鼻子吸氣兩次，然後長時間呼氣

cues.text: through the mouth, if you want, you can repeat it a second or even a third time, but typically, just one or two,
cues.en: through the mouth, if you want, you can repeat it a second or even a third time, but typically, just one or two,
cues.zh: 透過嘴，如果你願意，你可以重複第二次甚至第三次，但通常只重複一兩次，

cues.text: maybe three physiological sighs are sufficient to bring your level of stress
cues.en: maybe three physiological sighs are sufficient to bring your level of stress
cues.zh: 也許三聲生理嘆息就足以帶來你的壓力程度

cues.text: and alertness down very fast and allow you to feel more calm.
cues.en: and alertness down very fast and allow you to feel more calm.
cues.zh: 而且警覺性下降得很快，讓你感覺更平靜。

WPPPFqsECz0.title: An Antidote to Dissatisfaction
WPPPFqsECz0.speaker: Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell
WPPPFqsECz0.zh: 【Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell】不滿的解藥（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Everybody's familiar with the feeling that things are not as they should be.
cues.en: Everybody's familiar with the feeling that things are not as they should be.
cues.zh: 所有人都熟悉這種「萬事不如己意」的感覺

cues.text: That you're not successful enough.
cues.en: That you're not successful enough.
cues.zh: 所有人都熟悉這種「萬事不如己意」的感覺 覺得自己不夠成功

cues.text: Your relationships not satisfying enough.
cues.en: Your relationships not satisfying enough.
cues.zh: 覺得自己不夠成功 人際關係不夠完美

cues.text: That you don't have the things you crave.
cues.en: That you don't have the things you crave.
cues.zh: 得不到你所渴望的

cues.text: A chronic dissatisfaction that makes you look outwards with envy,
cues.en: A chronic dissatisfaction that makes you look outwards with envy,
cues.zh: 常常對生活感到不滿 使你對其他人充滿嫉妒心

cues.text: and inwards with disappointment.
cues.en: and inwards with disappointment.
cues.zh: 使你對其他人充滿嫉妒心 並對自己感到失望

cues.text: Pop culture, advertising, and social media made this worse
cues.en: Pop culture, advertising, and social media made this worse
cues.zh: 而流行文化、廣告和社交媒體使該情況更糟

cues.text: by reminding you that aiming for anything less than your dream job is failure,
cues.en: by reminding you that aiming for anything less than your dream job is failure,
cues.zh: 不斷提醒你達不到夢想的工作是多麼失敗

cues.text: you need to have great experiences constantly, be conventionally attractive, have a lot of friends, and find your soulmate,
cues.en: you need to have great experiences constantly, be conventionally attractive, have a lot of friends, and find your soulmate,
cues.zh: 不斷提醒你達不到夢想的工作是多麼失敗 你需要不斷地擁有許多優秀經歷 具有吸引力、擁有很多的朋友 找到你的靈魂伴侶

cues.text: and that others have all of these things and are truly happy.
cues.en: and that others have all of these things and are truly happy.
cues.zh: 找到你的靈魂伴侶 以及擁有這些事物的人們才算真正地感到幸福

cues.text: And of course, a vast array of self-improvement products implies that it's all your fault for not working hard enough for yourself.
cues.en: And of course, a vast array of self-improvement products implies that it's all your fault for not working hard enough for yourself.
cues.zh: 當然，市面上有許多種 自我提升的產品 都在暗示你對自己的未來不夠努力

cues.text: In the last two decades, researchers have been starting to investigate how we can counteract these impulses.
cues.en: In the last two decades, researchers have been starting to investigate how we can counteract these impulses.
cues.zh: 在過去的二十年中 研究人員開始調查了我們要如何抵抗這些想法

cues.text: The field of positive psychology emerged—the study of what makes life worth living,
cues.en: The field of positive psychology emerged—the study of what makes life worth living,
cues.zh: 「正向心理學」領域因此而生 該領域研究什麼事物使生活更美好

cues.text: while cognitive behavioral therapy was developed to change negative feelings.
cues.en: while cognitive behavioral therapy was developed to change negative feelings.
cues.zh: 該領域研究什麼事物使生活更美好 而「認知行為療法」 主要在改善負面的想法

cues.text: Scientists began to ask, "why are some people happier and more satisfied than others,
cues.en: Scientists began to ask, "why are some people happier and more satisfied than others,
cues.zh: 而「認知行為療法」 主要在改善負面的想法 科學家開始問 「為什麼有些人比其他人更快樂、更滿足？」

cues.text: and are there ways to apply what they're doing right to the rest of us?"
cues.en: and are there ways to apply what they're doing right to the rest of us?"
cues.zh: 科學家開始問 「為什麼有些人比其他人更快樂、更滿足？」 「有沒有方法能夠使其他人也變成這樣？」

cues.text: In this video, we want to talk about one of the strongest predictors of how happy people are, how easily they make friends, and how good they are at dealing with hardship.
cues.en: In this video, we want to talk about one of the strongest predictors of how happy people are, how easily they make friends, and how good they are at dealing with hardship.
cues.zh: 「有沒有方法能夠使其他人也變成這樣？」 在這個影片中，我們想討論人們有多快樂、 他們交朋友的難易程度，以及遇到困難時的表現 的最強預測因子之一

cues.text: And antidote to dissatisfaction, so to speak.
cues.en: And antidote to dissatisfaction, so to speak.
cues.zh: 他們交朋友的難易程度，以及遇到困難時的表現 的最強預測因子之一 也可以說是一種讓不滿之心消逝的解藥

cues.text: Gratitude While gratitude might sound like another self-improvement trend preached by people who use hashtags,
cues.en: Gratitude While gratitude might sound like another self-improvement trend preached by people who use hashtags,
cues.zh: 「感恩」 雖然「感恩」很像是另一種自我提升的概念 被那些常用標記的人們所倡導 但我們要講的是 根據大量的科學工作和研究所得到的結果

cues.text: What we currently know about it is based on a body of scientific work and studies.
cues.en: What we currently know about it is based on a body of scientific work and studies.
cues.zh: 但我們要講的是 根據大量的科學工作和研究所得到的結果

cues.text: We will include them in the description.
cues.en: We will include them in the description.
cues.zh: 但我們要講的是 根據大量的科學工作和研究所得到的結果 我們將它們放在說明欄中

cues.text: Gratitude can mean very different things to different people in different contexts.
cues.en: Gratitude can mean very different things to different people in different contexts.
cues.zh: 「感恩」對不同背景下的不同人有著不同的意義

cues.text: It's a character trait, a feeling, a virtue, and a behavior.
cues.en: It's a character trait, a feeling, a virtue, and a behavior.
cues.zh: 「感恩」對不同背景下的不同人有著不同的意義 它是一種性格特徵、一種感受、 一種美德，又或是一種行為

cues.text: You can feel grateful towards someone who did something for you, for random events like the weather, or even for nature, or fate.
cues.en: You can feel grateful towards someone who did something for you, for random events like the weather, or even for nature, or fate.
cues.zh: 它是一種性格特徵、一種感受、 一種美德，又或是一種行為 你會感恩某人為你做了某事 感恩天氣、甚至是大自然或是命運

cues.text: And it's wired into our biology.
cues.en: And it's wired into our biology.
cues.zh: 而這些都與我們的生物學有所關聯

cues.text: 1. How gratitude connects us to each other The predecessor of gratitude is probably reciprocity.
cues.en: 1. How gratitude connects us to each other The predecessor of gratitude is probably reciprocity.
cues.zh: 1：「感恩」如何使我們彼此聯絡在一起 感恩的前身可能是互惠性

cues.text: It likely evolved as a biological signal that motivates animals to exchange things for their mutual benefit,
cues.en: It likely evolved as a biological signal that motivates animals to exchange things for their mutual benefit,
cues.zh: 它可能演變成一種生物訊號 促使生物為了彼此的共同利益而互相交流

cues.text: and can be found in the animal kingdom among certain fish, birds, or mammals,
cues.en: and can be found in the animal kingdom among certain fish, birds, or mammals,
cues.zh: 促使生物為了彼此的共同利益而互相交流 並能在動物界中見到，如特定魚類、鳥類或哺乳動物

cues.text: but especially in primates.
cues.en: but especially in primates.
cues.zh: 尤其是以靈長類動物為大宗

cues.text: When your brain recognizes that someone's done something nice for you, it reacts with gratitude to motivate you to repay them.
cues.en: When your brain recognizes that someone's done something nice for you, it reacts with gratitude to motivate you to repay them.
cues.zh: 當你的大腦接收到某人為了你做了一件好事 它會促使你報答他

cues.text: This gratitude makes you care about others and others care about you.
cues.en: This gratitude makes you care about others and others care about you.
cues.zh: 這種感恩之心使你在乎其他人 而其他人也關心你

cues.text: This was important because as human brains got better at reading emotions,
cues.en: This was important because as human brains got better at reading emotions,
cues.zh: 這點很重要，因為人類的大腦擅長讀出情緒

cues.text: selfish individuals were identified and shunned.
cues.en: selfish individuals were identified and shunned.
cues.zh: 這點很重要，因為人類的大腦擅長讀出情緒 自私的個體會被識別出來並被排斥

cues.text: It became an evolutionary advantage to play well with others and build lasting relationships.
cues.en: It became an evolutionary advantage to play well with others and build lasting relationships.
cues.zh: 與他人良好相處以及建立持久的感情， 成為了演變的優勢

cues.text: For example, if you were hungry and someone else showed you where to find tasty berries,
cues.en: For example, if you were hungry and someone else showed you where to find tasty berries,
cues.zh: 舉例來說，你如果餓了， 而有人告訴你哪裡可以找到美味的漿果

cues.text: you felt gratitude towards them, and a bond to return the favor in the future.
cues.en: you felt gratitude towards them, and a bond to return the favor in the future.
cues.zh: 舉例來說，你如果餓了， 而有人告訴你哪裡可以找到美味的漿果 你會感謝他們，並為了之後要報答對方而建立關係

cues.text: A drive to be prosocial.
cues.en: A drive to be prosocial.
cues.zh: 這就是利社會的來源

cues.text: When you repay them, they felt gratitude towards you.
cues.en: When you repay them, they felt gratitude towards you.
cues.zh: 當您償還人情時，他們會感激你

cues.text: This brought your ancestors closer together, and forged bonds and friendships.
cues.en: This brought your ancestors closer together, and forged bonds and friendships.
cues.zh: 這使你的祖先更加親近，並建立了連結與友誼

cues.text: So early forms of gratitude were biological mechanisms that modified your behavior towards cooperation,
cues.en: So early forms of gratitude were biological mechanisms that modified your behavior towards cooperation,
cues.zh: 這使你的祖先更加親近，並建立了連結與友誼 因此，在過去的感激之情是改變人們的行為 並朝向分工合作的生物機制

cues.text: which helped humans to dominate Earth.
cues.en: which helped humans to dominate Earth.
cues.zh: 並朝向分工合作的生物機制 而使人類統治地球

cues.text: But over time, gratitude became more than just an impulse to play fair.
cues.en: But over time, gratitude became more than just an impulse to play fair.
cues.zh: 但是隨著時間的流逝，感恩變得不只是為了報答了

cues.text: 2. The consequences of gratitude Scientists found that gratitude stimulates the pathways in your brain involved in feelings of reward,
cues.en: 2. The consequences of gratitude Scientists found that gratitude stimulates the pathways in your brain involved in feelings of reward,
cues.zh: 2：感恩的結果 科學家發現感激之情會刺激你的大腦 並產生獎勵的感覺

cues.text: forming social bonds, and interpreting others' intentions.
cues.en: forming social bonds, and interpreting others' intentions.
cues.zh: 形成社會連結 並理解他人的想法 這也代表更容易刻下與回憶起正面的回憶

cues.text: It also makes it easier to save and retrieve positive memories.
cues.en: It also makes it easier to save and retrieve positive memories.
cues.zh: 這也代表更容易刻下與回憶起正面的回憶

cues.text: Even more, gratitude directly counteracts negative feelings and traits like envy and social comparison,
cues.en: Even more, gratitude directly counteracts negative feelings and traits like envy and social comparison,
cues.zh: 不只如此，「感恩」可以抵抗負面的想法或特質 如嫉妒、社會比較 自戀、犬儒主義，以及唯物主義

cues.text: narcissism, cynicism and materialism.
cues.en: narcissism, cynicism and materialism.
cues.zh: 自戀、犬儒主義，以及唯物主義

cues.text: As a consequence, people who are grateful no matter what for tend to be happier and more satisfied.
cues.en: As a consequence, people who are grateful no matter what for tend to be happier and more satisfied.
cues.zh: 因此不論是出於什麼理由，有感恩之心的人們 往往會更快樂、更滿足

cues.text: They have better relationships, an easier time making friends,
cues.en: They have better relationships, an easier time making friends,
cues.zh: 他們有更好的人際關係 更容易結交朋友 他們睡得更好

cues.text: they sleep better, tend to suffer less from depression, addiction, and burnout,
cues.en: they sleep better, tend to suffer less from depression, addiction, and burnout,
cues.zh: 他們睡得更好 較不容易憂鬱、成癮和過勞

cues.text: and are better at dealing with traumatic events.
cues.en: and are better at dealing with traumatic events.
cues.zh: 較不容易憂鬱、成癮和過勞 而且善於處理心靈的創傷

cues.text: In a way, gratitude makes it less likely that you'll fall into one of the psychological traps modern life has set for you
cues.en: In a way, gratitude makes it less likely that you'll fall into one of the psychological traps modern life has set for you
cues.zh: 在某種程度上，感恩會讓你陷入 現代的心理泥沼的可能性較小

cues.text: For example, gratitude measurably counters the tendency to forget
cues.en: For example, gratitude measurably counters the tendency to forget
cues.zh: 例如，感恩顯著地減少了忘掉與輕視正面事物的傾向

cues.text: and downplay positive events.
cues.en: and downplay positive events.
cues.zh: 例如，感恩顯著地減少了忘掉與輕視正面事物的傾向

cues.text: If you work long and hard for something, actually getting it can feel daft and empty.
cues.en: If you work long and hard for something, actually getting it can feel daft and empty.
cues.zh: 例如，感恩顯著地減少了忘掉與輕視正面事物的傾向 如果你為了某事物而辛勞工作 但當真正得到它時卻感到茫然且空虛 你會發現你的情感處於最初的狀態

cues.text: You can find yourself emotionally back where you started, and try to achieve the next biggest thing,
cues.en: You can find yourself emotionally back where you started, and try to achieve the next biggest thing,
cues.zh: 你會發現你的情感處於最初的狀態 並嘗試達成下一個大目標，只為了找尋那種滿足感

cues.text: looking for that satisfaction instead of being satisfied with yourself.
cues.en: looking for that satisfaction instead of being satisfied with yourself.
cues.zh: 並嘗試達成下一個大目標，只為了找尋那種滿足感 而不是對自己感到滿意

cues.text: Or imagine being lonely and wanting to have more friends.
cues.en: Or imagine being lonely and wanting to have more friends.
cues.zh: 或者想像一下你很孤獨，想要有更多的朋友

cues.text: You actually might have someone or even multiple people who want to hangout,
cues.en: You actually might have someone or even multiple people who want to hangout,
cues.zh: 或者想像一下你很孤獨，想要有更多的朋友 實際上可能有一或數人想出門玩

cues.text: but you might feel that this is not enough, that you're a loser and feel bad about yourself.
cues.en: but you might feel that this is not enough, that you're a loser and feel bad about yourself.
cues.zh: 實際上可能有一或數人想出門玩 但是你覺得這樣還是不夠 你覺得你是個失敗者，並對自己感到難過

cues.text: So you might turn down their attempts to hangout, and become more lonely.
cues.en: So you might turn down their attempts to hangout, and become more lonely.
cues.zh: 你覺得你是個失敗者，並對自己感到難過 所以你可能會拒絕跟他們出門，而變得更孤單

cues.text: If you feel grateful for your relationships instead, you might accept invitations, or even take the initiative.
cues.en: If you feel grateful for your relationships instead, you might accept invitations, or even take the initiative.
cues.zh: 所以你可能會拒絕跟他們出門，而變得更孤單 但如果你感恩你的人際關係 您可能會接受邀請，甚至主動邀約

cues.text: The more often you risk opening up, the higher the chance of solidifying relationships and meeting new people.
cues.en: The more often you risk opening up, the higher the chance of solidifying relationships and meeting new people.
cues.zh: 您可能會接受邀請，甚至主動邀約 你越常開啟自己的心扉，則你穩固關係的機會就越大 並結交新朋友

cues.text: In the best case, gratitude can trigger a feedback loop.
cues.en: In the best case, gratitude can trigger a feedback loop.
cues.zh: 並結交新朋友 在最佳情況下，感恩可以引起回饋環

cues.text: Positive feelings lead to more prosocial behavior, which leads to more positive social experiences
cues.en: Positive feelings lead to more prosocial behavior, which leads to more positive social experiences
cues.zh: 在最佳情況下，感恩可以引起回饋環 正面的情緒帶來了更多利社會行為 從而給你更多正面的社會經驗

cues.text: that cause more positive feelings.
cues.en: that cause more positive feelings.
cues.zh: 從而給你更多正面的社會經驗 並讓你有更多的正面情緒

cues.text: This is a common experience after serious hardship like chemotherapy, for example.
cues.en: This is a common experience after serious hardship like chemotherapy, for example.
cues.zh: 這是個苦難後常見的經歷 舉化學療法當例子

cues.text: Life can feel amazing after a crisis is over.
cues.en: Life can feel amazing after a crisis is over.
cues.zh: 在危機過去之後，生活會讓人充滿驚喜

cues.text: The smallest things can be bottomless sources of joy, from being able to taste, to just sitting in the sun,
cues.en: The smallest things can be bottomless sources of joy, from being able to taste, to just sitting in the sun,
cues.zh: 在危機過去之後，生活會讓人充滿驚喜 微不足道的事物也可以是無限的歡樂之源 從能夠品嘗食物、到淋浴在陽光下 或是與朋友談天說地

cues.text: or chatting with a friend.
cues.en: or chatting with a friend.
cues.zh: 或是與朋友談天說地

cues.text: Objectively, your life is the same or maybe even slightly worse than before,
cues.en: Objectively, your life is the same or maybe even slightly worse than before,
cues.zh: 或是與朋友談天說地 客觀地說，你的生活並沒有改變， 甚至比以前更糟

cues.text: but your brain compares your present experiences with the times when life was bad,
cues.en: but your brain compares your present experiences with the times when life was bad,
cues.zh: 客觀地說，你的生活並沒有改變， 甚至比以前更糟 但是你的大腦會將你現在的經歷 與以前很糟的時光做比較

cues.text: and reacts with gratitude.
cues.en: and reacts with gratitude.
cues.zh: 但是你的大腦會將你現在的經歷 與以前很糟的時光做比較 而使你現在更加有感恩之心

cues.text: So, in a nutshell, gratitude refocuses your attention towards the good things you have,
cues.en: So, in a nutshell, gratitude refocuses your attention towards the good things you have,

cues.text: Good evening.

cues.text: What if I told you that we can change the world through our food choices?
cues.en: What if I told you that we can change the world through our food choices?

cues.text: I challenge you in the next 12 minutes to open your minds and your hearts

cues.text: to the power of plant-based eating, and the fact that animal agriculture, the raising of animals for food,
cues.en: to the power of plant-based eating, and the fact that animal agriculture, the raising of animals for food,

cues.text: has grown to become one of the most damaging industries on our planet.
cues.en: has grown to become one of the most damaging industries on our planet.

cues.text: But I want to make clear that my intent is not to be judgmental,
cues.en: But I want to make clear that my intent is not to be judgmental,
cues.zh: 但我想澄清的是，我的意圖不是要做出評判，

cues.text: but instead, to increase your awareness and give you important information which you may not know.
cues.en: but instead, to increase your awareness and give you important information which you may not know.

cues.text: you'll ever make in your life, for three significant reasons:

cues.zh: 但有時短短兩到三週內就會出現逆轉

cues.text: by switching to a plant-based diet.
cues.en: by switching to a plant-based diet.
cues.zh: 改用植物性飲食。

cues.text: Reducing and eliminating the consumption of meat and meat products
cues.en: Reducing and eliminating the consumption of meat and meat products
cues.zh: 減少和消除肉類和肉製品的消費

cues.text: with a greener diet rich in fruits, vegetables, nuts,
cues.en: with a greener diet rich in fruits, vegetables, nuts,
cues.zh: 富含水果、蔬菜、堅果的綠色飲食，

cues.text: seeds, and whole grains will lead to a healthier world.
cues.en: seeds, and whole grains will lead to a healthier world.
cues.zh: 種子和全穀物將帶來一個更健康的世界。

cues.text: The Earth.
cues.en: The Earth.
cues.zh: 地球。

cues.text: It's not only the health of our bodies that's at stake, it's the health of our planet.
cues.en: It's not only the health of our bodies that's at stake, it's the health of our planet.
cues.zh: 這不僅關係到我們身體的健康，也關係到我們星球的健康。

cues.text: This is what we're facing now at critical levels:
cues.en: This is what we're facing now at critical levels:
cues.zh: 這就是我們現在面臨的關鍵層次：

cues.text: climate change and global warming, deforestation, depletion of our resources, soil erosion, species and habitat loss,
cues.en: climate change and global warming, deforestation, depletion of our resources, soil erosion, species and habitat loss,
cues.zh: 氣候變遷與全球暖化、森林砍伐、資源枯竭、土壤侵蝕、物種和棲息地喪失，

cues.text: ocean dead zones, water and air pollution, and world hunger.
cues.en: ocean dead zones, water and air pollution, and world hunger.
cues.zh: 海洋死亡區、水和空氣汙染以及世界飢餓。

cues.text: These are not things we can put off dealing with.
cues.en: These are not things we can put off dealing with.
cues.zh: 這些不是我們可以推遲處理的事情。

cues.text: We must now urgently reverse imminent catastrophic environmental damage.
cues.en: We must now urgently reverse imminent catastrophic environmental damage.
cues.zh: 我們現在必須緊急扭轉迫在眉睫的災難性環境破壞。

cues.text: Certainly, environmentalists and legislators are rightly focusing on reducing carbon emissions,
cues.en: Certainly, environmentalists and legislators are rightly focusing on reducing carbon emissions,
cues.zh: 當然，環保人士和立法者正確地關注減少碳排放，

cues.text: and they're investing in alternative and renewable energy sources.
cues.en: and they're investing in alternative and renewable energy sources.
cues.zh: 他們正在投資替代能源和再生能源。

cues.text: But all of this would take decades to implement, be enormously expensive, in the tens of trillions of dollars,
cues.en: But all of this would take decades to implement, be enormously expensive, in the tens of trillions of dollars,
cues.zh: 但這一切都需要數十年的時間才能實施，耗資巨大，達數十萬億美元，

cues.text: and there's the complexity of social, economic and political issues
cues.en: and there's the complexity of social, economic and political issues
cues.zh: 還有社會、經濟和政治問題的複雜性

cues.text: which must be dealt with at a global scale.
cues.en: which must be dealt with at a global scale.
cues.zh: 必須在全球範圍內解決這個問題。

cues.text: Because of this, you need to know there is one thing
cues.en: Because of this, you need to know there is one thing
cues.zh: 因此，你需要知道一件事

cues.text: that is a major cause of all of these global problems,
cues.en: that is a major cause of all of these global problems,
cues.zh: 這是所有這些全球問題的主要原因

cues.text: and that is animal agriculture.
cues.en: and that is animal agriculture.
cues.zh: 這就是畜牧業。

cues.text: Here are just a few facts.
cues.en: Here are just a few facts.
cues.zh: 以下只是一些事實。

cues.text: Animal agriculture accounts for 51% of greenhouse gas emissions.
cues.en: Animal agriculture accounts for 51% of greenhouse gas emissions.
cues.zh: 畜牧業佔溫室氣體排放量的51%。

cues.text: It's also the number one cause of species and habitat loss
cues.en: It's also the number one cause of species and habitat loss
cues.zh: 這也是物種和棲息地喪失的首要原因

cues.text: due to deforestation for grazing and growing of feed crops.
cues.en: due to deforestation for grazing and growing of feed crops.
cues.zh: 由於為了放牧和種植飼料作物而砍伐森林。

cues.text: In our country, it's the main cause of water pollution;
cues.en: In our country, it's the main cause of water pollution;
cues.zh: 在我國，它是水汙染的主要原因；

cues.text: it uses half of our water; 70% of our grain;
cues.en: it uses half of our water; 70% of our grain;
cues.zh: 它使用了我們一半的水； 70%的糧食；

cues.text: and 80% of our agricultural land is used to feed the 10 billion land animals
cues.en: and 80% of our agricultural land is used to feed the 10 billion land animals
cues.zh: 我們 80% 的農業用地用於餵養 100 億隻陸地動物

cues.text: that are killed every year for food.
cues.en: that are killed every year for food.
cues.zh: 每年都會被殺死以獲取食物。

cues.text: By contrast, you can cut your carbon footprint in half
cues.en: By contrast, you can cut your carbon footprint in half
cues.zh: 相比之下，您可以將碳足跡減少一半

cues.text: by going vegetarian.
cues.en: by going vegetarian.
cues.zh: 透過吃素。

cues.text: The Stanford Environmental Law Journal states that our reliance on animal products
cues.en: The Stanford Environmental Law Journal states that our reliance on animal products
cues.zh: 史丹佛環境法雜誌指出，我們對動物產品的依賴

cues.text: is a leading cause of everything, the one industry that is destroying our planet.
cues.en: is a leading cause of everything, the one industry that is destroying our planet.
cues.zh: 是一切事物的主要原因，也是正在摧毀我們星球的一個產業。

cues.text: The United Nations Environment Program strongly states that a substantial reduction of impacts
cues.en: The United Nations Environment Program strongly states that a substantial reduction of impacts
cues.zh: 聯合國環境規劃署強烈宣告，大幅減少影響

cues.text: would only be possible with a substantial worldwide diet change,
cues.en: would only be possible with a substantial worldwide diet change,
cues.zh: 只有在全球大幅改變飲食習慣才有可能實現，

cues.text: away from animal products.
cues.en: away from animal products.
cues.zh: 遠離動物性產品。

cues.text: While policy leaders and even environmentalists are largely overlooking this issue,
cues.en: While policy leaders and even environmentalists are largely overlooking this issue,
cues.zh: 雖然政策領導人甚至環保人士在很大程度上忽視了這個問題，

cues.text: there is something you can do right now.
cues.en: there is something you can do right now.
cues.zh: 您現在可以做某事。

cues.text: The single most powerful action you can take
cues.en: The single most powerful action you can take
cues.zh: 您可以採取的最有力的行動

cues.text: to help save our environment and resources is to shift to a plant-based diet.
cues.en: to help save our environment and resources is to shift to a plant-based diet.
cues.zh: 幫助保護我們的環境和資源就是轉向植物性飲食。

cues.text: Compassion.
cues.en: Compassion.
cues.zh: 同情。

cues.text: I'm going to tell you the story of an animal in a factory farm.
cues.en: I'm going to tell you the story of an animal in a factory farm.
cues.zh: 我要跟你講一個工廠化農場裡動物的故事。

cues.text: Worldwide every year, 56 billion land animals and 90 billion marine animals are killed for food.
cues.en: Worldwide every year, 56 billion land animals and 90 billion marine animals are killed for food.
cues.zh: 全世界每年有 560 億隻陸地動物和 900 億隻海洋動物被殺害作為食物。

cues.text: But I'm not going to show you any graphic images or videos,
cues.en: But I'm not going to show you any graphic images or videos,
cues.zh: 但我不會向你展示任何圖形影象或影片，

cues.text: you can easily find these on the internet.
cues.en: you can easily find these on the internet.
cues.zh: 您可以在網路上輕鬆找到這些內容。

cues.text: Instead, I want you to imagine and visualize in your mind
cues.en: Instead, I want you to imagine and visualize in your mind
cues.zh: 相反，我希望你在腦海中想像和想像

cues.text: what I have to say.
cues.en: what I have to say.
cues.zh: 我必須說的話。

cues.text: This is the story of a sow.
cues.en: This is the story of a sow.
cues.zh: 這是一頭母豬的故事。

cues.text: "My entire life, I'm kept in a meadow gestation crate,
cues.en: "My entire life, I'm kept in a meadow gestation crate,
cues.zh: 「我一生都被關在草地妊娠箱裡，

cues.text: in half darkness, on a graded concrete floor.
cues.en: in half darkness, on a graded concrete floor.
cues.zh: 在半黑暗中，在分級混凝土地板上。

cues.text: I can't even turn around.
cues.en: I can't even turn around.
cues.zh: 我甚至無法轉身。

cues.text: Confined and unable to engage in any of my natural behaviors,
cues.en: Confined and unable to engage in any of my natural behaviors,
cues.zh: 受到限制且無法進行任何自然行為，

cues.text: I suffer depression, frustration, and neurotic behaviors, sometimes screaming, and biting at the bars that surround me.
cues.en: I suffer depression, frustration, and neurotic behaviors, sometimes screaming, and biting at the bars that surround me.
cues.zh: 我患有憂鬱、沮喪和神經質行為，有時會尖叫，並咬我周圍的酒吧。

cues.text: My limbs are swollen, I have open wounds,
cues.en: My limbs are swollen, I have open wounds,
cues.zh: 我的四肢腫脹，有開放性傷口，

cues.text: and I'm lying on my own excrement.
cues.en: and I'm lying on my own excrement.
cues.zh: 我躺在自己的排洩物上。

cues.text: After giving birth from being forcibly impregnated, my babies are taken away from me,
cues.en: After giving birth from being forcibly impregnated, my babies are taken away from me,
cues.zh: 強行懷孕生下孩子後，我的孩子被奪走了，

cues.text: and I'm slaughtered at the age of only three to five years old.
cues.en: and I'm slaughtered at the age of only three to five years old.
cues.zh: 我才三、五歲就被宰了。

cues.text: We pigs, like the other animals in factory farms,
cues.en: We pigs, like the other animals in factory farms,
cues.zh: 我們豬，就像工廠化農場中的其他動物一樣，

cues.text: are supposed to be stunned into unconsciousness before being killed.
cues.en: are supposed to be stunned into unconsciousness before being killed.
cues.zh: 被殺之前應該被擊昏至失去知覺。

cues.text: But many of us are still alive as we are hoisted upside down, our throat slit,
cues.en: But many of us are still alive as we are hoisted upside down, our throat slit,
cues.zh: 但我們中的許多人仍然活著，因為我們被倒掛起來，喉嚨被割斷，

cues.text: and we are lowered into boiling water to remove our hair.
cues.en: and we are lowered into boiling water to remove our hair.
cues.zh: 然後我們被放入沸水中脫毛。

cues.text: But did you know? I have a sense of self, just like you.
cues.en: But did you know? I have a sense of self, just like you.
cues.zh: 但你知道嗎？我和你一樣，也有自我意識。

cues.text: I'm more intelligent than a dog or a cat, and even a three-year-old child.
cues.en: I'm more intelligent than a dog or a cat, and even a three-year-old child.
cues.zh: 我比狗貓都聰明，比三歲的孩子還聰明。

cues.text: I'm a highly social creature, intuitive and emotional, just like you.
cues.en: I'm a highly social creature, intuitive and emotional, just like you.
cues.zh: 我是一個高度社交的生物，直覺和情感，就像你一樣。

cues.text: I have memories, and I can recognize myself in a mirror, just like you.
cues.en: I have memories, and I can recognize myself in a mirror, just like you.
cues.zh: 我有記憶，我能認出鏡子裡的自己，就像你一樣。

cues.text: And I love to play, even computer games, just like you.
cues.en: And I love to play, even computer games, just like you.
cues.zh: 我喜歡玩，甚至是電腦遊戲，就像你一樣。

cues.text: I care for my young with a bond that's as strong as any human mother,
cues.en: I care for my young with a bond that's as strong as any human mother,
cues.zh: 我以與任何人類母親一樣牢固的紐帶照顧我的孩子，

cues.text: even singing to my babies during nursing.
cues.en: even singing to my babies during nursing.
cues.zh: 甚至在哺乳期間唱歌給我的寶寶。

cues.text: I am not something.
cues.en: I am not something.
cues.zh: 我不是什麼東西。

cues.text: I am someone.
cues.en: I am someone.
cues.zh: 我是某人。

cues.text: I am not pork.
cues.en: I am not pork.
cues.zh: 我不是豬肉。

cues.text: I am not bacon.
cues.en: I am not bacon.
cues.zh: 我不是培根。

cues.text: I am a living feeling being, just like you."
cues.en: I am a living feeling being, just like you."
cues.zh: 我是一個有感情的人，就像你一樣。 」

cues.text: So, how many of you have pets?
cues.en: So, how many of you have pets?
cues.zh: 那麼，你們當中有多少人養寵物呢？

cues.text: There must be a lot of you that have pets.
cues.en: There must be a lot of you that have pets.
cues.zh: 你們當中一定有很多人養寵物。

cues.text: And how many of you love your pets as family members?
cues.en: And how many of you love your pets as family members?
cues.zh: 你們當中有多少人像家人一樣愛你們的寵物？

cues.text: I know I do.
cues.en: I know I do.
cues.zh: 我知道我知道。

cues.text: We all have an innate compassion for animals.
cues.en: We all have an innate compassion for animals.
cues.zh: 我們對動物都有與生俱來的同情心。

cues.text: I challenge you to realize and put at the front of your awareness
cues.en: I challenge you to realize and put at the front of your awareness
cues.zh: 我挑戰你去認識並把它放在你的意識的前面

cues.text: that every animal in a factory farm, like the pig I just described,
cues.en: that every animal in a factory farm, like the pig I just described,
cues.zh: 工廠化農場裡的每隻動物，就像我剛才描述的豬，

cues.text: is just as individual a living being as any of your pets.
cues.en: is just as individual a living being as any of your pets.
cues.zh: 與您的任何寵物一樣，都是一個獨立的生物。

cues.text: All animals have the will to live, the capacity to suffer,
cues.en: All animals have the will to live, the capacity to suffer,
cues.zh: 所有動物都有生存的意願，有承受痛苦的能力，

cues.text: and are equally capable of receiving our love.
cues.en: and are equally capable of receiving our love.
cues.zh: 並且同樣能夠接受我們的愛。

cues.text: We may therefore ask ourselves the question: why love one, but eat the other?
cues.en: We may therefore ask ourselves the question: why love one, but eat the other?
cues.zh: 因此，我們可以問自己這樣一個問題：為什麼愛一個，卻吃另一個？

cues.text: Our choices regarding animals and diet are shaped by perception,
cues.en: Our choices regarding animals and diet are shaped by perception,
cues.zh: 我們對動物和飲食的選擇是由感知決定的，

cues.text: the fact that we see different animals in different ways.
cues.en: the fact that we see different animals in different ways.
cues.zh: 事實上，我們以不同的方式看待不同的動物。

cues.text: And there are a number of reasons for this, habit and culture, for one.
cues.en: And there are a number of reasons for this, habit and culture, for one.
cues.zh: 造成這種情況的原因有很多，其中之一就是習慣和文化。

cues.text: Initially, most of us didn't make the choice to eat meat.
cues.en: Initially, most of us didn't make the choice to eat meat.
cues.zh: 最初，我們大多數人並沒有選擇吃肉。

cues.text: It was given, right?
cues.en: It was given, right?
cues.zh: 已經給了，對吧？

cues.text: We continued the habit almost mindlessly, accepting it as normal.
cues.en: We continued the habit almost mindlessly, accepting it as normal.
cues.zh: 我們幾乎不假思索地繼續這個習慣，並認為這是正常的。

cues.text: I ate meat for half of my life, and when I was growing up,
cues.en: I ate meat for half of my life, and when I was growing up,
cues.zh: 我吃了半輩子的肉，在我長大的過程中，

cues.text: I never even gave it a thought, I never questioned it.
cues.en: I never even gave it a thought, I never questioned it.
cues.zh: 我從來沒有想過，我從來沒有質疑過。

cues.text: It wasn't until I was well into my college years that I decided to become vegetarian.
cues.en: It wasn't until I was well into my college years that I decided to become vegetarian.
cues.zh: 直到進入大學時期，我才決定要成為素食主義者。

cues.text: Another reason has to do with a coping process that psychologists call "psychic numbing,"
cues.en: Another reason has to do with a coping process that psychologists call "psychic numbing,"
cues.zh: 另一個原因與心理學家稱之為「精神麻木」的應對過程有關

cues.text: pertaining, in this case, to loss of life on a massive scale.
cues.en: pertaining, in this case, to loss of life on a massive scale.
cues.zh: 在這種情況下，涉及大規模的生命損失。

cues.text: Even though at some level we are aware that animals are being slaughtered for food,
cues.en: Even though at some level we are aware that animals are being slaughtered for food,
cues.zh: 儘管在某種程度上我們知道動物被宰殺作為食物，

cues.text: we avoid the emotional pain of empathizing with them as individuals.
cues.en: we avoid the emotional pain of empathizing with them as individuals.
cues.zh: 我們避免將他們視為個體而產生情感上的痛苦。

cues.text: It's really like a kind of denial, where we disconnect ourselves from the experience.
cues.en: It's really like a kind of denial, where we disconnect ourselves from the experience.
cues.zh: 這其實就像一種否認，我們將自己與體驗脫節。

cues.text: This is what a slaughterhouse worker says, "I don't think of farmed animals as individuals.
cues.en: This is what a slaughterhouse worker says, "I don't think of farmed animals as individuals.
cues.zh: 屠宰場工人如是說：「我不認為養殖動物是個體。

cues.text: I wouldn't be able to do my job if I got that personal with them."
cues.en: I wouldn't be able to do my job if I got that personal with them."
cues.zh: 如果我和他們發生這種私人關係，我就無法完成我的工作。 」

cues.text: We simply don't see the face on the plate.
cues.en: We simply don't see the face on the plate.
cues.zh: 我們根本看不到盤子上的臉。

cues.text: Instead, it's generic food or meat, and marketing.
cues.en: Instead, it's generic food or meat, and marketing.
cues.zh: 相反，它是通用食品或肉類，以及行銷。

cues.text: Look at these products from the grocery store shelf.
cues.en: Look at these products from the grocery store shelf.
cues.zh: 看看雜貨店貨架上的這些產品。

cues.text: How do these images of happy animals and pleasant surroundings
cues.en: How do these images of happy animals and pleasant surroundings
cues.zh: 這些快樂的動物和宜人的環境的影象如何

cues.text: distance us from the animals suffering?
cues.en: distance us from the animals suffering?
cues.zh: 讓我們遠離受苦的動物？

cues.text: We also accept the eating of meat because what goes on behind the scenes of meat production
cues.en: We also accept the eating of meat because what goes on behind the scenes of meat production
cues.zh: 我們也接受吃肉，因為肉類生產的幕後發生的事情

cues.text: is largely invisible.
cues.en: is largely invisible.
cues.zh: 很大程度上是看不見的。

cues.text: It's difficult for the public to find the locations and addresses of factory farms
cues.en: It's difficult for the public to find the locations and addresses of factory farms
cues.zh: 公眾很難找到工廠化農場的位置和地址

cues.text: even though - does anyone want to venture a guess how many farms there are in this country?
cues.en: even though - does anyone want to venture a guess how many farms there are in this country?
cues.zh: 儘管如此——有人想冒險猜猜這個國家有多少個農場嗎？

cues.text: There are 20,000 of them, 20,000.
cues.en: There are 20,000 of them, 20,000.
cues.zh: 他們有兩萬，兩萬。

cues.text: In our country, 317 animals are killed every single second.
cues.en: In our country, 317 animals are killed every single second.
cues.zh: 在我國，每秒鐘有 317 隻動物被殺死。

cues.text: But for these factory farms, their only goals are efficiency and profit.
cues.en: But for these factory farms, their only goals are efficiency and profit.
cues.zh: 但對這些工廠化農場來說，他們唯一的目標就是效率和利潤。

cues.text: The animals are seen only as units of production.
cues.en: The animals are seen only as units of production.
cues.zh: 動物僅被視為生產單位。

cues.text: So I ask, the next time you're in the dining hall, dare to be aware of the animal that was killed to become someone's meal.
cues.en: So I ask, the next time you're in the dining hall, dare to be aware of the animal that was killed to become someone's meal.
cues.zh: 所以我請求，下次當你在餐廳時，敢於留意那些被宰殺成為某人食物的動物。

cues.text: Going green with your diet, it's not about giving anything up.
cues.en: Going green with your diet, it's not about giving anything up.

cues.text: Hola amigos, May here from Spanish and Go, your resource for learning real world travel Spanish.
cues.en: Hola amigos, May here from Spanish and Go, your resource for learning real world travel Spanish.
cues.zh: Hola 朋友們，五月來自西班牙語和 Go，您學習現實世界旅行西班牙語的資源。

cues.text: In this video, I'm going to tell you the top phrases in Spanish you must learn before any trip to any Spanish speaking place.
cues.en: In this video, I'm going to tell you the top phrases in Spanish you must learn before any trip to any Spanish speaking place.
cues.zh: 在本影片中，我將告訴您在前往任何西班牙語國家之前必須學習的西班牙語常用短語。

cues.text: From basic greetings and goodbyes, to more elaborate phrases like, can you please take my picture?
cues.en: From basic greetings and goodbyes, to more elaborate phrases like, can you please take my picture?
cues.zh: 從基本的問候和再見，到更複雜的短語，例如“你能給我拍張照片嗎？”

cues.text: ¿Listos? ¡Empecemos!
cues.en: ¿Listos? ¡Empecemos!
cues.zh: ¿ 列表？ Empecemos！

cues.text: So we're going to start with the most basic greeting, which is "hola." This word you're going to hear it all the time, so practice it. It means "hello" or "hi."
cues.en: So we're going to start with the most basic greeting, which is "hola." This word you're going to hear it all the time, so practice it. It means "hello" or "hi."
cues.zh: 因此，我們將從最基本的問候語開始，即“hola”。這個字你會常常聽到，所以要練習一下。它的意思是“你好”或“嗨”。

cues.text: The next one I have is "adios." "Adios" is a very common goodbye.
cues.en: The next one I have is "adios." "Adios" is a very common goodbye.
cues.zh: 我的下一個是「再見」。 「再見」是很常見的告別語。

cues.text: Sometimes people say that they feel like it's too dramatic maybe when you're not going to see someone ever again or something.
cues.en: Sometimes people say that they feel like it's too dramatic maybe when you're not going to see someone ever again or something.
cues.zh: 有時人們會說，當你再也見不到某個人或某件事時，他們覺得這太戲劇化了。

cues.text: But the truth is that we use it a lot here in Mexico and that's ¡Adiós!
cues.en: But the truth is that we use it a lot here in Mexico and that's ¡Adiós!
cues.zh: 但事實是，我們在墨西哥經常使用它，那就是 ¡ Adiós！

cues.text: Another goodbye is ¡Hasta luego!
cues.en: Another goodbye is ¡Hasta luego!
cues.zh: 另一個再見是¡ Hasta luego！

cues.text: This one is very, very used even when you are not planning on seeing the person again.
cues.en: This one is very, very used even when you are not planning on seeing the person again.
cues.zh: 即使你不打算再見到這個人，這個方法也非常非常有用。

cues.text: So like when you go to a store, you pay and then you say,
cues.en: So like when you go to a store, you pay and then you say,
cues.zh: 就像當你去商店時，你付錢然後說，

cues.text: ¡Hasta luego!
cues.en: ¡Hasta luego!
cues.zh: ¡哈斯塔魯戈！

cues.text: Maybe you're not going back, but you say it anyways.
cues.en: Maybe you're not going back, but you say it anyways.
cues.zh: 也許你不會回去，但你還是說了。

cues.text: Another very common greeting that we have here is ¡Qué tal!
cues.en: Another very common greeting that we have here is ¡Qué tal!
cues.zh: 我們這裡另一個很常見的問候語是¡ Qué tal！

cues.text: This one is great because you can use it in any situation, formal, informal, with friends, with someone you just met.
cues.en: This one is great because you can use it in any situation, formal, informal, with friends, with someone you just met.
cues.zh: 這個很棒，因為你可以在任何場合使用它，正式的，非正式的，與朋友一起，與你剛認識的人一起。

cues.text: That's ¡Qué tal! ¡Qué tal!
cues.en: That's ¡Qué tal! ¡Qué tal!
cues.zh: 這就是¡ Qué tal！ ¡ Qué tal！

cues.text: Next one is ¡Cómo está! ¡Cómo está!
cues.en: Next one is ¡Cómo está! ¡Cómo está!
cues.zh: 下一篇是¡ Cómo está！ ¡ Cómo está！

cues.text: This is another very common greeting that you're going to hear all the time.
cues.en: This is another very common greeting that you're going to hear all the time.
cues.zh: 這是您經常聽到的另一種非常常見的問候語。

cues.text: Remember that if you want to say it in the informal way, with the tú, you would say ¡Cómo estás!
cues.en: Remember that if you want to say it in the informal way, with the tú, you would say ¡Cómo estás!

cues.text: for someone who is your age or maybe younger.
cues.en: for someone who is your age or maybe younger.

cues.text: And that means ¡How are you?
cues.en: And that means ¡How are you?

cues.text: Moving on, I have three phrases that you can use throughout the day.
cues.en: Moving on, I have three phrases that you can use throughout the day.

cues.en: The first one is ¡Buenos días!

cues.en: ¡Buenos días! is ¡Good morning!

cues.text: That's ¡Buenos días!

cues.text: Now, from noon until about seven or right before eight, you're going to want to use ¡Buenas tardes!
cues.en: Now, from noon until about seven or right before eight, you're going to want to use ¡Buenas tardes!

cues.en: ¡Buenas tardes! means ¡Good afternoon!

cues.text: And then, from eight p.m. all the way until you go to bed at night, you say ¡Buenas noches!
cues.en: And then, from eight p.m. all the way until you go to bed at night, you say ¡Buenas noches!

cues.en: ¡Buenas noches! you can use it as a greeting or as a goodbye.
cues.zh: ¡ Buenas noches！您可以用它作為問候或告別。

cues.text: Now, I have three very important phrases that you're going to hear a lot here.
cues.en: Now, I have three very important phrases that you're going to hear a lot here.

cues.en: The first one is ¡Por favor!

cues.en: ¡Por favor! means ¡Please!

cues.en: So, you're going to want to use ¡Por favor!

cues.text: anytime you're asking for help or anytime you are ordering something.
cues.en: anytime you're asking for help or anytime you are ordering something.

cues.text: ¡Por favor!
cues.en: ¡Por favor!

cues.text: The next one is ¡Gracias!
cues.en: The next one is ¡Gracias!

cues.en: You're also going to notice that we say ¡Gracias! a lot.

cues.en: So, when someone says ¡Thank you!

cues.en: When someone says ¡Gracias! to you, you're going to want to say ¡De nada!

cues.text: That means ¡You're welcome!
cues.en: That means ¡You're welcome!

cues.en: Now, the next two phrases I have sometimes are a little bit confusing.

cues.en: The first one is ¡Lo siento!

cues.en: ¡Lo siento! means ¡I'm sorry!

cues.text: You say ¡Lo siento!
cues.en: You say ¡Lo siento!

cues.text: I'm sorry.

cues.text: Patrons of authentic Viennese coffeehouses are not only served a cup of coffee and a piece of cake
cues.en: Patrons of authentic Viennese coffeehouses are not only served a cup of coffee and a piece of cake
cues.zh: 正宗維也納咖啡館的顧客不僅可以享用一杯咖啡和一塊蛋糕

cues.text: but also a taste of real Viennese gastronomic culture.
cues.en: but also a taste of real Viennese gastronomic culture.
cues.zh: 還可以品嚐到真正的維也納美食文化。

cues.text: This café is an institution. Here, public figures meet private citizens and tourists.
cues.en: This café is an institution. Here, public figures meet private citizens and tourists.
cues.zh: 這家咖啡館是一個機構。在這裡，公眾人物會見普通公民和遊客。

cues.text: Some only come here for a coffee, others for lunch or dinner.
cues.en: Some only come here for a coffee, others for lunch or dinner.
cues.zh: 有些人只是來這裡喝咖啡，有些人來這裡吃午餐或晚餐。

cues.text: And what part do the around 1000 coffeehouses play in Viennese culture?
cues.en: And what part do the around 1000 coffeehouses play in Viennese culture?
cues.zh: 大約 1000 家咖啡館在維也納文化中扮演什麼角色？

cues.text: The essence of a Viennese coffeehouse is, of course, the coffee.
cues.en: The essence of a Viennese coffeehouse is, of course, the coffee.
cues.zh: 維也納咖啡館的精髓當然是咖啡。

cues.text: But watch out! Here, the espresso, for instance, is called Mokka.
cues.en: But watch out! Here, the espresso, for instance, is called Mokka.
cues.zh: 但要小心！例如，這裡的濃縮咖啡被稱為 Mokka。

cues.text: The Viennese specialties have unique names, as well: the Einspänner is a double espresso with whipped cream.
cues.en: The Viennese specialties have unique names, as well: the Einspänner is a double espresso with whipped cream.
cues.zh: 維也納特色菜也有獨特的名稱：Einspänner 是一種加了鮮奶油的雙份濃縮咖啡。

cues.text: A Viennese Melange is half a cup of coffee with half a cup of steamed cream topped with milk froth.
cues.en: A Viennese Melange is half a cup of coffee with half a cup of steamed cream topped with milk froth.
cues.zh: 維也納混合咖啡是半杯咖啡加半杯蒸奶油，上面撒上奶泡。

cues.text: A Turkish coffee is especially strong, and brewed and served in a Turkish cezve with Turkish honey.
cues.en: A Turkish coffee is especially strong, and brewed and served in a Turkish cezve with Turkish honey.
cues.zh: 土耳其咖啡特別濃，用土耳其蜂蜜沖泡和飲用。

cues.text: In the late 17th century, the Ottoman Turks besieged Vienna for the last time.
cues.en: In the late 17th century, the Ottoman Turks besieged Vienna for the last time.
cues.zh: 17世紀末，奧斯曼土耳其人最後一次圍困維也納。

cues.text: They are thought to have introduced coffee to Austria's capital.
cues.en: They are thought to have introduced coffee to Austria's capital.
cues.zh: 人們認為他們將咖啡引入了奧地利首都。

cues.text: Over the centuries since, a distinctive coffeehouse culture has evolved here.
cues.en: Over the centuries since, a distinctive coffeehouse culture has evolved here.
cues.zh: 幾個世紀以來，這裡逐漸形成了獨特的咖啡館文化。

cues.text: In 2011, UNESCO added it to their list of the world's intangible cultural heritage.
cues.en: In 2011, UNESCO added it to their list of the world's intangible cultural heritage.
cues.zh: 2011年，聯合國教科文組織將其列入世界非物質文化遺產名錄。

cues.text: In addition to the coffee, sweets and pastries are every bit as important.
cues.en: In addition to the coffee, sweets and pastries are every bit as important.
cues.zh: 除了咖啡之外，糖果和糕點也同樣重要。

cues.text: Among the classics are the famous apple strudel Sachertorte cake,
cues.en: Among the classics are the famous apple strudel Sachertorte cake,
cues.zh: 其中經典包括著名的蘋果派薩赫蛋糕，

cues.text: and fine egg-pancakes.
cues.en: and fine egg-pancakes.
cues.zh: 和精美的雞蛋煎餅。

cues.text: These are baked in a pan as thinly as possible and filled with apricot jam for example.
cues.en: These are baked in a pan as thinly as possible and filled with apricot jam for example.
cues.zh: 例如，它們在平底鍋中烤得盡可能薄，並填入杏醬。

cues.text: Then they're rolled up and dusted with powdered sugar.
cues.en: Then they're rolled up and dusted with powdered sugar.
cues.zh: 然後將它們捲起來並撒上糖粉。

cues.text: The waiters – called Herr or Frau Ober – play a key role in any Viennese coffeehouse.
cues.en: The waiters – called Herr or Frau Ober – play a key role in any Viennese coffeehouse.
cues.zh: 服務生——被稱為“Herr”或“Frau Ober”——在任何維也納咖啡館中都扮演著關鍵角色。

cues.text: They are elegantly dressed all in black and white.
cues.en: They are elegantly dressed all in black and white.
cues.zh: 他們穿著優雅的黑白衣服。

cues.text: And what are the tasks they have to master for their job?
cues.en: And what are the tasks they have to master for their job?
cues.zh: 他們的工作必須掌握哪些任務？

cues.text: The café was opened in 1873 by Franz Landtmann.
cues.en: The café was opened in 1873 by Franz Landtmann.
cues.zh: 這家咖啡館由 Franz Landtmann 於 1873 年開設。

cues.text: It's interior is now listed as historically valuable.
cues.en: It's interior is now listed as historically valuable.
cues.zh: 它的內部現在被列為具有歷史價值。

cues.text: An especially precious commodity in a Viennese coffeehouse is time.
cues.en: An especially precious commodity in a Viennese coffeehouse is time.
cues.zh: 在維也納咖啡館裡，一個特別寶貴的商品就是時間。

cues.text: Stylish hospitality and historical ambience: the true soul of Vienna is found in its coffeehouses.
cues.en: Stylish hospitality and historical ambience: the true soul of Vienna is found in its coffeehouses.
cues.zh: 時尚的熱情好客和歷史氛圍：維也納的真正靈魂在於其咖啡館。

cues.text: Unlimited bags.

cues.en: clearly waiting for something specific.
cues.zh: 顯然是在等待特定的東西。

cues.text: Go up to those people and ask where they're headed ...
cues.en: Go up to those people and ask where they're headed ...
cues.zh: 走到那些人身邊，問他們要去哪裡…

cues.text: until you find your people.
cues.en: until you find your people.
cues.zh: 直到找到你的人。

cues.text: And then, every time a ferry arrives, check the company and the ship name written on it
cues.en: And then, every time a ferry arrives, check the company and the ship name written on it
cues.zh: 然後，每次渡輪到達時，檢查上面寫的公司和船名

cues.text: and see if it's yours.
cues.en: and see if it's yours.
cues.zh: 看看是不是你的。

cues.text: This one, for instance, is a Seajets and the ship's name is "Worldchampion jet".
cues.en: This one, for instance, is a Seajets and the ship's name is "Worldchampion jet".
cues.zh: 例如，這艘是 Seajets，該船的名稱是“Worldchampion jet”。

cues.text: Your ship's name will be written on your ticket and there's only one ship with each name.
cues.en: Your ship's name will be written on your ticket and there's only one ship with each name.
cues.zh: 您的船名將寫在您的機票上，並且每個名稱只有一艘船。

cues.text: So, when you see it ... it's yours, guaranteed.
cues.en: So, when you see it ... it's yours, guaranteed.
cues.zh: 所以，當您看到它時...它就是您的，保證。

cues.text: Now, when exactly will your ship arrive ?
cues.en: Now, when exactly will your ship arrive ?
cues.zh: 現在，你的船到底什麼時候到達？

cues.text: Well, usually around 15 minutes before official departure time
cues.en: Well, usually around 15 minutes before official departure time
cues.zh: 嗯，通常是在正式出發時間前 15 分鐘左右

cues.text: since that's the time they need to disembark everyone and then load up again.
cues.en: since that's the time they need to disembark everyone and then load up again.
cues.zh: 因為那是他們需要讓所有人下船然後再次上車的時間。

cues.text: But don't be surprised : small delays of like 10-20 minutes are common
cues.en: But don't be surprised : small delays of like 10-20 minutes are common
cues.zh: 但請不要感到驚訝：10-20 分鐘左右的小延遲很常見

cues.text: and, during peak season, you can sometimes have bigger delays, as well.
cues.en: and, during peak season, you can sometimes have bigger delays, as well.
cues.zh: 而且，在旺季期間，有時也會出現更大的延誤。

cues.text: Alright ! Now, let's talk about the actual boarding.
cues.en: Alright ! Now, let's talk about the actual boarding.
cues.zh: 好吧 ！現在，我們來談談實際登機的情況。

cues.text: How does it go exactly ?
cues.en: How does it go exactly ?
cues.zh: 具體進展如何？

cues.text: A few weeks ago, I asked you on Instagram how you would describe your experience of boarding a Greek ferry.
cues.en: A few weeks ago, I asked you on Instagram how you would describe your experience of boarding a Greek ferry.
cues.zh: 幾週前，我在 Instagram 上問你如何描述登上希臘渡輪的經歷。

cues.text: And the word that came back in nearly every answer was "CHAOS" !
cues.en: And the word that came back in nearly every answer was "CHAOS" !
cues.zh: 幾乎每個答案中出現的單字都是「混亂」！

cues.text: And yes ! It's true ! It is pretty intense !
cues.en: And yes ! It's true ! It is pretty intense !
cues.zh: 是的！這是真的！相當激烈！

cues.text: First, you have everyone disembarking from the ship, together with the cars, which are trying not to run over anyone ...
cues.en: First, you have everyone disembarking from the ship, together with the cars, which are trying not to run over anyone ...
cues.zh: 首先，你讓每個人都從船上下來，還有汽車，盡量不要撞到任何人...

cues.text: And then, the boarding starts.
cues.en: And then, the boarding starts.
cues.zh: 然後，登機開始。

cues.text: There's no real line : everyone is trying to squeeze in.
cues.en: There's no real line : everyone is trying to squeeze in.
cues.zh: 沒有真正的界線：每個人都在努力擠進去。

cues.text: So yeah ! Don't expect something nice and tidy !
cues.en: So yeah ! Don't expect something nice and tidy !
cues.zh: 所以是的！不要期望有漂亮整潔的東西！

cues.text: This is Greece : We do it the chaotic way ...
cues.en: This is Greece : We do it the chaotic way ...
cues.zh: 這就是希臘：我們以混亂的方式做事......

cues.text: Now, regarding your luggage. How does it work ?
cues.en: Now, regarding your luggage. How does it work ?
cues.zh: 現在，關於您的行李。它是如何運作的？

cues.text: Well, you can take all your bags with you upstairs, if you want.
cues.en: Well, you can take all your bags with you upstairs, if you want.
cues.zh: 好吧，如果你願意的話，你可以把所有的行李帶到樓上。

cues.text: But, if you intend on moving around the ship throughout the voyage,
cues.en: But, if you intend on moving around the ship throughout the voyage,
cues.zh: 但是，如果您打算在整個航程中在船上移動，

cues.text: your bags will probably become a bit of a nuisance.
cues.en: your bags will probably become a bit of a nuisance.
cues.zh: 你的包包可能會變得有點麻煩。

cues.text: So, if you want, you can leave your bags.
cues.en: So, if you want, you can leave your bags.
cues.zh: 因此，如果您願意，可以寄放行李。

cues.text: There are always some racks just there, as you enter the ship.
cues.en: There are always some racks just there, as you enter the ship.
cues.zh: 當你進入船時，那裡總是有一些架子。

cues.text: They're free to use.
cues.en: They're free to use.
cues.zh: 它們可以免費使用。

cues.text: Now how safe is it ? Well, pretty safe.
cues.en: Now how safe is it ? Well, pretty safe.
cues.zh: 現在安全嗎？嗯，很安全。

cues.text: I've never heard anyone getting stuff stolen.
cues.en: I've never heard anyone getting stuff stolen.
cues.zh: 我從來沒聽過有人偷東西。

cues.text: But, still, don't leave any valuables in those bags.
cues.en: But, still, don't leave any valuables in those bags.
cues.zh: 但是，仍然不要在這些包包裡留下任何貴重物品。

cues.text: Take a separate backpack with you, upstairs, with all your valuables.
cues.en: Take a separate backpack with you, upstairs, with all your valuables.
cues.zh: 上樓時請攜帶一個單獨的揹包，並裝上所有貴重物品。

cues.text: So, congratulations ! You're now on board the ferry.
cues.en: So, congratulations ! You're now on board the ferry.
cues.zh: 那麼，恭喜你！您現在已經登上渡輪了。

cues.text: What is there to do during the trip ?
cues.en: What is there to do during the trip ?
cues.zh: 旅途中可以做什麼？

cues.text: Well, if you're on a fast ferry ... Not much ...
cues.en: Well, if you're on a fast ferry ... Not much ...
cues.zh: 好吧，如果你搭乘快速渡輪......不多......

cues.text: You just go and sit down and wait for time to pass.
cues.en: You just go and sit down and wait for time to pass.
cues.zh: 你只需去坐下來等待時間過去。

cues.text: The only thing there is, apart from seats, is a little snack bar,
cues.en: The only thing there is, apart from seats, is a little snack bar,
cues.zh: 唯一的除了座位就是一個小小吃店，

cues.text: in case you get hungry or thirsty.
cues.en: in case you get hungry or thirsty.
cues.zh: 以防你餓了或渴了。

cues.text: If you're on a slow ferry, however, then you've got way more options.
cues.en: If you're on a slow ferry, however, then you've got way more options.
cues.zh: 然而，如果您乘坐慢速渡輪，那麼您就有更多選擇。

cues.text: First of all, you'll have to decide whether you want to sit inside or outside.
cues.en: First of all, you'll have to decide whether you want to sit inside or outside.
cues.zh: 首先，您必須決定要坐在室內還是室外。

cues.text: Outside is, of course, more fun.
cues.en: Outside is, of course, more fun.
cues.zh: 當然，外面更有趣。

cues.text: But it can get pretty windy or very hot.
cues.en: But it can get pretty windy or very hot.
cues.zh: 但天氣可能會變得很大風或很熱。

cues.text: And, in that case, you probably want to go sit inside.
cues.en: And, in that case, you probably want to go sit inside.
cues.zh: 而且，在這種情況下，您可能會想坐在裡面。

cues.text: And just for you know : Many ferries turn on the AC way too hard ... And it gets super cold inside !
cues.en: And just for you know : Many ferries turn on the AC way too hard ... And it gets super cold inside !
cues.zh: 而且您知道：許多渡輪將空調開啟得太厲害......而且裡面會變得非常冷！

cues.text: So, little pro tip : Bring a sweater with you ... Even if it's super hot outside, you might need it !
cues.en: So, little pro tip : Bring a sweater with you ... Even if it's super hot outside, you might need it !
cues.zh: 所以，小專業提示：帶一件毛衣......即使外面超級熱，你可能也需要它！

cues.text: Food on board is decent but, you know, nothing crazy and it's a little overpriced.
cues.en: Food on board is decent but, you know, nothing crazy and it's a little overpriced.
cues.zh: 船上的食物很不錯，但是，你知道，沒什麼瘋狂的，而且價格有點高。

cues.text: That's why Greeks usually grab some savory pies, from a bakery,
cues.en: That's why Greeks usually grab some savory pies, from a bakery,
cues.zh: 這就是為什麼希臘人通常會從麵包店買一些美味的餡餅，

cues.text: on their way to the port and eat that on the way.
cues.en: on their way to the port and eat that on the way.
cues.zh: 在去港口的路上，在路上吃掉它。

cues.text: But if you don't want to go through the trouble of doing that, no worries : food onboard is fine.
cues.en: But if you don't want to go through the trouble of doing that, no worries : food onboard is fine.
cues.zh: 但如果您不想經歷這樣做的麻煩，也不必擔心：船上的食物很好。

cues.text: And, of course, the main attraction, on slow ferries, is to go and stand outside, at the back of the ship,
cues.en: And, of course, the main attraction, on slow ferries, is to go and stand outside, at the back of the ship,
cues.zh: 當然，在緩慢的渡輪上，最吸引人的地方就是站在船尾的外面，

cues.text: when docking at other islands, on the way.
cues.en: when docking at other islands, on the way.
cues.zh: 途中停靠其他島嶼時。

cues.text: And get a glimpse at all these cute white washed houses
cues.en: And get a glimpse at all these cute white washed houses
cues.zh: 看看這些可愛的白色房屋

cues.text: on islands like Paros or Naxos, for instance. Beautiful sights.
cues.en: on islands like Paros or Naxos, for instance. Beautiful sights.
cues.zh: 例如，在帕羅斯島或納克索斯島等島嶼上。美麗的景點。

cues.text: Oh ... and one more thing ...
cues.en: Oh ... and one more thing ...
cues.zh: 哦...還有一件事...

cues.text: When you're at sea, it's common to lose reception, both phone and internet.
cues.en: When you're at sea, it's common to lose reception, both phone and internet.
cues.zh: 當您在海上時，電話和網路訊號中斷是很常見的。

cues.text: So, if you have an important email to send, do it before the ship departs.
cues.en: So, if you have an important email to send, do it before the ship departs.
cues.zh: 因此，如果您有一封重要的電子郵件要傳送，請在船出發前傳送。

cues.text: Alright !
cues.en: Alright !
cues.zh: 好吧 ！

cues.text: Now, how do you know when you're about to arrive at your destination ?
cues.en: Now, how do you know when you're about to arrive at your destination ?
cues.zh: 現在，您如何知道何時即將到達目的地？

cues.text: Well, there's going to be an announcement in Greek, first and then in English,
cues.en: Well, there's going to be an announcement in Greek, first and then in English,
cues.zh: 嗯，首先會用希臘文釋出公告，然後用英文發布，

cues.text: 15 minutes before arriving and then 10 minutes and then 5 minutes.
cues.en: 15 minutes before arriving and then 10 minutes and then 5 minutes.
cues.zh: 到達前 15 分鐘，然後 10 分鐘，然後 5 分鐘。

cues.text: So, you'll have plenty of time to see it coming.
cues.en: So, you'll have plenty of time to see it coming.
cues.zh: 因此，您將有足夠的時間見證它的到來。

cues.text: When you hear the second or third announcement,
cues.en: When you hear the second or third announcement,
cues.zh: 當你聽到第二或第三個通知時，

cues.text: that means it's time to go downstairs, to the vehicle level,
cues.en: that means it's time to go downstairs, to the vehicle level,
cues.zh: 這意味著是時候下樓到車輛樓層了

cues.text: take your bags off the racks and, then, wait there for the ramp to go down.
cues.en: take your bags off the racks and, then, wait there for the ramp to go down.
cues.zh: 把你的行李從架子上拿下來，然後在那裡等待坡道下降。

cues.text: If you're specifically going to Santorini by ferry, you have some amazing views 20 to 25 minutes before arriving.
cues.en: If you're specifically going to Santorini by ferry, you have some amazing views 20 to 25 minutes before arriving.
cues.zh: 如果您專門搭乘渡輪前往聖托里尼，您可以在抵達前 20 至 25 分鐘欣賞到令人驚嘆的景色。

cues.text: Because you first pass by Oia, which looks absolutely epic from sea level.
cues.en: Because you first pass by Oia, which looks absolutely epic from sea level.
cues.zh: 因為您首先會經過伊亞，從海平面上看，這裡絕對是史詩般的。

cues.text: And, then, you'll have the Cliffs of Imerovigli, which are also super impressive !
cues.en: And, then, you'll have the Cliffs of Imerovigli, which are also super impressive !
cues.zh: 然後，您將看到伊莫洛維裡懸崖，這也令人印象深刻！

cues.text: So, yeah, if you're going to Santorini, don't rush down as soon as you hear the first announcement.
cues.en: So, yeah, if you're going to Santorini, don't rush down as soon as you hear the first announcement.
cues.zh: 所以，是的，如果您要去聖托里尼島，請不要在聽到第一個訊息後就急著去。

cues.text: Stay up for a few more minutes to take in all of the views !
cues.en: Stay up for a few more minutes to take in all of the views !
cues.zh: 再熬夜幾分鐘，欣賞所有美景！

cues.text: Alright ! Now, super important : There are a few new rules regarding the Acropolis tickets !
cues.en: Alright ! Now, super important : There are a few new rules regarding the Acropolis tickets !
cues.zh: 好吧 ！現在，非常重要：關於雅典衛城門票有一些新規則！

cues.text: So, if you plan on visiting the Acropolis in Athens, definitely check this video out. Super important !
cues.en: So, if you plan on visiting the Acropolis in Athens, definitely check this video out. Super important !
cues.zh: 因此，如果您計劃參觀雅典衛城，請務必觀看此影片。超重要！

cues.text: And for the awesome e-bike tour, around Athens, it's this one.
cues.en: And for the awesome e-bike tour, around Athens, it's this one.
cues.zh: 對於雅典周圍的精彩電動腳踏車之旅來說，就是這個。

cues.text: And there you go ! That's it for today ! Hope you liked it ! See you in the next one ! Bye !
cues.en: And there you go ! That's it for today ! Hope you liked it ! See you in the next one ! Bye !
cues.zh: 就這樣吧！今天就這樣！希望你喜歡它！下一篇見！再見 ！

cues.zh: DELIEUVIN：多虧了一種新的科學研究，我們才真正能夠進入這幅畫的內部。

cues.text: NARRATOR: Can science unlock her secrets?
cues.en: NARRATOR: Can science unlock her secrets?
cues.zh: 旁白：科學能解開她的秘密嗎？

cues.text: MARGARET LIVINGSTONE: She seems like she's alive, because she looks different depending on where you're looking.
cues.en: MARGARET LIVINGSTONE: She seems like she's alive, because she looks different depending on where you're looking.
cues.zh: 瑪格麗特·利文斯通：她看起來就像還活著，因為根據你看的地方，她看起來會有所不同。

cues.text: NARRATOR: And decipher the genius behind her creator?
cues.en: NARRATOR: And decipher the genius behind her creator?
cues.zh: 旁白：解讀她的創造者背後的天才？

cues.text: "Decoding da Vinci," right now, on "NOVA." ♪
cues.en: "Decoding da Vinci," right now, on "NOVA." ♪
cues.zh: “解碼達文西”，現在在“NOVA”節目中。 ♪

cues.text: ♪ NARRATOR: In the heart of Paris lies a former royal castle.
cues.en: ♪ NARRATOR: In the heart of Paris lies a former royal castle.
cues.zh: ♪ 旁白：巴黎市中心坐落著一座前皇家城堡。

cues.text: It is now the world's busiest art museum:
cues.en: It is now the world's busiest art museum:
cues.zh: 它現在是世界上最繁忙的藝術博物館：

cues.text: the Louvre.
cues.en: the Louvre.
cues.zh: 盧浮宮。

cues.text: Filled with glorious galleries of antiquities, mummies, and Michelangelos.
cues.en: Filled with glorious galleries of antiquities, mummies, and Michelangelos.
cues.zh: 充滿了輝煌的古董、木乃伊和米開朗基羅畫廊。

cues.text: ♪ But one masterpiece is the biggest draw of all.
cues.en: ♪ But one masterpiece is the biggest draw of all.
cues.zh: ♪ 但一件傑作才是最吸引人的。

cues.text: Today's reigning queen-- the "Mona Lisa," by Leonardo da Vinci.
cues.en: Today's reigning queen-- the "Mona Lisa," by Leonardo da Vinci.
cues.zh: 今天的女王－列奧納多·達·芬奇的《蒙娜麗莎》。
