cues.zh: LIVINGSTONE：指向真實版本。

cues.text: Can I keep that?
cues.en: Can I keep that?
cues.zh: 我可以保留那個嗎？

cues.text: NARRATOR: Peter got only one of four "Mona Lisas" right,
cues.en: NARRATOR: Peter got only one of four "Mona Lisas" right,
cues.zh: 旁白：彼得只答對了四幅《蒙娜麗莎》中的一幅，

cues.text: and Livingstone says that's not unusual.
cues.en: and Livingstone says that's not unusual.
cues.zh: 利文斯頓說這並不罕見。

cues.text: LIVINGSTONE: Most people don't know how bad peripheral vision is,
cues.en: LIVINGSTONE: Most people don't know how bad peripheral vision is,
cues.zh: 利文斯頓：大多數人不知道周邊視力有多糟糕，

cues.text: because as soon as something happens in their peripheral vision, they look at it,
cues.en: because as soon as something happens in their peripheral vision, they look at it,
cues.zh: 因為一旦他們的余光中發生什麼事情，他們就會看到它，

cues.text: and then they bring the high-resolution part of their visual system onto it.
cues.en: and then they bring the high-resolution part of their visual system onto it.
cues.zh: 然後他們將視覺系統的高解析度部分放到上面。

cues.text: NARRATOR: In fact, our eyes are constantly moving-- three times a second, filling in the details.
cues.en: NARRATOR: In fact, our eyes are constantly moving-- three times a second, filling in the details.
cues.zh: 旁白：事實上，我們的眼睛不斷地移動——每秒三次，填充細節。

cues.text: The effect got Livingstone thinking: could this explain
cues.en: The effect got Livingstone thinking: could this explain
cues.zh: 這一效應引起了利文斯頓的思考：這是否可以解釋

cues.text: why the "Mona Lisa" sometimes seems to be smiling, and sometimes not?
cues.en: why the "Mona Lisa" sometimes seems to be smiling, and sometimes not?
cues.zh: 為什麼《蒙娜麗莎》有時好像在微笑，有時卻沒有？

cues.text: Using a photo app, she blurs the image, like in our peripheral vision.
cues.en: Using a photo app, she blurs the image, like in our peripheral vision.
cues.zh: 她使用照片應用程式模糊影象，就像我們的餘光一樣。

cues.text: LIVINGSTONE: So I filtered the image in such a way that it would look
cues.en: LIVINGSTONE: So I filtered the image in such a way that it would look
cues.zh: LIVINGSTONE：所以我對影像進行了過濾，使其看起來像

cues.text: like what you would see to your peripheral vision, knowing what I know about processing.
cues.en: like what you would see to your peripheral vision, knowing what I know about processing.
cues.zh: 就像你用餘光看到的一樣，瞭解我對處理的瞭解。

cues.text: NARRATOR: The result?
cues.en: NARRATOR: The result?
cues.zh: 旁白：結果呢？

cues.text: LIVINGSTONE: She's grinning from ear to ear.
cues.en: LIVINGSTONE: She's grinning from ear to ear.
cues.zh: 利文斯頓：她笑得合不攏嘴。

cues.text: NARRATOR: As you look at the "Mona Lisa," your eye moves around the painting.
cues.en: NARRATOR: As you look at the "Mona Lisa," your eye moves around the painting.
cues.zh: 旁白：當您觀看《蒙娜麗莎》時，您的眼睛會在畫作周圍移動。

cues.text: When you look away from her mouth, it enters your peripheral vision,
cues.en: When you look away from her mouth, it enters your peripheral vision,
cues.zh: 當你的視線離開她的嘴時，它會進入你的餘光，

cues.text: and Mona Lisa appears to smile.
cues.en: and Mona Lisa appears to smile.
cues.zh: 蒙娜麗莎似乎在微笑。

cues.text: But look directly at the mouth, and the smile vanishes.
cues.en: But look directly at the mouth, and the smile vanishes.
cues.zh: 但直視嘴角，笑容就消失了。

cues.text: LIVINGSTONE: She seems like she's alive, because she looks different depending on where you're looking.
cues.en: LIVINGSTONE: She seems like she's alive, because she looks different depending on where you're looking.
cues.zh: LIVINGSTONE：她看起來就像還活著，因為根據你看的地方，她看起來會有所不同。

cues.text: ISAACSON: Leonardo's paintings come alive because he understands human emotion,
cues.en: ISAACSON: Leonardo's paintings come alive because he understands human emotion,
cues.zh: 艾薩克森：李奧納多的畫作之所以生動，是因為他了解人類的情感，

cues.text: and because he has a good feel for the underlying science.
cues.en: and because he has a good feel for the underlying science.
cues.zh: 而且因為他對基礎科學有很好的感覺。

cues.text: That combination comes together year after year as he's doing the "Mona Lisa"
cues.en: That combination comes together year after year as he's doing the "Mona Lisa"
cues.zh: 當他年復一年地創作《蒙娜麗莎》時，這種組合結合在一起了

cues.text: to make it such an interactive painting.
cues.en: to make it such an interactive painting.
cues.zh: 使其成為一幅互動繪畫。

cues.text: NARRATOR: Back at the Louvre, Cinzia Pasquali has removed
cues.en: NARRATOR: Back at the Louvre, Cinzia Pasquali has removed
cues.zh: 旁白：回到羅浮宮，Cinzia Pasquali 已經移除了

cues.text: the old yellowed varnish from "Bacchus," uncovering the brilliant original colors.
cues.en: the old yellowed varnish from "Bacchus," uncovering the brilliant original colors.
cues.zh: 「巴克斯」的舊泛黃清漆，露出了絢麗的原始色彩。

cues.text: It reveals an atmospheric perspective that suggests Leonardo's touch.
cues.en: It reveals an atmospheric perspective that suggests Leonardo's touch.
cues.zh: 它揭示了一種暗示達文西風格的大氣視角。

cues.text: DELIEUVIN: Taking off these layers of darkened and yellowed varnish,
cues.en: DELIEUVIN: Taking off these layers of darkened and yellowed varnish,
cues.zh: DELIEUVIN：去除這些變暗變黃的清漆層，

cues.text: we were able to rediscover the original forms, the quality of the blue.
cues.en: we were able to rediscover the original forms, the quality of the blue.
cues.zh: 我們能夠重新發現藍色的原始形式和品質。

cues.text: It's a wonderful blue.
cues.en: It's a wonderful blue.
cues.zh: 這是一種美妙的藍色。

cues.text: And see how the painter represent these cities
cues.en: And see how the painter represent these cities
cues.zh: 看看畫家如何表現這些城市

cues.text: with that effect of humidity, of what Leonardo called the atmospheric perspective.
cues.en: with that effect of humidity, of what Leonardo called the atmospheric perspective.
cues.zh: 濕度的影響，也就是李奧納多所說的大氣透視。

cues.text: NARRATOR: But Pasquali's investigation has also uncovered details
cues.en: NARRATOR: But Pasquali's investigation has also uncovered details
cues.zh: 旁白：但是帕斯誇裡的調查也發現了一些細節

cues.text: like the harsh shading in the face, that don't show
cues.en: like the harsh shading in the face, that don't show
cues.zh: 就像臉上不明顯的陰影一樣

cues.text: the characteristic sfumato fingerprint of Leonardo.
cues.en: the characteristic sfumato fingerprint of Leonardo.
cues.zh: 萊昂納多的特徵塗抹指紋。

cues.text: I can't see Leonardo's touch.
cues.en: I can't see Leonardo's touch.
cues.zh: 我看不到李奧納多的觸感。

cues.text: This is a little mechanical.
cues.en: This is a little mechanical.
cues.zh: 這有點機械化。

cues.text: This line for the shadow is so hard, you know.
cues.en: This line for the shadow is so hard, you know.
cues.zh: 你知道，這條陰影線太難了。

cues.text: Leonardo don't do this.
cues.en: Leonardo don't do this.
cues.zh: 萊昂納多不會這樣做。

cues.text: NARRATOR: Pasquali and the team at the Louvre have solved a centuries-old mystery.
cues.en: NARRATOR: Pasquali and the team at the Louvre have solved a centuries-old mystery.
cues.zh: 旁白：帕斯誇裡和羅浮宮的團隊解開了一個數百年之久的謎團。

cues.text: The "Bacchus" cannot be attributed to Leonardo.
cues.en: The "Bacchus" cannot be attributed to Leonardo.
cues.zh: 「酒神」不能歸咎於李奧納多。

cues.text: ♪ But that doesn't mean he wasn't involved.
cues.en: ♪ But that doesn't mean he wasn't involved.
cues.zh: ♪ 但這並不意味著他沒有參與其中。

cues.text: Very often, his apprentices are actually painting the pictures, so he would conceive the general design of the work,
cues.en: Very often, his apprentices are actually painting the pictures, so he would conceive the general design of the work,
cues.zh: 很多時候，他的徒弟其實是在畫畫，所以他會構思作品的整體設計，

cues.text: and then the manual execution would be delegated to members of his workshop.
cues.en: and then the manual execution would be delegated to members of his workshop.
cues.zh: 然後手動執行將被委託給他的工作室的成員。

cues.text: ♪ NARRATOR: The restoration has succeeded in bringing much of the original beauty back to this painting.
cues.en: ♪ NARRATOR: The restoration has succeeded in bringing much of the original beauty back to this painting.
cues.zh: ♪ 旁白：修復工作成功地使這幅畫恢復了大部分原有的美感。

cues.text: But it also raises an intriguing question: should the same thing be done to the "Mona Lisa"?
cues.en: But it also raises an intriguing question: should the same thing be done to the "Mona Lisa"?
cues.zh: 但這也提出了一個耐人尋味的問題：是否應該對《蒙娜麗莎》做同樣的事情？

cues.text: DELIEUVIN: You have to imagine that under that varnish, you could see a wonderful blue sky.
cues.en: DELIEUVIN: You have to imagine that under that varnish, you could see a wonderful blue sky.
cues.zh: DELIEUVIN：你必須想像在清漆下，你可以看到美妙的藍天。

cues.text: Probably also the face or the hand are more pink,
cues.en: Probably also the face or the hand are more pink,
cues.zh: 可能臉或手也更粉紅，

cues.text: like natural skin.
cues.en: like natural skin.
cues.zh: 像天然皮膚一樣。

cues.text: ISAACSON: If we could just take that varnish off,
cues.en: ISAACSON: If we could just take that varnish off,
cues.zh: 艾薩克森：如果我們能把那層清漆去掉的話，

cues.text: we could see it the way Leonardo really did it.
cues.en: we could see it the way Leonardo really did it.
cues.zh: 我們可以按照列奧納多的實際做法來看待它。

cues.text: But I think French governments have fallen for less cause
cues.en: But I think French governments have fallen for less cause
cues.zh: 但我認為法國政府的失敗原因較少

cues.text: than trying to take the "Mona Lisa" out of circulation and clean it.
cues.en: than trying to take the "Mona Lisa" out of circulation and clean it.
cues.zh: 而不是試圖將《蒙娜麗莎》停止流通並對其進行清潔。

cues.text: NARRATOR: Perhaps there is another way.
cues.en: NARRATOR: Perhaps there is another way.
cues.zh: 旁白：也許還有另一種方法。

cues.text: Could she be given a digital makeover?
cues.en: Could she be given a digital makeover?
cues.zh: 可以給她數位化改造嗎？

cues.text: That is what Pascal Cotte is trying to do.
cues.en: That is what Pascal Cotte is trying to do.
cues.zh: 這就是帕斯卡·科特正在努力做的事情。

cues.text: He has analyzed the "Mona Lisa" with a remarkably powerful camera and lights,
cues.en: He has analyzed the "Mona Lisa" with a remarkably powerful camera and lights,
cues.zh: 他用非常強大的相機和燈光分析了《蒙娜麗莎》，

cues.text: which he demonstrates using a replica.
cues.en: which he demonstrates using a replica.
cues.zh: 他用複製品演示了這一點。

cues.text: COTTE: We make the measurements in the basement of the Louvre, inside the laboratory.
cues.en: COTTE: We make the measurements in the basement of the Louvre, inside the laboratory.
cues.zh: 科特：我們在羅浮宮地下室的實驗室內進行測量。

cues.text: It's very emotional, to have the painting in your hands
cues.en: It's very emotional, to have the painting in your hands
cues.zh: 手上拿著這幅畫，心情非常激動

cues.text: without the frame.
cues.en: without the frame.
cues.zh: 沒有框架。

cues.text: You can look at this painting under this very intense light,
cues.en: You can look at this painting under this very intense light,
cues.zh: 你可以在非常強烈的光線下看這幅畫，

cues.text: that reveal everything that you cannot see usually.
cues.en: that reveal everything that you cannot see usually.
cues.zh: 它揭示了你通常看不到的一切。

cues.text: ♪ NARRATOR: Cotte's extremely detailed scan of the "Mona Lisa"
cues.en: ♪ NARRATOR: Cotte's extremely detailed scan of the "Mona Lisa"
cues.zh: ♪ 旁白：科特對《蒙娜麗莎》極為詳細的掃描

cues.text: and his analysis of the optics and chemistry of paint
cues.en: and his analysis of the optics and chemistry of paint
cues.zh: 以及他對油漆的光學和化學的分析

cues.text: reveal how the colors may have changed over time.
cues.en: reveal how the colors may have changed over time.
cues.zh: 揭示顏色如何隨著時間的推移而變化。

cues.text: It's not just the varnish that yellows and darkens,
cues.en: It's not just the varnish that yellows and darkens,
cues.zh: 不只是清漆變黃、變暗，

cues.text: but the pigments and oil in the paint itself.
cues.en: but the pigments and oil in the paint itself.
cues.zh: 而是油漆本身的顏料和油。

cues.text: Cotte's challenge is to reverse-engineer the effects of that aging.
cues.en: Cotte's challenge is to reverse-engineer the effects of that aging.
cues.zh: 科特面臨的挑戰是對老化的影響進行逆向工程。

cues.text: KEMP: This is not just photoshopping it and messing around with the colors,
cues.en: KEMP: This is not just photoshopping it and messing around with the colors,
cues.zh: KEMP：這不僅僅是修圖和亂搞顏色，

cues.text: which you and I could do and get tolerable results,
cues.en: which you and I could do and get tolerable results,
cues.zh: 你和我可以做到並獲得可以接受的結果，

cues.text: but this is based on pigment analysis.
cues.en: but this is based on pigment analysis.
cues.zh: 但這是基於顏料分析。

cues.text: NARRATOR: First, Cotte determines how much the varnish has darkened, and with his computer, peels it away.
cues.en: NARRATOR: First, Cotte determines how much the varnish has darkened, and with his computer, peels it away.
cues.zh: 旁白：首先，科特確定清漆變黑的程度，然後用他的電腦將其剝離。

cues.text: Next, he identifies what the color of each pigment
cues.en: Next, he identifies what the color of each pigment
cues.zh: 接下來，他確定了每種顏料的顏色

cues.text: would have looked like 500 years ago, and recreates them to see the colors just as Leonardo did.
cues.en: would have looked like 500 years ago, and recreates them to see the colors just as Leonardo did.
cues.zh: 看起來就像 500 年前一樣，並重新建立它們以像列奧納多一樣看到顏色。

cues.text: COTTE: For example, we know that Leonardo make the sky with white lead and lapis lazuli.
cues.en: COTTE: For example, we know that Leonardo make the sky with white lead and lapis lazuli.
cues.zh: 科特：例如，我們知道達文西用白鉛和青金石製作了天空。

cues.text: So, we have software that remove the wrong colors
cues.en: So, we have software that remove the wrong colors
cues.zh: 所以，我們有可以刪除錯誤顏色的軟體

cues.text: to obtain the genuine color.
cues.en: to obtain the genuine color.
cues.zh: 以獲得真實的顏色。

cues.text: NARRATOR: Then, pixel by pixel, Cotte restores those colors.
cues.en: NARRATOR: Then, pixel by pixel, Cotte restores those colors.
cues.zh: 旁白：然後，科特逐個畫素地恢復這些顏色。

cues.text: Suddenly, a greenish sky becomes brilliantly blue, and a bit of flush comes back to Lisa's cheeks.
cues.en: Suddenly, a greenish sky becomes brilliantly blue, and a bit of flush comes back to Lisa's cheeks.
cues.zh: 突然，綠色的天空變成了耀眼的藍色，麗莎的臉頰上又出現了一點紅暈。

cues.text: Finally, as the French say: voilà.
cues.en: Finally, as the French say: voilà.
cues.zh: 最後，正如法國人所說：瞧。

cues.text: KEMP: Suddenly, she doesn't look like a submarine goddess.
cues.en: KEMP: Suddenly, she doesn't look like a submarine goddess.
cues.zh: 坎普：突然之間，她看起來不再像潛水艇女神了。

cues.text: She looks as if she's in the fresh air, which is just terrific.
cues.en: She looks as if she's in the fresh air, which is just terrific.
cues.zh: 她看起來就像是在新鮮空氣中，這真是太棒了。

cues.text: NARRATOR: Cotte's restoration has brought Lisa back to life,
cues.en: NARRATOR: Cotte's restoration has brought Lisa back to life,
cues.zh: 旁白：科特的康復讓麗莎復活了，

cues.text: at least digitally-- closer to the state that Leonardo saw her,
cues.en: at least digitally-- closer to the state that Leonardo saw her,
cues.zh: 至少在數字上——更接近萊昂納多看到她的狀態，

cues.text: allowing us all to see the painting's legendary beauty
cues.en: allowing us all to see the painting's legendary beauty
cues.zh: 讓我們大家一窺這幅畫的傳奇美

cues.text: and the science it took: the geometry and optics of perspective;
cues.en: and the science it took: the geometry and optics of perspective;
cues.zh: 以及它所需要的科學：幾何學和透視光學；

cues.text: the anatomy behind her face; and the sfumato soft lines,
cues.en: the anatomy behind her face; and the sfumato soft lines,
cues.zh: 她臉後面的解剖結構；以及暈染柔和的線條，

cues.text: capturing the mystery and movement of life.
cues.en: capturing the mystery and movement of life.
cues.zh: 捕捉生命的奧秘和運動。

cues.text: But even with all the modern insights, the "Mona Lisa" is vastly more
cues.en: But even with all the modern insights, the "Mona Lisa" is vastly more
cues.zh: 但即使有所有現代的見解，《蒙娜麗莎》也遠不止於此。

cues.text: than the sum of her scientific parts.
cues.en: than the sum of her scientific parts.
cues.zh: 比她的科學部分的總和還要多。

cues.text: Pinning down exactly why we are so drawn to her
cues.en: Pinning down exactly why we are so drawn to her
cues.zh: 明確為什麼我們如此被她吸引

cues.text: ultimately remains as elusive as her smile.
cues.en: ultimately remains as elusive as her smile.
cues.zh: 最終仍然像她的微笑一樣難以捉摸。

cues.text: NARRATOR: Three years before his death, Leonardo was invited to France
cues.en: NARRATOR: Three years before his death, Leonardo was invited to France
cues.zh: 旁白：李奧納多過世前三年，他受邀前往法國

cues.text: to live and work for the king.
cues.en: to live and work for the king.
cues.zh: 為國王生活和工作。

cues.text: He crossed the Alps by horse or mule,
cues.en: He crossed the Alps by horse or mule,
cues.zh: 他騎著馬或騾子翻越了阿爾卑斯山，

cues.text: carrying three paintings.
cues.en: carrying three paintings.
cues.zh: 帶著三幅畫。

cues.text: Those paintings, including the "Mona Lisa," now hang at the Louvre,
cues.en: Those paintings, including the "Mona Lisa," now hang at the Louvre,
cues.zh: 這些畫作，包括《蒙娜麗莎》，現在掛在羅浮宮，

cues.text: where the doors are about to open on the 500-year blockbuster Leonardo exhibition--
cues.en: where the doors are about to open on the 500-year blockbuster Leonardo exhibition--
cues.zh: 500 年來轟動一時的列奧納多展覽的大門即將開啟——

cues.text: a celebration of a genius who fused together the worlds of art and science.
cues.en: a celebration of a genius who fused together the worlds of art and science.
cues.zh: 慶祝一位將藝術與科學融合在一起的天才。

cues.text: DELIEUVIN: Leonardo is an Italian Renaissance painter, but his genius is universal, and it speaks to everybody.
cues.en: DELIEUVIN: Leonardo is an Italian Renaissance painter, but his genius is universal, and it speaks to everybody.
cues.zh: DELIEUVIN：李奧納多是一位義大利文藝復興時期的畫家，但他的天才是普遍的，對每個人來說都是如此。

cues.text: ♪ BORGO: Leonardo wanted you to forget that you're looking at pigments on a piece of wood.
cues.en: ♪ BORGO: Leonardo wanted you to forget that you're looking at pigments on a piece of wood.
cues.zh: ♪ 博爾戈：李奧納多希望你忘記你正在看一塊木頭上的顏料。

cues.text: The idea is that you're looking at a real living, breathing being.
cues.en: The idea is that you're looking at a real living, breathing being.
cues.zh: 這個想法是，你看到的是一個真實的、活生生的、會呼吸的生物。

cues.text: ♪ ISAACSON: The key to Leonardo da Vinci
cues.en: ♪ ISAACSON: The key to Leonardo da Vinci
cues.zh: ♪ 艾薩克森：達文西的鑰匙

cues.text: is that he doesn't make a distinction between the beauty of nature that he studies in his science
cues.en: is that he doesn't make a distinction between the beauty of nature that he studies in his science
cues.zh: 是他沒有區分他在科學中研究的自然之美

cues.text: and the beauty of his art.
cues.en: and the beauty of his art.
cues.zh: 和他的藝術之美。

cues.text: ♪ He could have spent more time just being a painter.
cues.en: ♪ He could have spent more time just being a painter.
cues.zh: ♪ 他本來可以花更多時間當畫家。

cues.text: But had he done that, he wouldn't have been Leonardo da Vinci,
cues.en: But had he done that, he wouldn't have been Leonardo da Vinci,
cues.zh: 但如果他這麼做了，他就不是李奧納多·達文西了，

cues.text: and he wouldn't have painted the "Mona Lisa." ♪
cues.en: and he wouldn't have painted the "Mona Lisa." ♪
cues.zh: 他也不會畫《蒙娜麗莎》。 ♪

vy3ea-uoDAw.title: Creating a Mood with Lighting | Inside Pixar: Foundations | Pixar
vy3ea-uoDAw.speaker: Pixar
vy3ea-uoDAw.zh: 【Pixar】用燈光營造氣氛 |皮克斯內部：基本款 |皮克斯（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: WOMAN: In computer graphic scenes, we have to place lights so that you're not only able to see, but also to establish
cues.en: WOMAN: In computer graphic scenes, we have to place lights so that you're not only able to see, but also to establish
cues.zh: 女：在電腦圖形場景中，我們必須放置燈光，以便您不僅能夠看到，還能夠建立

cues.text: the time of day and define mood for the scene,
cues.en: the time of day and define mood for the scene,
cues.zh: 一天中的時間並定義場景的情緒，

cues.text: whether it's scary, or happy, or sad.
cues.en: whether it's scary, or happy, or sad.
cues.zh: 無論是害怕，還是快樂，還是悲傷。

cues.text: NARRATOR: Hold on.
cues.en: NARRATOR: Hold on.
cues.zh: 旁白：等一下。

cues.text: So you're saying that lighting makes a scene looks scary, or happy, or sad?
cues.en: So you're saying that lighting makes a scene looks scary, or happy, or sad?
cues.zh: 所以你是說燈光讓場景看起來可怕、快樂或悲傷？

cues.text: Huh, talk about mood lighting.
cues.en: Huh, talk about mood lighting.
cues.zh: 呵呵，說說氣氛照明吧。

cues.text: Light triggers emotion.
cues.en: Light triggers emotion.
cues.zh: 光觸發情感。

cues.text: Why is this scary?
cues.en: Why is this scary?
cues.zh: 為什麼這很可怕？

cues.text: Why does this look so cold and ominous?
cues.en: Why does this look so cold and ominous?
cues.zh: 為什麼這看起來如此冰冷和不祥？

cues.text: Why does this feel like an interrogation?
cues.en: Why does this feel like an interrogation?
cues.zh: 為什麼這感覺像是在審問？

cues.text: NARRATOR: Hmm, I thought I was the one asking the questions here.
cues.en: NARRATOR: Hmm, I thought I was the one asking the questions here.
cues.zh: 旁白：嗯，我以為我是在這裡問問題的人。

zZJi_78XUVg.title: How Christopher Nolan Writes and Directs a Movie | The Director's Chair
zZJi_78XUVg.speaker: StudioBinder
zZJi_78XUVg.zh: 【StudioBinder】克里斯多福諾蘭如何編劇和導演電影 |導演椅（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: One of the things I love about directing is the multi-faceted nature of the challenge.
cues.en: One of the things I love about directing is the multi-faceted nature of the challenge.
cues.zh: 我喜歡導演的原因之一是挑戰的多面性。

cues.text: The idea of a narrative that's a maze or labyrinth.
cues.en: The idea of a narrative that's a maze or labyrinth.
cues.zh: 迷宮或迷宮的敘事概念。

cues.text: Rather than being above that maze, and watching the characters make mistakes and wrong turns,
cues.en: Rather than being above that maze, and watching the characters make mistakes and wrong turns,
cues.zh: 而不是在迷宮之上，看著角色犯錯誤和走錯彎，

cues.text: you would enter into the maze, kind of looking over their shoulder, and make the wrong turns with them
cues.en: you would enter into the maze, kind of looking over their shoulder, and make the wrong turns with them
cues.zh: 你會進入迷宮，從他們的肩膀後面看，然後和他們一起走錯彎

cues.text: and find a blind alleys with them.
cues.en: and find a blind alleys with them.
cues.zh: 並與他們一起找到死衚衕。

cues.text: There's a feeling of reality.
cues.en: There's a feeling of reality.
cues.zh: 有一種真實的感覺。

cues.text: There's a feeling of being somewhere that matters.
cues.en: There's a feeling of being somewhere that matters.
cues.zh: 有種身處某個重要地方的感覺。

cues.text: I approached the structure from very mathematical and geometrical point of view.
cues.en: I approached the structure from very mathematical and geometrical point of view.
cues.zh: 我從數學和幾何的角度來研究這個結構。

cues.text: A lot of diagrams, lot of careful planning.
cues.en: A lot of diagrams, lot of careful planning.
cues.zh: 很多圖表，很多仔細的計畫。

cues.text: So that was certainly the case with Memento.
cues.en: So that was certainly the case with Memento.
cues.zh: 《記憶碎片》的情況確實如此。

cues.text: First way to draw it is, as I have like that.
cues.en: First way to draw it is, as I have like that.
cues.zh: 第一種繪製方法是，就像我那樣。

cues.text: That's basically the end of the movie.
cues.en: That's basically the end of the movie.
cues.zh: 電影基本上就這樣結束了。

cues.text: This stuff is the black and white stuff.
cues.en: This stuff is the black and white stuff.
cues.zh: 這個東西就是黑白的東西。

cues.text: This is color.
cues.en: This is color.
cues.zh: 這是顏色。

cues.text: And what we do is we cut between the two, the whole way through.
cues.en: And what we do is we cut between the two, the whole way through.
cues.zh: 我們所做的就是在兩者之間進行切入，從始至終。

cues.text: You said we talked before. I don`t remember that.
cues.en: You said we talked before. I don`t remember that.
cues.zh: 你說我們之前談過。我不記得了。

cues.text: So we alternate scene here, scene there, scene there,scene there,
cues.en: So we alternate scene here, scene there, scene there,scene there,
cues.zh: 所以我們交替這裡的場景，那裡的場景，那裡的場景，那裡的場景，

cues.text: and they meet towards the end of the film.
cues.en: and they meet towards the end of the film.
cues.zh: 他們在電影接近尾聲時相遇了。

cues.text: The thing that I started to develop and I've carried on over since that there's most certainly is probably cross-cutting.
cues.en: The thing that I started to develop and I've carried on over since that there's most certainly is probably cross-cutting.
cues.zh: 我開始開發並一直堅持下去的東西很可能是橫切的。

cues.text: I always trying intercut scenes.
cues.en: I always trying intercut scenes.
cues.zh: 我總是嘗試交叉剪輯場景。

cues.text: Based on a concept from music called a shepherd progression or shepard tone.
cues.en: Based on a concept from music called a shepherd progression or shepard tone.
cues.zh: 基於音樂中稱為牧羊人進行或牧羊人音調的概念。

cues.text: It's a series of ascending notes on a scale that by emphasizing in volume different elements of the scale,
cues.en: It's a series of ascending notes on a scale that by emphasizing in volume different elements of the scale,
cues.zh: 它是音階上的一系列上升音符，透過在音量上強調音階的不同元素，

cues.text: it can continuously go up, like a corkscrew effect or a barbershop hole.
cues.en: it can continuously go up, like a corkscrew effect or a barbershop hole.
cues.zh: 它可以不斷上升，就像螺旋效應或理髮店的洞一樣。

cues.text: It's always rising.
cues.en: It's always rising.
cues.zh: 它總是在上漲。

cues.text: As one storyline is peeking, and other one is building, and the third one is just starting out.
cues.en: As one storyline is peeking, and other one is building, and the third one is just starting out.
cues.zh: 一個故事情節正在醞釀之中，另一個故事情節正在構建，而第三個故事情節才剛剛開始。

cues.text: Full speed, Peter.
cues.en: Full speed, Peter.
cues.zh: 全速前進，彼得。

cues.text: Keep coming round.
cues.en: Keep coming round.
cues.zh: 繼續過來。

cues.en: But Shakespearean works are not boring, confusing, long and painful plays written more than 400 years ago.

cues.text: They're adventures relating to the extremities of human nature: love,
cues.en: They're adventures relating to the extremities of human nature: love,

cues.text: hate, jealousy, zealous ambition, fear, mistrust, deception, and murder.
cues.en: hate, jealousy, zealous ambition, fear, mistrust, deception, and murder.

cues.text: He invented over 2,000 words for use in his plays, which still remain in the Oxford English Dictionary.

NarYRNnzswM.title: Making the Colour Purple: The Science of Art | National Gallery
NarYRNnzswM.speaker: The National Gallery
NarYRNnzswM.zh: 【The National Gallery】使顏色變成紫色：藝術科學|國家美術館（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: In painting, the colour purple was traditionally achieved by artists mixing red and blue pigments together.
cues.en: In painting, the colour purple was traditionally achieved by artists mixing red and blue pigments together.
cues.zh: 在繪畫中，紫色傳統上是由藝術家將紅色和藍色顏料混合在一起獲得的。

cues.text: Different mixtures resulted in purples of varying intensities and shades.
cues.en: Different mixtures resulted in purples of varying intensities and shades.
cues.zh: 不同的混合物產生不同強度和色調的紫色。

cues.text: But how can the separate ingredients of a purple be identified?
cues.en: But how can the separate ingredients of a purple be identified?
cues.zh: 但如何辨識紫色的不同成分呢？

cues.text: At the National Gallery Scientific Department a tiny sample of paint, usually taken from
cues.en: At the National Gallery Scientific Department a tiny sample of paint, usually taken from
cues.zh: 在國家美術館科學部，有一個微小的油漆樣本，通常取自

cues.text: the edge or from underneath the frame of a picture, is immersed in resin, dried, and
cues.en: the edge or from underneath the frame of a picture, is immersed in resin, dried, and
cues.zh: 將邊緣或畫框下方浸入樹脂中，乾燥，然後

cues.text: then polished to produce a cross-section.
cues.en: then polished to produce a cross-section.
cues.zh: 然後拋光以產生橫截面。

cues.text: This cross-section can be examined at high magnification under a microscope.
cues.en: This cross-section can be examined at high magnification under a microscope.
cues.zh: 此橫截面可以在顯微鏡下以高放大倍率進行檢查。

cues.text: This sample clearly shows separate blue and red pigment particles. Other methods of examination
cues.en: This sample clearly shows separate blue and red pigment particles. Other methods of examination
cues.zh: 該樣品清楚地顯示了單獨的藍色和紅色顏料顆粒。其他檢查方法

cues.text: tell us even more.
cues.en: tell us even more.
cues.zh: 告訴我們更多。

cues.text: This scanning electron microscope, coupled with an energy dispersive x-ray analyser,
cues.en: This scanning electron microscope, coupled with an energy dispersive x-ray analyser,
cues.zh: 此掃描電子顯微鏡與能量色散 X 射線分析儀結合，

cues.text: can determine the composition of the pigments.
cues.en: can determine the composition of the pigments.
cues.zh: 可以確定顏料的組成。

cues.text: The blue pigment in this purple paint contains copper, identifying it as the mineral azurite.
cues.en: The blue pigment in this purple paint contains copper, identifying it as the mineral azurite.
cues.zh: 這種紫色顏料中的藍色顏料含有銅，將其識別為礦物藍銅礦。

cues.text: The red pigment contains aluminium, which is characteristic of what are known as 'red lake' pigments.
cues.en: The red pigment contains aluminium, which is characteristic of what are known as 'red lake' pigments.
cues.zh: 紅色顏料含有鋁，這是所謂的「紅湖」顏料的特徵。

cues.text: The colour in red lake comes from the dyestuff in insects such as kermes or cochineal, or
cues.en: The colour in red lake comes from the dyestuff in insects such as kermes or cochineal, or
cues.zh: 紅湖的顏色來自昆蟲的染料，如胭脂紅或胭脂紅，或者

cues.text: plants such as madder root.
cues.en: plants such as madder root.
cues.zh: 植物，如茜草根。

cues.text: Analysing a red lake using high performance liquid chromatography
cues.en: Analysing a red lake using high performance liquid chromatography
cues.zh: 使用高效液相層析分析紅湖

cues.text: can identify which of these materials were used.
cues.en: can identify which of these materials were used.
cues.zh: 可以辨識使用了哪些材料。

cues.text: To understand the ways in which a colour could have been obtained, members of the Department use historical recipes to prepare pigments.
cues.en: To understand the ways in which a colour could have been obtained, members of the Department use historical recipes to prepare pigments.
cues.zh: 為了了解獲得顏色的方法，該部門的成員使用歷史配方來製備顏料。

cues.text: This is a 19th century method for obtaining red lake from madder root.
cues.en: This is a 19th century method for obtaining red lake from madder root.
cues.zh: 這是 19 世紀從茜草根中獲取紅湖的方法。

cues.text: Red lake pigments are particularly prone to fading on exposure to light.
cues.en: Red lake pigments are particularly prone to fading on exposure to light.
cues.zh: 紅色色澱顏料在光照下特別容易褪色。

cues.text: In this portrait of a young princess by Jan Gossaert the blue pattern on the sleeves was
cues.en: In this portrait of a young princess by Jan Gossaert the blue pattern on the sleeves was
cues.zh: 在揚·戈薩爾特 (Jan Gossaert) 創作的這幅年輕公主的肖像中，袖子上的藍色圖案是

cues.text: originally purple. The red lake pigment Gossaert mixed with blue azurite has almost entirely
cues.en: originally purple. The red lake pigment Gossaert mixed with blue azurite has almost entirely
cues.zh: 原本是紫色的。紅色色澱顏料戈薩爾與藍色藍銅礦混合幾乎完全

cues.text: faded and the original colour is now only visible at the edge, where the paint has been
cues.en: faded and the original colour is now only visible at the edge, where the paint has been
cues.zh: 褪色，原始顏色現在僅在油漆已塗過的邊緣可見

cues.text: protected from light.
cues.en: protected from light.
cues.zh: 避光。

cues.text: The Scientific Department's contribution to understanding the materials, behaviour and
cues.en: The Scientific Department's contribution to understanding the materials, behaviour and
cues.zh: 科學部門對理解材料、行為和

cues.text: stability of colour helps conservators and curators not only understand how the paintings
cues.en: stability of colour helps conservators and curators not only understand how the paintings
cues.zh: 顏色的穩定性不僅可以幫助管理者和策展人瞭解畫作的性質

cues.text: in the collection have changed over time, but also how best to preserve them for the future.
cues.en: in the collection have changed over time, but also how best to preserve them for the future.
cues.zh: 收藏品隨著時間的推移而發生了變化，而且還討論瞭如何最好地儲存它們以供將來使用。

cues.text: whatever order you like.

N_cg2aNuIRE.title: From the Ocean Floor to Space: Companies Hunt for EV Battery Minerals
N_cg2aNuIRE.speaker: The Wall Street Journal
N_cg2aNuIRE.zh: 【The Wall Street Journal】從海底到太空：公司尋找電動車電池礦物（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: This little rock has come from the bottom of the Pacific Ocean, some 14,000 feet down.
cues.en: This little rock has come from the bottom of the Pacific Ocean, some 14,000 feet down.
cues.zh: 這塊小岩石來自太平洋底部約 14,000 英尺深的地方。

cues.text: Now, it may look like a lump of coal, but it's actually dense with cobalt, nickel, manganese, and copper,
cues.en: Now, it may look like a lump of coal, but it's actually dense with cobalt, nickel, manganese, and copper,
cues.zh: 現在，它可能看起來像一塊煤，但實際上富含鈷、鎳、錳和銅，

cues.text: some of the key minerals in EV batteries.
cues.en: some of the key minerals in EV batteries.
cues.zh: 電動汽車電池中的一些關鍵礦物質。

cues.text: The fact that a company has been to the bottom of the ocean and brought this to the surface
cues.en: The fact that a company has been to the bottom of the ocean and brought this to the surface
cues.zh: 一家公司已經深入海底並將其帶到水面的事實

cues.text: shows just how far we're now willing to go in the hunt for the minerals
cues.en: shows just how far we're now willing to go in the hunt for the minerals
cues.zh: 顯示了我們現在願意在尋找礦物方面走多遠

cues.text: that will power our electric vehicles.
cues.en: that will power our electric vehicles.
cues.zh: 這將為我們的電動車提供動力。

cues.text: See, as demand for electric vehicles increases, the need for their critical minerals
cues.en: See, as demand for electric vehicles increases, the need for their critical minerals
cues.zh: 隨著電動車需求的增加，對其關鍵礦物的需求也隨之增加

cues.text: is set to explode and dramatically outpace supply.
cues.en: is set to explode and dramatically outpace supply.
cues.zh: 即將爆發並大幅超過供應。

cues.text: That's pushed some startups to pioneer new techniques that could fundamentally reshape
cues.en: That's pushed some startups to pioneer new techniques that could fundamentally reshape
cues.zh: 這促使一些新創公司開創了可以從根本上重塑的新技術

cues.text: how we find and extract the minerals for our batteries.
cues.en: how we find and extract the minerals for our batteries.
cues.zh: 我們如何尋找和提取電池所需的礦物質。

cues.text: So, what do the different tiers of EV battery mineral mining look like?
cues.en: So, what do the different tiers of EV battery mineral mining look like?
cues.zh: 那麼，不同等級的電動車電池礦物開採是什麼樣的呢？

cues.text: Let's start with this rock.
cues.en: Let's start with this rock.
cues.zh: 我們先從這塊石頭開始吧。

cues.text: It's a test sample that comes from here, a huge area 1000 miles off the coast of Mexico
cues.en: It's a test sample that comes from here, a huge area 1000 miles off the coast of Mexico
cues.zh: 這是來自這裡的測試樣本，距離墨西哥海岸1000英里的廣闊區域

cues.text: called the Clarion Clipperton Zone.
cues.en: called the Clarion Clipperton Zone.
cues.zh: 稱為克拉里昂克利珀頓區。

cues.text: And down there our rock isn't exactly a rare find.
cues.en: And down there our rock isn't exactly a rare find.
cues.zh: 在那裡我們的岩石並不是什麼罕見的發現。

cues.text: There are thousands of these potato-sized nodules.
cues.en: There are thousands of these potato-sized nodules.
cues.zh: 這些馬鈴薯大小的結節有數千個。

cues.text: Holding another one of them is The Metals Company CEO, Gerard Barron.
cues.en: Holding another one of them is The Metals Company CEO, Gerard Barron.
cues.zh: 另一位持有者是金屬公司執行長 Gerard Barron。

cues.text: We're very fortunate that our nodules actually lay on the ocean floor,
cues.en: We're very fortunate that our nodules actually lay on the ocean floor,
cues.zh: 我們非常幸運，我們的結核實際上位於海底，

cues.text: a little bit like golf balls on a driving range.
cues.en: a little bit like golf balls on a driving range.
cues.zh: 有點像練習場上的高爾夫球。

cues.text: We don't have to go and dig, or drill, or tunnel to find them,
cues.en: We don't have to go and dig, or drill, or tunnel to find them,
cues.zh: 我們不必去挖掘、鑽孔或挖隧道來找到它們，

cues.text: they're literally laying there waiting for us to pick them up.
cues.en: they're literally laying there waiting for us to pick them up.
cues.zh: 他們確實躺在那裡等待我們去接他們。

cues.text: The company's plan is to send down robots like this to collect the nodules
cues.en: The company's plan is to send down robots like this to collect the nodules
cues.zh: 該公司的計劃是派出這樣的機器人來收集結核

cues.text: and bring them up to the surface for processing.
cues.en: and bring them up to the surface for processing.
cues.zh: 並將它們帶到表面進行處理。

cues.text: Now, while companies have wanted to mine these fields for decades,
cues.en: Now, while companies have wanted to mine these fields for decades,
cues.zh: 現在，雖然公司幾十年來一直想開採這些油田，

cues.text: a combination of technological limitations and regulatory hurdles
cues.en: a combination of technological limitations and regulatory hurdles
cues.zh: 技術限制和監管障礙的結合

cues.text: have prevented anyone from exploiting the resource.
cues.en: have prevented anyone from exploiting the resource.
cues.zh: 阻止任何人開採該資源。

cues.text: But, that could all change if and when the UN's International Seabed Authority
cues.en: But, that could all change if and when the UN's International Seabed Authority
cues.zh: 但是，如果聯合國國際海底管理局

cues.text: finalizes its regulations on seabed mining.
cues.en: finalizes its regulations on seabed mining.
cues.zh: 最終確定海底採礦法規。

cues.text: So far the governing body has given out 22 licenses to contractors
cues.en: So far the governing body has given out 22 licenses to contractors
cues.zh: 到目前為止，管理機構已向承包商頒發了 22 張許可證

cues.text: to explore the ocean floor, but not to mine it.
cues.en: to explore the ocean floor, but not to mine it.
cues.zh: 探索海底，但不是採礦。

cues.text: It's a bit of a land grab and I think as we move closer to the final mining code being adopted,
cues.en: It's a bit of a land grab and I think as we move closer to the final mining code being adopted,
cues.zh: 這有點像搶地盤，我認為隨著我們越來越接近最終採用的採礦程式碼，

cues.text: which we expect no later than 2025, countries are awakening to the fact
cues.en: which we expect no later than 2025, countries are awakening to the fact
cues.zh: 我們預計最遲到 2025 年，各國都會意識到這一事實

cues.text: that this is an enormous economic and national security opportunity.
cues.en: that this is an enormous economic and national security opportunity.
cues.zh: 這是一個巨大的經濟和國家安全機會。

cues.text: But, as with most mining, deep-sea mining isn't without its controversy,
cues.en: But, as with most mining, deep-sea mining isn't without its controversy,
cues.zh: 但是，與大多數採礦一樣，深海採礦也並非沒有爭議，

cues.text: especially as thousands of new species have been discovered down there.
cues.en: especially as thousands of new species have been discovered down there.
cues.zh: 尤其是當那裡發現了數以千計的新物種時。

cues.text: Some groups have called for an outright ban of the practice.
cues.en: Some groups have called for an outright ban of the practice.
cues.zh: 一些團體呼籲徹底禁止這種做法。

cues.text: Meanwhile, countries like Canada and companies like BMW and Volvo
cues.en: Meanwhile, countries like Canada and companies like BMW and Volvo
cues.zh: 同時，加拿大等國家以及寶馬和沃爾沃等公司

cues.text: have asked for progress to be paused until protection of the marine habitat
cues.en: have asked for progress to be paused until protection of the marine habitat
cues.zh: 要求暫停進展，直到保護海洋棲息地

cues.text: can be guaranteed.
cues.en: can be guaranteed.
cues.zh: 可以保證。

cues.text: The Metals Company says that its operation will have the lightest impact
cues.en: The Metals Company says that its operation will have the lightest impact
cues.zh: 金屬公司表示其營運受到的影響最小

cues.text: on the marine ecosystem.
cues.en: on the marine ecosystem.
cues.zh: 關於海洋生態系。

cues.text: Some people wanna move forward in a very precautionary manner, as do we,
cues.en: Some people wanna move forward in a very precautionary manner, as do we,
cues.zh: 有些人想以非常謹慎的方式前進，我們也是如此，

cues.text: that's why we've spent now more than 400 million dollars to fully understand those impacts.
cues.en: that's why we've spent now more than 400 million dollars to fully understand those impacts.
cues.zh: 這就是為什麼我們現在花了 4 億多美元來充分了解這些影響。

cues.text: Now, while our ocean floor minerals have been known about for decades,
cues.en: Now, while our ocean floor minerals have been known about for decades,
cues.zh: 現在，雖然我們對海底礦物的瞭解已有數十年之久，

cues.en: finding new deposits to mine can be challenging and time consuming.
cues.zh: 尋找新礦床進行開採可能具有挑戰性且耗時。

cues.text: It usually involves setting off seismic charges or taking core samples and then spending weeks analyzing that data.
cues.en: It usually involves setting off seismic charges or taking core samples and then spending weeks analyzing that data.
cues.zh: 它通常涉及引爆地震炸藥或採集岩心樣本，然後花費數週時間分析這些資料。

cues.text: But, startup Fleet Space says that its satellite network could change that.
cues.en: But, startup Fleet Space says that its satellite network could change that.
cues.zh: 但是，新創公司 Fleet Space 表示，其衛星網路可能會改變這一狀況。

cues.text: We do an ultrasound for Mother Earth.
cues.en: We do an ultrasound for Mother Earth.

cues.text: as has been the case in mining before.
cues.en: as has been the case in mining before.
cues.zh: 就像以前採礦業的情況一樣。

cues.en: The company deploys a grid of ambient noise tomography sensors in the ground

cues.en: that pick up natural micro-vibrations.

cues.text: down to about 2.5 kilometers.
cues.en: down to about 2.5 kilometers.

cues.en: The data from those sensors is then collected in real time by a network of satellites,

cues.en: Fleet Space says that this gives its customers, who includes the likes of mining giant Rio Tinto,

cues.en: to just drill at random until they hit things either.

cues.text: our energy transition.
cues.en: our energy transition.

cues.en: After the 1910 blaze, the US Forest Service primarily focused on stopping fires.

cues.zh: 但今天，我們面臨著這樣的情況：“數千名消防員仍在西部與數十場火災作鬥爭。”

cues.text: "More than 85 thousand acres burned." "The worst wildfire season in state history."

cues.zh: “超過85000英畝的土地被燒毀。” “該州歷史上最嚴重的野火季節。”

cues.text: Scientists are beginning to understand that decades of fire suppression has created dense
cues.en: Scientists are beginning to understand that decades of fire suppression has created dense

cues.text: forests that are ready to ignite in catastrophic ways..

cues.text: One proposed solution dates back hundreds of years:

cues.text: burning parts of our forests, on purpose.
cues.en: burning parts of our forests, on purpose.
cues.zh: 故意燃燒我們的部分森林。

cues.text: "So remember!
cues.en: "So remember!
cues.zh: 「所以記住！

cues.text: the public on the dangers of forest fires.
cues.en: the public on the dangers of forest fires.
cues.zh: 向公眾宣傳森林火災的危險。

cues.text: But even before that famous campaign, the federal government had put thousands of men
cues.en: But even before that famous campaign, the federal government had put thousands of men
cues.zh: 但甚至在那次著名的競選之前，聯邦政府就已經派了數千人

cues.text: to work building fire towers and suppressing burns.
cues.en: to work building fire towers and suppressing burns.
cues.zh: 建造消防塔和抑制燒傷。

cues.en: In 1935, the Forest Service even established the “10 AM policy” - a rule that states
cues.zh: 1935 年，林務局甚至制定了「上午 10 點政策」——該規則規定

cues.text: all fires should be suppressed by 10am the day after they’re reported.
cues.en: all fires should be suppressed by 10am the day after they’re reported.
cues.zh: 所有火災應在收到報告後的第二天上午 10 點之前撲滅。

cues.text: This mentality that “all fire is bad” drove an entire generation’s understanding
cues.en: This mentality that “all fire is bad” drove an entire generation’s understanding
cues.zh: 這種「所有的火都是不好的」的心態推動了整個世代的認識

cues.text: of what fire means to a forest: “A tragedy that happens year after year in our great American forest areas."
cues.en: of what fire means to a forest: “A tragedy that happens year after year in our great American forest areas."
cues.zh: 火災對森林意味著什麼：“在我們偉大的美國森林地區年復一年發生的悲劇。”

cues.text: But by the 1960s, scientists realized that narrative isn’t entirely accurate.
cues.en: But by the 1960s, scientists realized that narrative isn’t entirely accurate.
cues.zh: 但到了 20 世紀 60 年代，科學家意識到這種敘述並不完全準確。

cues.text: KOLDEN: For most of the globe and particularly the forests in the western US, they actually
cues.en: KOLDEN: For most of the globe and particularly the forests in the western US, they actually
cues.zh: KOLDEN：對於全球大部分地區，特別是美國西部的森林來說，它們實際上

cues.text: evolved with fire.

cues.en: Tree rings, soil samples, and charcoal records all show a history of fire - likely started

cues.text: by lightning strikes and other natural phenomena.
cues.en: by lightning strikes and other natural phenomena.
cues.zh: 雷擊和其他自然現象。

cues.text: And that history shows that fire isn’t always a destructive force - but an important part
cues.en: And that history shows that fire isn’t always a destructive force - but an important part
cues.zh: 歷史表明，火併不總是一種破壞性力量，而是一個重要組成部分

cues.text: of forest ecology.
cues.en: of forest ecology.
cues.zh: 森林生態學。

cues.text: KOLDEN: Fire plays a really important role where it is essentially removing a lot of
cues.en: KOLDEN: Fire plays a really important role where it is essentially removing a lot of
cues.zh: KOLDEN：火起著非常重要的作用，它基本上消除了很多

cues.text: the older, less productive material from the landscape and is creating pockets in patches
cues.en: the older, less productive material from the landscape and is creating pockets in patches
cues.zh: 景觀中較古老、生產力較低的材料正在形成斑塊

cues.text: of different ages of vegetation.
cues.en: of different ages of vegetation.
cues.zh: 不同年齡的植被。

cues.text: KOLDEN: That diversity of ages also produces a diversity of species.
cues.en: KOLDEN: That diversity of ages also produces a diversity of species.
cues.zh: KOLDEN：年齡的多樣性也產生了物種的多樣性。

cues.text: In many places, fires work as a “reset button” for the forest.
cues.en: In many places, fires work as a “reset button” for the forest.
cues.zh: 在許多地方，火災就像森林的「重啟按鈕」。

cues.text: It clears out dead brush and older materials and makes space for new growth.
cues.en: It clears out dead brush and older materials and makes space for new growth.
cues.zh: 它清除枯死的灌木叢和舊材料，為新的生長騰出空間。

cues.text: For some species, fire is even vital for reproduction.
cues.en: For some species, fire is even vital for reproduction.
cues.zh: 對某些物種來說，火對於繁殖甚至至關重要。

cues.text: For example, low burning fires dry out sequoia tree cones enough for them to open and drop seeds.
cues.en: For example, low burning fires dry out sequoia tree cones enough for them to open and drop seeds.
cues.zh: 例如，低燃燒的火會使紅杉樹球果乾燥，足以讓它們張開並掉落種子。

cues.text: At the same time, the fire clears the ground to expose fresh, nutrient rich soil which
cues.en: At the same time, the fire clears the ground to expose fresh, nutrient rich soil which
cues.zh: 同時，大火清理了地面，露出了新鮮、營養豐富的土壤，

cues.text: creates ideal conditions for seeds to germinate.
cues.en: creates ideal conditions for seeds to germinate.
cues.zh: 為種子發芽創造理想的條件。

cues.text: But aside from the ecological benefits, fires also help a forest become more resistant to
cues.en: But aside from the ecological benefits, fires also help a forest become more resistant to
cues.zh: 但除了生態效益之外，火災還可以幫助森林增強抵抗力

cues.text: high severity burns later on.
cues.en: high severity burns later on.
cues.zh: 隨後發生嚴重燒傷。

cues.text: Low burning fires clear the forest floor and lower branches from trees.
cues.en: Low burning fires clear the forest floor and lower branches from trees.
cues.zh: 低度燃燒的火焰清除了森林地面和樹枝。

cues.text: Then, if a more intense fire moves through the same area, it’s slowed by a lack of fuel.
cues.en: Then, if a more intense fire moves through the same area, it’s slowed by a lack of fuel.
cues.zh: 然後，如果同一區域發生更強烈的火災，由於缺乏燃料，火勢會減慢。

cues.text: KOLDEN: So when you get those type of patches all over the place, it becomes difficult for fire to move through that landscape again any time soon.
cues.en: KOLDEN: So when you get those type of patches all over the place, it becomes difficult for fire to move through that landscape again any time soon.
cues.zh: 科爾登：因此，當你在整個地方都出現這種型別的斑塊時，火災很快就很難再次穿過該地區。

cues.text: But decades of suppression have led to a build up of dry, dead materials in our forests
cues.en: But decades of suppression have led to a build up of dry, dead materials in our forests
cues.zh: 但數十年的鎮壓導致我們的森林中乾燥、死亡的物質不斷堆積

cues.text: so we’re long past that point of just letting all fires burn.
cues.en: so we’re long past that point of just letting all fires burn.
cues.zh: 所以我們早已超越了讓所有的火焰燃燒的階段。

cues.text: KOLDEN: We've got a forest that has not seen fire, but that it evolved with fire.
cues.en: KOLDEN: We've got a forest that has not seen fire, but that it evolved with fire.
cues.zh: 科爾登：我們有一片森林，雖然沒有經歷過火災，但它是隨著火災而演變的。

cues.text: KOLDEN: And so there's all of this build up in the forest of extra fuel.
cues.en: KOLDEN: And so there's all of this build up in the forest of extra fuel.
cues.zh: 科爾登：所以所有這些都在額外燃料的森林中累積起來。

cues.text: KOLDEN: And it is climate change exacerbating those extreme conditions.
cues.en: KOLDEN: And it is climate change exacerbating those extreme conditions.
cues.zh: 科爾登：氣候變遷加劇了這些極端條件。

cues.text: There’s just no simple reset button for a century of suppression...
cues.en: There’s just no simple reset button for a century of suppression...
cues.zh: 對於一個世紀的鎮壓來說，沒有簡單的重置按鈕...

cues.text: or a changing climate.
cues.en: or a changing climate.
cues.zh: 或氣候變遷。

cues.en: So in order to better adapt to a hotter, drier future, some are turning to a centuries old practice.
cues.zh: 因此，為了更好地適應更炎熱、更乾燥的未來，有些人正在轉向數百年歷史的做法。

cues.text: Indigenous people have long understood the value of fire, and, for millennia before colonization,
cues.en: Indigenous people have long understood the value of fire, and, for millennia before colonization,
cues.zh: 原住民早已瞭解火的價值，並且在殖民化之前的幾千年裡，

cues.text: would burn sections of forest on purpose.
cues.en: would burn sections of forest on purpose.
cues.zh: 會故意燒毀部分森林。

cues.text: AZZUZ: We have a history of our men burning our hunting grounds.
cues.en: AZZUZ: We have a history of our men burning our hunting grounds.
cues.zh: 阿祖茲：我們有我們的人燒毀我們狩獵場的歷史。

cues.text: Women will burn to restore their food gathering sites.
cues.en: Women will burn to restore their food gathering sites.
cues.zh: 婦女們會焚燒食物以恢復她們的食物採集地點。

cues.text: So, you know, burning is just a key tool that we use as indigenous people to keep our environment healthy.
cues.en: So, you know, burning is just a key tool that we use as indigenous people to keep our environment healthy.
cues.zh: 所以，你知道，燃燒只是我們原住民用來維持環境健康的關鍵工具。

cues.text: But colonists began placing strict laws against burning as early as 1850 - criminalizing the
cues.en: But colonists began placing strict laws against burning as early as 1850 - criminalizing the
cues.zh: 但早在 1850 年，殖民者就開始製定嚴格的法律禁止焚燒——將焚燒定為犯罪行為。

cues.text: long-held practice.
cues.en: long-held practice.
cues.zh: 長期堅持的實踐。

cues.en: After the 1910 blaze, legislation against all burning only became more strict.
cues.zh: 1910 年大火之後，禁止焚燒的立法變得更加嚴格。

cues.en: AZZUZ: Indigenous people could be shot for burning.
cues.zh: 阿祖茲：原住民可能因焚燒而被槍殺。

cues.text: And now, we’re looking to them to lead the way.
cues.en: And now, we’re looking to them to lead the way.

cues.en: AZUZZ: Most people think, oh, these guys just go out and burn whenever they want to.
cues.zh: AZUZZ：大多數人認為，哦，這些人只要想就出去燒死。

cues.en: God, I wish it was that easy AZUZZ: We go before the counties to get their permits.

cues.text: AZUZZ: We go before our tribal councils to get their permission and their permits to burn on tribal land.
cues.en: AZUZZ: We go before our tribal councils to get their permission and their permits to burn on tribal land.
cues.zh: AZUZZ：我們向部落委員會尋求許可，並獲得在部落土地上焚燒的許可。

cues.text: AZUZZ: We go before the tribal air quality.
cues.en: AZUZZ: We go before the tribal air quality.
cues.zh: AZUZZ：我們先考慮部落的空氣品質。

cues.text: AZUZZ: We go before the county's air quality.
cues.en: AZUZZ: We go before the county's air quality.
cues.zh: AZUZZ：我們首先考慮的是縣內的空氣品質。

cues.text: AZUZZ: And then I work with NOAA to predict my weather throughout that week while we're burning.
cues.en: AZUZZ: And then I work with NOAA to predict my weather throughout that week while we're burning.
cues.zh: AZUZZ：然後我與 NOAA 合作預測燃燒期間整個一週的天氣。

cues.text: AZUZZ: Once we have ignition, everybody falls in the place they need to be in.
cues.en: AZUZZ: Once we have ignition, everybody falls in the place they need to be in.
cues.zh: AZUZZ：一旦我們點火，每個人都會跌倒在他們需要的地方。

cues.text: AZUZZ: They have their tools ready, they have their radios on, we all know where everybody is at every moment.
cues.en: AZUZZ: They have their tools ready, they have their radios on, we all know where everybody is at every moment.
cues.zh: AZUZZ：他們準備好了工具，開啟了收音機，我們都知道每個人每時每刻都在哪裡。

cues.text: The fire started in these controlled burns moves slowly across the forest floor and clears
cues.en: The fire started in these controlled burns moves slowly across the forest floor and clears

cues.text: out the buildup of dead material.
cues.en: out the buildup of dead material.

cues.text: If the wind shifts, or fire gets too high it’s quickly contained and put out by the

cues.zh: 如果風向改變，或者火勢太高，它會很快被控制並被撲滅。

cues.text: trained crew.
cues.en: trained crew.
cues.zh: 訓練有素的船員。

cues.text: There's not one piece of our day that isn't choreographed.
cues.en: There's not one piece of our day that isn't choreographed.
cues.zh: 我們這一天的每一件事都是經過精心設計的。

cues.text: In 2020 and 2021 lawmakers introduced bills to increase the use of controlled burning nationwide.
cues.en: In 2020 and 2021 lawmakers introduced bills to increase the use of controlled burning nationwide.
cues.zh: 2020 年和 2021 年，立法者提出法案，增加全國控制燃燒的使用。

cues.text: It’s a start, but it’s won't be enough on it’s own.
cues.en: It’s a start, but it’s won't be enough on it’s own.
cues.zh: 這是一個開始，但光靠它還不夠。

cues.zh: 最近的資料顯示，野火規模逐年擴大，破壞性也越來越大。

cues.text: Campaigns like Smokey the Bear weren’t wrong to teach us to be careful with fire.
cues.en: Campaigns like Smokey the Bear weren’t wrong to teach us to be careful with fire.
cues.zh: 像斯莫基熊這樣的活動教導我們小心火災並沒有錯。

cues.text: Today, research shows that human carelessness like loose cigarettes, campfires, and sometimes

cues.en: even arson cause over 85% of disastrous wildfires.

cues.zh: 更受控制的燒傷有助於最大限度地減少這些風險。

cues.text: But we also need to recognize that fire is a natural part of the landscape we’re now

cues.text: living in - and climate change is only going to make it worse.

cues.en: resistant materials in high-risk areas and truly educating the public on fire safety.

cues.text: AZUZZ: I..Yeah, saw Smokey Bear as a child and kind of thought that was going to
cues.en: AZUZZ: I..Yeah, saw Smokey Bear as a child and kind of thought that was going to

cues.en: But here I am as an adult, realizing that Smokey really frightened an entire population

cues.en: of people into realizing, if we do this, something's going to happen to us.

cues.en: AZUZZL: We're going to lose our homes.
cues.zh: AZUZZL：我們將失去家園。

cues.en: AZUZZ: We're going to destroy our environment.
cues.zh: AZUZZ：我們會破壞我們的環境。

cues.en: The issue is that power grids, which carry electricity to homes and businesses weren't designed for wind and solar.
cues.zh: 問題在於，為家庭和企業輸送電力的電網並不是為風能和太陽能而設計的。

cues.text: And even though renewables have become a larger part of the overall power supply,
cues.en: And even though renewables have become a larger part of the overall power supply,
cues.zh: 儘管再生能源已成為整個電力供應的重要組成部分，

cues.text: grid infrastructure hasn't kept up.
cues.en: grid infrastructure hasn't kept up.
cues.zh: 電網基礎設施沒有跟上。

cues.text: It's why some grid experts say renewables contributed to the severity of the blackout across Spain
cues.en: It's why some grid experts say renewables contributed to the severity of the blackout across Spain
cues.zh: 這就是為什麼一些電網專家表示再生能源導致了西班牙全境停電的嚴重性

cues.text: and Portugal in April.
cues.en: and Portugal in April.
cues.zh: 四月和葡萄牙。

cues.text: So we asked a mechanical engineer with over 15 years of experience
cues.en: So we asked a mechanical engineer with over 15 years of experience
cues.zh: 所以我們請教了一位擁有超過15年經驗的機械工程師

cues.text: to explain the hidden risks of renewables and three ways to make the grid more resilient to disruptions.
cues.en: to explain the hidden risks of renewables and three ways to make the grid more resilient to disruptions.
cues.zh: 解釋再生能源的隱藏風險以及使電網更能抵禦幹擾的三種方法。

cues.text: Renewable power, wind and solar specifically, don't provide something we call
cues.en: Renewable power, wind and solar specifically, don't provide something we call
cues.zh: 再生能源，特別是風能和太陽能，不提供我們所說的東西

cues.text: inherent rotational inertia, which is something that has provided stability to the grid
cues.en: inherent rotational inertia, which is something that has provided stability to the grid
cues.zh: 固有的旋轉慣性，為電網提供了穩定性

cues.text: for decades since basically it was first invented.
cues.en: for decades since basically it was first invented.
cues.zh: 自從它被首次發明以來已經有幾十年了。

cues.text: Conventional power plants like coal and natural gas have inertia built into their design.
cues.en: Conventional power plants like coal and natural gas have inertia built into their design.
cues.zh: 煤炭和天然氣等傳統發電廠的設計中存在慣性。

cues.text: This is a 3D printed model of a gas turbine.
cues.en: This is a 3D printed model of a gas turbine.
cues.zh: 這是燃氣渦輪機的 3D 列印模型。

cues.text: So we burn the natural gas here and it creates this large spinning piece
cues.en: So we burn the natural gas here and it creates this large spinning piece
cues.zh: 所以我們在這裡燃燒天然氣，它創造了這個巨大的旋轉部件

cues.text: of rotating machinery.
cues.en: of rotating machinery.
cues.zh: 的旋轉機械。

cues.text: And this thing, this whole deal is connected to a generator that might be sitting over here
cues.en: And this thing, this whole deal is connected to a generator that might be sitting over here
cues.zh: 這件事，整個交易都與可能坐在這裡的發電機有關

cues.text: that produces our electricity.
cues.en: that produces our electricity.
cues.zh: 產生我們的電力。

cues.text: All conventional power plants produce electricity that matches the frequency on the grid,
cues.en: All conventional power plants produce electricity that matches the frequency on the grid,
cues.zh: 所有傳統發電廠產生的電力都與電網頻率相匹配，

cues.text: which is 60 hertz in the US.
cues.en: which is 60 hertz in the US.
cues.zh: 在美國是 60 赫茲。

cues.text: And all the power generators, they all need to be in sync.
cues.en: And all the power generators, they all need to be in sync.
cues.zh: 所有的發電機都需要同步。

cues.text: If a power plant goes down, the inertia provides buffer time for other energy sources to jump in.
cues.en: If a power plant goes down, the inertia provides buffer time for other energy sources to jump in.
cues.zh: 如果發電廠發生故障，慣性就會為其他能源的介入提供緩衝時間。

cues.text: Imagine how if you're riding a bike and you stop pedaling, you continue to move forward.
cues.en: Imagine how if you're riding a bike and you stop pedaling, you continue to move forward.
cues.zh: 想像一下，如果您正在騎腳踏車並且停止踩踏板，您將如何繼續前進。

cues.text: That's inertia.
cues.en: That's inertia.
cues.zh: 這就是慣性。

cues.text: The momentum that you have would help you get up the initial portion of that hill.
cues.en: The momentum that you have would help you get up the initial portion of that hill.
cues.zh: 你所擁有的動力將幫助你爬上那座山的最初部分。

cues.text: The grid can only tolerate a small change in frequency.
cues.en: The grid can only tolerate a small change in frequency.
cues.zh: 電網只能容忍頻率的微小變化。

cues.text: Anything too drastic and power plants will disconnect from the grid to protect themselves from damage.
cues.en: Anything too drastic and power plants will disconnect from the grid to protect themselves from damage.
cues.zh: 任何過於激烈的事情，發電廠都會與電網斷開連線，以保護自己免受損害。

cues.text: Using more renewable energy and fewer conventional power sources
cues.en: Using more renewable energy and fewer conventional power sources
cues.zh: 使用更多的可再生能源和更少的傳統能源

cues.text: means there's less inherent inertia in the network, which can increase the risk
cues.en: means there's less inherent inertia in the network, which can increase the risk
cues.zh: 意味著網路中固有的慣性較小，這會增加風險

cues.text: of widespread blackouts.
cues.en: of widespread blackouts.
cues.zh: 大面積停電。

cues.text: Solar by its nature is not actually rotating.
cues.en: Solar by its nature is not actually rotating.
cues.zh: 太陽本質上並不旋轉。

cues.text: And wind turbines, even though they are spinning, don't rotate at speeds that match the frequency of the grid.
cues.en: And wind turbines, even though they are spinning, don't rotate at speeds that match the frequency of the grid.
cues.zh: 風力渦輪機即使在旋轉，也不會以與電網頻率相符的速度旋轉。

cues.text: So one of the best solutions to address the lack of inherent rotational inertia is
cues.en: So one of the best solutions to address the lack of inherent rotational inertia is
cues.zh: 因此，解決固有轉動慣量缺乏的最佳解決方案之一是

cues.text: to use a grid-forming inverter.
cues.en: to use a grid-forming inverter.
cues.zh: 使用併網逆變器。

cues.text: This technology essentially provides renewable energy with synthetic inertia.
cues.en: This technology essentially provides renewable energy with synthetic inertia.
cues.zh: 該技術本質上是提供具有合成慣性的可再生能源。

cues.text: Most inverters at renewable power plants today are grid-following,
cues.en: Most inverters at renewable power plants today are grid-following,
cues.zh: 當今再生能源發電廠的逆變器大多是跟隨電網的，

cues.text: meaning they rely on the grid's voltage and frequency.
cues.en: meaning they rely on the grid's voltage and frequency.
cues.zh: 這意味著它們依賴電網的電壓和頻率。

cues.text: So if there's an outage, the inverter loses its reference and can't function.
cues.en: So if there's an outage, the inverter loses its reference and can't function.
cues.zh: 因此，如果發生斷電，逆變器就會失去參考並且無法運作。

cues.text: Grid-forming inverters are more advanced.
cues.en: Grid-forming inverters are more advanced.
cues.zh: 併網逆變器更加先進。

cues.text: They can operate independently and support the grid when there's a disruption.
cues.en: They can operate independently and support the grid when there's a disruption.
cues.zh: 它們可以獨立運作並在發生中斷時為電網提供支援。

cues.text: Here's how they work.
cues.en: Here's how they work.
cues.zh: 以下是它們的工作原理。

cues.text: The solar panel produces direct current.
cues.en: The solar panel produces direct current.
cues.zh: 太陽能板產生直流電。

cues.text: You could imagine it as sort of a constant supply of current coming out of the solar panel,
cues.en: You could imagine it as sort of a constant supply of current coming out of the solar panel,
cues.zh: 你可以把它想像成從太陽能板發出的恆定電流，

cues.text: but our grid operates on alternating current, and so we need to take this blue line
cues.en: but our grid operates on alternating current, and so we need to take this blue line
cues.zh: 但我們的電網使用交流電，所以我們需要走這條藍線

cues.text: and we need to turn it into a waveform that's operating at 60 hertz.
cues.en: and we need to turn it into a waveform that's operating at 60 hertz.
cues.zh: 我們需要將其轉換為工作頻率為 60 赫茲的波形。

cues.text: That's what a grid-forming inverter does.
cues.en: That's what a grid-forming inverter does.
cues.zh: 這就是併網逆變器的作用。

cues.text: And because it's adjusting everything electronically, it can react to frequency changes much faster
cues.en: And because it's adjusting everything electronically, it can react to frequency changes much faster
cues.zh: 而且由於它以電子方式調整一切，因此可以更快地對頻率變化做出反應

cues.text: than a conventional generator.
cues.en: than a conventional generator.
cues.zh: 比傳統發電機。

cues.text: It also has an endless supply of synthetic inertia.
cues.en: It also has an endless supply of synthetic inertia.
cues.zh: 它還具有源源不絕的合成慣性。

cues.text: Grid-forming inverters are really, really great at allowing us to, say, build a microgrid.
cues.en: Grid-forming inverters are really, really great at allowing us to, say, build a microgrid.
cues.zh: 電網形成逆變器真的非常非常適合讓我們建造微電網。

cues.text: So imagine a military installation, for instance.
cues.en: So imagine a military installation, for instance.
cues.zh: 例如，想像一下軍事設施。

cues.text: But Todd says they're not as effective when it comes to managing a larger region.
cues.en: But Todd says they're not as effective when it comes to managing a larger region.
cues.zh: 但託德表示，在管理更大的地區時，它們的效率並不高。

cues.text: You could imagine you've got all these different regions of some state that are all connected.
cues.en: You could imagine you've got all these different regions of some state that are all connected.
cues.zh: 您可以想像某個州的所有這些不同區域都是相互連線的。

cues.text: They all now need to be synchronized.
cues.en: They all now need to be synchronized.
cues.zh: 它們現在都需要同步。

cues.text: With rotational inertia, we have decades and decades of understanding
cues.en: With rotational inertia, we have decades and decades of understanding
cues.zh: 對於轉動慣量，我們有數十年的瞭解

cues.text: and history of managing across large regions.
cues.en: and history of managing across large regions.
cues.zh: 以及跨大區域管理的歷史。

cues.text: With an increasing penetration of renewables, we find ourselves in a new world
cues.en: With an increasing penetration of renewables, we find ourselves in a new world
cues.zh: 隨著再生能源的普及，我們發現自己處於一個新世界

cues.text: where we have new challenges to address.
cues.en: where we have new challenges to address.
cues.zh: 我們有新的挑戰需要解決。

cues.text: Grid-forming inverters also require additional measurements like voltage,
cues.en: Grid-forming inverters also require additional measurements like voltage,
cues.zh: 併網逆變器還需要額外的測量，例如電壓、

cues.text: frequency, and temperature, And that can be done by imagining, say, like we put in a whole bunch of instrumentation
cues.en: frequency, and temperature, And that can be done by imagining, say, like we put in a whole bunch of instrumentation
cues.zh: 頻率和溫度，這可以透過想像來完成，比如說，就像我們放入一大堆儀器一樣

cues.text: all over the grid to make sure that we've got awareness on what's happening
cues.en: all over the grid to make sure that we've got awareness on what's happening
cues.zh: 整個網格，以確保我們瞭解正在發生的事情

cues.text: at each location or within these transmission line on the grid.
cues.en: at each location or within these transmission line on the grid.
cues.zh: 在電網上的每個位置或這些輸電線路內。

cues.text: Todd's second solution to renewable energy's lack of inherent inertia
cues.en: Todd's second solution to renewable energy's lack of inherent inertia
cues.zh: 託德針對再生能源缺乏固有慣性的第二個解決方案

cues.text: is something called a synchronous condenser.
cues.en: is something called a synchronous condenser.
cues.zh: 是一種稱為同步冷凝器的東西。

cues.text: I am a mechanical engineer, and so I'm a bit of sucker for rotational machines.
cues.en: I am a mechanical engineer, and so I'm a bit of sucker for rotational machines.
cues.zh: 我是機械工程師，所以我對旋轉機器有點著迷。

cues.text: And a synchronous condenser is just that, a large spinning piece of machinery
cues.en: And a synchronous condenser is just that, a large spinning piece of machinery
cues.zh: 同步凝汽器就是一個大型旋轉機械

cues.text: similar to the gas turbine model you saw earlier.
cues.en: similar to the gas turbine model you saw earlier.
cues.zh: 類似於您之前看到的燃氣渦輪機模型。

cues.text: Instead of actually injecting natural gas into this system,
cues.en: Instead of actually injecting natural gas into this system,
cues.zh: 而非實際將天然氣注入該系統，

cues.text: we actually take electricity from the solar panel and we get this large spinning mass
cues.en: we actually take electricity from the solar panel and we get this large spinning mass
cues.zh: 我們實際上從太陽能電池板獲取電力，我們得到了這個巨大的旋轉質量

cues.text: that provides additional rotational inertia.
cues.en: that provides additional rotational inertia.
cues.zh: 這提供了額外的轉動慣量。

cues.text: He says, ideally this should be paired with a grid-forming inverter to get the best of both worlds.
cues.en: He says, ideally this should be paired with a grid-forming inverter to get the best of both worlds.
cues.zh: 他說，理想情況下，它應該與併網逆變器搭配使用，以獲得兩全其美的效果。

cues.text: There is a trade off that we have to acknowledge: not all that electricity is being sold into the marketplace.
cues.en: There is a trade off that we have to acknowledge: not all that electricity is being sold into the marketplace.
cues.zh: 我們必須承認一個權衡：並非所有電力都出售到市場上。

cues.text: Instead, some of that electricity needs to go into spinning this large piece of steel.
cues.en: Instead, some of that electricity needs to go into spinning this large piece of steel.
cues.zh: 相反，其中一些電力需要用於旋轉這塊大鋼鐵。

cues.text: It's essentially like buying insurance.
cues.en: It's essentially like buying insurance.
cues.zh: 這本質上就像是購買保險。

cues.text: It's a cost that is incurred, but it provides some level of risk adjustment benefit
cues.en: It's a cost that is incurred, but it provides some level of risk adjustment benefit
cues.zh: 這是產生的成本，但它提供了一定程度的風險調整效益

cues.text: to the overall grid so that it ensures that it continues to operate reliably.
cues.en: to the overall grid so that it ensures that it continues to operate reliably.
cues.zh: 到整個電網，以確保其繼續可靠運作。

cues.text: So our third opportunity to improve the resilience of the grid would be to have backup power supply,
cues.en: So our third opportunity to improve the resilience of the grid would be to have backup power supply,
cues.zh: 因此，我們提高電網彈性的第三個機會是擁有備用電源，

cues.text: what we call Battery Energy Storage Systems, or BESS.
cues.en: what we call Battery Energy Storage Systems, or BESS.
cues.zh: 我們稱之為電池儲能係統，或 BESS。

cues.text: So there's a transmission tower that's out here in the distance, and we provide power along these transmission lines
cues.en: So there's a transmission tower that's out here in the distance, and we provide power along these transmission lines
cues.zh: 遠處有一座輸電塔，我們沿著這些輸電線路提供電力

cues.text: and then eventually gets dropped down to this battery energy storage system.
cues.en: and then eventually gets dropped down to this battery energy storage system.
cues.zh: 然後最終下降到這個電池能量儲存系統。

cues.text: It stores power in one location, and it has large set of inverters in another location.
cues.en: It stores power in one location, and it has large set of inverters in another location.
cues.zh: 它在一個位置儲存電力，並在另一個位置擁有大量逆變器。

cues.text: And so the battery, this fills up with energy over time,
cues.en: And so the battery, this fills up with energy over time,
cues.zh: 所以電池隨著時間的推移會充滿能量，

cues.text: and then it gets provided to these inverters, and then those inverters eventually will feed back power
cues.en: and then it gets provided to these inverters, and then those inverters eventually will feed back power
cues.zh: 然後它被提供給這些逆變器，然後這些逆變器最終會回饋電力

cues.text: into the grid when it is needed.
cues.en: into the grid when it is needed.
cues.zh: 需要時將其插入網格。

cues.text: If there's an unexpected outage, batteries can deploy excess energy to stabilize the grid.
cues.en: If there's an unexpected outage, batteries can deploy excess energy to stabilize the grid.
cues.zh: 如果發生意外停電，電池可以釋放多餘的能量來穩定電網。

cues.text: The use of battery energy storage systems has been increasing at a significant rate
cues.en: The use of battery energy storage systems has been increasing at a significant rate
cues.zh: 電池儲能係統的使用正在以顯著的速度成長

cues.text: over the last handful of years, but prior to that, the cost of batteries were very high.
cues.en: over the last handful of years, but prior to that, the cost of batteries were very high.
cues.zh: 過去幾年，但在此之前，電池的成本非常高。

cues.text: Now the cost of batteries have declined so dramatically
cues.en: Now the cost of batteries have declined so dramatically
cues.zh: 現在電池的成本已經大幅下降

cues.text: that this is a solution set that is being brought to bear in significant quantities all across the world.
cues.en: that this is a solution set that is being brought to bear in significant quantities all across the world.
cues.zh: 這是一套正在全世界大量應用的解決方案。

cues.text: As renewable energy becomes more prevalent, Todd says the key to reducing the risk of widespread outages
cues.en: As renewable energy becomes more prevalent, Todd says the key to reducing the risk of widespread outages
cues.zh: 託德表示，隨著再生能源變得越來越普遍，降低大範圍停電風險的關鍵是

cues.text: is to keep building and improving the infrastructure supporting it.
cues.en: is to keep building and improving the infrastructure supporting it.
cues.zh: 一是不斷建設和完善支撐的基礎設施。

cues.text: All energy sources have trade-offs.

cues.zh: 所有能源都需要權衡。

cues.text: There is no silver bullet.

cues.zh: 沒有靈丹妙藥。

cues.text: It's critical for us to keep thinking about how do we design in a way that we best balance
cues.en: It's critical for us to keep thinking about how do we design in a way that we best balance
cues.zh: 對我們來說，不斷思考如何以最佳平衡的方式進行設計至關重要

cues.text: all of these trade-offs.
cues.en: all of these trade-offs.
cues.zh: 所有這些權衡。

o2DDU4g0PRo.speaker: TED

cues.text: Look at these images.
cues.en: Look at these images.
cues.zh: 看看這些影象。

cues.text: Now, tell me which Obama here is real.
cues.en: Now, tell me which Obama here is real.
cues.zh: 現在，告訴我這裡哪個歐巴馬是真的。

cues.text: Barack Obama: To help families refinance their homes, to invest in things like high-tech manufacturing,
cues.en: Barack Obama: To help families refinance their homes, to invest in things like high-tech manufacturing,
cues.zh: 巴拉克·歐巴馬：幫助家庭為房屋再融資、投資高科技製造業等

cues.text: clean energy and the infrastructure that creates good new jobs.
cues.en: clean energy and the infrastructure that creates good new jobs.
cues.zh: 清潔能源和創造良好新就業機會的基礎設施。

cues.text: Supasorn Suwajanakorn: Anyone?
cues.en: Supasorn Suwajanakorn: Anyone?
cues.zh: Supasorn Suwajanakorn：有人嗎？

cues.text: The answer is none of them.
cues.en: The answer is none of them.
cues.zh: 答案是沒有一個。

cues.text: None of these is actually real.
cues.en: None of these is actually real.
cues.zh: 這些都不是真實的。

cues.text: So let me tell you how we got here.
cues.en: So let me tell you how we got here.
cues.zh: 那麼讓我告訴你我們是如何到達這裡的。

cues.text: My inspiration for this work was a project meant to preserve our last chance for learning about the Holocaust
cues.en: My inspiration for this work was a project meant to preserve our last chance for learning about the Holocaust
cues.zh: 我對這項工作的靈感是一個旨在保留我們瞭解大屠殺的最後機會的專案

cues.text: from the survivors.
cues.en: from the survivors.
cues.zh: 來自倖存者。

cues.text: It's called New Dimensions in Testimony, and it allows you to have interactive conversations
cues.en: It's called New Dimensions in Testimony, and it allows you to have interactive conversations
cues.zh: 它被稱為證詞新維度，它允許您進行互動對話

cues.text: with a hologram of a real Holocaust survivor.
cues.en: with a hologram of a real Holocaust survivor.
cues.zh: 帶有真正的大屠殺倖存者的全息圖。

cues.text: Man: How did you survive the Holocaust?
cues.en: Man: How did you survive the Holocaust?
cues.zh: 男：你是怎麼在大屠殺中倖存的？

cues.text: Hologram: How did I survive?
cues.en: Hologram: How did I survive?
cues.zh: 全像圖：我是怎麼活下來的？

cues.text: I survived, I believe, because providence watched over me.
cues.en: I survived, I believe, because providence watched over me.
cues.zh: 我相信，我之所以能活下來，是因為上帝眷顧著我。

cues.text: SS: Turns out these answers were prerecorded in a studio.
cues.en: SS: Turns out these answers were prerecorded in a studio.
cues.zh: SS：原來這些答案是在錄音室預先錄製的。

cues.text: Yet the effect is astounding.
cues.en: Yet the effect is astounding.
cues.zh: 然而效果卻是驚人的。

cues.text: You feel so connected to his story and to him as a person.
cues.en: You feel so connected to his story and to him as a person.
cues.zh: 你會覺得自己與他的故事以及他這個人有著如此密切的連結。

cues.text: I think there's something special about human interaction that makes it much more profound
cues.en: I think there's something special about human interaction that makes it much more profound
cues.zh: 我認為人與人之間的互動有一些特別之處，使其更加深刻

cues.text: and personal than what books or lectures or movies could ever teach us.
cues.en: and personal than what books or lectures or movies could ever teach us.
cues.zh: 比書籍、講座或電影所能教導我們的更個人化。

cues.text: So I saw this and began to wonder, can we create a model like this for anyone?
cues.en: So I saw this and began to wonder, can we create a model like this for anyone?
cues.zh: 所以我看到這一點並開始想知道，我們可以為任何人建立這樣的模型嗎？

cues.text: A model that looks, talks and acts just like them?
cues.en: A model that looks, talks and acts just like them?
cues.zh: 一個外表、說話和行為都像他們的模特兒嗎？

cues.text: So I set out to see if this could be done and eventually came up with a new solution
cues.en: So I set out to see if this could be done and eventually came up with a new solution
cues.zh: 所以我開始看看是否可以做到這一點，並最終提出了一個新的解決方案

cues.text: that can build a model of a person using nothing but these: existing photos and videos of a person.
cues.en: that can build a model of a person using nothing but these: existing photos and videos of a person.
cues.zh: 它可以只使用以下內容來建立一個人的模型：一個人的現有照片和影片。

cues.text: If you can leverage this kind of passive information, just photos and video that are out there,
cues.en: If you can leverage this kind of passive information, just photos and video that are out there,
cues.zh: 如果你可以利用這種被動訊息，例如現有的照片和影片，

cues.text: that's the key to scaling to anyone.
cues.en: that's the key to scaling to anyone.
cues.zh: 這是向任何人擴充套件的關鍵。

cues.text: By the way, here's Richard Feynman, who in addition to being a Nobel Prize winner in physics
cues.en: By the way, here's Richard Feynman, who in addition to being a Nobel Prize winner in physics
cues.zh: 順便說一句，這是理查德·費曼，他不僅是諾貝爾物理學獎得主

cues.text: was also known as a legendary teacher.
cues.en: was also known as a legendary teacher.
cues.zh: 也稱為傳奇老師。

cues.text: Wouldn't it be great if we could bring him back to give his lectures and inspire millions of kids,
cues.en: Wouldn't it be great if we could bring him back to give his lectures and inspire millions of kids,
cues.zh: 如果我們能讓他回來演講並激勵數以百萬計的孩子，那不是很好嗎？

cues.text: perhaps not just in English but in any language?
cues.en: perhaps not just in English but in any language?
cues.zh: 也許不只是英語，而是任何語言？

cues.text: Or if you could ask our grandparents for advice and hear those comforting words
cues.en: Or if you could ask our grandparents for advice and hear those comforting words
cues.zh: 或者如果你可以向我們的祖父母尋求建議並聽到那些安慰的話

cues.text: even if they're no longer with us?
cues.en: even if they're no longer with us?
cues.zh: 即使他們不再和我們在一起？

cues.text: Or maybe using this tool, book authors, alive or not, could read aloud all of their books for anyone interested.
cues.en: Or maybe using this tool, book authors, alive or not, could read aloud all of their books for anyone interested.
cues.zh: 或者，也許使用這個工具，書籍作者，無論是否活著，都可以為任何有興趣的人大聲朗讀他們的所有書籍。

cues.text: The creative possibilities here are endless, and to me, that's very exciting.
cues.en: The creative possibilities here are endless, and to me, that's very exciting.
cues.zh: 這裡的創意可能性是無窮無盡的，對我來說，這非常令人興奮。

cues.text: And here's how it's working so far.
cues.en: And here's how it's working so far.
cues.zh: 到目前為止，它的運作方式如下。

cues.text: First, we introduce a new technique that can reconstruct a high-detailed 3D face model from any image
cues.en: First, we introduce a new technique that can reconstruct a high-detailed 3D face model from any image
cues.zh: 首先，我們介紹一種新技術，可以從任何影像重建高細節的 3D 人臉模型

cues.text: without ever 3D-scanning the person.
cues.en: without ever 3D-scanning the person.
cues.zh: 無需對人進行 3D 掃描。

cues.text: And here's the same output model from different views.
cues.en: And here's the same output model from different views.
cues.zh: 這是不同檢視下的相同輸出模型。

cues.text: This also works on videos, by running the same algorithm on each video frame
cues.en: This also works on videos, by running the same algorithm on each video frame
cues.zh: 這也適用於影片，透過在每個影片幀上執行相同的演演算法

cues.text: and generating a moving 3D model.
cues.en: and generating a moving 3D model.
cues.zh: 並產生移動的 3D 模型。

cues.text: And here's the same output model from different angles.
cues.en: And here's the same output model from different angles.
cues.zh: 這是不同角度的相同輸出模型。

cues.text: It turns out this problem is very challenging, but the key trick is that we are going to analyze
cues.en: It turns out this problem is very challenging, but the key trick is that we are going to analyze
cues.zh: 事實證明這個問題非常具有挑戰性，但關鍵在於我們要分析

cues.text: a large photo collection of the person beforehand.
cues.en: a large photo collection of the person beforehand.
cues.zh: 事先收集該人的大量照片。

cues.en: For George W. Bush, we can just search on Google, and from that, we are able to build an average model,
